Terimler ve işaret kuralı şirket UKC pol.en: The terms and their sign convention follow the company UKC policy.

Dynamic allowances: heel/list, wave resp.en: Dynamic allowances: ship- and voyage-specific margins such as heel or list, wave response, water density and measurement or survey uncertainty.

Safety contour değeri sonuçtan türetilir.en: The safety contour value is derived from the result; if the ENC has no contour of that exact value, ECDIS uses the next deeper contour.

Resmî ENC/permit/update paketi doğrulanı.en: The official ENC, permit and update package is verified and converted into the SENC inside the ECDIS.

Presentation library, seçili display cat.en: The presentation library shows chart objects with standard symbols according to the selected display category and scale.

GNSS, gyro, log ve diğer sensörler own-s.en: GNSS, gyro, log and the other sensors feed own ship's position, heading and speed; the user monitors their source and status.

Safety settings ile route geometry, auto.en: The safety settings work together with the route geometry, the automatic route check and the monitoring alerts.

Bridge team resmî chart data'yı publicat.en: The bridge team cross-checks the official chart data against nautical publications, manual fixes, radar and visual information, and the UKC and passage plan assumptions.

Backup arrangement, update/route data ve.en: The backup arrangement, with its updates, route data and independent power and sensor arrangements, is kept ready to continue the passage if the primary fails.

Record of Equipment, type approval basel.en: Verify the Record of Equipment, the type-approval baseline and the approved backup arrangement, together with the power and sensor sources of the primary and backup.

Berth-to-berth resmî ENC/RNC kapsamı, us.en: At the appraisal stage, check berth-to-berth official ENC/RNC coverage, usage bands and scales, permits, edition and update status, rejected updates and nautical publications.

Static draft, squat, dynamic allowances,.en: Derive the safety depth and safety contour from the static draft, squat, dynamic allowances, tide and the minimum UKC policy, and the XTD and look-ahead settings from the risk on each leg.

Waypoint, turn/wheel-over, speed, cleari.en: Plan the route with waypoints, turns and wheel-over points, speeds, clearing lines and parallel indexes, no-go areas, abort points and contingencies, and reporting points.

Automatic route check'i çalıştır; tüm uy.en: Run the automatic route check; resolve every warning and inspect the route visually leg by leg at the largest appropriate scale.

Master approval/revision control ile act.en: Protect the active route through the Master's approval and revision control; verify that the correct, current route has been transferred to both primary and backup.

Monitoring'de active leg, source/status,.en: During monitoring, keep watching the active leg, sensor source and status, chart scale, XTD, safety and look-ahead alarms and the next turn.

Primary GNSS'i bağımsız fix/second PNT v.en: Cross-check the primary GNSS at planned intervals against independent fixes or a second PNT source and radar and visual information; record any discrepancy and report it to the Master.

Alarmı neden/consequence ile yönet; ackn.en: Deal with each alarm by its cause and consequence; after acknowledging it, record the corrective action and any change of route or settings.

Arıza/position doubt'ta backup prosedürü.en: On a failure or when the position is in doubt, go to the backup procedure, re-establish a safe speed, steering mode and fixing interval, and troubleshoot the primary system only after the navigation is safe.

Position freeze/jump veya impossible COG.en: Position frozen or jumping, or impossible COG/SOG

GNSS loss, jamming/spoofing, network lat.en: GNSS loss, jamming or spoofing, network latency, a wrong source, or dead reckoning mode

Track-control bağımlılığını kes; radar/v.en: Stop relying on track control; go back to radar, visual and independent fixes, check the source, time and status, and call the Master.

Chart ile radar/görsel obje hizasız.en: Chart and radar or visual objects do not line up

Position/heading error, datum/ENC qualit.en: Position or heading error, datum or ENC quality, radar alignment, or a common sensor fault

Overlay'i bağımsız kanıt sayma; position.en: Do not treat the overlay as independent evidence; check position and heading separately, plot a manual fix and widen the safety margins.

Yanlış sıra, expired permit, corrupted m.en: Wrong order, expired permit, corrupted media, or SENC/software incompatibility

Update log ve cell status'u incele; resm.en: Examine the update log and the cell status; load the correct base cell, new edition or update from the official service, and set up an alternative chart or backup for the affected route.

Route check çok sayıda alarm veriyor.en: Route check gives a large number of alarms

Yanlış safety contour/XTD/look-ahead, in.en: Wrong safety contour, XTD or look-ahead, unsuitable route geometry, or custom layers

Alarmı disable etme; UKC/passage assumpt.en: Do not disable the alarm; reassess the UKC and passage assumptions and each leg, and separate real dangers from nuisance alarms.

Route check sıfır alarm veriyor.en: Route check gives no alarms at all

Safety settings/scan extent yanlış, disp.en: Safety settings or scan extent wrong, display or data incomplete, or the route not examined thoroughly

Bunu emniyet kanıtı sayma; appropriate s.en: Do not take this as proof of safety; inspect the route visually leg by leg at an appropriate scale and have it reviewed independently.

Power, workstation, network veya softwar.en: Power, workstation, network or software fault

Onaylı backup'a geç; route/update/source.en: Change over to the approved backup; verify the route, update and source status, set up safe speed, extra fixes and bridge team measures, and then follow the maker's restart procedure.

Primary ve backup aynı anda yanlış.en: Primary and backup wrong at the same time

Common GNSS/gyro/network/power veya aynı.en: Common GNSS, gyro, network or power source, or the same corrupted route or data

Common-mode kaynağı izole et; kâğıt/alte.en: Isolate the common-mode source; go to paper or alternative navigation, manual fixing and the Master's and company's contingency procedure.

Backup tipini varsayma; Cargo/Passenger.en: Do not assume the type of backup; confirm it from the Record of Equipment for the Cargo or Passenger Ship Safety Certificate and the company-approved arrangement.

Generic ECDIS competence ile gemideki ür.en: Treat generic ECDIS competence and familiarisation with the maker and model on board as separate requirements.

ENC, permit ve update'i yalnız resmî/aut.en: Obtain ENCs, permits and updates only through the official or authorised chart service chain; do not present an unofficial overlay as a chart source.

Safety settings'i sabit şablon kopyası d.en: Set the safety settings from a recorded calculation based on the current draft, UKC, tide, squat and the risk on each leg, not by copying a fixed template.

Custom display ile kritik object'i sakla.en: Do not hide critical objects with a custom display; use the standard display and object queries deliberately for planning and monitoring.

MSC.232(82), MSC.530(106) revizyonu, MSC.en: Use MSC.232(82), its revision MSC.530(106), MSC.1/Circ.1503/Rev.2 and IHO S-52/S-66 together with the maker's manual and the SMS.

VHF üzerinden 161.975 ve 162.025 MHz'de.en: It broadcasts data over VHF on 161.975 and 162.025 MHz using the SOTDMA protocol.

GPS, gyro ve log'dan aldığı dinamik veri.en: It broadcasts the dynamic data it receives from the GPS, gyro and log together with the static data.

Class A ve Class B cihazları farklı eriş.en: Class A and Class B units use different access schemes, power and reporting rates; a target that does not appear on AIS may still be there.

Trip öncesi statik veriyi (MMSI, ad, IMO.en: Before the voyage, verify the static data (MMSI, name, IMO number, type, draft).

Voyage data: destination, ETA, navigatio.en: Update the voyage data: destination, ETA and navigational status.

Liman manevrası sırasında durumu 'moored.en: During port manoeuvres, change the status to 'moored' or 'underway' as appropriate.

Anormal hedef veya spoofing şüphesinde r.en: If a target looks abnormal or spoofing is suspected, cross-check it with the radar.

Diğer gemilerden veri alınmıyor.en: No data received from other ships

VHF anten/kablo arızası, alıcı arızası.en: VHF antenna or cable fault, receiver fault

Anteni ve kabloyu kontrol et, BIT testi.en: Check the antenna and the cable; run the BIT test.

Yetkili teknisyenle güncelle..en: Have an authorised technician update it.

AIS'i sadece güvenlik nedeni varsa (kapt.en: Switch AIS off only for a security reason (the Master's decision); the switch-off must be entered in the log.

MMSI ve gemi bilgisi her sefer kontrol e.en: Check the MMSI and ship data on every voyage.

AIS, çatışmadan kaçınmada radar/görsel g.en: For collision avoidance, AIS does not replace radar and visual observation.

Alıcı, en az 4 uydudan zaman sinyali alı.en: The receiver takes time signals from at least 4 satellites and computes the position by trilateration.

DGNSS/SBAS düzeltmesi uygun kapsama ve s.en: With suitable coverage and an acceptable correction age, DGNSS or SBAS corrections can improve accuracy and integrity information; sub-metre accuracy is not guaranteed for every receiver and environment.

GNSS, GPS + GLONASS + Galileo + BeiDou'y.en: GNSS improves reliability by using GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou together.

Anteni gölgesiz açık alana monte et..en: Mount the antenna in an open position with no obstructions.

Cold/warm start süresini üretici manual'.en: Judge the cold or warm start time against the maker's manual; when a fix is obtained, verify the datum, antenna offset, selected source, integrity/RAIM and alarm status.

DGNSS/SBAS düzeltmesi varsa correction a.en: If DGNSS or SBAS corrections are in use, monitor the correction age and integrity status; HDOP on its own is not a fixed 'good/bad' threshold.

Pozisyonu radar/celestial ile periyodik.en: Cross-check the position by radar or celestial observations at regular intervals.

Anteni kontrol et, secondary GPS'e geç,.en: Check the antenna, change over to the secondary GPS, use celestial fixes.

Radar/visual fix ile doğrula, raporla..en: Verify with radar or visual fixes and report it.

Az uydu görüş, kötü geometri.en: Few satellites in view, poor geometry

Bekle, antenin önündeki engelleri kontro.en: Wait, and check for obstructions in front of the antenna.

GPS tek başına primer pozisyon kaynağı o.en: Do not use GPS on its own as the primary position source; always cross-check it.

Anten kabloları periyodik kontrol edilme.en: Check the antenna cables at regular intervals.

Spoofing/jamming şüphesinde derhal alter.en: If spoofing or jamming is suspected, change to an alternative position-fixing method at once.

Deviation: Gemi kaynaklı sapma (derece,.en: Deviation: error caused by the ship's own magnetism (degrees, E or W)

Variation: Coğrafi manyetik sapma (derec.en: Variation: the local magnetic variation (degrees, E or W)

Pusula kerterizi 245°, deviation 3°W, va.en: If the compass bearing is 245°, deviation 3°W and variation 5°E, what is the true bearing?

Gyro pusula, hızla dönen rotorun hareket.en: The gyro compass finds true north through the gyroscopic inertia of a fast-spinning rotor.

Sıvı veya elektrostatik damping ile salı.en: Liquid or electrostatic damping removes the oscillation.

Manyetik pusula, kart üzerindeki mıknatı.en: The magnetic compass shows magnetic north because the magnets on the card align with the earth's magnetic field.

Gyro'yu üreticinin settling ve restart p.en: Start the gyro in good time following the maker's settling and restart procedure; on some modern sensors the time differs from that of a classic rotor gyro.

Latitude ve speed correction'ı manuel ay.en: Enter the latitude and speed corrections if they have to be set manually.

Uygun kerteriz/transit ile compass error.en: Find the compass error from a suitable bearing or transit, and check that it is consistent with the variation and the current deviation card.

Repeater'ları (köprü, dümen, pelorus) gy.en: Keep the repeaters (bridge, steering position, pelorus) in step with the gyro.

Latitude/speed correction hatalı, follow.en: Wrong latitude or speed correction, follow-up fault

Düzeltmeleri kontrol et, servis çağır..en: Check the corrections and call for service.

Sigortayı değiştir, manuel sync yap..en: Renew the fuse and align the repeater manually.

Manyetik pusula sıvısı kabarcıklı.en: Bubble in the magnetic compass liquid

Sıvı tamamla, conta değiştir..en: Top up the liquid and renew the seal.

Manyetik değişim, yeni demir kütlesi.en: Change in the ship's magnetism, new iron mass nearby

Deviation kartını yetkili kişiyle yenide.en: Have a compass adjuster swing the compass and draw up a new deviation card.

Manyetik pusula çevresine demir/manyetik.en: Do not place iron or magnetic material near the magnetic compass.

Gyro alarmı (power failure) sürekli izle.en: Monitor the gyro alarm (power failure) at all times.

Compass adjustment sıklığını bayrak/clas.en: How often the compass is adjusted depends on the flag, class, SMS and the error observed; rather than relying on a fixed yearly interval, verify the current deviation card and the trend of the error.

Acil durumda manyetik pusula primer kayn.en: In an emergency the magnetic compass becomes the primary heading source, so it must always be in working order.

v: Suda ses hızı (yaklaşık 1 500 m/s).en: v: Speed of sound in water (about 1 500 m/s)

Echo sounder sinyali 0.04 saniye sonra g.en: If the echo sounder signal returns after 0.04 seconds, what is the depth of water?

Transducer, su altına ses darbesi (genel.en: The transducer sends a sound pulse into the water (usually 50 or 200 kHz).

Deniz dibinden yansıyan eko alınır; gidi.en: The echo reflected from the seabed is received and the depth is calculated from the round-trip time.

Derinlik = (ses hızı × süre) / 2; ses hı.en: Depth = (speed of sound × time) / 2; the speed of sound in water is taken as ~1500 m/s.

Trip öncesi gain ve range ayarını yap..en: Set the gain and range before the voyage.

Shallow water alarm değerini draft + UKC.en: Set the shallow-water alarm to the draft plus the UKC margin.

Frekans seçimini su derinliği ve dip yap.en: Choose the frequency to suit the depth and the nature of the seabed (shallow: 200 kHz, deep: 50 kHz).

Voyage boyunca derinlik kaydını VDR'a ak.en: Keep the depth record going to the VDR throughout the voyage.

Transducer kirli/arızalı, kablo kopuk.en: Transducer fouled or faulty, cable broken

Transducer'ı kontrol et, kabloyu izole e.en: Check the transducer and insulate the cable.

Hava kabarcığı, balık sürüsü, ikincil ya.en: Air bubbles, a shoal of fish, a second-trace echo

Gain'i ayarla, çapraz kontrol için çift.en: Adjust the gain and use both frequencies to cross-check.

Alarm setini ve hoparlörü kontrol et..en: Check the alarm setting and the speaker.

Sığ su/UKC riski olan etaplarda echo sou.en: On legs with shallow-water or UKC risk, the echo sounder is actively monitored as the passage plan and standing orders require, and the reading is cross-checked against the charted depth, the tide and an independent position.

Transducer havuzlamada sürekli su altınd.en: The transducer must stay submerged at all times; it is dealt with in dry dock.

Derinlik bilgisi tek başına yeterli deği.en: The depth reading alone is not enough; assess it together with the chart and the tide.

6 silindirli, 900 mm çapında, 2 500 mm s.en: Calculate the power of a 6-cylinder engine with a bore of 900 mm and a stroke of 2 500 mm, running at 100 rpm with Pmep = 1 800 kPa.

Her krank turunda bir iş çevrimi (emme+s.en: One working cycle (intake + compression + power + exhaust) is completed in every crankshaft revolution.

Egzoz uniflow scavenging ile silindirin.en: With uniflow scavenging, exhaust leaves through the top of the cylinder and scavenge air enters at the bottom.

Düşük devirli crosshead motor çoğunlukla.en: A slow-speed crosshead engine usually drives the shaft and propeller directly; the actual operating range is followed on the engine layout diagram and the combinator and limit curves.

Crosshead yapısı sayesinde piston kuvvet.en: Thanks to the crosshead, the piston force is passed to the crankshaft without producing a side thrust on the liner.

Start receiver basıncını, pre-lube basın.en: Check the starting-air receiver pressure, the pre-lubrication pressure and every permissive and interlock against the maker's minimum starting limits.

Pre-lub pompasını çalıştırarak yatakları.en: Run the pre-lubrication pump to lubricate the bearings.

Turning gear'ı devre dışı bırak, indicat.en: Disengage the turning gear and blow the engine through with the indicator cocks open.

Kademeli olarak dead slow → slow → half.en: Increase speed in steps: dead slow → slow → half → full ahead.

Stop sonrası turning gear ile soğuma sür.en: After stopping, turn the engine with the turning gear while it cools down.

Start havası ile dönmüyor.en: Engine does not turn on starting air

Hava basıncı düşük, distribütör arızası.en: Low air pressure, starting-air distributor fault

Kompresör ve hava distribütörünü kontrol.en: Check the compressor and the starting-air distributor.

Egzoz sıcaklığı bir silindirde yüksek.en: High exhaust temperature on one cylinder

Yakıt enjektör arızası, supap problemi.en: Fuel injector fault, exhaust valve problem

Enjektörü ve supabı kontrol et/değiştir..en: Check or renew the injector and the valve.

ACİL slow down, oil mist detector ve yat.en: EMERGENCY slow-down; check the oil mist detector and the bearings.

Yağ ve kömür birikimi + yüksek sıcaklık.en: Oil and carbon deposits plus high temperature

Yakıtı kes, scavenge space söndürme sist.en: Cut off the fuel, operate the scavenge space extinguishing system and let it cool.

Yükü düşür, egzoz ve T/C'yi kontrol et..en: Reduce the load and check the exhaust and the turbocharger.

Oil-mist/hot-bearing şüphesinde motoru d.en: If oil mist or a hot bearing is suspected, do not open the crankcase straight after stopping the engine; do not slacken a door without the fire/OMD procedure, the maker's waiting and cooling time, a remote temperature check and a permit.

Tüm enerji kaynakları izole edilip turni.en: Do not work on the engine until every energy source has been isolated and the turning gear engaged.

Yakıt sıcaklık ve viskozitesi spec içind.en: Keep the fuel temperature and viscosity within the specification.

Sülfür içeriğine göre uygun silindir yağ.en: Choose a cylinder oil with a BN suited to the sulphur content of the fuel.

Periyodik bumper, eksantrik ve yatak cle.en: Measure the bumper, camshaft and bearing clearances at regular intervals.

İki krank turunda bir iş çevrimi tamamla.en: One working cycle (intake, compression, power, exhaust) is completed every two crankshaft revolutions.

Trunk piston yapısı; eksantrik mili kran.en: Trunk-piston design; the camshaft turns at half crankshaft speed.

Genellikle 400-1000 rpm arası çalışır; r.en: It usually runs at 400–1000 rpm and drives a reduction gearbox or a generator.

Yağ ve soğutma suyu sıcaklığını çalıştır.en: Check the lubricating oil and cooling water temperatures before starting.

Pre-lub yap, jacket water'ı sirküle etti.en: Pre-lubricate and circulate the jacket water.

Start havası veya elektrik marş ile çalı.en: Start on air or with the electric starter.

Yükü kademeli artır, exhaust temp ve T/C.en: Raise the load in steps and watch the exhaust temperatures and the turbocharger pressure.

Stop sonrası soğutma sirkülasyonunu sürd.en: Keep the cooling water circulating after stopping.

Yakıt yok, hava karışık, rack tutuk.en: No fuel, air in the system, fuel rack sticking

Yakıt sistemini havasız al, rack'i serbe.en: Bleed the air from the fuel system and free the rack.

Piston ring kaçırma, yağ buharı.en: Blow-by past the piston rings, oil vapour

Yükü düşür, ring/yatak kontrolü yap..en: Reduce the load; check the rings and bearings.

Timing ve enjektörü kontrol et..en: Check the timing and the injector.

Filtre değiştir, pompa kontrolü yap..en: Change the filter and check the pump.

Yakıt değişiminde sıcaklık-viskozite eğr.en: During a fuel changeover (HFO/MGO), follow the temperature–viscosity curve.

Karter kapağını alarm/yangın şüphesinden.en: Do not open a crankcase door straight after an alarm or a suspected fire; do not intervene until the maker's waiting and cooling time, a temperature check, ventilation and the permit/LOTO conditions have all been met.

Periyodik valve clearance ayarı kritikti.en: Regular adjustment of the valve clearances is critical.

Aşırı yüklemeden kaçın; turbo aşıntısını.en: Avoid overloading; it speeds up turbocharger wear.

PD: Pervaneye iletilen güç (W).en: PD: Power delivered to the propeller (W)

12 000 kW güç, %65 pervane verimi ve 7.2.en: Calculate the thrust for a power of 12 000 kW, a propeller efficiency of 65% and a speed of advance of 7.2 m/s.

Ana motorun krank şaftı, intermediate ve.en: The main engine crankshaft transmits torque to the propeller through the intermediate shaft and the tail shaft.

Stern tube yatakları (white metal veya s.en: The stern tube bearings (white metal or water-lubricated) support the shaft.

Thrust bearing pervaneden gelen ileri/ge.en: The thrust bearing passes the ahead and astern thrust of the propeller to the hull.

Stern tube seal (Simplex tipi) yağ kaçağ.en: The stern tube seal (Simplex type) prevents oil leakage and the entry of seawater.

Trip öncesi yatak sıcaklıkları, yağ sevi.en: Before the voyage, check the bearing temperatures, the oil level and the seal air pressure.

Stern tube yağ tankı seviyesini ve sıcak.en: Monitor the level and temperature of the stern tube oil tank.

Havuzlamada seal değişimi planla..en: Plan a seal renewal at the next dry-docking.

Yağ akışı yetersiz, white metal aşıntısı.en: Insufficient oil flow, white metal wear

Yağ basıncını kontrol et, gerekirse moto.en: Check the oil pressure and stop the engine if necessary.

Devri düşür, dalgıç ile pervane kontrolü.en: Reduce revolutions, have a diver inspect the propeller and measure the alignment.

Yağ analizi yap, seal bakımı/değişimi pl.en: Have the oil analysed and plan seal maintenance or renewal.

Stern tube yağ tankı head pressure'ı sea.en: Keep the head pressure of the stern tube oil tank above the sea pressure at the ship's draft.

Periyodik shaft alignment ve crank defle.en: Measure shaft alignment and crankshaft deflections at regular intervals.

Tüm yatak alarmları kritik sayılmalı; al.en: Treat every bearing alarm as critical and reduce speed when one sounds.

Sabit yapraklı (FPP) pervane, motor devr.en: A fixed-pitch propeller (FPP) produces thrust through engine revolutions; going astern means reversing the engine.

Kontrol edilebilir pillaki (CPP) pervane.en: With a controllable-pitch propeller (CPP), thrust is controlled by changing the blade angle (pitch) through a hydraulic mechanism.

Kavitasyon, yaprak üzerinde basınç düşüş.en: Cavitation is the collapse of vapour bubbles formed by the pressure drop over the blade; it causes erosion and vibration.

CPP pitch göstergesini kontrol et; hidro.en: Check the CPP pitch indicator and monitor the hydraulic pressure.

Manevra sırasında ani pitch değişiminden.en: Avoid sudden pitch changes while manoeuvring.

Devir/pitch kombinasyonunu yakıt verimli.en: Optimise the combination of revolutions and pitch for fuel efficiency.

Hidrolik basınç düşük, OD kutusu arızası.en: Low hydraulic pressure, OD box fault

Basıncı kontrol et, OD box bakımı yap..en: Check the pressure and service the OD box.

Pervane yaprağı hasarlı, balansı bozulmu.en: Propeller blade damaged, propeller out of balance

Dalış/havuzlama ile incele, gerekirse de.en: Inspect it by diver or in dry dock and renew if necessary.

Yaprak yüzeyini kontrol et, profil resto.en: Check the blade surface and restore the profile.

Pervane civarında dalış öncesi şaft kili.en: Lock the shaft before any diving near the propeller.

CPP hidrolik yağı temiz tutulmalı; anali.en: Keep the CPP hydraulic oil clean and have it analysed at regular intervals.

Sığ sularda squat etkisi nedeniyle kavit.en: In shallow water, watch for cavitation caused by squat.

FN: Dümen normal kuvveti (N).en: FN: Normal force on the rudder (N)

10 m² palet alanı, 12 knot hız ve 35° dü.en: Calculate the rudder force for a blade area of 10 m², a speed of 12 knots and a rudder angle of 35°.

Hidrolik silindir veya rotary vane aktüa.en: A hydraulic ram or a rotary-vane actuator turns the rudder stock through the tiller.

İki bağımsız güç ünitesi (steering gear.en: Two independent steering gear power units provide redundancy.

Otopilot, gyro/heading sensörü ile dümen.en: The autopilot provides PID control between the gyro or heading sensor and the steering gear.

Emergency steering, dümen makinesi daire.en: Emergency steering is carried out by local manual control from the steering gear room.

Trip öncesi (departure öncesi 12 saat iç.en: Test the steering gear within 12 hours before departure (both units, local and remote).

Heading lock veya track modunu deniz koş.en: Choose heading mode or track mode to suit the sea conditions.

Manevra alanlarında her iki pompayı para.en: In manoeuvring areas, run both pumps in parallel.

Periyodik olarak emergency steering tatb.en: Hold emergency steering drills at regular intervals.

Dümen verilen komuta tepki vermiyor.en: Rudder does not respond to the helm order

Hidrolik basınç düşük, follow-up arızası.en: Low hydraulic pressure, follow-up fault, sticking valve

Diğer üniteye geç, emergency steering'e.en: Change over to the other unit, go to emergency steering and check the hydraulic system.

Otopilotu manuele al, sensörü kalibre et.en: Switch from autopilot to hand steering and calibrate the sensor.

Acilen kaçağı durdur, basıncı düşür, con.en: Stop the leak at once, reduce the pressure and renew the seal.

Manuele geç, gyro hatalıysa manyetik pus.en: Change to hand steering; if the gyro is at fault, steer by the magnetic compass.

SOLAS gereği steering gear testleri kayı.en: Steering gear tests must be recorded as SOLAS requires.

Emergency steering haberleşmesi (telefon.en: Test the emergency steering communications (telephone or radio).

Hidrolik yağ seviyesi ve sıcaklığı sürek.en: Monitor the hydraulic oil level and temperature at all times.

Köprüden lokal kontrole geçiş prosedürü.en: Every officer must know the procedure for changing over from bridge control to local control.

720 rpm'de çalışan 8 kutuplu bir jenerat.en: Calculate the frequency produced by an 8-pole generator running at 720 rpm.

Dizel motor, alternatörü tahrik ederek 3.en: The diesel engine drives the alternator to produce 3-phase AC (usually 440 V, 60 Hz).

AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) çıkış.en: The AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) keeps the output voltage constant.

Governor, motor devri kontrolü ile freka.en: The governor keeps the frequency constant by controlling engine speed.

Paralel çalışmada synchroscope veya auto.en: For parallel running, the incoming machine is brought into phase with the busbar using the synchroscope or auto-synchroniser.

Çalıştırmadan önce yağ, su, yakıt seviye.en: Before starting, check the oil, water and fuel levels.

Motoru rölantide ısıt; voltaj ve frekans.en: Warm the engine up at idle; when voltage and frequency reach their rated values, parallel it.

Yük dağılımını eşitle (governor droop ay.en: Balance the load sharing (governor droop setting).

Devre dışı alırken önce yükü diğer jener.en: When taking it off the board, first transfer the load to the other generators, open the breaker and let the engine cool at idle.

Yakıt yok, marş yok, low oil pressure tr.en: No fuel, no start, low oil pressure trip

Yakıt hattını havasız al, akü/marşı kont.en: Bleed the fuel line, check the battery and starter, reset the alarm.

Breaker açıldıysa motoru kontrol et, seb.en: If the breaker has tripped open, check the engine and find the cause.

Manuel governor moda geç, AVR'yi kontrol.en: Change to manual governor mode and check the AVR.

Yükü azalt, fan/filtre kontrolü yap..en: Reduce the load; check the fan and filters.

Emergency generator otomatik devreye gir.en: The emergency generator should start automatically; follow the manual reset and restart procedure.

Senkronizasyonda phase sequence aynı olm.en: When synchronising, the phase sequence must be the same.

Kara şalter (breaker) açma/kapama sırası.en: Open and close the shore-connection breaker in the order the procedure lays down.

Yakıt değişimi ve viskozite kontrolü düz.en: Carry out fuel changeovers and viscosity checks properly and regularly.

Emergency generator testini geminin PMS/.en: Test the emergency generator at the interval set in the ship's PMS/SMS so that both the auto-start sequence and, where it can be done safely, supply under load are proven; running it off load alone is not enough.

Yakıt brulörde yakılarak baca gazıyla su.en: Fuel burnt in the burner heats the water tubes with the flue gas; the water boils and produces steam.

Atık ısı kazanı (composite/economiser),.en: The waste-heat boiler (composite boiler or economiser) produces steam from the main engine exhaust gas.

Buhar tamburu (steam drum), buhar ve suy.en: The steam drum separates the steam from the water.

Safety valve, set basıncın üstünde otoma.en: The safety valve opens automatically above its set pressure and relieves the pressure.

Yakmadan önce burner management system'i.en: Before lighting up, confirm that the burner management system has completed the purge air changes and time; do not bypass the interlock, and do not use a fixed '3 minutes' in place of the maker's sequence.

Brulörü tutuştur, alev güvenlik sensörü.en: Light the burner and monitor the flame with the flame-failure sensor.

Su seviyesini gauge glass ile sürekli ko.en: Keep checking the water level in the gauge glass.

Basıncı yavaş yükselt; set basınçta safe.en: Raise the pressure slowly; test the safety valve at its set pressure at regular intervals.

Brulörü kes, sebebi bul, su tamamla; kur.en: Shut off the burner, find the cause and restore the water level; firing a boiler without water burns it out.

Buhar tüketimi düşük, basınç kontrolü ar.en: Low steam demand, faulty pressure control

Yakıt akışını kıs, safety valve setini k.en: Reduce the fuel flow and check the safety valve setting.

İgnition arızası, yakıt basıncı düşük, a.en: Ignition fault, low fuel pressure, blocked atomiser

Igniter'ı kontrol et, atomizer'ı temizle.en: Check the igniter, clean the atomiser, check the fuel pressure.

Hemen yakıtı kes, izole et, su besleme k.en: Cut off the fuel at once, isolate the boiler, shut the feed water and let it cool.

Su kalitesi (chloride, pH, oxygen) periy.en: Analyse the water quality (chloride, pH, oxygen) at regular intervals.

Safety valve test sertifikası geçerli ol.en: The safety valve test certificate must be valid.

Furnace açılmadan önce tam soğuma ve hav.en: The furnace must be fully cooled and ventilated before it is opened.

Brulör bakımı sırasında yakıt vanaları ç.en: During burner maintenance, close the fuel valves with double isolation.

ri: Gravity disc iç yarıçapı.en: ri: Inner radius of the gravity disc

Dış yarıçapı 150 mm olan separatörde 0.9.en: For a separator with an outer radius of 150 mm, calculate the gravity disc radius for a fuel with a density of 0.960 g/cm³.

Yüksek devirde dönen bowl içinde merkezk.en: In the bowl spinning at high speed, centrifugal force separates oil, water and sludge.

Yoğun olan su ve tortu çevreye, hafif ol.en: The denser water and sludge move outwards; the lighter oil moves towards the centre.

Gravity disc çapı, yakıt-su arayüzü konu.en: The gravity disc diameter sets the position of the oil–water interface and is chosen according to the fuel density.

Otomatik desludging sistemi tortu boşalt.en: The automatic desludging system opens the sludge ports at intervals.

Yakıt ön ısıtmasını yakıt analizi, visko.en: Set the fuel preheating according to the fuel analysis, the viscosity and the separator nomogram.

Pre-water seal yap, sonra yakıtı bowl'a.en: Make the water seal first, then admit fuel to the bowl.

Akış debisini ve sıcaklığı izle..en: Monitor the flow rate and the temperature.

Periyodik desludging zamanını yakıta gör.en: Set the desludging interval to suit the fuel.

Bowl dengesizliği, yatak aşıntısı.en: Bowl out of balance, bearing wear

Hemen durdur, bowl ve yatakları kontrol.en: Stop it at once and check the bowl and the bearings.

Hatalı gravity disc, yüksek debi.en: Wrong gravity disc, flow rate too high

Doğru gravity disc seç, debiyi düşür..en: Fit the correct gravity disc and reduce the flow rate.

Operasyon suyu basıncı düşük, valf arıza.en: Low operating water pressure, valve fault

Operasyon suyunu kontrol et, valfleri te.en: Check the operating water and clean the valves.

Kayış aşıntısı, motor problemi, fren tak.en: Worn belt, motor problem, brake on

Kayış/motor/freni kontrol et..en: Check the belt, the motor and the brake.

Bowl açılmadan önce tam durma onaylanmal.en: Confirm that the bowl has stopped completely (rotation indicator) before opening it.

Bowl montajında işaretler (matchmark) hi.en: When assembling the bowl, line up the matchmarks; otherwise the bowl may burst.

PPE: kulaklık zorunlu; sıcak yakıt ile ç.en: PPE: ear defenders are mandatory; wear gloves when working with hot fuel.

Periyodik bowl açıp temizleme (overhaul).en: Open and clean (overhaul) the bowl at regular intervals.

Pistonlu (reciprocating) kompresör, kran.en: A reciprocating compressor draws in and compresses air with a crank and piston.

İki kademeli sıkıştırma + intercooler il.en: Two-stage compression with an intercooler keeps the temperature down.

Hava deposu (air receiver) start havası.en: The air receiver holds compressed air at about 30 bar for starting.

Otomatik drain ve safety valve ile su ve.en: Water and excess pressure are released through the automatic drain and the safety valve.

Yağ seviyesi, soğutma suyu, drenaj durum.en: Check the oil level, the cooling water and the drains.

Otomatik modda alt basınçta start, üst b.en: In automatic mode it starts at the lower pressure and stops at the upper pressure; in manual mode, watch it.

Çıkış sıcaklığını izle (yüksek sıcaklık.en: Watch the discharge temperature (high temperature = an intercooler or valve problem).

Suction/discharge valve aşıntısı, ring k.en: Worn suction or delivery valves, leaking rings

Valveleri ve ring'leri kontrol et/değişt.en: Check or renew the valves and rings.

Filtre değiştir, pompa kontrol et..en: Change the filter and check the pump.

Acil durdur; ring/yatak inceleme; karter.en: Emergency stop; inspect the rings and bearings; check the crankcase ventilation.

Air receiver safety valve test sertifika.en: The air receiver safety valve test certificate must be current.

Kademe çıkış sıcaklıklarını maker alarm/.en: Monitor the stage discharge temperatures against the maker's alarm and trip values and the normal trend; do not use a universal 140 °C limit.

Bakım sırasında basınç tam olarak tahliy.en: The pressure must be released completely before maintenance.

Yağ kalitesi ve değişim periyodu üretici.en: Oil grade and change interval must follow the maker's recommendation.

Deniz suyu pompası 200 m³/saat debi ve 2.en: A seawater pump delivers 200 m³/h against a head of 25 m. Calculate the motor power required at 70% efficiency.

Santrifüj pompa, impeller dönüşü ile sıv.en: A centrifugal pump gives the liquid kinetic energy through the rotating impeller; the volute turns it into pressure.

Pozitif deplasmanlı pompa (gear, screw,.en: A positive-displacement pump (gear or screw type) delivers a fixed volume every revolution.

Eductor (jet pump), yüksek hızlı sıvının.en: An eductor (jet pump) draws liquid by the vacuum created when a high-velocity driving fluid lowers the pressure.

Pompa kavitasyonu, emiş tarafında basınc.en: Pump cavitation occurs when the pressure on the suction side falls below the vapour pressure.

Çalıştırmadan önce pompayı priming ile d.en: Prime the pump before starting (a centrifugal pump must not run dry).

Suction/discharge valflerini doğru sıray.en: Open the suction and discharge valves in the correct order.

Çıkış basıncını ve akımı izle..en: Monitor the discharge pressure and the motor current.

Stop ederken önce discharge valve, sonra.en: When stopping, close the discharge valve first and then stop the motor (to prevent water hammer).

Hava girişi, foot valve arızası, filtre.en: Air ingress, foot valve fault, blocked strainer

Hava sızıntısını kapat, foot valve/filtr.en: Stop the air leak; check the foot valve and the strainer.

Impeller aşıntısı, ring clearance büyük,.en: Worn impeller, excessive wear-ring clearance, cavitation

Impeller değiştir, suction koşullarını i.en: Renew the impeller and improve the suction conditions.

Alignment kontrolü, yatak değişimi, NPSH.en: Check the alignment, renew the bearings, check the NPSH.

Salmastrayı değiştir, soğutma akışını sa.en: Renew the seal and make sure it is cooled and flushed.

Fire/emergency pump testini PMS/SMS sıkl.en: Test the fire and emergency fire pumps at the interval set in the PMS/SMS so that priming, pressure, flow at a selected hydrant and the independent suction and power source are all proven.

Tank içine kuru pompa salmamak için sevi.en: Watch the tank level so that the pump does not run dry.

Pompa motoru elektriksel izolasyon ve LO.en: Isolate the pump motor electrically and apply LOTO before maintenance.

Yağlı/zehirli sıvı pompalarında salmastr.en: On pumps handling oily or toxic liquids, record any seal leakage.

Vakum evaporatörü, deniz suyunu düşük ba.en: A vacuum evaporator boils seawater at low pressure, at about 50 °C.

Buhar yoğuşturucuda (condenser) deniz su.en: The vapour is cooled by seawater in the condenser and becomes fresh water.

Salinometer, üretilen suyun tuzluluğunu.en: The salinometer monitors the salinity of the water produced; above the limit, the dump valve operates.

Reverse osmosis (RO) sistemleri, yarı ge.en: Reverse osmosis (RO) systems produce fresh water by forcing seawater through a semi-permeable membrane at high pressure.

Vakum pompasını çalıştır, vakum -90 kPa.en: Start the vacuum pump and bring the vacuum to about -90 kPa.

Jacket water'ı buharlaştırıcıya yönlendi.en: Lead the jacket water to the evaporator.

Üretilen suyu ilk dakikalarda dump'a al,.en: Dump the water produced in the first minutes; send it to the tank once the quality is stable.

Vakum yetersiz, evaporatör scaling.en: Insufficient vacuum, scale in the evaporator

Vakum pompasını kontrol et, evaporatörü.en: Check the vacuum pump and clean the evaporator with acid.

Demister kontrol, sensör kalibre, dump d.en: Check the demister, calibrate the sensor, dump the output.

RO membran düşük debi.en: Low flow through the RO membrane

Membranı temizle, gerekirse değiştir..en: Clean the membrane and renew it if necessary.

Liman, nehir ağzı veya kirlenme şüphesin.en: In port, in an estuary or where pollution is suspected, isolate the FWG/RO as the Water Safety Plan and SMS require, and verify the quality of the tank and product water again.

Üretilen su içme amaçlı kullanılacaksa U.en: If the water produced is to be used for drinking, treat it by UV, silver ions or chlorination.

Periyodik mikrobiyolojik analiz yapılmal.en: Carry out microbiological analysis at regular intervals.

Asit temizliğinde uygun PPE (yüz maskesi.en: Wear suitable PPE (face shield, gloves) when cleaning with acid.

Burner, chamber'i type-approved feed-ena.en: The burner brings the chamber up to the type-approved feed-enable temperature; sludge or garbage is not fed until the control system allows it.

Sludge dosing pompası ısıtılmış sludge'ı.en: The sludge dosing pump atomises the heated sludge and sprays it into the combustion chamber.

Hava fanı yanma için yeterli oksijen sağ.en: The air fan supplies enough oxygen for combustion; the air–fuel ratio is controlled.

Baca gazı sıcaklık sensörüyle izlenir; d.en: The flue gas is monitored by a temperature sensor; if the temperature drops, the unit shuts down automatically.

Sludge tankı seviyesini, yakıt tankını v.en: Check the sludge tank level, the fuel tank and the air fan.

Burner ile maker start sequence'ini tama.en: Complete the maker's start sequence with the burner; start feeding sludge or solids only at the chamber temperature that the type approval and the interlock allow.

Chamber/combustion-gas sıcaklığını type-.en: Keep the chamber and combustion-gas temperatures within the type-approved operating band; do not accept over-dosing or visible smoke as normal.

Çalışma sonunda dosingi kes, brulor ile.en: At the end of the run, stop dosing and purge the chamber with the burner on clean fuel.

Garbage Record Book'a tür, hacim, başlan.en: Enter the type, volume and start and finish times in the Garbage Record Book.

Yakıt yok, ignition elektrot kirli, foto.en: No fuel, dirty ignition electrodes, faulty photocell

Yakıt valfini aç, elektrotları temizle,.en: Open the fuel valve, clean the electrodes and check the photocell.

Hava yetersiz, atomizer tıkalı, sludge ç.en: Too little air, blocked atomiser, sludge too viscous

Hava fanı debisi artır, atomizer söküm t.en: Increase the air fan flow, dismantle and clean the atomiser, check the sludge preheating.

Refrakter hasarı, fazla sludge dosingi,.en: Refractory damage, too much sludge being dosed, fuel of low calorific value

Refrakter inspeksiyon, dosing kıs, yakıt.en: Inspect the refractory, reduce the dosing, and do not mix the fuel with dirty sludge.

Switch ve conta değişimi, kilit test..en: Renew the switch and the seal, and test the interlock.

Çalışırken charge door kesinlikle açılma.en: Never open the charging door while the incinerator is running: there is a risk of flashback.

Plastik veya PVC içeren atık dioxin/fura.en: Waste containing plastics or PVC produces dioxins and furans, which harm health and the environment.

Refrakteri termal şoktan korumak için ma.en: Complete the maker's controlled cool-down and purge time to protect the refractory from thermal shock; a fixed 4 hours does not apply to every model.

Stack çıkışı çevresinde personel olmamal.en: Keep people away from the stack outlet; in cold weather the hot gas may not be visible.

Sintine pompası yağlı suyu separatöre be.en: The bilge pump feeds the oily water to the separator; in the first chamber the free oil rises to the top and is drawn off to the collecting tank.

Su, koalesan filtre elemanından geçer; m.en: The water passes through the coalescer element, where micron-sized droplets join together and rise to the surface.

Çıkış suyu OCM'den geçer; numune sürekli.en: The outlet water passes the OCM; the sample is measured continuously and the data are logged.

≥15 ppm okumada 3-yollu solenoid valf ot.en: At a reading of ≥15 ppm, the 3-way solenoid valve automatically returns the discharge to the bilge tank and raises an alarm.

Çalıştırmadan önce sealing water hattını.en: Before starting, open the sealing water line (required on some models).

Pompa başlat, ilk birkaç dakika resirkül.en: Start the pump and prime the OCM in recirculation mode for the first few minutes.

Deşarj koşulları checklist ile doğruland.en: Only after the discharge conditions have been verified with the checklist and the responsible officer has given permission, select overboard following the maker's sequence; monitor the OCM reading, the sample flow and the operation of the automatic stopping device.

ORB Code'a uygun operasyon kodu, start/s.en: The responsible officer records the ORB operation code, start and stop times, position, quantity and method without delay; follow the arrangement for the Master's check and signature.

Bitirince hatları temiz su ile flush et,.en: When finished, flush the lines with clean water and keep the OCM sensor clean.

OCM sensörü kirli, koalesan element doym.en: Dirty OCM sensor, saturated coalescer element

OCM cell temizliği, koalesan element değ.en: Clean the OCM cell and renew the coalescer element.

Sintine kuyusu boş, hava emiyor.en: Bilge well empty, pump drawing air

Suction kontrol, hava al, valfleri kontr.en: Check the suction, vent the air, check the valves.

Sludge tankına transfer et, ORB'a yaz..en: Transfer to the sludge tank and enter it in the ORB.

Lamba/optik bozuk, sıfır kalibrasyon kay.en: Lamp or optics faulty, zero calibration lost

Üretici prosedürüne göre temiz su ile ze.en: Calibrate zero and span with clean water following the maker's procedure.

OCM mührü (seal) PSC inspeksiyonunda kon.en: The OCM seal is checked during PSC inspections; it must not be broken.

Bypass hattı veya sahte OCM bağlantısı k.en: Never fit a bypass line or a false OCM connection; the penalties include heavy fines and imprisonment.

Numune hattı sürekli akışlı olmalı; tıka.en: The sample line must flow continuously; a blockage does not raise an alarm but gives a false low reading.

Slop tankı transferi shore reception fac.en: When the slop tank contents are delivered to a shore reception facility, the receipt is attached to the ORB.

Aerobik tankta blower hava verir; aktif.en: In the aeration tank the blower supplies air; the bacteria in the activated sludge break the organic matter down into CO₂ and H₂O.

Settling tankında çamur çöker; dipte bir.en: In the settling tank the sludge settles out, and the sludge collecting at the bottom is returned to the aeration tank.

Üst sıvı kontak tankında klor (kalsiyum.en: The clear liquid is disinfected with chlorine (calcium hypochlorite tablets or electrolysis) in the contact tank.

Discharge pompası işlenmiş su tankından.en: The discharge pump delivers the treated water from its tank overboard; a level switch controls it automatically.

Biyolojik proseste blower duty/standby v.en: In the biological process, keep the duty and standby blowers and their operating cycle as the maker's manual requires; after a long loss of air, check the health of the biomass and recover the plant under control.

Dezenfeksiyon tipine göre dozaj/elektrol.en: Depending on the type of disinfection, check the dosing or electrolysis, the residual and the consumables against the maker's manual and the discharge standard.

Discharge pompasını ancak Annex IV, spec.en: Start the discharge pump only after the conditions of Annex IV, any special-area or port rule and the ship's sewage management plan have been verified.

Haftalık olarak çamur seviyesini ölç; ge.en: Measure the sludge level weekly; if necessary, transfer surplus sludge to the sludge tank.

Blower yetersiz, aşırı yükleme, deterjan.en: Blower inadequate, plant overloaded, too much detergent

Hava debisini artır, mutfak greywater'ı.en: Increase the air flow, divert the galley grey water and add a bacterial culture.

Klor tabletini doldur, settling'i temizl.en: Refill the chlorine tablets, clean the settling tank and seed the system again.

Level switch arızalı, impeller tıkalı (p.en: Faulty level switch, impeller blocked (wipes, etc.)

Switch test, pompa söküm temizlik..en: Test the switch; dismantle and clean the pump.

Filtre değiştir, kayış gerginlik kontrol.en: Change the filter and check the belt tension.

STP girişine wet wipe, peçete, bez atılm.en: Do not put wet wipes, paper towels or rags into the STP; they block the pumps and nozzles.

Klor/dezenfektan ile çalışırken SDS'de b.en: When handling chlorine or disinfectant, use the chemical PPE, ventilation and emergency arrangements given in the SDS; mixing it wrongly with acid can release toxic gas.

Sistem 24+ saat durduğunda bakteri kültü.en: If the system is stopped for 24 hours or more, the bacterial culture may die and the plant may need seeding when restarted.

Holding tank kapasitesi POB, üretim debi.en: Holding tank capacity is calculated from the persons on board, the rate of production, route and port restrictions and the reception plan; the high-level alarm and the remaining holding time are checked at each watch handover.

U = 3000 W/m²·K, A = 8 m², ΔTlm = 15 K o.en: Find the heat transfer capacity of an L.O. cooler with U = 3000 W/m²·K, A = 8 m² and ΔTlm = 15 K.

Sıcak akışkan (yağ, ceket suyu, hava) bi.en: The hot fluid (oil, jacket water, air) flows on one side and the cooling fluid (seawater or LT fresh water) on the other, in opposite directions (counter-flow).

İnce ayırıcı yüzey (plaka/boru) üzerinde.en: Heat passes by conduction from the hot side to the cold side through a thin dividing wall (plate or tube).

Termostatik/üç-yollu valf çıkış sıcaklığ.en: A thermostatic three-way valve senses the outlet temperature and adjusts the flow of coolant.

Central sistemde SW yalnızca central coo.en: In a central cooling system, seawater cools only the central cooler; the internal circuit runs on clean fresh water.

Devreye almadan önce hava kilidini gider.en: Before putting it into service, vent any air lock; start the SW and FW pumps.

Giriş/çıkış sıcaklık ve basınç farkını (.en: Note the inlet and outlet temperatures and the pressure difference (ΔP); a rising ΔP is a sign of fouling.

Termostatik valfin set sıcaklığını (ör..en: Check the set temperature of the thermostatic valve (e.g. jacket water ~80–85 °C).

Deniz suyu strainer'ını düzenli temizle;.en: Clean the seawater strainer regularly; if the SW flow falls, the outlet temperature rises.

Plakalı cooler'ı periyodik aç, plakaları.en: Open the plate cooler at intervals, clean the plates chemically (acid) and check the gaskets.

Plaka/boru kirli (fouling), SW debisi dü.en: Fouled plates or tubes, low SW flow, air lock

Cooler temizliği, SW strainer temizliği,.en: Clean the cooler and the SW strainer; vent the air.

Plaka çatlağı, gasket bozuk, boru delinm.en: Cracked plate, failed gasket, perforated tube

Basınç testi, hasarlı plaka/boru değişim.en: Pressure test; renew damaged plates or tubes and the gaskets.

Tortu/çamur birikimi, tıkanma.en: Build-up of deposits or sludge, blockage

Nitrit seviyesini test et ve dozla, hava.en: Test the nitrite level and dose as needed; stop the air ingress.

Kimyasal temizlikte (asit) uygun PPE kul.en: Use suitable PPE for chemical (acid) cleaning and rinse thoroughly after neutralising.

Plakalı cooler'ı sökerken plaka sırasını.en: When dismantling a plate cooler, mark the order and orientation of the plates; plates refitted wrongly will leak.

Basınçlıyken flanş/cıvata gevşetilmez; ö.en: Never slacken flanges or bolts under pressure; isolate and release the pressure first.

Deniz suyu tarafı galvanik korozyon için.en: On the seawater side, check the anodes and coating against galvanic corrosion.

Kompresör soğutucu gazı sıkıştırır → kon.en: The compressor compresses the refrigerant gas → the condenser liquefies it with seawater → liquid receiver → expansion valve (pressure falls) → evaporator (cools the room air and evaporates) → compressor.

Termostat oda sıcaklığını okur; set nokt.en: The thermostat senses the room temperature; at the set point it closes the solenoid valve and the compressor pumps down.

Defrost timer/sensör tetiklendiğinde sıc.en: When the defrost timer or sensor trips, hot gas or electric heaters are applied to the evaporator.

Sefere çıkmadan kumanya yüklendiğinde tü.en: When provisions are loaded before sailing, all rooms are brought down to their set temperatures.

Sıcaklık ve alarm kayıtlarını Food Safet.en: Keep temperature and alarm records as the food safety management plan, the MLC, company procedures and the cargo or provisions require; do not assume that HACCP is mandatory in the same form on every ship.

Evaporator coil'inde aşırı buz birikimi.en: If too much ice builds up on the evaporator coil, start a defrost manually.

Refrigerant level (sight glass) ve oil l.en: Check the refrigerant level (sight glass) and the compressor oil level.

Condenser sea-water strainer'ını differe.en: Clean the condenser seawater strainer according to the differential pressure, the flow and temperature trend and the PMS; do not use a fixed weekly interval in place of evidence of fouling.

Gaz kaçağı, evaporator buzlu, solenoid v.en: Refrigerant leak, evaporator iced up, solenoid valve closed

Sızdırmazlık, defrost, solenoid test..en: Leak-test, defrost, test the solenoid valve.

LP switch ayarsız, gaz az, sıvı geri dön.en: LP switch out of adjustment, low refrigerant charge, liquid returning to the compressor

Switch ayar, gaz şarj, ekspansiyon valf.en: Adjust the switch, charge refrigerant, service the expansion valve.

Conta değişim, defrost frekansı artır..en: Renew the door seal and defrost more often.

Soğuk depoya tek başına girilmez; içerid.en: Never enter a cold store alone; there is a risk of being trapped inside (panic alarm + radio).

Defrost sırasında üretilen sıvı drain ha.en: The drain line that carries off the water from defrosting must not block (freezing or leakage).

Refrigerant kaçağı boğulma, toksisite ve.en: A refrigerant leak can cause asphyxiation, toxicity or flammability hazards; whether a fixed detector is required is decided from the refrigerant class and charge, the space and the class or flag risk assessment, and portable gas measurement and ventilation are kept ready.

Kompresör çalışırken suction valf kapatı.en: Do not close the suction valve while the compressor is running (liquid compression breaks the compressor).

Ana bara gerilimi kaybolur; düşük gerili.en: The main busbar voltage is lost; the undervoltage relay sends a start signal to the emergency generator.

Marş kaynağı (akü/hidrolik/hava) ana güç.en: The starting source (battery, hydraulic or air) starts the set independently of the main power supply.

Set nominal gerilim ve frekansa ulaşınca.en: When the set reaches rated voltage and frequency, the emergency busbar breaker closes and the interconnector stays open.

Akü ve yakıt seviyesini kontrol et, manu.en: Check the battery and the fuel level; try a manual start.

ISC bağlantısı kolay erişilebilir yerde,.en: The international shore connection must be easily accessible and clearly marked.

Kış aylarında açık güverte hatlarında do.en: In winter, protect lines on the open deck against freezing.

Pilot hattını kontrol et, manuel boşaltı.en: Check the pilot line and use the manual release lever.

CO₂ odası iyi havalandırılmalı, sıcaklık.en: The CO₂ room must be well ventilated and kept below 55 °C.

Release box erişilebilir, işaretli ve ka.en: Keep the release cabinet accessible, marked and protected against accidental operation; test its seal, interlock and alarm function according to the ship's approved arrangement.

Personel kazara aktivasyona karşı eğitil.en: Crew must be trained to prevent accidental release and must know what the alarm means.

Yangın pompası deniz suyunu basınçlandır.en: The fire pump pressurises the seawater.

AFFF cilde temas ederse bol su ile yıkan.en: If AFFF gets on the skin, wash it off with plenty of water.

Foam genişleme oranı ve drenaj süresi pe.en: Measure the foam expansion ratio and drainage time at intervals.

Cam ampul ısıyla genleşip patlar, başlık.en: The glass bulb expands with heat and bursts, opening the sprinkler head.

Hat basıncı düşer, alarm valfi açılır ve.en: The line pressure drops, the alarm valve opens and the pump starts.

Deluge sisteminde manuel veya dedektör t.en: In a deluge system, manual or detector release discharges all the heads in the section at once.

Sistemi her zaman basınçlı (charged) kon.en: Keep the system charged (pressurised) at all times.

Manometre, tank/pump ve alarm testlerini.en: Carry out the gauge, tank, pump and alarm tests as the PMS and the maker's and FSS Code test arrangements require.

Test valfinden örnek deşarj alarak alarm.en: Test the alarm valve by discharging water through the test valve.

Deşarj sonrası ıslanan sigorta panelleri.en: After a discharge, check any fuse panels and electronics that got wet.

Sızıntıyı tespit et, jokey pompayı kontr.en: Find the leak and check the jockey pump.

Başlığı değiştir, doğru moment ile sık..en: Renew the head and tighten it to the correct torque.

Switch test, kontak temizle veya değişti.en: Test the switch; clean or renew the contacts.

Sprinkler başlıklarına boya, izolasyon v.en: Never paint, insulate or attach anything to sprinkler heads.

Başlık çevresinde 50 cm açık alan bırakı.en: Leave 50 cm of clear space around each head.

Donma riskli alanlarda kuru tip (dry pip.en: In areas at risk of freezing, a dry-pipe system is preferred.

Muayene, flow test ve basınç test aralık.en: Confirm the inspection, flow test and pressure test intervals from the maker, class or flag, the MSC guidance and the PMS; a yearly hydraulic test of the whole system is not a general rule.

Blower bu gazı deck main hattına basar..en: The blower delivers this gas to the deck main.

Deck water seal sıvı bariyer oluşturarak.en: The deck water seal forms a liquid barrier that prevents backflow.

Hat basıncı düşerse alarm; çok artarsa P.en: If the line pressure falls, an alarm sounds; if it rises too far, the P/V breaker relieves it.

Boiler'ı yeterli yükte tut, scrubber pom.en: Keep the boiler at sufficient load and start the scrubber pump.

Blower'ı low/high speed devreye al, çıkı.en: Start the blower at low or high speed and monitor the outlet O₂.

O₂ %5'in altına inince main isolation va.en: When the O₂ falls below 5%, open the main isolation valve.

Discharge sırasında tank pozitif basınçt.en: During discharge, the tanks are kept at a positive pressure (~200 mmWC).

Boiler düşük yük, blower kaçırıyor.en: Boiler at low load, blower leaking

Boiler yükünü artır, blower seal/conta k.en: Increase the boiler load and check the blower seals.

Deck water seal seviyesi düşük.en: Low level in the deck water seal

Seviye otomatiğini kontrol et, manuel be.en: Check the automatic level control and top up manually.

Tank valfi sızdırıyor, P/V valve açık ka.en: Tank valve leaking, P/V valve stuck open

Valfleri kontrol, P/V'yi test et..en: Check the valves and test the P/V valve.

Tank atmosferine giriş öncesi mutlaka ga.en: Before anyone enters a tank, it must be gas-free and the O₂ measured.

IGS kapalıyken kargo discharge yasaktır..en: Discharging cargo with the IGS shut down is prohibited.

Scrubber'da yıkama suyu sürekli akmalı,.en: Wash water must flow through the scrubber continuously, otherwise it overheats and corrodes.

Sistem üzerinde her zaman iki bağımsız n.en: The system must always have two independent non-return barriers.

Sinyal merkezi panel tarafından bölgeye.en: The central panel assigns the signal to its zone and gives a visual and audible alarm.

Panel lamp, fault, isolator ve zone/loop.en: Carry out the panel lamp, fault, isolator and zone/loop tests at the intervals set in the Fire Safety Operational Booklet and the PMS.

Dedektörleri onaylı test gazı/ısı/alev s.en: Function-test the detectors with an approved test gas, heat source or flame simulator according to the maker's instructions and the MSC.1/Circ.1432 maintenance plan.

Dedektör temizleme/değişim aralığını çev.en: Plan detector cleaning and replacement according to the contamination of the space, the self-monitoring data, the maker's limit and the test trend.

Yanlış alarm sonrası bölge önce silinir,.en: After a false alarm, the zone is first silenced and then reset.

Dedektörü temizle, gerekirse değiştir..en: Clean the detector and renew it if necessary.

Hattı ölç, terminasyonu kontrol et..en: Test the circuit and check the terminations.

Aküyü değiştir, şarj devresini test et..en: Renew the battery and test the charging circuit.

Dedektör altında 50 cm açık koni olmalı,.en: Keep a clear cone of 50 cm below each detector; do not stow anything there.

Boya/dekorasyon sırasında dedektörler sö.en: During painting or refurbishment, do not remove detectors or cover them up.

Test sırasında köprüüstüne ve makine kon.en: Inform the bridge and the engine control room before any test.

Yıllık sertifika ve test raporları gemi.en: Keep the annual certificates and test reports in the ship's records.

CO₂ kapalı küçük hacimde kullanırsa boğu.en: Using CO₂ in a small enclosed space carries a risk of asphyxiation.

Kuru kimyasal sonrası elektronik ekipman.en: Electronic equipment needs drying and cleaning after dry powder has been used.

Söndürücü kullanımı eğitimi SOLAS III/19.en: Training in the use of extinguishers is given under SOLAS III/19.4: to new crew members within two weeks of joining, and so that all the equipment is covered within every two-month period.

Demand valf, kullanıcı nefes aldıkça mas.en: The demand valve supplies air to the mask as the wearer breathes in.

Low-pressure warning maker set değerinde.en: The low-pressure warning operates at the maker's set value; at entry control the team works out the pressure–time calculation and a turn-around pressure, and starts back without waiting for the whistle.

Kullanım öncesi tüp basıncını sıcaklık d.en: Before use, check the cylinder pressure against the maker's full-charge value, corrected for temperature, and record that it is enough for the team's working time and return reserve.

Görev sırasında basıncı izle; düdük çald.en: Watch the pressure while working; turn back when the whistle sounds.

Conta kontrol et, kompresörden yeniden d.en: Check the seals and recharge from the compressor.

Demand valf sürekli açık (free flow).en: Demand valve in continuous free flow

Doğru boy seç, contayı değiştir, sakal t.en: Choose the right size, renew the seal, be clean-shaven.

SCBA tüpünün hydrostatic test ve ömür li.en: Confirm the hydrostatic test and service life limits of the SCBA cylinder from the cylinder standard, the maker and the flag requirements; do not judge the certificate and markings by a fixed 5-year rule alone.

EEBD eğitimi yapılmadan kullanılmamalı;.en: Do not use an EEBD without training; the hood must protect the eyes.

Yangın takımı yerinde, mühürlü ve eksiks.en: Keep the firefighter's outfits in place, sealed and complete; record the monthly check.

Yakıt servis pompası emergency stop kont.en: The fuel service pump emergency stop contact cuts the circuit through the protection relay.

Yangın doğrulanıp tahliye sağlandıktan s.en: Once the fire is confirmed and the space evacuated: shut off the fuel (QCV) → stop the fans → stop the fuel pumps → release CO₂.

Aylık testlerde her QCV ayrı ayrı kapatı.en: In the monthly tests each QCV is closed, reopened and greased in turn.

Emergency stop butonları PSC denetiminde.en: Emergency stop buttons are function-tested during PSC inspections.

Test sonrası ilgili sistemlerin yeniden.en: After the test, record in the logbook that the systems concerned have been put back in service.

Yay korozyonu, kablo gevşek, hava basınc.en: Corroded spring, slack wire, no air pressure

Mekanik kontrol, yağla, hava şişesi bası.en: Check it mechanically, lubricate it and recharge the air bottle.

Kontaktörü test et, bobini değiştir..en: Test the contactor and renew the coil.

Valf revize edilmeli, gerekirse değiştir.en: Overhaul the valve and renew it if necessary.

Tatbikat dışında QCV asla kapatılmamalı.en: Never close a QCV except in a test or drill (the main engine may stop).

Test öncesi köprüüstü ve makine kontrol.en: Inform the bridge and the engine control room before the test.

Re-set sonrası yakıt hattında havayı al,.en: After resetting, bleed the air from the fuel line and check for leaks.

Etiketleme net olmalı: hangi tank/pompa.en: Labelling must be clear: show which tank or pump each pull wire operates.

Santrifüj pompada impeller döner; merkez.en: In a centrifugal pump the impeller turns; centrifugal force throws the liquid outwards into the volute and builds up the discharge pressure.

Submerged pompada tank içi pompa motoru.en: In a submerged pump, the in-tank pump motor is driven by hydraulic oil; the liquid rises straight from the pump into the riser.

Pozitif deplasmanlı stripping pompası he.en: A positive-displacement stripping pump moves a fixed volume every revolution; it gives a low flow rate but a high vacuum.

Booster pompa ana pompanın discharge'ını.en: The booster pump takes the discharge of the main pump and raises its pressure further.

Tank discharge planına göre suction valf.en: Open the suction valve according to the tank discharge plan and line up the manifold valve to the terminal.

Pompayı düşük rpm'de çalıştır, prime tam.en: Start the pump at low rpm and increase the flow gradually once it is primed.

Tank seviyesi ~%10'a düştüğünde strippin.en: When the tank level falls to ~10%, change over to the stripping pump; check it with the vacuum-cleared lamp.

Boşaltım sonunda hatları nitrogen/inert.en: At the end of discharge, purge the lines with nitrogen or inert gas and flush the manifold.

Hava emiyor, valf kapalı, impeller aşınm.en: Drawing air, valve closed, worn impeller

Suction line ve valfleri kontrol et, pri.en: Check the suction line and valves, prime the pump, service the impeller.

Yatak yağı yetersiz, mekanik conta sızın.en: Insufficient bearing oil, mechanical seal leaking
