NPSH kontrol, hizalamayı yeniden yap, ba.en: Check the NPSH, realign the pump and balance it.

Sıvı seal sağla, conta değişimi yap..en: Provide a liquid seal and renew the seal.

Pump room'a girmeden önce O₂, LEL ve H₂S.en: Before entering the pump room, measure O₂, LEL and H₂S; use SCBA if necessary.

Statik biriktiren cargo ve boş tanka ilk.en: With static-accumulator cargoes and at the start of loading into an empty tank, a low line velocity is used until the inlet is covered; the exact velocity and depth come from ISGOTT, the terminal and the cargo plan, and 1 m/s is not applied blindly to every cargo.

Cargo ESD/remote stop istasyonlarının ye.en: The locations of the cargo ESD and remote stop stations and the equipment they act on are verified from the approved plan and the ship/shore safety checklist; the risk of an unwanted pressure surge from valve closure is assessed beforehand.

Boşaltım sırasında trim ve heel sürekli.en: Monitor trim and heel continuously during discharge and allow for the free surface moment.

Tank seviyesi belirli bir oranda boşaltı.en: The COW pump is started once the tank has been discharged to a given level.

Makine, tank içinde belirli açıda dönerk.en: As the machine turns through set angles inside the tank, its jet of crude oil strikes the tank surfaces and dissolves the residues.

Çözünen tortu yükle birlikte stripping p.en: The dissolved residues are pumped with the cargo by the stripping pump to the slop tank.

İkinci aşama (bottom wash) tank dibine o.en: The second stage (bottom wash) concentrates on the tank bottom to keep the ROB to a minimum.

Top wash'i yalnız onaylı COW Manual'deki.en: Start the top wash only at the tank-specific ullage, machine pattern and point in the discharge sequence given in the approved COW Manual.

Bottom wash/stripping zamanını tank plan.en: Time the bottom wash and stripping from the approved COW programme, taking account of the tank plan, suction coverage and the terminal discharge sequence.

Yıkama süresince hat basıncını ve makine.en: Monitor the line pressure and the machine rotation throughout the wash.

Yıkama sonrası tankı stripping ile boşal.en: After washing, strip the tank and keep it under pressure with the IGS.

Yıkama kayıtlarını COW Operations Manual.en: Record the washing as the COW Operations and Equipment Manual requires and in the Oil Record Book.

Pompa arızası, hat sızıntısı, makine tık.en: Pump fault, leaking line, blocked machine

Pompa kontrol, hat sızıntı testi, makine.en: Check the pump, leak-test the line, dismantle and clean the machine.

Türbin kanadı tıkalı, hidrolik motor arı.en: Turbine blades blocked, hydraulic motor faulty

Makineyi sök, türbini temizle veya motor.en: Dismantle the machine and clean the turbine, or renew the motor.

Tank O₂/IG basıncı limit dışı.en: Tank O₂ or IG pressure outside limits

IGS yetersiz, analizör/sampling hatası v.en: IGS inadequate, analyser or sampling error, or tank leakage

COW'u derhal durdur; onaylı manual'deki.en: Stop COW at once; restore the tank O₂ and supply O₂ limits in the approved manual, positive pressure and analyser accuracy.

COW sırasında fixed/portable O₂ ölçümler.en: During COW, fixed and portable O₂ readings are compared at the interval in the approved manual; the manual's stop criteria are applied before the tank approaches the 8% O₂ limit.

Yıkama makineleri için onaylı operasyone.en: Keep the washing machines within their approved operating envelope.

Statik şarj birikimini önlemek için yıka.en: Control the washing flow to prevent a build-up of static charge.

Personel pump room'a girmeden önce H₂S ö.en: Crew must test for H₂S before entering the pump room (especially with sour crude).

Radar gauge, tank tepesindeki anten 6–10.en: With a radar gauge, the antenna on the tank top transmits microwaves at 6–10 GHz; the delay of the signal reflected from the liquid surface is converted into ullage.

Hidrostatik sensör tank dibindeki basınc.en: A hydrostatic sensor calculates the level by dividing the pressure at the tank bottom by the density of the liquid.

PT100 sıcaklık sensörü tankın 3 farklı y.en: PT100 temperature sensors at 3 different heights in the tank give an average temperature.

Sinyaller CCR (cargo control room) ekran.en: The signals are shown graphically on the display in the CCR (cargo control room).

Yükleme/boşaltım öncesi radar gauge'ı ma.en: Before loading or discharging, cross-check the radar gauge with a manual UTI reading.

High level alarm test butonu ile çalışır.en: Confirm that the high-level alarm works with its test button.

Ullage, sıcaklık ve trim'i CCR'da sürekl.en: Monitor ullages, temperatures and trim continuously in the CCR.

Inerted tank'a UTI sokmadan önce vapor l.en: Before putting a UTI into an inerted tank, fit it to the vapour lock valve and connect the static bonding.

Anten kirli, vapor space yoğun buhar.en: Dirty antenna, dense vapour in the ullage space

Sensörü test et, hattı ölç, yedek devrey.en: Test the sensor, check the circuit and bring in the back-up.

Bağlantıyı sıkı, gerekirse PT100 değişti.en: Tighten the connection and renew the PT100 if necessary.

UTI manuel ölçümde statik bonding kablos.en: For manual UTI measurements, the static bonding cable must always be connected.

Yükleme sırasında bağımsız overfill alar.en: The independent overfill alarm must be working during loading.

Tank ullage planı ve sıcaklık logu shift.en: Keep the tank ullage plan and the temperature log up to date every watch.

Sensör kalibrasyon sertifikası periyodik.en: Renew the sensor calibration certificate at regular intervals.

Hidrolik güç ünitesi (HPU), silindirleri.en: The hydraulic power unit (HPU) operates the cylinders and the locking mechanisms.

Açma sırasında: kilitler açılır → kapak.en: When opening: the cleats release → the cover lifts → the cylinders fold the panels to the side or down.

Sızdırmazlık coaming çevresindeki rubber.en: Weathertightness comes from the rubber gasket around the coaming, which is compressed as the cover closes.

Drainage channel sızan suyu over-board v.en: The drainage channel leads any water that gets past overboard or to the bilge.

Açmadan önce kapağın üstündeki yük ve bu.en: Before opening, clear any cargo, ice or snow from the top of the cover.

HPU'yu çalıştır, basıncı set değere geti.en: Start the HPU and bring the pressure to the set value.

Kilitleri sırasıyla aç, kapak hareketi s.en: Release the cleats in sequence and keep everyone clear while the cover moves.

Kapatma sonrası gasket'in tam oturduğunu.en: After closing, check that the gasket is fully seated and tighten the cleats.

Denize çıkmadan önce hose test ile sızdı.en: Before going to sea, confirm weathertightness with a hose test.

Coaming üzerinde tortu, hidrolik basınç.en: Debris on the coaming, low hydraulic pressure

Coaming temizle, HPU basıncı kontrol et..en: Clean the coaming and check the HPU pressure.

Gasket yenile, kompresyon bar düzelt..en: Renew the gasket and straighten the compression bar.

Sistemi havadan al, valf ve seal kontrol.en: Bleed the air from the system and check the valves and seals.

Açık kapak fırtınalı havada operasyon ya.en: Do not operate with the covers open in stormy weather.

Kapak üzerinde personel çalışacaksa kili.en: If people are to work on a cover, fit the safety locking pins.

Periyodik gasket kontrolü ve hose/ultras.en: Keep records of regular gasket checks and of hose or ultrasonic tests.

Hatch cover load capacity stowage planın.en: Take the load capacity of the hatch covers into account in the stowage plan.

Twist-lock üst container'ın corner casti.en: The twistlock enters the corner casting of the container above and is locked by turning it through 90°.

Lashing rod'un alt ucu D-ring'e takılır,.en: The lower end of the lashing rod is attached to the D-ring and the upper end to the container corner; it is tensioned with the turnbuckle.

Yükün eylemsizliği (acceleration × mass).en: The inertia force of the cargo (acceleration × mass) must be less than the sum of the MSLs of the lashings.

CSM, geminin GM ve roll periyoduna göre.en: The CSM gives the calculation of lashing forces based on the ship's GM and rolling period.

Yükleme öncesi tüm ekipman görsel kontro.en: Before loading, all equipment is inspected visually.

Stowage planına göre twist-lock'lar kont.en: Twistlocks are fitted under the containers according to the stowage plan.

Container indirilip locked edildikten so.en: The lashing rods are fitted after the container has been landed and locked.

Turnbuckle hand-tight + 1/2 tur ile sıkı.en: Turnbuckles are tightened hand-tight plus 1/2 turn, and checked daily for slackness at sea.

Heavy weather raporu sonrası lashing kon.en: After a heavy weather report, the lashings are checked again.

Yedek twist-lock ile değiştir, arızalıyı.en: Replace it with a spare twistlock and send the faulty one for repair.

Locknut/wire ile emniyete al, periyodik.en: Secure it with the locknut or seizing wire and retighten at intervals.

Hemen değiştir, MPI testi..en: Replace it at once; carry out an MPI test.

Lashing operasyonu sırasında baret, eldi.en: Hard hats, gloves and safety shoes are mandatory during lashing.

Yüksek seviyelere lashing eldiveni ile m.en: For high tiers, use a mast climber or cherry picker, wearing lashing gloves.

Aşırı sıkmaktan kaçın; turnbuckle thread.en: Do not overtighten; it damages the turnbuckle thread.

Heavy weather durumunda güverteye lashin.en: In heavy weather, going on deck to check lashings may be forbidden.

Plug bağlantısı yapıldığında container i.en: Once the reefer is plugged in, the container's PLC runs the compressor to bring the box to the set temperature.

Soğutucu gaz (R-134a, R-404A vb.) kompre.en: The refrigerant (R-134a, R-404A, etc.) is compressed in the compressor → condensed by outside air in the condenser → its pressure drops at the expansion valve → it cools the air inside the container in the evaporator.

Defrost cycle (otomatik) periyodik olara.en: The automatic defrost cycle melts the ice on the evaporator at intervals.

RMS, alarmları gemi şebekesine ethernet/.en: The RMS passes alarms to the ship's network over Ethernet or the PLC.

Container'ı plug'a takmadan önce socket.en: Before plugging the container in, measure the socket voltage.

Set sıcaklık, vent ve hava değişim oranı.en: Set the temperature, vent and air exchange rate according to the manifest.

Günlük RMS kontrolü yap; alarm varsa yed.en: Check the RMS daily; if there is an alarm, connect the unit to a spare socket.

Boşaltımdan önce sıcaklık logu çıktısını.en: Print out the temperature log before discharge.

Sigortayı reset et, kabloyu test et..en: Reset the fuse and test the cable.

Kondenseri temizle, gaz şarjını kontrol.en: Clean the condenser and check the refrigerant charge.

Heater test, kontrol kartı kontrol..en: Test the heater and check the control board.

PMS reefer yükü trip.en: Reefer load tripped by the PMS

Toplam yük jeneratör kapasitesini aştı.en: Total load exceeded the generator capacity

Reefer'leri kademeli devreye al, PMS lim.en: Switch the reefers on in stages and adjust the PMS limit.

Plug ve cable bağlantısı yapılırken eldi.en: Wear gloves and insulating footwear when connecting plugs and cables.

IMDG sınıfı tehlikeli yük varsa reefer'l.en: If there is IMDG-class dangerous cargo, distribute the reefers according to the segregation rules.

Yangın riski: reefer plug yangınları sık.en: Fire risk: reefer plug fires are common; monitor the temperature of the fuse boards.

RMS kayıtları konişmento (BL) için kanıt.en: RMS records serve as evidence in bill of lading (B/L) claims and must be kept.

HPU hidrolik silindirleri besler; ramp m.en: The HPU supplies the hydraulic cylinders; the ramp opens on its hinges.

Locking pinler kapalı pozisyonda otomati.en: The locking pins lock automatically or manually in the closed position.

Weathertight gasket coaming üzerinde sız.en: The weathertight gasket seals against the coaming.

Inclination ve closure switch sinyali br.en: The inclination and closure switch signals go to the bridge alarm system.

Açmadan önce trim/list kontrol et, ramp.en: Before opening, check the trim and list; the end of the ramp must land on the quay.

Kilitleri açıp HPU'yu devreye al; ramp'ı.en: Release the locks, start the HPU and lower the ramp slowly.

Yükleme sonrası ramp'ı kaldır, kilitle v.en: After loading, raise the ramp, lock it and check its weathertightness.

Closure indicator'ın 'closed' sinyali br.en: The closure indicator must show 'closed' on the bridge.

Denizde fırtınada ramp ekstra securing p.en: At sea in a storm, the ramp is secured with extra pins or wires.

HPU basıncı yok, kilit takılı, kontrol v.en: No HPU pressure, lock still engaged, faulty control valve

HPU ve kilitleri kontrol et, valfi devre.en: Check the HPU and the locks; bypass the valve and try to move the ramp manually.

Switch arızalı, kapak tam oturmamış.en: Faulty switch, door not fully seated

Gasket yenile, kilit sık..en: Renew the gasket and tighten the locks.

Ramp altında personel/araç bulunduğunda.en: Never move the ramp while people or vehicles are underneath it.

Bow ramp/visor weathertight integrity'si.en: The weathertight integrity of the bow ramp and visor must be confirmed before going to sea.

Trim ve list ramp eğiminden ±2° aşmamalı.en: Trim and list must not change the ramp slope by more than ±2°.

Yıllık class survey kapsamında ramp yapı.en: The ramp structure must be inspected at the annual class survey.

Hidrolik motor → ana tambur (hoist) → wi.en: Power flow: hydraulic motor → hoist drum → wire rope → block → hook.

Slewing (dönüş) hidrolik veya elektrik m.en: Slewing is driven by a hydraulic or electric motor through gearing.

Luffing silindiri bom açısını değiştirir.en: The luffing cylinder changes the boom angle (the SWL varies with boom angle).

Limit switch'ler aşırı yük, aşırı yüksel.en: Limit switches give protection against overload, over-hoisting and the end of travel.

Vinci çalıştırmadan önce yağ seviyesi, t.en: Before running the crane, check the oil level, the wire rope and the hook safety latch.

Yük ağırlığını SWL × açı tablosundan doğ.en: Check the load weight against the SWL for the boom angle in the load table.

Slewing sırasında ani durdurmadan kaçın;.en: Avoid sudden stops while slewing, so that the load does not swing.

Tag line (rehber halat) ile yük dönüşü k.en: Rotation of the load is controlled with a tag line.

Operasyon bitince bom kavrama bracket'in.en: When the operation is finished, the boom is stowed in its cradle.

Hidrolik basınç düşük, valf bobin arızas.en: Low hydraulic pressure, valve coil fault

Pompa basıncını kontrol et, bobini değiş.en: Check the pump pressure and renew the coil.

Slewing bearing yağı kontrol, gerektiğin.en: Check the slewing bearing lubricant and change it when necessary.

Tel halat çatlağı.en: Broken wires in the wire rope

Halatı segment olarak inceleme, kriter a.en: Inspect the wire section by section and renew it if the discard criteria are exceeded.

Limit switch ayarı, mekanik mafsal kontr.en: Adjust the limit switch and check the mechanical linkage.

Yük altında veya salınım yörüngesinde pe.en: No one may be under the load or in its swing path.

Wind, list/trim ve sea-state stop limitl.en: Apply the wind, list/trim and sea-state stop limits from the approved load chart and operating manual; a fixed 15 m/s and 5° is not a safe limit for every crane and configuration.

Wire rope'u maker/ISO discard criteria i.en: Assess the wire rope visually and by measurement against the maker's or ISO discard criteria; do not prescribe conventional MPI/UT for wire rope by rote, and lubricate it according to the rope construction and the PMS.

Sertifikalı operatör + sinyalist ile çal.en: Work with a certified operator and signaller; hand signals must be standardised.

Yıkama makinesi yüksek basınçlı suyu tan.en: The washing machine sprays high-pressure water onto the tank surfaces.

Yıkama suyu tank dibinde toplanır; educt.en: The washing water collects at the bottom of the tank; the eductor draws it off by the venturi effect and delivers it to the slop tank.

Slop ayrışma süresi sıcaklık, emülsiyon.en: The settling time of the slops depends on temperature, emulsion and the interface measurement; waiting a fixed 24 hours does not on its own prove the quality of the discharge.

Üstteki yağ tabakası bir sonraki yüke ka.en: The oil layer on top is loaded together with the next cargo (load on top, LOT), and the water underneath is discharged under control through the ODME.

Yıkama programını cargo planına göre haz.en: Prepare the washing programme according to the cargo plan (hot or cold, chemicals, etc.).

İnertlenen tankta tank atmosferini ≤%8 O.en: In an inerted tank, keep the atmosphere at ≤8% O₂ and under positive pressure; monitor the ≤5% O₂ limit for the supply gas separately.

Yıkama makinesini approved cycle/program.en: Run the washing machine according to the approved cycle or programme, the shadow diagram and the coating and cargo restrictions; do not use an arbitrary 90° position.

Slop interface ve sample'ı doğrula; yaln.en: Verify the slop interface and sample; start a controlled discharge only if MARPOL Annex I Reg. 34, the ODME operational manual and the discharge criteria are fully met.

Tank gas free yapılmadan girişe izin ver.en: Do not allow entry until the tank is gas-free; issue a permit to enter.

Driving water basıncı düşük, nozül tıkal.en: Low driving water pressure, blocked nozzle

Pompa basıncı, nozül söküm temizlik..en: Check the pump pressure; dismantle and clean the nozzle.

Sökerek bakım, yatak değişimi..en: Dismantle and overhaul it; renew the bearings.

Filtre temizliği, sensör kalibrasyon ve.en: Clean the filter; calibrate and test the sensor.

Tank içi giriş Enclosed Space Entry perm.en: Tank entry requires an enclosed space entry permit and satisfactory gas test results.

Settling time, portable conductive/non-c.en: Confirm the settling time, the rules for portable conductive and non-conductive equipment and the water-mist and static precaution times from ISGOTT, the cargo SDS and the approved tank-cleaning procedure; a fixed 30 minutes is not enough for every operation.

ODME logu Oil Record Book'a işlenir; PSC.en: The ODME record is entered in the Oil Record Book and is asked for at PSC inspections.

Sıcak yıkamada personel yanık önlemi (PP.en: During hot washing, crew must wear PPE against burns.

Ballast in: deniz suyu pompası → filtre.en: Ballasting: seawater pump → filter (40 µm) → UV reactor or EC unit → ballast tank.

Ballast out: tank → bypass filtre → UV (.en: Deballasting: tank → filter bypass → UV (repeated if required) → neutralisation (for EC) → overboard.

UV reaktörde lambalar yüksek yoğunluklu.en: In the UV reactor the lamps produce high-intensity UV-C; a sensor monitors intensity and transmittance.

EC ünitesinde elektrotlar deniz suyunu e.en: In the EC unit, electrodes electrolyse the seawater; the TRO (total residual oxidant) produced is kept at 2–10 mg/L.

Operasyon öncesi BWMS'i hazırla, lamba ı.en: Prepare the BWMS before the operation and wait for the lamp warm-up time (UV systems).

Pompa başlat, akış BWMS rated capacity a.en: Start the pump; keep the flow below the rated capacity of the BWMS.

TRO/UV intensity sensörlerini izle; alar.en: Monitor the TRO or UV intensity sensors; on an alarm, stop the operation rather than going to bypass mode.

Deballast sonunda nötralizasyon ünitesin.en: At the end of deballasting, run the neutralisation unit (EC systems) and confirm overboard TRO < 0.1 mg/L.

BWRB'a tarih, koordinat, hacim, yapılan.en: Record the date, position, volume, operation carried out and system status in the BWRB.

Lamba ömrü dolmuş, kuvars kılıf kirli.en: Lamps at end of life, quartz sleeves dirty

Lambaları değiştir, kuvars kılıfları tem.en: Renew the lamps and clean the quartz sleeves (acid wash).

Otomatik backflush devrede mi kontrol et.en: Check that automatic backflushing is working and clean the filter manually.

Tuzluluk ölç, asit yıkama yap, elektrot.en: Measure the salinity, acid-wash and check the electrodes.

Sistem bypass moduna geçti.en: System has gone into bypass mode

Operasyonu durdur, PSC bildirim ve servi.en: Stop the operation, notify the port State (PSC) and call for service.

UV lambalarına çıplak gözle bakma (göz h.en: Never look at UV lamps with the naked eye (eye damage); the lamps must be de-energised during maintenance.

EC ünitesinde hidrojen birikimi olabilir.en: Hydrogen can build up in the EC unit; the ventilation must always be running (explosion risk).

Kimyasal nötralizasyon ürünleri (sodyum.en: Store the neutralising chemicals (sodium thiosulphate) according to the MSDS.

Sistem arızasında 'Contingency Measure'.en: If the system fails, the contingency measures procedure is followed (notify the port State, consider an alternative port).

Chiller kompresörü gaz sıkıştırır → kond.en: The chiller compressor compresses the refrigerant → it is liquefied in the seawater-cooled condenser → expansion valve → evaporator (cools the chilled water).

Chilled water pompa ile AHU coil'lerine.en: The chilled water is pumped to the AHU coils, which cool and dehumidify the airflow.

AHU fanı şartlandırılmış havayı kanallar.en: The AHU fan delivers the conditioned air into the ducts, and diffusers distribute it in the spaces.

Termostat oda sıcaklığını okur; chilled.en: The thermostat senses the room temperature and modulates the chilled water valve or the damper.

Sezon başında chiller'ı start et; oil he.en: At the start of the season, start the chiller; switch on the oil heater 24 hours beforehand to protect the compressor.

Chilled water pompa ve expansion tank se.en: Check the chilled water pump and the expansion tank level.

Filtreleri 1–3 ayda bir temizle/değiştir.en: Clean or change the filters every 1–3 months; a blocked filter overloads the fan motor.

Yıllık leak test, oil analizi ve refrako.en: Every year, carry out a leak test, an oil analysis and a glycol check with a refractometer.

Filtre tıkalı, gaz kaçağı, valf kapalı.en: Blocked filter, refrigerant leak, closed valve

Filtre, gaz şarj kontrol, valf testi..en: Check the filter and the refrigerant charge; test the valves.

SW pompa, strainer kontrol; kondenser as.en: Check the SW pump and strainer; acid-wash the condenser.

Gaz kaçağı, expansion valf arızalı, evap.en: Refrigerant leak, faulty expansion valve, dirty evaporator

Sızdırmazlık testi, valf bakım, evap tem.en: Leak-test, service the valve, clean the evaporator.

Drain pan temizliği, izolasyon onarımı..en: Clean the drain pan and repair the insulation.

Soğutucu gaz sızıntısında ortam ventile.en: If refrigerant leaks, ventilate the space; high concentrations cause asphyxiation.

Chiller machinery space gaz dedektörüyle.en: The chiller machinery space should be protected by a gas detector (for R134a).

Bakım sırasında sistem boşaltma için 're.en: Use a recovery unit to empty the system during maintenance; refrigerant must not be released to the atmosphere.

Provision room'a giren personel için içe.en: The inside door release of the provision rooms must always work for anyone who goes in.

Pompa FWT'den suyu alır, basınç tankına.en: The pump draws water from the fresh water tank and delivers it to the pressure tank, where the air cushion is compressed and stores energy.

Musluklar açıldığında basınç tankından s.en: When taps are opened, water flows from the pressure tank and the pressure falls.

Stop basıncının (örn. 3 bar) altına düşü.en: When the pressure falls below the cut-in value (e.g. 3 bar) the pressure switch starts the pump, and when it reaches the upper value (e.g. 5 bar) it stops it.

UV sterilizator akış sırasında suyu ster.en: The UV steriliser treats the water as it flows through.

FWT seviyesini günlük kontrol et; hidrof.en: Check the fresh water tank level daily; the hydrophore pump must not run dry (the mechanical seal burns out).

Basınç tankı ön havasını ayda bir kontro.en: Check the pressure tank air precharge monthly (with a gauge, water side empty).

Klor dozaj veya UV lambasını çalışır tut.en: Keep the chlorine dosing or the UV lamp working.

Pompa start/stop sıklığını izle; >6/dk i.en: Watch how often the pump starts and stops; more than 6 per minute means the tank air precharge is low.

Pressure tank ön havası boş, kaçak var,.en: No air precharge in the pressure tank, a leak, or the pressure switch out of adjustment

Tank havası şarj, hat sızdırmazlık, pres.en: Recharge the tank air, check the lines for leaks, adjust the pressure switch.

Musluktan kesik kesik su.en: Water comes from the taps in spurts

Hava emiyor, basınç tankı membranı yırtı.en: Pump drawing air, torn pressure tank membrane

Suction line kontrol, membran değişim..en: Check the suction line and renew the membrane.

Calorifier rezistansı bozuk, termostat a.en: Calorifier heating element burnt out, faulty thermostat

Rezistans test, termostat değişim..en: Test the heating element and renew the thermostat.

İçme suyu kötü tat/koku.en: Drinking water tastes or smells bad

Tank kirli, klor düşük, UV bozuk.en: Dirty tank, low chlorine, UV unit faulty

Tank temizlik, klor şoku, UV lamba değiş.en: Clean the tank, shock-chlorinate it and renew the UV lamp.

Tank inspeksiyonu enclosed space entry p.en: Inspect tanks only under an enclosed space entry permit, after a gas (O₂) test.

Pres tank şarj havası kompresörden alınm.en: Do not charge the pressure tank with air from the compressor (oil contamination); use pure N₂ or clean air.

FWT giriş hatlarında non-return valve sa.en: The non-return valves on the fresh water tank filling lines must be sound (risk of contamination).

Calorifier elektrik rezistansı kuruda en.en: Never switch on the calorifier heating element when it is dry (it burns out).

Kompresör atmosferden hava çeker, 1. kad.en: The compressor draws in atmospheric air, compresses it to 5–7 bar in the 1st stage and cools it in the intercooler.

2. kademede 30 bara çıkarılır, aftercool.en: The 2nd stage raises it to 30 bar; the aftercooler cools it and moisture is separated out.

Receiver'a basılır; tank dolduğunda unlo.en: It is delivered to the receiver; when the receiver is full, the unloader operates or the compressor stops.

Dryer adsorpsiyon (silica gel) veya refr.en: The dryer removes water by adsorption (silica gel) or by refrigeration.

Kompresör start öncesi yağ seviyesi, soğ.en: Before starting the compressor, check the oil level, the cooling water and the drains.

Otomatik mod: receiver tank basıncı düşt.en: Automatic mode: it starts automatically when the receiver pressure falls.

Drain'leri condensate yükü, auto-drain i.en: Check the drains according to the condensate load, the auto-drain function and the PMS and watch routine; lead oily condensate to the proper collecting system.

Start air valfi izolasyonu kontrol et; k.en: Check that the starting-air valve is isolated; otherwise an accidental start is possible.

Inter/aftercooler temizliğini pressure d.en: Plan intercooler and aftercooler cleaning from the pressure drop, the temperature approach, leak tests and the PMS condition trend.

Suction filter tıkalı, kafa contası, kap.en: Blocked suction filter, head gasket failure, broken valve plate

Filtre, kafa söküm, valf bakım..en: Check the filter, remove the head and overhaul the valves.

Soğutma suyu yok, kondenser kirli, inter.en: No cooling water, fouled cooler, blocked intercooler

SW kontrol, temizlik..en: Check the SW supply and clean the coolers.

Emniyet valfi sızdırıyor, drain valfi aç.en: Leaking safety valve, drain valve open, line leak

Valf reseat, hatta sızdırmazlık testi..en: Reseat the valve and leak-test the line.

Dryer çiğ noktası yüksek.en: High dew point after the dryer

Desiccant değişim, regen heater kontrol..en: Renew the desiccant and check the regeneration heater.

Receiver tank üzerinde safety valve mutl.en: The safety valve on the receiver must always work; test it manually at regular intervals.

Yüksek basınç hattında çatlak/sızıntıya.en: Keep your body clear when approaching a crack or leak in a high-pressure line (a high-velocity jet cuts the skin).

Bakım öncesi tank tamamen depressurize e.en: Before maintenance, depressurise the receiver completely and apply isolation and lockout/tagout (LOTO).

Yağlı kompresörde aşırı yağ taşkını patl.en: In an oil-lubricated compressor, excessive oil carry-over creates an explosion risk; check the oil filter and separator regularly.

Yakıtlı kazanda brulor su yüzeyini ısıtı.en: In an oil-fired boiler the burner heats the water; it evaporates and dry steam is taken off at the top.

Buhar kollektörden tüketicilere dağıtılı.en: Steam is distributed from the manifold to the consumers and condenses as it gives up its heat.

Kondens steam trap üzerinden kondens hat.en: Condensate passes through the steam traps into the condensate line and returns to the hot well.

Feed water pompası hot well'den kazana b.en: The feed pump delivers water from the hot well to the boiler; the level controller holds the drum level steady.

Kazanı çalıştırmadan önce su seviyesi (g.en: Before firing the boiler, check the water level in the gauge glass and test the safety valve.

Brulor yakıt valfini yavaş aç; alev tutu.en: Open the burner fuel valve slowly and check ignition with the flame eye.

Drum basıncı yükselirken çıkış valfini k.en: As drum pressure rises, open the main steam valve gradually (to prevent thermal shock).

Operasyon sırasında pH, klorür, fosfat,.en: During operation, test pH, chloride, phosphate and salinity daily.

Blow-down: kazan suyundaki çamur ve tuzu.en: Blow-down: surface and bottom blow-downs remove sludge and salts from the boiler water.

Yakıt soğuk, ignition arızası, fotosel k.en: Fuel too cold, ignition fault, dirty photocell

HFO ısıt, ignition kontrol, fotosel temi.en: Heat the HFO, check the ignition, clean the photocell.

Kazan suyu kirli, yüksek TDS, alkalinity.en: Contaminated boiler water, high TDS, high alkalinity

Blow-down yap, kimyasal dozaj kontrol..en: Blow down and check the chemical dosing.

Steam trap takılı kalmış, kondens hattın.en: Steam trap stuck, leak in the condensate line

Trap test, hat sızdırmazlık..en: Test the traps and leak-test the line.

Soot birikimi, düşük yük, alkali yakıt.en: Soot build-up, low load, high-alkali fuel

Soot blow düzenli yap, yangın halinde st.en: Blow soot regularly; in a fire, use steam smothering or CO₂.

Buhar hattı çalıştırılırken yavaş ısıtıl.en: Warm a steam line through slowly when putting it in service; opening it suddenly causes water hammer, which can burst the pipe.

Safety valve manuel test düzenli yapılır.en: Test the safety valve manually at regular intervals; a seized safety valve means disaster.

Sıcak yüzey yanığı için hatlar izole edi.en: Insulate the lines to prevent burns from hot surfaces; never touch them with bare hands.

Boş çalışan kazan (low water) overheatin.en: A boiler fired with low water risks overheating and explosion; keep the level alarms properly adjusted.

Tehlike çağrısı DSC ile (kim, nerede, ne.en: A distress alert (who, where, what kind of distress) is sent automatically by DSC with a single button.

Sahil istasyonu / yakın gemiler DSC alar.en: The coast station and nearby ships are alerted by the DSC alarm and receive the details on the voice channel.

MSI (NAVTEX, SafetyNET) otomatik olarak.en: MSI receivers (NAVTEX, SafetyNET) automatically print weather reports, NAVAREA warnings and SAR broadcasts.

EPIRB ve SART'ın aktivasyonu uydu/Radar.en: Activating the EPIRB and the SART guides search and rescue units to the ship by satellite and by radar.

Vardiya başında battery, antenler, lamba.en: At the start of the watch, check the batteries, antennas, lamps and printer paper.

Günlük DSC self-test (test çağrısı sahil.en: Daily DSC self-test (an internal test, not a test call to a coast station).

Live DSC test çağrısını Radio Log proced.en: Make live DSC test calls according to the radio log procedure, coast station availability, flag guidance and the maker's instructions; if there is no coverage or acknowledgement, record the failed attempt and the reason, and never use a distress alert.

Aylık EPIRB self-test, SART self-test, b.en: Monthly: EPIRB self-test, SART self-test and battery expiry check.

Radio log'a tüm test ve tehlike trafiği.en: All tests and distress traffic are recorded in the radio log.

GPS feed yok, MMSI girilmemiş, anten arı.en: No GPS input, MMSI not entered, antenna fault

GPS bağlantı, MMSI kontrol, antenna VSWR.en: Check the GPS connection and the MMSI; measure the antenna VSWR.

Anten kopuk, kanal seçimi yanlış (518 kH.en: Antenna disconnected, wrong frequency selected (518 kHz English), squelch too high

Antenna ve preamp test, frekans/lang aya.en: Test the antenna and preamplifier; set the frequency and language.

Şarj devresi arızalı, battery ömrü dolmu.en: Faulty charging circuit, battery at end of life

Charger ölçüm, battery load test, gereki.en: Test the charger, load-test the battery and renew it if necessary.

Tehlike butonuna kazara basılırsa hemen.en: If the distress button is pressed by mistake, cancel the DSC alert and send a voice cancellation message to the coast station at once.

EPIRB hidrostatik release ünitesi (HRU).en: The EPIRB hydrostatic release unit (HRU) must be within its expiry date.

Telsiz odasında reserve power source ve.en: Keep the reserve source of energy and the batteries for the radio installation fully charged.

Radyo arıza günlüğü ve onarım kayıtları.en: The radio fault log and repair records are asked for at PSC inspections.

DSC çağrısı: sender MMSI, alıcı MMSI/all.en: A DSC call contains: sender MMSI, addressee MMSI or all ships, category (distress/urgency/safety/routine), position and nature of distress.

VHF DSC distress alert acknowledgement a.en: If a VHF DSC distress alert is not acknowledged, the set may automatically repeat it after about 3.5–4.5 minutes; do not confuse this with the 'five consecutive transmissions' of the MF/HF formats, and watch the maker's display.

Distress alert sonrasında telsiz Ch 16'y.en: After a distress alert, the radio switches automatically to Ch 16 and a MAYDAY by voice is expected.

Power on, GPS feed ve self-test kontrol..en: Check power on, the GPS input and the self-test.

Ch 16 ve Ch 70 daima açık (silent watch).en: Ch 16 and Ch 70 are always monitored (listening watch).

Çağrı için uygun channel/power seç, dinl.en: For a call, choose a suitable channel and power, listen first, press the PTT and speak briefly using SMCP and radio procedure; do not hold the carrier unnecessarily.

Distress için nature/position/time otoma.en: For a distress alert, check the nature, position and time data (automatic or manual) and hold the guarded DISTRESS button down for the time marked on the set.

Test çağrısını gemi planı ve coast-stati.en: Make test calls according to the ship's plan and the coast station's instructions; record the acknowledgement or failure in the radio log.

Volume/squelch, hoparlör arızası.en: Volume or squelch setting, speaker fault

Ayar test, hoparlör değişim..en: Check the settings; renew the speaker.

Anten/connection korozyon, başka cihaz i.en: Corroded antenna or connections, interference from other equipment

Anten konnektör temizlik, EMI kaynak izo.en: Clean the antenna connector and isolate the source of interference.

MMSI yok, GPS feed yok, Ch 70 başka ciha.en: No MMSI, no GPS input, Ch 70 in use by another unit

MMSI ayar, GPS bağlantı, conflict çöz..en: Set the MMSI, connect the GPS and resolve the conflict.

Ch 16 sürekli dinlenmeli (silent watch)..en: Keep a continuous listening watch on Ch 16.

Yanlış DSC çağrısı: hemen Ch 16'da sesli.en: False DSC alert: broadcast a voice cancellation on Ch 16 at once and record it in the log.

Anten/feedline sağlığını forward/reflect.en: Trend the condition of the antenna and feeder from forward and reflected power or the maker's BIT; take the VSWR alarm and acceptance values from the maker's manual, and do not take unauthorised measurements on a live antenna line.

Frekans seçilir, ATU ground plane ile an.en: Once the frequency is selected, the ATU tunes the antenna and ground plane to 50 Ω.

DSC modülü tehlike çağrısını dijital ola.en: The DSC module modulates the distress call digitally (PSK).

Sahil veya gemi DSC alarmı ile uyarılır;.en: Coast stations and ships are alerted by the DSC alarm; the MAYDAY is received on the voice channel.

NBDP mod: ARQ (otomatik tekrar isteği) i.en: NBDP mode: error-free telex exchange using ARQ (automatic repeat request).

Gemi pozisyonuna göre uygun band seç (ya.en: Choose the band to suit the ship's position (MF for short range, HF for long range).

Self-test ve live DSC testini Radio Log.en: Carry out the self-test and the live DSC test according to the radio log procedure and the maker's instructions; record coast station availability and any acknowledgement received.

Distress: nature, position/time ve uygun.en: Distress: select the nature, position and time and the appropriate call attempt; hold the guarded distress button down for the time marked on the set and watch the DSC and voice follow-up display.

Ack alındıktan sonra voice frekansa geç.en: After the acknowledgement, change to the voice frequency and give the details.

Anten kopuk, ground bağlantısı zayıf, AT.en: Antenna broken, poor ground connection, ATU fault

Anten süreklilik, ground bond temizlik,.en: Test antenna continuity, clean the ground bond and service the ATU.

Final amplifier zayıflamış, anten verim.en: Weak final amplifier, poor antenna efficiency

PA test, anten VSWR ölçüm..en: Test the PA and measure the antenna VSWR.

Mekanik veya kağıt rulosu.en: Mechanism or paper roll at fault

Kağıt yenile, mekanik temizlik..en: Fit a new paper roll and clean the mechanism.

Yüksek voltajlı PA modülü; servis sırası.en: The PA module carries high voltage; the capacitors must be discharged before servicing.

Anten yakın çalışan personel için RF rad.en: There is an RF radiation hazard for anyone working near the antenna; keep clear while transmitting.

Frekans çakışmasını önlemek için ITU pla.en: Follow the ITU frequency plan to avoid conflicts.

GPS pozisyonu otomatik enjekte; mesajla.en: The GPS position is inserted automatically and sent with the message.

Store-and-forward: gemi LES'e iletir, LE.en: Store-and-forward: the ship sends to the LES and the LES forwards to the addressee; it is not real-time.

Distress: tek tuş ile RCC'ye iletilir, a.en: Distress: sent to the RCC with one button, and an acknowledgement is received.

Login durumu ve LES seçimi günlük kontro.en: Check the login status and LES selection daily.

EGC mesajları printer çıktısı veya scree.en: EGC messages appear as printouts or in the screen log; check them every watch.

Distress test: gemi VHF'inden RCC'ye tel.en: Distress test: a live test is possible after informing the RCC by VHF or telephone.

Login yok, LES dışında, anten obstructio.en: Not logged in, outside LES coverage, antenna obstructed

Login yap, LES seç, anten önündeki obstr.en: Log in, select an LES and clear the obstruction in front of the antenna.

Kağıt/kartuş bitmiş, port arızası.en: Out of paper or ink, port fault

GPS testi, kablo kontrol..en: Test the GPS and check the cable.

Mesaj iletim ücretli; uzun mesaj LES tar.en: Messages are charged; long messages can be expensive at LES rates.

EGC/MSI reception seçimini seyredilen NA.en: Set EGC/MSI reception for the NAVAREA/METAREA and coastal warning areas being navigated; do not use any setting that suppresses mandatory distress and urgency messages or those for the relevant area.

Antenna 360° serbest açıya sahip olmalı;.en: The antenna must have a clear view through 360°; do not mount it behind a mast or the funnel.

Su ile temas → switch kapanır → 50 sn iç.en: Contact with water → the switch closes → within 50 s it starts transmitting the 406 MHz alert and the 121.5 MHz homing signal.

Cospas-Sarsat uyduları (LEO + GEO + MEO).en: Cospas-Sarsat satellites (LEO + GEO + MEO) receive the signal and relay it to an RCC.

RCC gemi sahibini ve son pozisyonu doğru.en: The RCC verifies the owner and the last position and starts SAR action.

Aylık görsel inspeksiyon: bracket sağlam.en: Monthly visual inspection: bracket sound, expiry dates checked, HRU in good order.

Self-test'i maker'ın izin verdiği test p.en: Carry out the self-test within the test window and duration the maker allows; do not drain the battery by repeating the GNSS self-test unnecessarily, and record the result displayed.

Yıllık servis: yetkili tarafından batter.en: Annual service: an authorised technician tests the battery, the GPS and the transmit power.

Gemi terk durumunda: bracket'tan al, su.en: On abandoning ship: take it from its bracket and throw it into the water, or activate it with the manual switch.

Servise gönder, gerekirse değişim..en: Send it for service and replace it if necessary.

Suya düşmüş, manuel butona basılmış.en: It has fallen into the water, or the manual button has been pressed

EPIRB'i çıkar, kapat (manuel switch off).en: Recover the EPIRB, switch it off manually and cancel the alert with the RCC by telephone.

Yanlış alarm SAR kaynaklarını bağlar; te.en: A false alert ties up SAR resources; follow the test button and test time instructions on the beacon, and if it is activated for real, switch the beacon off and cancel the alert with the RCC at once, giving its identity and position.

EPIRB'i seyir köprüsünün dışına, suyun u.en: Mount the EPIRB outside the wheelhouse where water can reach it (the HRU must work if the ship is abandoned).

Bracket etrafını boyama (HRU sıkışır)..en: Do not paint around the bracket (the HRU will stick).

Radar pulse SART'a ulaştığında SART aynı.en: When a radar pulse reaches the SART, the SART transmits a 12-pulse response on the same frequency.

Yanıt PRF artarken tek noktaya, azalırke.en: The response appears as a line of dots that turns into arcs and then concentric circles as the searching ship closes the SART.

AIS-SART aynı şekilde GPS pozisyonu ile.en: An AIS-SART likewise transmits AIS messages at intervals with its GPS position.

Aylık görsel: bracket, switch, expiry ko.en: Monthly visual check: bracket, switch, expiry date.

Aylık self-test: butona bas, LED + sesli.en: Monthly self-test: press the button; LED plus audible signal → OK.

Aktivasyon: switch açılır, 9 GHz pulse a.en: Activation: switch it on; it responds when it detects a 9 GHz radar pulse.

Yüksek bir yere asılır (lifeboat tepe ve.en: It is mounted as high as possible (on top of the lifeboat or on the liferaft's pole).

Radar ekranında görünmüyor.en: Not seen on the radar display

Çok alçak monte, 3 GHz radar kullanımı,.en: Mounted too low, an S-band (3 GHz) radar in use, or the SART not switched on

Yüksek monte, X-band radar, switch kontr.en: Mount it higher, use an X-band radar, check the switch.

Self-test'i yalnız maker işaretli süre/m.en: Carry out the self-test only for the time and in the mode the maker marks; a radar SART response can appear on nearby X-band displays and an AIS-SART test message on AIS units.

Yanlış aktivasyonda hemen kapat, RCC'ye.en: If it is activated by mistake, switch it off at once and inform the RCC.

Test sırasında diğer geminin radar ekran.en: During a test the SART may appear on other ships' radar displays, so a warning is given.

Reset interval boyunca nöbetçinin reset.en: Within each reset interval, the officer of the watch is expected to reset the system (manual button or motion sensor).

Reset alınmazsa bridge visual → bridge a.en: If there is no reset, the alarms escalate bridge visual → bridge audible → remote second and third stages, with the timing of MSC.128(75).

Gemi ECDIS, AIS gibi sistemlerden bilgi.en: It takes no data from systems such as ECDIS or AIS; it works independently.

Vardiya başında BNWAS aktif olduğunu doğ.en: At the start of the watch, confirm that the BNWAS is active.

Dormancy interval'i Master'ın protected.en: Check the dormant period against the Master's protected setting and standing orders; do not go outside the approved range of 3–12 minutes.

Underway durumunda approved operational.en: When underway, confirm from the panel and the alarm-inhibit indication that the approved operational mode really is active.

PMS testinde dormancy, bridge visual/aud.en: In the PMS test, time and verify the dormant period, the bridge visual and audible alarms, the remote call locations, the reset points and the power-failure alarm.

Hoparlör arıza, kablo bağlantı, ayar yan.en: Speaker fault, cable connection, wrong setting

Hoparlör test, hat kontrol, ayar onar..en: Test the speaker, check the wiring and correct the setting.

Reset switch arızalı, motion sensor takı.en: Faulty reset switch, motion sensor stuck

Switch test, sensor temizlik/değişim..en: Test the switch; clean or renew the sensor.

BNWAS'ı kalıcı devre dışı bırakmak SOLAS.en: Disabling the BNWAS permanently breaches SOLAS and is a serious PSC deficiency.

Reset için sahte düzenek (bantlı buton v.en: Any device to fake the reset (a taped-down button, etc.) is forbidden.

Remote alarm location/sequence'i onaylı.en: Verify the remote alarm locations and sequence from the approved BNWAS plan; before testing, inform the Master, the bridge team and the crew who will be affected.

Tüm veri kaynakları VDR concentrator uni.en: All data sources are connected to the VDR concentrator unit.

Concentrator dahili memory'ye sürekli ya.en: The concentrator writes continuously to its internal memory (FIFO).

Kayıt aynı anda long-term medium ile ins.en: The recording is written at the same time to the long-term medium and to the fixed and float-free capsules, and kept for the retention period in the performance standard.

Kazada save butonu basılırsa tüm memory.en: If the save button is pressed after an accident, the memory is write-protected.

Power, recording, source-fault ve UTC st.en: Check the power, recording, source-fault and UTC status in the maker's or PMS routine; do not reset a fault and lose it.

Audio/source testini maker test mode ve.en: Carry out the audio and source tests in the maker's test mode and according to the APT and PMS, without disturbing the actual bridge recording.

Capsule/locating device kontrolünü APT k.en: Check the capsules and locating device according to the APT scope, expiry dates and service instructions.

Kaza/olay sonrası Master/SMS talimatıyla.en: After an accident or incident, use the save/protect function on the Master's instruction and as the SMS requires; do not switch the unit off on your own initiative, and protect the chain of custody of the data.

Kablo, mikrofon arızası, audio level düş.en: Cable or microphone fault, low audio level

Mikrofon test, kablo kontrol, ayar..en: Test the microphone, check the cable, adjust the settings.

Grabber test, kablo değiştir..en: Test the grabber and renew the cable.

Bağlantı, HRU değişim..en: Check the connection and renew the HRU.

VDR memory'ye doğrudan müdahale yasak; y.en: Tampering with the VDR memory is forbidden; unauthorised persons must not delete data.

Olay sonrası preservation, indirme ve te.en: After an incident, preserve, download and hand over the data as the company emergency procedures and the authorities instruct, and record it; do not alter the data, and act quickly against the risk of it being overwritten.

Capsule çevresini erişilebilir tut ve fi.en: Keep the area around the capsule accessible and confirm its survival ratings from its own type approval and markings; do not copy a single temperature or depth figure from the internet.

Davit gravity tipi: brake bırakılır, dav.en: Gravity davit: the brake is released, the davit swings out by gravity and the boat is lowered under control on the winch wire.

Free-fall: release handle çekilir, lifeb.en: Free fall: the release handle is pulled and the lifeboat slides down the ramp into the water, dives bow first and then surfaces.

Release gear, normal tahliyede tekne wat.en: In a normal launch, the release gear is used for off-load release once the boat is waterborne and the falls are unloaded; on-load release is for emergencies and special cases, and misusing it can kill.

Hydrostatic interlock, hook reset indica.en: The hydrostatic interlock, the hook reset indicator and the operating handle form one safety chain; the reset and locked state is confirmed physically at each hook following the maker's instructions.

Embarkation: launch alarm → muster stati.en: Embarkation: launch alarm → muster station → the person in charge of the lifeboat controls boarding.

Davit/winch'i assigned operator ve coxsw.en: Operate the davit and winch through the chain of command of the assigned operator and the coxswain; do not release the brake until the checklist for gripes, plug, painter, falls and lowering area is complete.

Tekne waterborne, falls unloaded ve hydr.en: Once the boat is waterborne, the falls unloaded and the hydrostatic interlock state confirmed, follow the approved off-load release procedure; cross-check the hook reset at both ends before recovery.

Free-fall launch'ta tüm kişiler numaralı.en: For a free-fall launch, everyone sits in a numbered seat with the maker-approved restraint and head support; simulated or actual launches are carried out only under the approved drill procedure.

Fren balata aşınmış, ayar bozuk.en: Worn brake lining, out of adjustment

Balata değişim, fren ayarı..en: Renew the lining and adjust the brake.

Fall wire hasarlı (kink/korozyon/broken.en: Fall wire damaged (kinks, corrosion, broken wires)

Yağlama, sheave hizası, deniz suyu veya.en: Lubrication, sheave alignment, seawater or fatigue

Tekneyi kullanımdan çıkar; SOLAS III/20,.en: Take the boat out of service; inspect or renew the falls according to SOLAS III/20, the maker's discard criteria and the approved maintenance plan, and do not apply the mistaken practice of 'turning end for end every 5 years'.

Battery zayıf, yakıt eski/su girmiş.en: Weak battery, stale fuel or water in the fuel

Battery şarj, yakıt drain ve yenile..en: Charge the battery, drain and renew the fuel.

Hook bakım, hidrostatik mekanizma test..en: Service the hooks and test the hydrostatic mechanism.

Drill/bakım sırasında secondary safety d.en: During drills and maintenance, use a secondary safety device or fall-prevention arrangement only as described in the maker's and MSC.402 procedures; never interfere with a hook under load.

Free-fall release sırasında baş ve boyun.en: During a free-fall release, the head and neck must be supported from behind and a lifejacket worn.

Davit altındaki bölgede personel olmasın.en: Keep people away from the area under the davit (risk of a falling boat if there is no limit switch).

Yağlama düzenli; korozyon ve sıkışma kaz.en: Lubricate regularly; corrosion and seizing lead to accidents.

Manuel: painter line gemiden serbest bır.en: Manual: the painter stays made fast to the ship, the liferaft is thrown overboard, and a strong pull on the painter opens the CO₂ valve → the raft inflates.

Otomatik (HRU): su basıncı HRU'yu çalışt.en: Automatic (HRU): water pressure operates the HRU and frees the lashing; the container floats up, the painter made fast to the ship tightens and starts inflation, and as the ship continues to sink the weak link breaks and frees the inflated raft.

Inflation/orientation süresi çevre ve ty.en: The inflation and righting time depends on the conditions and the type approval; if the raft inflates upside down, use the marked righting strap and procedure.

Aylık görsel: canister sağlam, painter b.en: Monthly visual check: canister sound, painter attached, HRU in date, lashing and cradle sound.

Yıllık servis: yetkili istasyona gönder,.en: Annual service: send it to an approved service station and obtain the certificate.

Drill'de manuel atış simülasyonu (gerçek.en: In drills, simulate manual launching (not an actual deployment — it is expensive).

Manual launch'ta painter'ın gemiye doğru.en: For a manual launch, check that the painter is made fast to a strong point on the ship, throw the container clear of obstructions and pull the painter until the firing head operates; board dry by embarkation ladder or davit if possible, and treat jumping into the sea as the last resort.

Yeniden bağla, weak link kontrol..en: Reattach it and check the weak link.

Liferaft konteyneri etrafında istif/eşya.en: Keep the area around the liferaft container clear of stores and gear; it must float free if the ship sinks.

HRU 'weak link' painter ile gemi arasınd.en: The HRU weak link is between the painter and the ship; as the ship sinks, the painter is pulled, the raft inflates and the weak link breaks (freeing the raft).

Pyrotechnic expiry tarihini item label/s.en: Track pyrotechnic expiry dates from the item labels and the service certificate; do not assume a fixed 5 years, and hand expired items over to an approved shore disposal chain.

Liferaft yıllık servis sertifikası gemid.en: Keep the liferaft annual service certificate on board (checked by PSC).

Davit gravity ile veya hidrolik ile boat.en: The davit swings the boat out by gravity or hydraulically.

Single-fall davit ile hızlı iniş; suda q.en: A single-fall davit gives a fast launch; in the water the fall is released with the quick-release hook.

Motor start, mürettebat MOB veya raft'a.en: The engine is started and the crew head for the MOB (person overboard) or the liferaft.

Recovery: boat altına horse-collar, hook.en: Recovery: the hook is connected (with a horse-collar under the boat) and the davit hoists the boat.

Vardiya başı: motor yakıt, battery, lash.en: At the start of the watch: check the engine fuel, the battery, the lashings and the painter.

Launch alarm: 2 kişi rescue boat'a, davi.en: Launch alarm: 2 crew board the rescue boat, the davit operator starts the hydraulics and the boat is lowered to the water.

Suda motor start, görev yap, geri dön, h.en: In the water: start the engine, carry out the task, return, hook on and hoist with the davit.

Launch/manoeuvre drill ile annual/five-y.en: Carry out launching and manoeuvring drills, and the annual and five-yearly examinations and tests of the davit and release gear, separately as SOLAS III/19-20, MSC.402 and the maker's maintenance plan require.

Yakıt eski, buji kirli, primer pump hata.en: Stale fuel, dirty spark plug, faulty primer pump

Yakıt yenile, buji temizlik, pump test..en: Renew the fuel, clean the spark plug, test the pump.

Yağ az, pompa zayıf, valf takılı.en: Low oil, weak pump, sticking valve

Yağ ekle, pompa servis, valf bakım..en: Top up the oil, service the pump and the valve.

Boat altında personel olmamalı; düşme ri.en: Nobody may be under the boat; it may fall.

Outboard motor egzozu CO içerir; uzun sü.en: Outboard motor exhaust contains CO; do not run the engine for long periods in an enclosed area.

Recovery sırasında dalga koşullarına dik.en: Watch the sea state during recovery; a hook coming off can be fatal.

FRB/rescue-boat drill PPE'sini approved.en: Choose the PPE for fast rescue boat and rescue boat drills according to the approved boat manual, the risk assessment, the sea and weather conditions and the company procedure; check that lifejackets and communications are complete.

Operasyonu yöneten güverte zabiti; başüs.en: The deck officer in charge of the operation; the forward and aft team leaders and the authorised operator

Gemiye özgü kullanım kitabını, risk değe.en: Confirm the ship-specific operating manual, the risk assessment, the allocation of duties and the means of uninterrupted communication.

Enerji kaynağı, lokal/acil durdurma, fre.en: Check the power supply, local and emergency stops, brakes, guards, limits and leaks with no load; clear the areas where people could fall, be trapped or be struck by a recoiling line or chain.

Uygunsa kaldırma donanımı sicili, SWL ve.en: Where applicable, the register of lifting appliances, SWL and certificates

1 Ocak 2026'dan itibaren kaldırma donanı.en: Safety of lifting appliances and anchor handling winches from 1 January 2026; applicability depends on the equipment

Gemiye özel limit, komuta zinciri ve emn.en: Ship-specific limits, chain of command and safe stopping method

Köprüüstü vardiya zabiti; kritik ayar ve.en: The officer of the watch; for critical settings and deviations, the Master and bridge team management

Cihazın güç, self-test/BITE, sensör kayn.en: At watch handover, check the equipment's power, self-test/BITE, sensor sources, date and time, dimmer and alarm status.

Ayarları seyir safhası, draft/UKC politi.en: Set it up for the stage of the passage, the draft/UKC policy, visibility, traffic, chart coverage and the Master's night orders; do not take over the previous watch's settings blindly.

Arıza/servis kaydı; olaya ilişkin veriys.en: Defect and service record; VDR save if the data relate to an incident

Seyir cihazlarının gemi tipi/tonaj/yapım.en: Carriage of navigational equipment by ship type, tonnage and date of build, and keeping official charts and publications up to date

Emniyetli seyir vardiyası, gözcülük ve m.en: Safe navigational watchkeeping, lookout and proper use of all available means

Cihaz tipine özgü fonksiyon, alarm, test.en: Functions, alarms, tests and back-up arrangements specific to the type of equipment

Başmühendis gözetimindeki vardiya mühend.en: The engineer on watch under the Chief Engineer's supervision; engine control confirmed with the bridge

Yağlama, soğutma, yakıt/hava, elektrik v.en: Before starting, check the lubrication, cooling, fuel and air, electrical and control air auxiliaries, and the state of interlocks, alarms and trips.

Turning gear, çalışma izni/LOTO, persone.en: Check the turning gear, the work permit and LOTO status, personnel and tools, and bridge–engine room communication; allow remote control only once local preparation is complete.

Yakıt-yağ analizi ve klas/servis raporla.en: Fuel and oil analyses and class or service reports

Makine, elektrik, dümen ve acil durum dü.en: Machinery, electrical, steering and emergency arrangements

Emniyetli işletme, kritik ekipman, bakım.en: Safe operation, critical equipment, maintenance and handling of non-conformities

Gemi ve makine tipine özgü limit, tolera.en: Limits, tolerances and tests specific to the ship and the type of machinery

Vardiya mühendisi veya atanmış makine za.en: The engineer on watch or an assigned engineer officer; for electrical work, the ETO or other authorised personnel

Hat dizilimini P&ID üzerinden doğrula; t.en: Verify the line-up against the P&ID; check the tank levels, suction and discharge valves, vents, drains, lubrication, cooling and electrical supply.

Stand-by ünitenin gerçekten hazır olduğu.en: Confirm that the standby unit is really ready, that alarms and trips are normal and that maintenance isolations have been removed.

Kimyasal/atık/servis kaydı (sisteme uygu.en: Chemical, waste or service records (where they apply to the system)

Temel makine, elektrik, kazan, basınçlı.en: Basic provisions for machinery, electrical installations, boilers, pressure systems and fire safety

Atık veya deşarj üreten yardımcı sisteml.en: For auxiliary systems that produce waste or discharges, the relevant Annex and the approved arrangement

Hat dizilimi, interlock, normal değer ve.en: Line-up, interlocks, normal values and safe maintenance

Kaptan komutasındaki acil durum organiza.en: The emergency organisation under the Master's command; depending on the system, the Chief Engineer, officers and a trained fire party

Fire Control Plan, muster list, sabit si.en: Verify the ship-specific fire control plan, muster list, fixed system release procedure, evacuation of the space and communications.

Valf/izolasyon konumu, güç kaynağı, alar.en: Check visually, without disturbing any seals, the valve and isolation positions, the power supply, alarms, cylinder or tank pressure or pump readiness, and the access seals.

Fire/LSA bakım kontrol listesi ve PMS.en: Fire and LSA maintenance checklist and PMS

Yetkili servis, dolum, hidrostatik test.en: Report of an authorised service, recharging, hydrostatic test or inspection

Yangının önlenmesi, algılanması, sınırla.en: Fire prevention, detection, containment and extinction

Sabit ve seyyar yangın sistemlerinin tek.en: Technical arrangement of fixed and portable fire systems

Gemiye özgü mahal, vana, uzaktan kapatma.en: Ship-specific spaces, valves, remote shut-offs and release sequence

Kaptan gözetiminde birinci zabit/cargo o.en: The Chief Officer or cargo officer under the Master's supervision, coordinating with the terminal and the engine control room

Onaylı cargo/operations manual, loading.en: Verify the approved cargo or operations manual, the loading plan, the ship/shore safety checklist, communications and the emergency stop method together.

Hat, tank/ambar, valf, vent, seviye-bası.en: Before the operation, confirm the lines, tanks or holds, valves, vents, level and pressure alarms, closing arrangements and the appropriate gas measurements.

Cargo log/Statement of Facts ve checklis.en: Cargo log, statement of facts and checklist

CSM, test sertifikası, PMS ve defect rep.en: CSM, test certificate, PMS and defect report

Yük bilgisi, istifleme, sabitleme ve teh.en: Provisions on cargo information, stowage, securing and dangerous goods

Gemi ve yük tipine uygulanabilen çevre v.en: Environmental and cargo codes applicable to the ship and the type of cargo

Gemiye özgü hat, limit, ESD ve operasyon.en: Ship-specific lines, limits, ESD and operating sequence

Başmühendis/atanmış mühendis; kayıt ve d.en: The Chief Engineer or an assigned engineer; MARPOL/BWM responsibility shared with the Master for records and discharge decisions

Onaylı plan/operating manual, sertifika,.en: Verify the approved plan or operating manual, certificates, calibration, sampling points and line-up against the actual pipework.

Bypass veya mühürlü vana durumunu, sensö.en: Check the state of bypasses and sealed valves, the sensor and alarm self-test and the tank capacity; do not start the operation just because the equipment is type-approved.

İlgili resmî record book ve elektronik k.en: The relevant official record book and electronic records

PMS, tank sounding ve reception facility.en: PMS, tank soundings and reception facility receipt

Sistemin ürettiği deşarj, atık veya emis.en: Provisions that apply to the discharges, waste or emissions the system produces

Balast yönetim planı, D-2 standardı ve k.en: Ballast water management plan, the D-2 standard and records

Type-approved sistemin gemiye özgü çalış.en: The ship-specific operating envelope and limitations of the type-approved system

Kaptan gözetimindeki GOC/ROC yetkili tel.en: The radio operator holding a GOC/ROC, or the assigned LSA officer, under the Master's supervision; for life-saving, the duties on the muster list

Gemi sertifikası, sea area, ekipman kiml.en: Check the ship's certificate, the sea area, the equipment identity and MMSI, the reserve power, the self-test and the date, time and position input.

LSA için erişim, securing, release/HRU,.en: For LSA, verify access, securing, the release gear or HRU, the weekly and monthly checks and the authorised service dates against the maker's instructions; never improvise a hazardous release test.

Radio log veya GMDSS test kaydı.en: Radio log or GMDSS test record

LSA haftalık/aylık kontrol ve drill kayd.en: LSA weekly and monthly inspection and drill records

Batarya/HRU/servis sertifikası ve PMS.en: Battery, HRU and service certificates and the PMS

Can kurtarma araçları, hazır bulundurma,.en: Life-saving appliances, readiness, maintenance and drills

Modernize GMDSS fonksiyonları, deniz ala.en: Modernised GMDSS functions, sea areas and radio equipment

Filika/rescue boat, launching appliance.en: Authorisation for the maintenance and testing of lifeboats, rescue boats, launching appliances and release gear

Windlass statik demirleme yükünü tek baş.en: The windlass is not left to carry the static load of the ship at anchor on its own; the brake, the clutch and the chain stopper each have their own job and do not replace one another.

Zincirin yönü, şakül/marka, hız, yük ve.en: Watch the lead of the cable, the shackle marks, the speed, the load and the angle at which the cable leaves the seabed together.

Fren sıcaklığı, hidrolik basınç/kaçak, m.en: Follow the trend of brake temperature, hydraulic pressure and leaks, motor current, and any unusual noise or vibration.

Köprü ile her komutta kapalı çevrim repe.en: Use closed-loop repeat-back with the bridge for every order; compare the observed movement of the cable with the control indicator.

Demir yerine oturduğunda yükün stopper'a.en: Once the anchor is home or brought up, confirm physically that the load has been transferred to the stopper; do not rely on the brake lever position alone.

Kontrolsüz zincir kaçırma, fren tutmamas.en: Do not continue if the cable runs out of control, the brake does not hold or anyone enters the line of the cable.

Basınç/akım ani yükselmesi, zincirin haw.en: Stop and call the Master on a sudden rise in pressure or current, if the cable sits wrongly in the hawse pipe or if communication is lost.

Gerçek bir demir ırgadı örneği. Wildcat,.en: An example of a real windlass. The arrangement of the wildcat, clutch, band brake and chain stopper varies from ship to ship; a photograph is not an operating diagram.

SWL tek bir evrensel kapasite değildir;.en: The SWL is not one universal capacity; the outreach, boom angle, weight of the grab or spreader, dynamic loading, trim and list and the wind all change what the load chart allows.

Load chart, outreach, kanca yüksekliği,.en: Watch the load chart, the outreach, the hook height, the spooling of the wire, and the brake and limit indicators as the load moves.

Rüzgâr, gemi hareketi, side-pull, yük sa.en: Keep reassessing the wind, the ship's motion, side pull, the swing of the load and the quality of communications.

Yük ağırlığı ve loose gear toplamını bel.en: Confirm the weight of the load plus the loose gear from documents or tags; never lift a load of unknown weight on a guess.

Yüksüz fonksiyon-fren-limit testi ile fi.en: With an off-load function, brake and limit test, check that the movement matches the direction of the control.

Overload/limit alarmı, fren kaydırması,.en: Make the load safe on an overload or limit alarm, brake slip, wire damage, anyone under the load, or loss of communication.

Beklenmeyen list/trim, çatlak/deformasyo.en: If there is unexpected list or trim, cracking or deformation, a hydraulic leak or an unusual noise, do not continue until a competent person has examined it.

Gemi güverte vinci örneği. Doğru kapasit.en: An example of a ship's deck crane. The real capacity comes from that crane's load chart, its SWL marking and the records of certified loose gear, not from a photograph.

Auto-tension her rıhtım operasyonunda gü.en: Auto-tension is not a safe default for every berth; if the ship and terminal procedures and the mooring pattern do not suit it, lines can pay out and heave in one after another.

Halat lead'i, katmanlanma, aşınma, eşit.en: Watch the lead of the line, how it lies on the drum, chafe, even load sharing and the direction of snap-back.

Fren tutma, render/tension göstergesi, g.en: Assess the brake holding, the render and tension indicators, changes in tide and draft, and the effect of wind and current together.

Mooring planındaki hat fonksiyonunu ve d.en: On deck, confirm the function of each line in the mooring plan and that the right fairleads and bollards are used.

Fren test sonucu ile üretici/design MBL.en: Compare the brake test result with the setting based on the maker's or design MBL; do not tighten the brake by feel alone.

Personel bight/snap-back alanındaysa, ha.en: Stop the winch if anyone is in a bight or snap-back zone, if the line is jumping or if communication is lost.

Fren kayması, pedestal/fairlead deformas.en: On brake slip, deformation of a pedestal or fairlead, or serious damage to the line, transfer the load under control to another line and report it.

Bir mooring winch kurulum örneği. Tambur.en: An example of a mooring winch installation. The drum, split drum, warping head and brake arrangement vary from ship to ship; a safe area is more than a fixed painted strip.

Cleat'leri aşırı sıkmak hasarlı conta, c.en: Overtightening the cleats does not make up for damaged packing, a damaged compression bar or blocked drains; a hose or ultrasonic test result means something only if the correct procedure is followed.

Panel hizası, teker/ray, hidrolik kaçak,.en: Watch the panel alignment, wheels and rails, hydraulic leaks, cross-joints, compression of the packing and the drain channel.

Kapatmada cleat yükünü dengeli uygula; c.en: When closing, apply the cleats evenly; check the coaming, the drain non-return valves and the access hatches together.

Kapanma sonrası fiziksel kilit/cleat poz.en: After closing, have two people walk round to confirm the position of the locks and cleats and that the drains are clear.

Yük/hava riskine göre yetkin kişiyle ult.en: Depending on the cargo and weather risk, have a competent person carry out an ultrasonic test or an approved hose test; do not mistake a chalk test for a weathertightness test.

Panel hareket alanında kişi/engel, hizas.en: Stop the movement if there is a person or obstruction in the path of the panels, a panel out of line or a safety interlock fault.

Çatlak, kalıcı deformasyon, conta hattın.en: If there is cracking, permanent deformation, serious leakage along the packing line or a locking failure, refer the decision to sail to the Master and the class process.

Gerçek bir ambar kapağı örneği. Fotoğraf.en: An example of a real hatch cover. The photograph shows the general appearance of the type; weathertightness depends on the packing, compression bar, cross-joints and drains all working together.

Capstan halatı kilitleyen bir depolama t.en: A capstan is not a storage drum that locks the line; as the number of turns increases, both the holding force and the risk of jamming or riding turns grow.

Halatın düzgün turunu, kuyruk tarafındak.en: Watch that the turns lie properly, where the person tailing the line stands, and for the start of a riding turn.

Motor yükü, warping head yüzeyi, ayak ku.en: Keep checking the motor load, the surface of the warping head, the return of the foot control and communications.

Halat lead'inin capstan eksenine uygun v.en: Before the operation, confirm that the lead of the line suits the capstan axis and that the fairlead is clean.

Kumandayı bıraktığında hareketin kesildi.en: Test off load that the capstan stops when the control is released; do not count switching the main breaker as a test.

Halat üst üste binmeye, kişinin eli/giys.en: Stop at once if the turns start to ride over each other, a hand or clothing comes close, or control of the tail is being lost.

Kumanda takılması, frenlememe, anormal s.en: If the control sticks, the brake fails, temperatures are abnormal or the pedestal is cracked, apply LOTO and report it.

Dikey capstan/warping head örneği. Halat.en: An example of a vertical capstan or warping head. The direction of the turns and the operator's safe position depend on the ship's actual fairlead arrangement.

Radar her hedefi garanti ederek gösterme.en: Radar does not guarantee to show every target; clutter settings can remove a target, and the ARPA CPA/TCPA is an estimate that depends on the sensors, the tracking time and any manoeuvre by the target.

Brilliance, range, orientation/motion, g.en: Set brilliance, range, orientation and motion, gain, tuning, sea and rain clutter and pulse length to suit the conditions; check on different ranges that automatic settings are not suppressing small targets.

Relative/true vector, vector time, targe.en: Do not base decisions on CPA/TCPA without reading the relative or true vectors, the vector time, the target history, the acquisition status and the heading and speed sensors.

Hedefi görsel kerteriz, ikinci radar, AI.en: Cross-check a target with visual bearings, the second radar, its AIS identity and, if possible, the chart or parallel indexing; do not mistake an AIS symbol for a radar echo.

EBL/VRM ve paralel index'i sabit harita.en: Check the EBL/VRM and parallel indexes against a fixed charted object; if the heading marker, antenna alignment or range and bearing accuracy is in doubt, carry out a performance check.

Heading veya speed input kaybı, yanlış m.en: If the heading or speed input is lost, the motion or vector mode is wrong, the radar or antenna fails, or there is obvious misalignment, do not trust the ARPA result and call the Master.

Kötü görüşte hedef algısı yetersizse saf.en: If detection of targets is poor in restricted visibility, reassess the safe speed, reinforce the lookout and set up the team for early and substantial action in line with COLREG.

Radar performance/PM ve compass bearing.en: Radar performance monitor (PM) and compass bearing check records

Passage plan üzerindeki PI/clearing rang.en: Parallel index and clearing range information in the passage plan

Gemi radarlarının revize performans stan.en: Revised performance standards for shipborne radar

Gözcülük, emniyetli hız, çatışma riski,.en: Look-out, safe speed, risk of collision, action to avoid collision and restricted visibility

Radar/ARPA kullanımı ve emniyetli köprüü.en: Use of radar/ARPA and safe navigational watchkeeping

X-band bir radar PPI/ARPA konsolu örneği.en: An example of an X-band radar PPI/ARPA console. The green echoes on the screen show the real surroundings; the maker's interface may be old, but the logic of range, gain, clutter, EBL/VRM, vectors and trails applies to current radars too.

ECDIS kendi başına emniyetli rota üretme.en: ECDIS does not produce a safe route by itself; it meets the chart carriage requirement only when type approval, official and up-to-date data, correct use and an adequate independent backup arrangement are all in place.

Appraisal'da tüm rota için resmî ENC kap.en: At appraisal, check official ENC coverage, usage bands and scales, permits and update status for the whole route; at planning, check the safety depth and contour, XTD, look-ahead, no-go areas, wheel-over points and abort points.

Monitoring sırasında seçili position/hea.en: During monitoring, watch the selected position, heading and speed sources, chart scale and overscale, off-track, safety contour and special-condition alerts; do not acknowledge an alarm without understanding its cause.

Primary GNSS mevkiini radar/visual fix,.en: Cross-check the primary GNSS position with radar or visual fixes, a second independent PNT source or another suitable method; do not treat the radar overlay alignment as independent proof of position.

Automatic route check sonrasında rotayı.en: After the automatic route check, inspect the route visually leg by leg at the largest suitable ENC scale; take action as the mariner for isolated dangers, CATZOC and data quality, SCAMIN and temporary or preliminary information.

Resmî kapsam/permit/update yokluğu, upda.en: Do not approve the plan if official coverage, permits or updates are missing, an update is rejected, the datum or PNT is in doubt or the backup arrangement cannot be used; refer it to the Master and the company procedure.

Position jump/freeze, heading uyuşmazlığ.en: On a position jump or freeze, a heading mismatch, a safety alarm or an unplanned deviation, first bring the ship into a safe navigational condition; do not make following the route line on the screen an automatic reflex.

ENC update report, permit ve update reje.en: ENC update reports, permits and records of rejected updates

Master-approved passage plan/revision ve.en: Master-approved passage plan and revisions, and records of alarms and position cross-checks

1 Ocak 2009-31 Aralık 2025 arasında kuru.en: Revised performance standard for ECDIS installed between 1 January 2009 and 31 December 2025

1 Ocak 2026-2028 kurulumlarında alternat.en: An alternative for installations from 1 January 2026 to 2028; from 1 January 2029, the standard for new S-100 ECDIS

ECDIS için iyi uygulama, data/maintenanc.en: Good practice for ECDIS, and data, maintenance and training roles

Gösterim, ENC veri/koruma ve denizci kul.en: Display, ENC data and protection, and guidance for mariners

Ortadaki ekran ECDIS, yanlardaki ekranla.en: The centre screen is the ECDIS and the side screens are radar consoles. The photograph shows ECDIS within an integrated bridge; chart colours and menus vary with the maker and the standard, but official data, safety settings and independent position checking do not change.

AIS hedef tespit sensörü değildir; yanlı.en: AIS is not a target detection sensor; its data may be wrong, delayed, wrongly entered by hand or not transmitted at all, and it cannot carry a COLREG decision on its own.

MMSI/call sign/IMO, draft, destination,.en: Keep the MMSI, call sign, IMO number, draft, destination, ETA and navigational status correct for the voyage; monitor the sensor status and the age of the position.

CPA/TCPA ve association durumunu radar e.en: Compare the CPA/TCPA and the association status with the radar echo; check whether one target is showing as two symbols or has been wrongly associated.

AIS kimliğini radar echo/bearing-range v.en: Match the AIS identity with the radar echo, its bearing and range, and visual observation; prove that the ship named on the screen is the physical target.

Own-ship yayınını uygun test/shore repor.en: Verify own ship's transmission by a suitable test, a shore report or a second receiver as the procedure lays down; the decision to switch off for security reasons is the Master's, and is recorded.

Yanlış own-ship identity/position, sürek.en: If own ship's identity or position is wrong, there is a continuous TX alarm or spoofing is suspected, stop using the data for decisions and inform the Master.

Hedef manevrası AIS ile radar arasında u.en: If a target's manoeuvre does not agree between AIS and radar, go back to radar plotting and visual information; do not let a VHF agreement replace your COLREG obligations.

Bir Class A AIS MKD örneği. Bu fiziksel.en: An example of a Class A AIS minimum keyboard and display (MKD). This unit is only the minimum display; on a modern ship AIS data are mostly shown on the ECDIS or radar, and they are still not radar echoes.

GNSS ekrandaki hassasiyet kadar doğru ka.en: GNSS cannot be assumed to be as accurate as the decimals on the display; the antenna and multipath, geometry, augmentation, jamming or spoofing and the datum all affect the result.

Kullanılan constellation, datum, positio.en: Monitor the constellation in use, the datum, the age of the position, HDOP, quality and RAIM, and the alarm indications, as the stage of the passage requires.

COG/SOG'nin düşük hızdaki oynaklığını he.en: Distinguish the unsteadiness of COG/SOG at low speed from the heading and log data; remember that one GNSS source feeding every system can create a common error.

Mevkiyi radar/visual/terrestrial fix ve.en: Cross-check the position with radar, visual or terrestrial fixes and, if possible, an independent antenna and receiver; seeing the same coordinates on two screens is not independent verification.

Jamming/spoofing şüphesinde zaman, COG/S.en: If jamming or spoofing is suspected, check the time, COG/SOG, AIS targets, the radar overlay and the alignment of charted objects together.
