Ani position jump, imkânsız hız/rota, in.en: On a sudden position jump, an impossible speed or course, an integrity alarm or the same error on more than one GNSS, stop relying on the autopilot or track control and call the Master.

Kıyı yaklaşmasında doğrulanamayan mevkiy.en: When approaching the coast, do not rely on appearing to be within the planned XTD with a position you cannot verify; go back to a safe speed, safe sea room and manual fixing.

Köprüüstü GNSS alıcısı örneği. Ekrandaki.en: An example of a bridge GNSS receiver. The coordinates on the display are not proof of accuracy; read the quality and integrity indications together with an independent position check.

Gyro ve manyetik pusula farklı kuzey ref.en: The gyro and magnetic compasses have different north references and different errors; repeaters all showing the same value does not prove that the master compass is right.

Master-repeater farkı, gyro alarmı, lati.en: Watch for differences between master and repeaters, gyro alarms, the latitude and speed inputs, and on the magnetic compass for bubbles, freedom of movement and the effect of deviation.

Her vardiya ve belirgin rota/enlem/hız d.en: Check the trend of compass error by a practicable method every watch and after any significant change of course, latitude or speed; do not treat a single observation as absolute.

Gyro error'ı celestial azimuth/amplitude.en: Find the gyro error from a celestial azimuth or amplitude or a reliable transit; work out the magnetic compass error by separating variation and deviation.

Steering, radar ve ECDIS heading değerle.en: Compare the headings at the steering position, radar and ECDIS with the master and repeaters; tell a distribution fault apart from a compass fault.

Heading jump, repeater uyumsuzluğu veya.en: On a heading jump, a repeater mismatch or a gyro error that cannot be checked, come off automatic or track steering in a controlled way and set up back-up navigation by the magnetic compass.

Manyetik pusula yakınına yeni ferromanye.en: If new ferromagnetic or electrical equipment has been placed near the magnetic compass, do not trust the old card until the deviation has been checked.

Fotoğraf bir gyro repeater/azimuth circl.en: The photograph shows a gyro repeater with an azimuth circle; it should not be confused with a magnetic compass binnacle. The master gyro, the repeaters and the magnetic compass each have their own error checks.

Echo sounder charted depth veya tam UKC.en: The echo sounder reading is neither the charted depth nor the full UKC; draft, transducer offset, tide, squat and heel and the speed of sound are dealt with separately.

Range, gain, frequency, keel/transducer.en: Monitor the range, gain, frequency, keel or transducer offset, shallow-water alarm and bottom lock against the actual depth of water.

Aeration, heavy weather, soft mud, steep.en: Recognise false traces from aeration, heavy weather, soft mud, a steep bottom and second-trace echoes; notice when automatic ranging loses the bottom.

Gösterim referansını gemi draftı/offset.en: Verify the display reference against the ship's draft and the offset documentation; do not confuse 'below keel', 'below transducer' and 'below surface'.

Charted depth+tide ile ölçümü trend olar.en: Compare the trend of the reading with charted depth plus tide; where they differ, consider survey quality, squat, heel and sound velocity.

Sığ su alarmı, bottom loss veya beklenme.en: On a shallow-water alarm, loss of the bottom or an unexpected rapid shoaling, call the Master and reassess speed, course and the UKC plan.

Offset bilinmiyorsa ekrandaki sayıyı UKC.en: If the offset is not known, do not report the figure on the display as the UKC; do not continue the approach without a reliable back-up measurement or enough sea room.

Tarihî kâğıt kayıtlı bir echo sounder ör.en: This is an older echo sounder with a paper recorder; modern bridges use colour digital displays. What matters in training is the transducer reference, gain and range, the bottom echo and the distinction from UKC.

Tek bir exhaust temperature veya scaveng.en: There is no universal normal value for exhaust temperature or scavenge pressure; read the trend between cylinders against the maker's limits.

Silindir egzoz sıcaklığı farkı, scavenge.en: Trend the differences in cylinder exhaust temperatures, scavenge pressure and temperature, Pmax and IMEP, bearing and LO readings and the behaviour of the turbocharger together.

Slow steaming, manevra ve yük artışında.en: During slow steaming, manoeuvring and load increases, observe the limits on thermal load, excess air, liner lubrication and the torsional barred speed range.

Otomasyon değerini lokal gösterge/indepe.en: Verify automation readings against local gauges, independent thermometers and pressure gauges, and by comparing cylinders.

Köprü telegraph komutu, governor/fuel in.en: Confirm in a closed loop the bridge telegraph order, the governor and fuel index and the actual rpm or pitch response.

Crankcase oil mist, scavenge fire işaret.en: On crankcase oil mist, signs of a scavenge fire, a severe bearing temperature, loss of LO or overspeed, follow the maker's emergency response.

Anormal vuruntu, hızlı egzoz sapması vey.en: On abnormal knocking, a rapid exhaust temperature deviation or metal particles, reduce the load safely; the decision on restarting or inspection is the Chief Engineer's.

Düşük devirli iki zamanlı ana makinenin.en: An example of the top platform and cylinder covers of a slow-speed two-stroke main engine. The internal cycle and the flow of oil, air and fuel must be read from the system diagram.

Ana tahrik ve genset uygulamasında gover.en: Governor, load sharing and gearbox limits differ between propulsion and generator applications; automatic load acceptance does not replace mechanical preparation.

Egzoz sıcaklık balansı, charge air, LO/C.en: Monitor exhaust temperature balance, charge air, LO and CW, crankcase, turbocharger speed and generator or gearbox load together.

Start-stop sayısı, düşük yükte kurum/wet.en: Manage the number of starts and stops, carbon build-up and wet stacking at low load, and the effect of sudden load steps within the maker's limits.

Lokal basınç/sıcaklığı otomasyonla karşı.en: Compare local pressures and temperatures with the automation; prove the result of a cylinder cut-out or load balance with the exhaust trend.

Clutch/gear veya breaker bağlantısından.en: Before engaging the clutch or gearbox or closing the breaker, verify the rpm, phase and load sharing and the permissives.

LO loss, overspeed, crankcase mist, cool.en: On loss of LO, overspeed, crankcase mist, cooling failure or severe knocking, shut down safely without bypassing the protection.

Start air/fuel leak, misfire veya yük pa.en: On a starting air or fuel leak, misfiring or unstable load sharing, plan the changeover to the standby engine and inform the Chief Engineer.

Orta devirli dört zamanlı motor örneği..en: An example of a medium-speed four-stroke engine. The generator or propulsion connection and the valve and turbocharger arrangement vary with the model.

Bearing sıcaklığının normal olması align.en: A normal bearing temperature does not on its own prove that the alignment, wear-down and stern tube seals are sound.

Bearing temperature, vibration, stern tu.en: Trend bearing temperatures, vibration, stern tube oil level and pressure, seal leakage and the behaviour of the couplings and shaft against rpm and load.

Hull deflection, draft/trim ve sıcaklık.en: In maintenance, take into account the effect of hull deflection, draft, trim and temperature changes on the alignment readings.

Sensör trendini lokal inspection, oil sa.en: Cross-check the sensor trend with local inspection, oil samples, wear-down or poker gauge readings and the class and maker's tolerances.

Vibration artışını motor combustion, pro.en: Do not replace parts before working out whether rising vibration comes from engine combustion, propeller fouling or damage, or shaft alignment.

Hızlı bearing temp artışı, metalik ses,.en: On a rapid rise in bearing temperature, a metallic noise, a large oil loss or seal leak, or severe vibration, reduce rpm safely and inform the Chief Engineer.

Shaft earth/grounding veya turning gear.en: After a fault in the shaft earthing device or the turning gear interlock, do not return to normal operation without an assessment by the maker or class.

Makine dairesindeki şaft hattı ve yatak.en: An example of the shaft line and a bearing in the engine room. The photograph shows the outside only; thrust transmission, the stern tube and alignment readings are understood from the diagram.

Pitch, rpm ve güç tek başına itme/verim.en: Pitch, rpm and power on their own are not thrust or efficiency; wake, slip, cavitation, fouling, draft and the sea state all change the result.

Shaft rpm/power, CPP pitch feedback, vib.en: Monitor shaft rpm and power, CPP pitch feedback, vibration, speed and slip, and the stern tube and gearbox load together.

Cavitation/ventilation işaretleri, ağır.en: Assess signs of cavitation or ventilation, racing in heavy weather and the barred speed range for the operating conditions.

Pitch command-feedback'i ve shaft power'.en: Compare the pitch command and feedback and the shaft power with the sea trial or baseline trend; do not diagnose a propeller fault from loss of speed alone.

Underwater damage/fouling şüphesini vibr.en: Confirm suspected underwater damage or fouling with the vibration spectrum, the fuel–power–speed trend and a suitable inspection.

Pitch runaway/feedback mismatch, severe.en: On pitch runaway or a feedback mismatch, severe vibration or reaching the shaft torque limit, reduce the load in coordination between bridge and engine room.

Blade/hub oil leak ya da grounding sonra.en: After a blade or hub oil leak, or a grounding, do not use high power until class or the maker has examined it.

Pervane ve dümen kurulum örneği. Blade g.en: An example of a propeller and rudder installation. Blade geometry, pitch and tip clearance cannot be measured from a photograph; the approved drawings and survey data are used.

Rudder angle indicator komutu değil gerç.en: The rudder angle indicator must show the actual feedback, not the order; autopilot performance is no substitute for the steering gear safety test.

Command-actual rudder farkı, pump pressu.en: Monitor the difference between ordered and actual rudder, pump pressure and temperature, oil level and leaks, hunting and response time.

Heavy weather veya düşük hızda dümen etk.en: In heavy weather or at low speed, assess the effect of the rudder together with propulsion and wake; do not keep the rudder loaded against the limit stops.

Pre-departure steering testinde full mov.en: In the pre-departure steering gear test, physically verify full movement, timing, the pumps, remote, local and emergency control, the indicators, the alarms and communications between bridge and steering gear room.

Gyro/autopilot hatasını lokal follow-up/.en: Tell a gyro or autopilot fault apart using local follow-up and non-follow-up control and the actual rudder feedback.

Rudder response kaybı, hydraulic burst/l.en: On loss of rudder response, a hydraulic burst or leak, conflicting indicators or hunting that cannot be controlled, follow the emergency steering procedure and call the Master.

Bir güç ünitesi arızasında kalan kapasit.en: If one power unit fails, do not continue normal manoeuvring until you have confirmed the remaining capacity and the SOLAS and maker's limits.

Pervane arkasındaki dümen dış görünümü..en: The outside of the rudder behind the propeller. The steering gear, its rams or rotary vane and the back-up control arrangement are inside the ship and are studied on a separate diagram.

Breaker'ın kapanması güvenli paraleli te.en: Closing the breaker does not on its own prove safe parallel running; phase sequence, voltage, frequency, synchronism, reverse power protection and load sharing all work together.

kW/kVAr, current balance, voltage/freque.en: Monitor kW and kVAr, current balance, voltage and frequency, PF, winding and bearing temperatures and the engine exhaust, LO and CW readings together.

Load step, spinning reserve, preferentia.en: Manage load steps, spinning reserve, preferential tripping and standby auto-start readiness to suit the ship's operation.

Senkron koşullarını synchroscope/lamp ve.en: Verify the synchronising conditions with the synchroscope or lamps and the protection permissives; never test the phase sequence by trying to parallel.

Load sharing'i her jeneratörün kW/kVAr t.en: Cross-check load sharing against each generator's kW and kVAr response and the governor and AVR modes.

Reverse power, differential/earth fault,.en: On reverse power, a differential or earth fault, unstable frequency or voltage, or a serious engine alarm, do not bypass the protection.

Blackout riskinde kritik yükleri koru, s.en: When there is a risk of blackout, protect the essential loads, follow the standby and emergency source procedure and call the Chief Engineer.

Gemi dizel jeneratör seti örneği. Prime.en: An example of a ship's diesel generator set. The prime mover, the alternator and the MSB protection chain are separate components.

Su seviye göstergesi tek noktadan doğrul.en: A water level indication from a single point is not reliable until it has been confirmed; the low-low water and flame failure interlocks must never be bypassed for convenience.

İki bağımsız level göstergesi, steam pre.en: Trend the two independent level indications, steam pressure, flame, the FD fan and draught, feed flow and water chemistry.

Light-up/purge, burner sequence ve sudde.en: During light-up and purge, the burner sequence and sudden load changes, distinguish swell and shrink from the real water level.

Gauge glass blow-through ve independent.en: Blow through the gauge glasses and test the independent level alarm in the order the maker and the SMS lay down; do not accept the transmitter reading on its own.

Safety valve, flame scanner ve low-water.en: Prove the safety valve, flame scanner and low-water trip tests with the authorised procedure and a record.

Low-low water, flame failure sonrası yak.en: On low-low water, fuel collecting after a flame failure, a furnace blowback or a suspected tube leak, shut down and purge safely at once.

Susuz kazana doğrudan feed verme; soğutm.en: Never feed water straight into a boiler that has run dry; the Chief Engineer and the maker's procedure decide on cooling and inspection.

Gemi yardımcı kazanı örneği. Burner, fur.en: An example of a ship's auxiliary boiler. The burner, furnace, drum and safety devices cannot all be seen in a photograph of the outside.

Purifier kapasitesi nominal debi değildi.en: A purifier's capacity is not its nominal flow rate; viscosity and temperature, density, the interface setting and the actual contamination all change how well it separates.

Feed temperature/viscosity, pressure, bo.en: Monitor the feed temperature and viscosity, pressure, bowl speed, vibration, back pressure and discharge cycle.

Water seal/interface veya ALCAP water se.en: Manage the water seal and interface, or the ALCAP water sensor, using the maker's settings for the type of oil.

Clean oil sample ve drain/sludge gözlemi.en: Compare a clean oil sample and what you see at the drain and sludge outlet with the inlet condition; the absence of alarms alone is no proof of separation.

Bowl assembly, gravity disc/parring disc.en: Check the bowl assembly and the correct type and position of the gravity disc, paring disc and sealing rings against the overhaul drawing.

High vibration, abnormal bowl noise, oil.en: On high vibration, abnormal bowl noise, oil overflow or loss of speed, cut the feed and follow the maker's shutdown sequence.

Sıcak yağ kaçağında ignition kaynakların.en: If hot oil is leaking, isolate sources of ignition; do not open the bowl until it has stopped completely.

Fuel-oil separator/purifier örneği. Bowl.en: An example of a fuel oil separator (purifier). The bowl and disc stack cannot be seen in the photograph; the correct flow diagram is what matters.

Receiver basıncı tek başına hava kalites.en: Receiver pressure alone proves neither air quality nor compressor safety; discharge temperature, drains, relief valves and oil carry-over are monitored as well.

Stage pressure/temperature, cooling wate.en: Monitor stage pressures and temperatures, cooling water, LO, the unloader and the automatic drains.

Start frequency ve receiver pressure dec.en: Trend the starting frequency and the fall in receiver pressure against leakage and air demand.

Interstage gauge ve relief/non-return du.en: Compare the interstage gauge and the state of the relief and non-return valves, checked locally, with the automation.

Receiver drain condensate/oil miktarı il.en: Cross-check the quality of the discharge air and the condition of the compressor against the amount of condensate and oil drained from the receiver.

High discharge temp, relief lifting, kno.en: Stop the compressor on high discharge temperature, a relief valve lifting, knocking, loss of cooling or oil carry-over.

Receiver/line üzerinde çalışmadan pressu.en: Before working on a receiver or line, isolate the pressure, drain it and apply LOTO; do not rely on the stop button alone.

Pistonlu starting-air compressor örneği..en: An example of a reciprocating starting-air compressor. The chain of intercooler, separator, non-return valve and receiver is an essential part of the system.

Pompa tipi ve duty point eşleşmeden 'val.en: 'Open the valve and start' is not safe unless the pump type matches the duty point; centrifugal and positive-displacement pumps behave differently at shut-off.

Suction/discharge pressure, flow, motor.en: Monitor suction and discharge pressure, flow, motor current, vibration, seal leakage and bearing temperatures against the duty point.

Cavitation, loss of prime, dead-heading.en: Distinguish cavitation, loss of prime, dead-heading and the need for minimum flow according to the type of pump.

Valve lineup ve tank level'i P&ID/fiziks.en: Verify the valve line-up and tank levels against the P&ID and on a physical round; do not rely on the mimic screen alone.

Basınç farkını gerçek akış/level change.en: Cross-check the pressure difference against actual flow or change of level; after maintenance, verify the direction of rotation off load.

Dry running, cavitation, seal failure, r.en: Stop on dry running, cavitation, seal failure, a rapid rise in pressure or current, or a failure of the relief valve on a positive-displacement pump.

Kimyasal/sıcak/yanıcı akışkan kaçağında.en: If a chemical, hot or flammable liquid leaks, isolate the area and follow the appropriate PPE and permit procedure.

Makine dairesindeki santrifüj pompa örne.en: An example of a centrifugal pump in the engine room. Not every pump application is the same; read the P&ID, the pump curve and the minimum-flow arrangement.

Üretilen düşük-salinity distillate otoma.en: Low-salinity distillate is not automatically drinkable; remineralisation, disinfection and the drinking water standard are a separate chain.

Vacuum, temperatures, ejector/seawater f.en: Trend the vacuum, temperatures, ejector and seawater flow, production rate and salinity against the feed conditions.

RO'da differential pressure/conductivity.en: On an RO unit watch the differential pressure and conductivity; on an evaporator watch for scale, foaming and carry-over through the demister.

Salinometer'ı doğrulanmış sample/conduct.en: Cross-check the salinometer with a verified sample or conductivity reading; test the automatic high-salinity dump with the maker's procedure.

Potable transfer öncesi dezenfeksiyon ve.en: Before transferring to the drinking water tanks, confirm the disinfection and the laboratory or shipboard tests required by the ship's plan.

High salinity, vacuum loss, membrane pre.en: On high salinity, loss of vacuum, the membrane pressure limit being reached or a chemical dosing failure, do not send the product to a drinking water tank.

Contamination şüphesinde tankı izole et,.en: If contamination is suspected, isolate the tank, take a sample and wait for the decision of the Chief Engineer and the Master.

Evaporator tip fresh-water generator örn.en: An example of an evaporator-type fresh water generator. An RO unit looks different; on both systems, checking the quality of the product is mandatory.

Her gemi atığı yakılamaz; MARPOL, yerel/.en: Not every kind of ship's waste may be incinerated; MARPOL, local and port bans, the type approval and the maker's feed limits all apply.

Chamber temperatures, draft/O2, burner f.en: Monitor chamber temperatures, draught and O2, the burner flame, feed rate and flue gas condition against the type-approved cycle.

PVC/halogenated material, pressurized co.en: Before feeding, separate out PVC and halogenated materials, pressurised containers, unknown chemicals and prohibited waste.

Atık kaynağı/miktarı ile incinerator/slu.en: Cross-check the sources and quantities of waste against the incinerator and sludge tank mass balance and the amount of ash.

Temperature sensor/interlock ve door sea.en: Prove the temperature sensors, interlocks and door seal with the PMS test; do not rely on the displayed value alone.

Flame failure, low temperature, positive.en: On flame failure, low temperature, positive pressure or smoke leakage, or refractory damage, stop the feed and carry out the purge and cool-down.

Yasak atık veya emisyon şüphesinde yakma.en: If prohibited waste or emissions are suspected, stop incinerating and follow the MARPOL and port procedures.

15 ppm göstergesi deşarj izni değildir;.en: A 15 ppm reading is not permission to discharge; the Annex I conditions, special area and local restrictions, being en route, approved equipment and correct records must all be satisfied.

Feed condition, pressure drop, temperatu.en: Monitor the feed condition, pressure drop, temperature and emulsion, the ppm trend, the sample flow and the response of the automatic stopping device.

Detergent/chemical emulsion ve clean-wat.en: Make sure detergent or chemical emulsions and clean-water flushing do not falsify the real sample; never create a bypass.

Gerçek valve lineup ve overboard/recircu.en: On a physical round, compare the actual valve line-up and the overboard and recirculation lines with the mimic screen.

15 ppm alarm/automatic stop testini onay.en: Prove the 15 ppm alarm and automatic stop with the approved method and a valid calibration; the test result must agree with the ORB entry.

ppm yükselişi, sample loss, alarm/auto-s.en: Shut the overboard valve if the ppm rises, the sample is lost, the alarm or automatic stop fails, a seal or bypass is suspect, or the ship is not in a position where discharge is allowed.

Arızayı seyreltme veya manuel valfle aşm.en: Never get round a fault by dilution or a manual valve; plan holding capacity and reception facilities with the Master and the Chief Engineer.

Plant running göstergesi effluent standa.en: A 'plant running' indication does not prove that the effluent meets the standard; the hydraulic and organic load, disinfectant, sludge and the Annex IV and local discharge conditions are monitored.

Blower/aeration, level, return sludge, d.en: Trend the blower and aeration, level, return sludge, disinfectant, odour and foam, and effluent clarity daily.

Toxic cleaner/chemical shock, overload v.en: Manage the effect on the biomass of toxic cleaners or chemical shocks, overloading and long idle periods.

Effluent sample/test ve disinfectant res.en: Cross-check effluent samples and tests and the disinfectant residual against the equipment limits.

Discharge/holding valve lineup'ını konum.en: Physically verify the discharge and holding valve line-up against the ship's position and the local rules.

Blower loss, overflow, failed disinfecti.en: On loss of the blower, an overflow, failed disinfection or non-compliant effluent, close the overboard valve and go to the holding and reception plan.

Kapalı tank/plant müdahalesinde enclosed.en: Do not enter a tank or the plant without an enclosed space permit that also covers the biological hazard.

Outlet sıcaklığını tutturmak exchanger'ı.en: Holding the outlet temperature does not on its own show that a heat exchanger is clean or sound; bypass, flow and cross-contamination are monitored as well.

Her iki taraf inlet/outlet temperature,.en: On both sides, trend the inlet and outlet temperatures, pressure drop, flow and control valve position together.

Fouling, air lock, gasket/tube leak ve t.en: Assess signs of fouling, air locks, gasket or tube leaks and thermal expansion against changes in load.

Heat balance ve sample/level değişimiyle.en: Check for cross-leakage using the heat balance and samples or changes of level; do not look only at the pressure on one side.

Temizlik sonrası pressure test/plate tig.en: After cleaning, verify the pressure test, plate pack tightening or tube plugging record against the maker's tolerances.

Rapid cross-contamination, major leak, h.en: On rapid cross-contamination, a major leak, a high pressure drop or loss of cooling, reduce the load and isolate the exchanger.

Sıcak/basınçlı ekipmanı drain-vent-cool.en: Do not open hot or pressurised equipment until it has been drained, vented and cooled and LOTO applied.

Suction/discharge pressure tek başına ch.en: Suction and discharge pressures alone do not tell you the refrigerant charge; superheat, subcooling, room and product temperatures, airflow and defrost are assessed together.

Room/product temperature, suction/discha.en: Trend room and product temperatures, suction and discharge, superheat, condenser cooling, oil level and the defrost cycle.

Ice pattern, fan/door seal, drain ve ref.en: On a physical round, check the ice pattern, fans and door seals, drains and the refrigerant leak detector.

Gauge readings'i calibrated thermometer.en: Cross-check the gauge readings with a calibrated thermometer and the compressor current; rule out leaks, airflow and defrost problems before adding refrigerant.

Stand-by compressor/room alarmı ve emerg.en: Test the standby compressor, the room alarms and the emergency response before the cargo or provisions are at risk.

High discharge pressure/temp, low oil, s.en: On high discharge pressure or temperature, low oil, a severe leak or signs of liquid slugging in the compressor, do not bypass the unit's protection.

Refrigerant kaçağında havalandır, alanı.en: If refrigerant leaks, ventilate, isolate the area and follow the safety data sheet and permit procedure for that gas.

Acil jeneratörün çalışması acil güç düze.en: The emergency generator running does not prove that the emergency power arrangement is sound; the automatic start time, the correct list of consumers, the opening of the interconnector and the supply endurance are all verified.

Bağımsız fuel tank, battery/air start.en: Independent fuel tank, battery or air start

Yakıt seviyesi, akü gerilimi/şarj, blok.en: Monitor the fuel level, battery voltage and charging, block heater, ventilation of the space and the mode selector (auto/manual).

Test sırasında gerilim/frekans oturma sü.en: During the test, assess how long the voltage and frequency take to settle, the behaviour under load and any signs of wet stacking.

Otomatik start dizisini ve interconnecto.en: Prove the automatic start sequence and the opening of the interconnector with a real loss-of-supply scenario, as far as the SMS allows; a manual start test alone is not enough.

Beslenen tüketicilerin onaylı elektrik ş.en: Check that the consumers supplied match the list of emergency consumers on the approved electrical diagram.

Otomatik start, yük alma veya transfer a.en: If the automatic start, taking load or the transfer fails, do not treat the arrangement as working; report it to the Chief Engineer and the Master as a critical defect.

Testten sonra set otomatik modda değilse.en: If the set is not in automatic mode after the test, the ship has no emergency power; correct it at once and record it.

Acil jeneratör mahalli örneği. Bağımsız.en: An example of an emergency generator room. The independent fuel, starting and emergency switchboard arrangements cannot all be seen in the photograph.

Şaft jeneratörü ana makineye bağımlıdır;.en: The shaft generator depends on the main engine; a main engine trip can mean an immediate loss of power, so it is not managed as a sole source.

kW/kVAr, frekans/gerilim kararlılığı, ko.en: Monitor kW and kVAr, frequency and voltage stability, converter temperature, harmonics and the shaft speed and pitch feedback together.

Seyir safhasına göre stand-by dizel jene.en: Manage the readiness of the standby diesel generator and the PMS changeover logic to suit the stage of the passage.

Senkron koşullarını ve yük transferini g.en: Cross-check the synchronising conditions and the load transfer with the actual kW response; before manoeuvring, actually try the changeover to an auxiliary generator.

Konvertörlü düzende sabit frekansın gerç.en: With a converter arrangement, confirm with an independent measurement that the frequency really is held constant.

Frekans/gerilim kararsızlığı, konvertör.en: On unstable frequency or voltage, converter over-temperature or a protection trip, take the shaft generator off the board and change over to an auxiliary generator.

Manevra ve dar su geçişlerinde tek kayna.en: Do not rely on the shaft generator as the only source when manoeuvring or in narrow waters; put standby capacity on line in advance.

İtici kuvveti gemi hızı arttıkça hızla d.en: Thruster effect falls off quickly as ship speed increases, and its electrical load can create a risk of blackout; the position of the control lever does not prove the thrust actually produced.

Motor akımı/sargı sıcaklığı, hatve geri.en: Monitor motor current and winding temperature, pitch feedback, vibration, gearbox oil level and busbar frequency together.

Sürekli tam güç kullanım süresini ve tek.en: Keep the time at continuous full power and the interval between restarts within the maker's limits.

Kumanda talebi, hatve göstergesi ve gemi.en: While manoeuvring, compare the control demand, the pitch indicator and the ship's actual response; do not rely on the indicator alone.

Kullanım öncesi devrede yeterli jeneratö.en: Before use, confirm from the PMS and the busbar load that there is enough generator capacity on line.

Aşırı titreşim, hatve geri besleme kaybı.en: On excessive vibration, loss of pitch feedback, a motor temperature alarm or a falling oil level, stop using the thruster and inform the bridge.

Tünel bölgesinde dalgıç/temizlik çalışma.en: If divers or cleaners are working near the tunnel, give no order to the thruster until it has been electrically isolated and locked out.

Tünel tipi baş itici örneği. Izgara, per.en: An example of a tunnel bow thruster. The grid, propeller and gearbox arrangement cannot all be seen in the photograph.

Hedef sıcaklığın tutması eşanjörün temiz.en: Holding the target temperature does not show that the heat exchanger is clean or the circuit sound; flow, differential pressure, valve position and water chemistry are assessed together.

Deniz suyu süzgeç fark basıncı, pompa ba.en: Trend the seawater strainer differential pressure, the pump pressures, the HT and LT inlet and outlet temperatures and the expansion tank level against the load.

Sığ/çamurlu/buzlu sularda sandık seçimin.en: In shallow, muddy or icy waters, choose the sea chest and manage the MGPS to suit the operating conditions.

Aynı yükte artan sıcaklık farkını temizl.en: Before reading a widening temperature difference at the same load as a need for cleaning, physically check the flow and the valve positions.

Genleşme tankındaki seviye değişimini ka.en: To tell a leak from internal leakage, cross-check a change of level in the expansion tank with a pressure test, traces of oil or gas and a chloride measurement.

Soğutma kaybı, deniz suyu emiş kaybı vey.en: On loss of cooling, loss of seawater suction or suspected internal leakage, reduce the load, change over to the standby pump and inform the Chief Engineer.

Sıcak HT devresinde basınç düşürülüp sıc.en: On a hot HT circuit, do not open a cover or valve until the pressure has been released and the temperature brought down to a safe level.

Sıcaklık değeri tek başına doğru enjeksi.en: Temperature alone does not prove correct injection; the deciding value is viscosity, and the supply and booster pressure stages are needed to prevent gassing.

Besleme/booster basıncı, ısıtıcı çıkış s.en: Monitor the supply and booster pressures, heater outlet temperature, viscosity, filter differential pressure and how often the filter backflushes together.

Yakıt değişiminde sıcaklık değişim hızın.en: During a fuel changeover, keep the rate of temperature change and the transition time in the mixing tank within the maker's limits.

Viskozimetre değerini numune/laboratuvar.en: Cross-check the viscometer reading against sample or laboratory data and the heater outlet temperature.

Servis tankı drenajı ve filtre bulguları.en: Assess what comes out of the service tank drain and what is found in the filters together with separator performance; do not blame the filter alone.

Yakıt pompalarında sıkışma, ani basınç k.en: If fuel pumps stick, pressure is suddenly lost, there is a serious leak or viscosity control is lost, reduce the load and make a planned changeover to a safe fuel.

Sıcak yakıt kaçağında tutuşma kaynakları.en: If hot fuel leaks, isolate sources of ignition; do not open the line while it is under pressure.

Yağ basıncının normal görünmesi film kal.en: A normal oil pressure proves neither the film thickness nor the oil quality; water content, viscosity and wear metals are a separate chain of checks.

Yağ basıncı/sıcaklığı, filtre fark basın.en: On rounds, record oil pressure and temperature, filter differential pressure and the levels in the tanks and the stern tube header tank.

Silindir yağı besleme oranını yük ve yak.en: Manage the cylinder oil feed rate together with the load, the sulphur content of the fuel and the iron and alkalinity results of the scrape-down analysis.

Yağ numunesi sonuçlarını (su, viskozite,.en: Compare oil sample results (water, viscosity, wear metals) with the trend; do not decide on an oil change from a single result.

Separatörün gerçekten yağ çektiğini ve b.en: Confirm by local observation that the separator really is taking oil and that its discharge cycle works.

Düşük yağ basıncı, yağda ciddi su veya k.en: On low oil pressure, serious water in the oil or a crankcase temperature or oil mist alarm, do not bypass the protection; stop the engine safely.

Karter kapağını soğuma süresi beklemeden.en: Do not open a crankcase door before the cooling time has passed; hot oil vapour can explode.

Mimik panodaki valf göstergesi gerçek ha.en: The valve indication on the mimic panel does not prove the actual line-up; keeping ballast and bilge lines separate is essential both against flooding and against pollution.

Pompa emiş/basma basıncı, tank seviye de.en: Monitor pump suction and discharge pressures, the change in tank levels, the effect on draft and trim and the eductor driving pressure together.

Sintine kuyusu seviyelerini ve yüksek se.en: On rounds, check the bilge well levels and that the high-level alarms work.

Kritik valfleri yerel olarak fiziksel do.en: Physically verify the critical valves locally; compare the change of level with the expected flow rate.

Kayıt defteri girişlerini gerçek soundin.en: Cross-check record book entries against the actual soundings and the times of the operations.

Beklenmeyen tank seviye değişimi, sintin.en: On an unexpected change in a tank level, a bilge level that will not go down or suspected flooding, stop the operation and report to the Chief Engineer and the Master.

Onaylı ayırıcı devre dışı veya koşullar.en: Do not discharge bilge water to sea while the approved separator is out of service or the conditions are not met; go to the holding and shore reception plan.

Sistem basıncının normal görünmesi yağ t.en: A normal system pressure proves neither oil cleanliness, the accumulator precharge nor tightness; most failures are caused by contamination and moisture.

Sistem basıncı, motor akımı, yağ sıcaklı.en: Monitor system pressure, motor current, oil temperature, filter differential pressure, tank level and signs of leakage.

Pompanın devreye girme sıklığını ve tüke.en: Trend how often the pump cuts in and how fast the consumers move, to detect internal leakage or loss of precharge.

Akümülatör ön şarjını yalnız sistem tara.en: Measure the accumulator precharge only after the system side has been depressurised; do not interpret frequent cutting-in without measuring.

Yağ numunesi partikül ve su sonuçlarını.en: Compare the particle and water results of oil samples with the maker's target cleanliness class.

Sürekli açan emniyet valfi, hızlı ısınma.en: If the relief valve keeps lifting, the oil heats up quickly, there is a serious leak or control is lost, stop the unit and bring the consumer to a safe position.

Basınçlı hatta çalışmaya başlamadan bası.en: Before starting work on a pressurised line, release the pressure, drain the accumulator side and apply lockout and tagout.

Sludge tankının dolu olmaması uyumun kan.en: A sludge tank that is not full is no proof of compliance; the consistency between sludge produced, sludge disposed of and the tank level is assessed together with the records.

Transfer sırasında tank seviyeleri, pomp.en: During a transfer, keep the tank levels, pump pressure, heating temperature and overflow tank under constant watch.

Sludge üretim hızını yakıt kalitesi ve s.en: Trend the rate of sludge production weekly together with fuel quality and separator performance.

Seviye değişimini beklenen debiyle ve so.en: Cross-check the change of level with the expected flow rate and the soundings; check the condensate observation tank for a leaking heating coil.

Kayıt defteri girişlerinin gerçek işlem,.en: Check that the record book entries agree with the actual operations, quantities and receipts.

Basınç yükselip debi oluşmadığında pompa.en: If the pressure rises but there is no flow, stop the pump; do not keep pumping against a closed valve.

Taşma, kaçak veya kirlilik şüphesinde op.en: On an overflow, a leak or suspected pollution, stop the operation, put the SOPEP into action and assess the reporting obligation with the Master.

Hidrantta basınç görülmesi tüm ring/main.en: Pressure at one hydrant does not prove the integrity of the whole fire main or the flow at the furthest nozzle; isolation and the independence of the emergency fire pump are tested as well.

Suction, discharge pressure, priming, le.en: Monitor suction, discharge pressure, priming, leakage and the performance at distant hydrants.

Isolating valves, international shore co.en: Keep the isolating valves, the international shore connection and the access to and power supply of the emergency pump ready.

En olumsuz hidrant düzeninde maker/SOLAS.en: Carry out the maker's, SOLAS and SMS test at the most unfavourable hydrant arrangement; do not look only at the pump discharge gauge.

Emergency fire pump'ın ana makine daires.en: Physically verify that the emergency fire pump's suction, power and starting arrangements are independent of a fire in the main engine room.

Dry running, suction loss, burst main ve.en: On dry running, loss of suction, a burst main or an electrical hazard, use suitable isolation and an alternative pump or section of the main.

Testte yetersiz pressure/flow veya froze.en: If the test finds insufficient pressure or flow, or a frozen or seized valve, report it at once as a critical defect.

CO₂ release bir ilk müdahale düğmesi değ.en: CO₂ release is not a first-response button; it creates an atmosphere that is fatal to people and is never used without evacuation, a head count, ventilation and fuel shutdown and the Master's authority.

Release cabinet, pilot cylinder, selecto.en: Check the release cabinet, pilot cylinders, selector valves, alarm and time delay, bottle weights or levels and the condition of the piping and nozzles at regular intervals.

Gerçek olayda mahal tahliyesi, personel.en: In a real event, follow the evacuation of the space, the head count, boundary cooling and the atmosphere before re-entry through the chain of command.

Protected space selector ve shutdown int.en: Verify the protected space selector valves and shutdown interlocks against the fire control plan and the maker's diagram; do not rely on memory for valve positions.

Servis/quantity kontrolünü yetkili yönte.en: Carry out the service and quantity checks by the authorised method; never test the release line by discharging CO₂.

Personel sayımı tamam değilse veya yanlı.en: Do not release if the head count is not complete or the wrong space may have been selected.

Release sonrası kontrolsüz yeniden giriş.en: After release, do not allow uncontrolled re-entry or start the ventilation; the Master and a trained team decide on the basis of gas measurements.

Foam tipleri/yüzdeleri ve application ra.en: Foam types, concentrations and application rates are not interchangeable; the wrong concentrate, incompatibility with seawater or applying it too forcefully can break the blanket.

Concentrate level/type, proportioning pr.en: Monitor the concentrate level and type, proportioning pressure, solution flow and access to the monitors and branch pipes.

Blanket bütünlüğü, wind, hot surface ve.en: Throughout the fire, keep reassessing the integrity of the foam blanket, the wind, hot surfaces, and drainage and containment.

Foam concentrate certificate/compatibili.en: Compare the foam concentrate certificate and compatibility and the proportioning test result with the system design.

Yalnız köpük görünümüne bakma; applicati.en: Do not judge by the look of the foam alone; verify the application rate and the coverage of the right space or area against the plan.

Yanlış concentrate, düşük proportioning,.en: If the concentrate is wrong, proportioning is low, there is electrical or chemical incompatibility or a risk of exposure to personnel, reorganise the application.

PFOS veya yasaklı/uygunsuz concentrate ş.en: If PFOS or a prohibited or unsuitable concentrate is suspected, stop using the stock and refer it to the company and flag procedure.

Sprinkler ve high/low-pressure water mis.en: Sprinklers and high- or low-pressure water mist are not the same system; nozzles, section valves, the pump or gas unit and the release logic depend on the maker's design.

Tank/pressure source, pump auto-start, s.en: Monitor the tank or pressure source, pump auto-start, section valves, the detector and release panel and any obstruction of the nozzles.

Activation sonrası affected section, wat.en: After activation, manage the affected section, water demand, drainage and free surface and the risk of re-ignition through the chain of command.

Remote indication ve local valve positio.en: Compare the remote indication with the local valve position; prove the alarm and pump response through the test valve with the maker's procedure.

Nozzle cap/obstruction ve approved spaci.en: Check nozzle caps, obstructions and the approved spacing during surveys and PMS checks; do not discharge water at random.

Yanlış section release, piping rupture v.en: On release into the wrong section, a pipe rupture or an electrical hazard, isolate and set up alternative extinguishing as the fire control plan lays down.

System impaired ise compensating measure.en: If the system is impaired, do not operate as if normal protection were in place until compensating measures are in force and flag, class and company have been notified.

IGS patlamayı imkânsız kılmaz; O₂, basın.en: An IGS does not make an explosion impossible; O₂, pressure, the integrity of the deck seal and non-return valve, venting and the cargo operation limits are all maintained together.

O₂, deck main pressure/temp, scrubber le.en: Monitor O₂, deck main pressure and temperature, scrubber level and flow, the blowers and the seal water together with the cargo rate.

Tank pressure/vacuum, P/V breaker ve bra.en: Manage tank pressure and vacuum, the P/V breaker and the branch isolations to suit the stage of loading, discharging or tank cleaning.

Fixed O₂ analyzer'ı portable calibrated.en: Cross-check the fixed O₂ analyser with a calibrated portable meter at a sampling point.

Deck seal/non-return ve alarm trips'i ma.en: Prove the deck seal, the non-return valve and the alarm trips with the maker's tests and the approved manual; do not rely on a panel lamp alone.

O₂ veya pressure approved limit dışına ç.en: If O₂ or pressure goes outside the approved limits, stop or slow the cargo operation concerned as the manual requires and call the Master and the cargo officer.

Deck seal failure, gas backflow veya scr.en: On a deck seal failure, gas backflow or a serious scrubber or blower fault, make the cargo line-up safe.

Normal panel tek tek detector temizliği/.en: A normal panel does not prove that each detector is clean and accessible or that no zone has been disabled; isolations and faults are managed as an active fire risk.

Panel power, loop/zone fault, disable/is.en: Throughout the watch, monitor panel power, loop and zone faults, the list of disabled or isolated points and the alarm history.

Hot work, steam/dust ve ventilation deği.en: Manage the risk of false alarms and temporary isolations from hot work, steam, dust and changes in ventilation through the permit system.

Seçilmiş detector/call point testini app.en: Test selected detectors and call points with an approved test medium and confirm that the panel shows the correct address and zone.

Fire patrol ve mahal turunu disabled det.en: Record fire patrols and rounds of the spaces as the compensating measure for disabled detectors; do not behave as if automatic detection were working.

Unknown isolation, repeated fault veya a.en: On an unexplained isolation, a repeated fault or an alarm that does not match the space, do not just reset the panel; investigate on the spot.

Gerçek alarm şüphesinde ventilation/fire.en: If the alarm may be real, start the ventilation, fire door and muster response as the SMS requires.

Renk/etiket ve basınç göstergesi tek baş.en: The colour, label and pressure gauge alone do not prove an extinguisher is suitable; the agent, fire class, capacity, access, service and escape route are assessed together.

Doğru konum, erişim, pin/seal, corrosion.en: Check the correct location, access, pin and seal, corrosion and damage, pressure or weight, and the service date.

Müdahalede ajan uyumu, wind, electrical.en: While fighting the fire, keep assessing whether the agent is suitable, the wind, electrical isolation, re-ignition and your escape route.

Fire Control Plan inventory ile gerçek a.en: Compare the actual number, type and location with the inventory on the fire control plan.

CO₂ ve cartridge/pressure tiplerinde mak.en: For CO₂, cartridge and stored-pressure types, use the maker's or service method of checking; do not assume an extinguisher is full because the gauge is in the green.

Yangın büyümüş, duman kaçışı kesmiş veya.en: If the fire has grown, smoke has cut off your escape or the agent is unsuitable, stop fighting it yourself and go to the alarm, muster and fixed system.

Kullanılmış/kısmen boşalmış söndürücüyü.en: Never put a used or partly discharged extinguisher back; mark it, replace it and record it.

EEBD yangınla mücadele veya kapalı mahal.en: An EEBD is not for firefighting or enclosed space entry; SCBA endurance is limited not by the nominal cylinder duration but by the wearer's effort and by reserve discipline.

Cylinder pressure/weight, mask/hood, str.en: Check the cylinder pressure or weight, the mask or hood, straps, seal, the whistle or low-air alarm and the expiry or service date.

SCBA kullanımında entry control, tally,.en: When SCBA is in use, follow entry control, tallies, communications, team backup and the turn-around pressure.

Donning, face-seal ve low-pressure alarm.en: Practise donning, face seal and the low-pressure alarm with a training set and procedure; do not discharge emergency sets unnecessarily.

Fire Control Plan/muster inventory ile l.en: Compare locations and numbers, and the state of spare cylinders and the compressor, with the fire control plan and the muster inventory.

Mask seal yok, pressure yetersiz, alarm/.en: Do not enter if the mask does not seal, the pressure is not enough, the alarm or communications have failed or there is no backup team.

EEBD ile yangına yaklaşma veya yeniden g.en: Never approach a fire or re-enter a space wearing an EEBD; it is only for reaching a clear escape route.

Tüm remote shutdown'ları aynı anda rastg.en: Pulling all the remote shutdowns at once, at random, is not safe; choosing the wrong system can affect propulsion, steering, emergency power or the safety of personnel.

Mühür, erişim, label, actuator energy ve.en: Check the seals, access, labels, actuator energy and the remote and local position indications.

Gerçek olayda kapanmanın yangın sınırı,.en: In a real event, manage through the chain of command what each shutdown means for the fire boundary, propulsion and electrical power, and the risk on restarting.

Testte komutun doğru valve/fan/pump üzer.en: In a test, confirm locally that the command actually moves the right valve, fan or pump; do not accept the panel light alone.

Fire Control Plan ve P&ID üzerindeki rem.en: Compare the remote stops and quick-closing valves shown on the fire control plan and P&ID with the labels on site.

Yanlış/kimliği belirsiz release veya stu.en: If a release is wrong or unidentified, or an actuator is stuck, mark the system as a critical defect and put compensating measures in place.

Yangın mahali emniyetli ilan edilmeden r.en: Do not reset or reopen anything until the fire space has been declared safe; the Master and the Chief Engineer bring systems back under control.

Pompa discharge pressure tek başına güve.en: Pump discharge pressure alone does not mean a safe flow; tank venting, valve line-up, shore back pressure, NPSH, cargo properties and the ESD are all monitored together.

Tank level/rate, suction-discharge, pump.en: Monitor tank levels and rates, suction and discharge, pump current and speed, bearings and seals, manifold pressure and venting together.

Stripping aşamasında vapour/gas entrainm.en: During stripping, manage vapour or gas entrainment, cavitation and the condition at the tank bottom within the pump's limits.

İki kişiyle valve line-up/tank identity.en: With two people, physically verify the valve line-up, tank identities and manifold connection against the ship/shore safety checklist.

Transfer rate'i tank level/ullage change.en: Cross-check the transfer rate with the change in tank levels or ullages and the shore figures; do not rely on a single flowmeter.

Unexpected level/pressure, ESD/communica.en: On an unexpected level or pressure, loss of ESD or communication, a seal leak or a venting failure, stop the transfer using the agreed emergency sequence.

Yanlış tank/line contamination şüphesind.en: If a wrong tank or line contamination is suspected, stop the flow without moving other valves, and go back to the samples, the plan and the cargo officer's decision.

COW rutin suyla yıkama değildir; approve.en: COW is not routine water washing; it is never carried out without the approved COW manual, an inerted condition, a washing programme, oxygen and pressure control and effective stripping.

IG deck pressure/O₂, COW line pressure/t.en: Throughout the programme, monitor IG deck pressure and O₂, COW line pressure and temperature, the machine cycle, the tank atmosphere and the stripping suction.

Static electricity, leakage, wash sequen.en: Keep static electricity, leakage, the washing sequence and slop and tank levels within the limits of the approved manual.

Machine movement/pressure ve stripping p.en: Confirm machine movement and pressure and stripping performance with the designated indicators and soundings.

COW planı ile gerçek tank/machine/line-u.en: Cross-check the COW plan against the actual tanks, machines and line-up, and the ORB entry.

IG pressure/O₂ limiti ihlali, COW line l.en: If the IG pressure or O₂ limit is exceeded, the COW line leaks, a machine fails or stripping is lost, stop washing as the manual requires.

Manual dışı tank/program veya uygun olma.en: Do not carry out COW in tanks or with a programme not covered by the manual, or with an unsuitable crude; refer it to the Master and the cargo officer.

Continuous radar gauge ile independent h.en: A continuous radar gauge and an independent high-level or overfill alarm do not do the same job; common power or sensor failures and the effect of cargo foam or vapour must be kept apart.

Level trend, rate, alarm health, vapour/.en: Monitor the level trend, rate, alarm health, the effect of vapour or foam, discrepancies between sensors and tank pressure.

Loading limit ve alarm setpoint'lerini t.en: Assess loading limits and alarm set points together with the tank tables, trim and list and thermal expansion.

Uygun kapalı manual gauging veya bağımsı.en: Cross-check the reading in a selected tank with suitable closed manual gauging or an independent sensor.

High/high-high alarm functional testini.en: Function-test the high and high-high alarms with the approved procedure; do not mistake a simulation on the process gauge for a test of the real independent alarm.

Unknown/frozen level, alarm fault veya r.en: On an unknown or frozen level, an alarm fault or a mismatch between rate and level, reduce or stop the loading rate and gauge the tank independently.

Overfill alarmını susturup operasyona de.en: Do not silence an overfill alarm and carry on; follow the ship/shore ESD plan.

Görsel kapalı görünüm veya tebeşir izi t.en: A cover that looks closed, or a chalk test, does not on its own prove weathertightness; structural condition, drainage, compression and a test are all needed.

Panel/track alignment, seal compression,.en: Watch panel and track alignment, seal compression, cross-joints, cleats and the condition of the drain non-return valves.

Heavy weather ve cargo operation sonrası.en: After heavy weather and cargo operations, check for deformation of coamings and panels and for signs of leakage.

Pre-loading/closing walkdown ve suitable.en: Verify the whole perimeter of each cover with a walk-round before loading and after closing, and with a suitable leak test.

Repair sonrası local patch'i değil globa.en: After a repair, test the compression and drainage continuity of the whole cover, not just the local patch.

Panel hareket alanı açık değilse veya lo.en: Do not move the panels if their path is not clear or a lock or interlock is not working.

Known leakage/deformation ile sea passag.en: With known leakage or deformation, refer the decision to go to sea to the cargo officer, the Master and class.

Lashing sayısı tek başına yeterlilik değ.en: The number of lashings alone does not show they are adequate; the calculation of cargo weight and CG, stowage position, accelerations, lashing angles, MSL/CS and the condition of the equipment decides it.

Correct gear/type, thread engagement, te.en: Check for the correct type of gear, thread engagement, tension, lashing angles, stack geometry and any loose or damaged unit.

Heavy weather, ice, vibration ve cargo s.en: Check the lashings again after heavy weather, icing, vibration and settling of the cargo.

Actual stow/weight ile approved CSM/comp.en: Compare the actual stowage and weights with the approved CSM and the loading computer input bay by bay, row by row and tier by tier.

Gear marking/certificate ve visual condi.en: Check gear markings and certificates and its visual condition; do not use equipment whose markings cannot be read or that is deformed.

CSM dışı stow, unknown weight/CG, missin.en: If the stowage is outside the CSM, weights or CG are unknown, fittings are missing or broken or access is unsafe, do not approve departure or the operation until it is put right.

Denizde lashing müdahalesi için risk ass.en: Never send the crew to work on lashings at sea without a risk assessment, a check of weather and deck access, and fall protection.

Socket enerjili ve display normal olması.en: A live socket and a normal display do not prove the pulp temperature of the cargo; the container unit, airflow, set point and the cargo instructions are assessed together.

Set/supply/return temp, current, phase/a.en: Monitor set, supply and return temperatures, current, phases and alarms, defrost and the ventilation setting against the cargo instructions.

Plug/lead condition, water ingress, secu.en: On every round, check the condition of plugs and leads, water ingress, securing and safe access.

Container ID ve setpoint'i manifest/reef.en: Cross-check container numbers and set points with the manifest and reefer list, and remote monitoring with the local display.

Electrical isolation/dead test'i bağlant.en: Before disconnecting, prove isolation and test for dead with a suitable tester and a permit.

Damaged/wet plug, earth fault, overheati.en: If a plug is damaged or wet, there is an earth fault, overheating or unsafe access, isolate the power and inform the ETO and the cargo officer.

Temperature excursion'da setpoint'i izin.en: On a temperature excursion, do not change the set point without authority; record the time of the alarm, the local condition and the cargo instructions.

Closed lamp tek başına emniyet değildir;.en: A 'closed' lamp alone is not safety; physical locking, cleats, isolation of hydraulic pressure and the bridge indication are each verified separately.

Movement zone, hinge/wire/cylinder load,.en: Watch the movement zone, the loads on hinges, wires and cylinders, hydraulic leaks, the interface with vehicles, and wind and ship motion.

Closing'de seal/compression, lock sequen.en: When closing, check the seals and compression, the locking sequence and the local and bridge indications step by step.

Sorumlu kişi tüm locks/cleats'i fiziksel.en: The person in charge physically checks all locks and cleats and compares them with the bridge indicator.

Departure checklist ve shell-door alarm.en: Complete the departure checklist and the shell door alarm test as the SMS requires; do not treat CCTV as the only evidence.

Person/vehicle movement zone'da, interlo.en: Stop the movement if a person or vehicle is in the movement zone, an interlock is bypassed, the movement is asymmetrical or there is anything abnormal with the wires or hydraulics.

Lock/seal/indicator uyuşmazlığında deniz.en: If locks, seals and indicators do not agree, refer the decision to go to sea to the Master and the class procedure.

Crane SWL, derrick union purchase SWL ve.en: A crane SWL, a derrick SWL in union purchase and the MSL of loose gear cannot simply be converted into one another; the rig configuration and the resultant loads are calculated.

Rig geometry, preventer/guy tension, wir.en: Watch the rig geometry, preventer and guy tensions, wire leads, brakes and limits, the swing of the load and the weather.

Single agreed signaller, radio fallback.en: Keep a single agreed signaller, a radio fallback and the exclusion zone throughout the operation.

Cargo weight/CG, lift points ve tüm gear.en: Compare the cargo weight and CG, the lifting points and all gear certificates and SWLs with the lift plan.

Yüksüz ve uygun test yükü altında brake/.en: Prove the brakes, limits and functions off load and with a suitable test load, following the approved procedure.

Unknown weight, side pull, gear damage,.en: Stop lifting if the weight is unknown, there is side pull, gear is damaged, communication is lost or someone is under the load.

Any overload/structural contact sonrası.en: After any overload or contact with the structure, do not use the gear again until a competent person has examined it.

Tank cleaning kimyasal püskürtme değildi.en: Tank cleaning is not just spraying chemicals; the atmosphere, static electricity, toxicity, tank coatings, heating, slop capacity and the law on discharges are all managed together.

Tank atmosphere, wash pressure/temp, mac.en: Monitor the tank atmosphere, washing pressure and temperature, the machine cycle, slop level, stripping suction and leaks on deck.

Simultaneous operations, venting/IG, che.en: Manage simultaneous operations, venting and IG, chemical exposure and the boundaries of enclosed spaces through the permit system and the SMS.

Cleaning plan ile actual tank/line/machi.en: Cross-check the cleaning plan against the actual tanks, lines and machine programmes, and the slop capacity.

Eductor motive pressure-vacuum ve stripp.en: Confirm the eductor's driving pressure and vacuum and the stripping result with soundings or ullages.

Atmosphere limit dışı, IG/vent failure,.en: Stop cleaning if the atmosphere is outside its limits, the IG or venting fails, there is a leak, a machine jams or slop capacity is at risk.

Tank entry için ayrı enclosed-space entr.en: Do not enter a tank until a separate enclosed space entry permit, gas-freeing and LOTO have been completed.

Type approval her su kalitesi/flow koşul.en: Type approval does not guarantee compliance in every water quality or flow condition; the system design limitations, TRO or UV dose, holding time and contingency measures apply.

Flow, filter differential pressure/backw.en: Compare flow, filter differential pressure and backflushing, UV intensity and UVT or TRO, temperature and salinity, and the treatment alarms with the SDL.

Bypass, sensor invalid, hold time ve neu.en: Manage bypass, invalid sensor readings, holding time and the neutralisation and discharge limits together with the voyage plan.

Valve line-up ve treatment status'u actu.en: Cross-check the valve line-up and treatment status against the actual ballast tanks and flow, and sensor readings against calibration or a sample.

BWRB entry, BWMP contingency action ve a.en: Check that the BWRB entry, the BWMP contingency action and the alarm export all describe the same operation.

Treatment critical alarm, unapproved byp.en: With a critical treatment alarm, an unapproved bypass, an invalid sensor or conditions outside the SDL, do not discharge as if the ship were compliant.

Contingency measure'i Kaptan/şirket/port.en: Decide on the contingency measure through the Master, the company and the port authority, and record it.

Treatment performance, type approval, pl.en: Treatment performance, type approval, the plan and the record book

ppm ekranı veya clean-water test sonucu.en: A ppm display or a clean-water test result does not prove the real bilge flow is compliant; approved piping, the alarm and stop, the position condition and an ORB mass balance are needed.

Feed homogenization, pressure drop, emul.en: Monitor feed homogeneity, pressure drop, emulsion, sample flow, the ppm trend and the automatic stop.

Tank sounding, processed quantity ve dis.en: Check that the tank soundings, the quantity processed and the discharge duration and rate add up.

Actual pipe/valve route'u approved drawi.en: Physically compare the actual pipe and valve route with the approved drawing.

Alarm/automatic stop testini approved pr.en: Prove the alarm and automatic stop with the approved procedure and a valid calibration.

Sample/alarm/stop arızası, ppm limit aşı.en: If the sample, alarm or stop fails, the ppm limit is exceeded or the legal conditions for discharge are not met, close the overboard valve without fail.

Bypass/seyreltme yapma; reception facili.en: Never bypass or dilute; set up a reception facility or holding plan and report the defect.

Genel '3/12 mil' ezberi tek başına karar.en: The general '3/12-mile' rule of thumb is not a decision tree on its own; the approved plant, comminution and disinfection, being en route, the discharge rate, special areas and coastal rules are read together.

Plant/blower/level/disinfection, effluen.en: Throughout the voyage, monitor the plant, blowers, levels and disinfection, effluent quality and holding capacity.

Discharge position/speed/rate ve local/s.en: Verify the discharge position, speed and rate and the local and special-area restrictions against the plan.

Valve line-up ve actual tank/effluent co.en: Compare the valve line-up and the actual tank and effluent condition with the panel.

Sample/test ve certificate/approved manu.en: Cross-check samples and tests against the certificate and the limits in the approved manual.

Plant failure, poor effluent, overflow r.en: Close the overboard valve on a plant failure, poor effluent, a risk of overflow or if the legal conditions are not met.

Tank/plant girişini enclosed-space/biolo.en: Do not enter a tank or the plant without enclosed space and biological hazard controls.

Sludge/garbage availability yakma izni d.en: Having sludge or garbage to burn is not permission to incinerate; prohibited materials, port and local restrictions, the condition of the chamber and the operating manual decide.

Chamber temp/draft, flame, feed, flue ve.en: Monitor the chamber temperature and draught, the flame, the feed, the flue and the condition of the refractory.

Waste category/mass balance ve ash dispo.en: Manage waste categories, the mass balance and the ash disposal route through the records.

Feed category'yi Garbage/Sludge record v.en: Confirm the category of what is fed against the garbage or sludge record and the MSDS.

Interlock/sensor testini PMS ve service.en: Cross-check the interlock and sensor tests with the PMS and the service report.

Unknown/prohibited waste veya port ban v.en: Do not incinerate unknown or prohibited waste, or where the port forbids it.

Set temperature indoor air quality değil.en: The set temperature is not indoor air quality; outside air, filters, dampers and fire closures, humidity, condensate and space pressure are assessed together.

Supply/return temp, humidity, filter ΔP,.en: Monitor supply and return temperatures, humidity, filter ΔP, fan current, condensate and damper positions.

Galley/hospital/battery/paint store gibi.en: Keep the separate pressure and exhaust arrangements of special spaces such as the galley, hospital, battery room and paint store.

BMS value'yu calibrated room/duct measur.en: Cross-check BMS values with calibrated measurements in the room or duct and the airflow.

Fire damper/remote stop ve smoke-control.en: Prove the fire dampers, remote stops and smoke control functions against the fire control plan and the PMS.

Smoke/fire spread, refrigerant leak veya.en: On spread of smoke or fire, a refrigerant leak or contamination, isolate the zone concerned according to plan.

Confined duct/fan bakımına LOTO ve hygie.en: Do not go into a confined duct or fan for maintenance without LOTO and hygiene and permit controls.

Basınç normal olsa da potable water kali.en: Even when the pressure is normal, drinking water quality, the air charge, pump cycling, backflow and tank hygiene are checked separately.

Cut-in/out pressure, pump starts, tank l.en: Monitor the cut-in and cut-out pressures, pump starts, the tank level and air cushion, leaks and the relief valve.

Chlorine/residual veya ship water plan p.en: Manage chlorine and residuals or the parameters in the ship's water plan, tank cleanliness and the risks of taking water from shore.

Pressure gauge/switch'i calibrated gauge.en: Cross-check the pressure gauge and switch with a calibrated gauge, and pump cycling against actual demand and a leak test.

Potable quality'yi uygun sample/test ile.en: Confirm drinking water quality with a suitable sample and test; appearance and taste are not proof.

Contamination/backflow, tank bladder/air.en: On contamination or backflow, a failed tank bladder or loss of air, or rapid cycling, isolate the affected supply and put it right.

Basınçlı tankı depressurize/LOTO olmadan.en: Do not open a pressure tank until it has been depressurised and LOTO applied.

Room air temperature ürün çekirdek sıcak.en: Room air temperature alone shows neither the core temperature nor the quality of the food; airflow, door openings, defrost and the duration of alarms are monitored.

Room/product temp, pressure, superheat,.en: Monitor room and product temperatures, pressures, superheat, defrost, fans and door seals.

Alarm duration ve food segregation/conti.en: Manage the duration of alarms, food segregation and contingency plans with the catering officer.

Remote sensor'u calibrated independent t.en: Compare the remote sensor with a calibrated independent thermometer.

Stand-by unit/alarm ve refrigerant leak.en: Test the standby unit and alarms and the refrigerant leak detection.

Severe refrigerant leak/high pressure/lo.en: On a severe refrigerant leak, high pressure or low oil, do not bypass the unit's protection.

Temperature excursion'da ürünü otomatik.en: After a temperature excursion, do not assume the food is fit to use; carry out a food safety assessment and record it.

Devreler arası cross-connection yanlış b.en: Cross-connecting circuits can spread the wrong pressure or contamination; starting air, control air and working air have different requirements.

Receiver pressures, dew point/oil-water.en: Monitor receiver pressures, dew point and the oil and water drains, compressor cycling and the non-return and relief valves.

Control-air quality ve starting-air rese.en: Assess control air quality and the starting air reserve together with the demand during manoeuvring.

Local gauges/receiver drains ve automati.en: Cross-check the local gauges, receiver drains and automatic start and stop with the control system.

Isolation/cross-connection lineup'ını P&.en: Physically verify the isolation and cross-connection line-up against the P&ID and the tags.

Oil carry-over/high temp/relief lift vey.en: On oil carry-over, high temperature, a relief valve lifting or contamination of the control air, isolate the affected source.

Starting-air manifold üzerinde turning g.en: Do not work on the starting air manifold without the turning gear engaged, the engine isolated and the manifold depressurised.

Steam valve open/pressure varlığı doğru.en: An open steam valve and pressure in the line do not prove that condensate is draining or the traps are working; the risks of water hammer and hot surfaces are monitored.

Header/branch pressure, drain/trap, retu.en: Monitor header and branch pressures, drains and traps, return temperature, hotwell level and the make-up trend.

Warm-through sırasında expansion, water.en: While warming through, manage the risks of expansion, water hammer and pockets of condensate by opening valves slowly.

Trap function'ı temperature/ultrasonic m.en: Cross-check trap operation by temperature or ultrasonic methods and the condensate return.

Valve lineup ve pressure-reducing/safety.en: Verify the valve line-up and the pressure-reducing and safety devices against the P&ID and the maker's tests.

Water hammer, major leak, failed trap ca.en: On water hammer, a major leak, a failed trap causing flooding or overpressure, isolate the branch safely.

Hot/pressurized line'ı cool-drain-vent-L.en: Do not open a hot or pressurised line until it has been cooled, drained and vented and LOTO applied.

GMDSS tek bir cihaz veya yalnız Inmarsat.en: GMDSS is not a single piece of equipment, nor just Inmarsat; providing its functions depends on the ship's sea area, approved services and equipment, and the arrangements for duplication or shore-based maintenance.

Sea area, watch receivers, position/time.en: Monitor the sea area, the watch receivers, the position and time input, the printer or storage, the antennas, the reserve source of energy and the charger alarm.

NAVTEX/SafetyNET MSI coverage ve message.en: Match NAVTEX and SafetyNET MSI coverage and the message filtering to the voyage route.

Approved self-test/test call'ları radyo.en: Carry out approved self-tests and test calls following the radio log procedure; never send a distress alert into the live network by mistake.

Battery autonomy/capacity ve duplicated.en: Verify battery endurance and capacity and the duplicated equipment arrangement against the certificate and the diagram.

Distress false alert'te approved cancell.en: On a false distress alert, follow the approved cancellation procedure at once and keep a record of the exchanges with the RCC and the coast station.

Watch/alerting fonksiyonu kaybında Maste.en: If the watch or alerting function is lost, inform the Master and plan the defect report, shore assistance and a compensating watch.

DSC distress alert ayrıntılı voice distr.en: A DSC distress alert does not replace the detailed distress traffic by voice; a wrong MMSI, position or time, or an antenna fault, corrupts the information SAR services get.

Ch 70 watch, GNSS age, MMSI, power sourc.en: Monitor the Ch 70 watch, the age of the GNSS position, the MMSI, the power source, squelch and volume and any antenna or VSWR fault.

Distress category/nature ve follow-up wo.en: Manage the distress category and nature and the follow-up working channel according to the incident procedure.

Internal/self-test ve izinli test call'ı.en: Verify the DSC path with the internal self-test and an authorised test call, and the audio path separately with a routine voice radio check.

Handset/channel/power selection'ı actual.en: Check the handset, channel and power selection on the actual display; do not mistake dual watch for the Ch 70 DSC watch.

False alert'te cihazı kapatıp susma; DSC.en: After a false alert, do not just switch the set off and say nothing; follow the DSC cancellation and Ch 16 voice cancellation procedure.

Position/MMSI yanlışsa distress tuşunu k.en: If the position or MMSI is wrong, plan a manual correction or a voice supplement rather than pressing the distress button regardless.

MF/HF menzili sabit değildir; frequency,.en: MF/HF range is not fixed; the frequency, the time of day, the ionosphere, the antenna and tuning and propagation decide it, and it is not operated as a simple alternative to satellite.

Sea area/frequency watch, tuning result,.en: Monitor the watch frequencies for the sea area, the tuning result, power, the antenna earth, propagation and the selected mode.

Distress acknowledgement/relay ve workin.en: Manage distress acknowledgements and relays and changes of working frequency following the GOC procedures.

Approved coast-station test call veya se.en: Verify the DSC path with an approved test call to a coast station or the self-test, and separately verify voice and the other installed functions listed in the Record of Equipment.

Position/time ve MMSI'yi alert ekranında.en: Compare the position, time and MMSI on the alert screen with their actual sources.

Tuning/antenna fault veya repeated faile.en: On a tuning or antenna fault or repeated failed calls, do not blindly repeat the same action; change to a suitable band or service and follow the Master's plan.

False distress'te band/mode'a uygun canc.en: After a false distress alert, cancel it in the way that suits the band and mode, record it and notify the authorities.

Terminal login/registered görünümü mesaj.en: A terminal showing as logged in or registered does not prove that a message was delivered or that the right ocean region or service is selected; the delivery status and the EGC configuration are monitored.

Logged-in status, position/time, EGC are.en: Monitor the login status, position and time, the EGC areas, the printer or storage, the antenna and the protection of the distress button.

Message priority, address ve delivery co.en: Check message priority, address and delivery confirmation to suit the operation.

Approved link/performance test ile termi.en: Verify the terminal path with an approved link or performance test, and the filtering by whether the EGC messages received are relevant to the route.

Distress position/identity display'ini G.en: Compare the distress position and identity display with the GNSS and the ship's certificate.

Failed delivery/login veya wrong identit.en: On a failed delivery or login, or a wrong identity or position, do not rely on one channel; use alternative GMDSS means and inform the Master.

False distress'te recognized service can.en: After a false distress alert, follow the recognised service's cancellation procedure and notify the RCC.

EPIRB test mode dışında aktive edilmez;.en: An EPIRB is not activated except in test mode; the hydrostatic release frees it automatically, but wrong mounting, a wrongly arranged lanyard or an obstruction can stop it floating free.

Bracket erişimi, housing, lanyard'ın doğ.en: Check access to the bracket, the housing, correct stowage of the lanyard, the HRU and battery expiry dates, the registration label and the GNSS self-test result.

Gerçek aktivasyonda beacon'ı açık gökyüz.en: In a real activation, keep the beacon upright with a clear view of the sky and, if possible, tied to the survival craft.

Maker self-test/GNSS testini izinli aral.en: Carry out the maker's self-test and GNSS test at the permitted intervals; never produce an RF transmission test that looks like a real distress.

HEX ID/MMSI registration'ı certificate/d.en: Compare the HEX ID and MMSI registration with the certificate and the database record; update them when the ship's name or flag changes.

Accidental activation'da beacon'ı kapatm.en: After an accidental activation, do not just switch the beacon off; cancel the false alert with the RCC or coast station and log it.

Expired/damaged/failed self-test EPIRB'i.en: Do not treat an EPIRB that is expired, damaged or has failed its self-test as serviceable; obtain an approved replacement or shore service.

Radar SART S-band radarda görünmez; ekra.en: A radar SART does not show on an S-band radar; the 12 response dots on the display can turn into arcs or circles with range and receiver saturation, and the antenna height decides the detection range.

Radar SART swept response / AIS messages.en: Radar SART swept response / AIS messages

Activation indication, mounting height/o.en: Watch the activation indication, the mounting height and orientation and access to it in the survival craft.

Radar SART aramada X-band radar range/ga.en: When searching for a radar SART, set the X-band radar's range, gain and sea clutter so that they do not suppress the response.

Maker self-test'i vessel radarına yanlış.en: Carry out the maker's self-test in the approved mode without producing false targets on ships' radars.

Inventory, battery expiry ve correct typ.en: Compare the inventory, battery expiry dates and correct type with the muster and LSA plans.

Distress dışında operational mode'a alma.en: Do not switch it to operational mode except in distress; if a false response appears, inform the bridge team.

Failed self-test/expired battery cihazı.en: Do not treat a unit that has failed its self-test or has an expired battery as serviceable, and do not put it back in the craft.

BNWAS gözcü veya vardiya zabiti yerine g.en: BNWAS does not replace the lookout or the officer of the watch; resetting it continuously or automatically defeats its purpose, and only the Master may set the operating mode.

Operating mode, timer, reset locations,.en: At the start of the watch, check the operating mode, the timer, the reset locations, the stage alarms and the routing to the backup officers.
