Reset'in gerçek bridge activity'yi temsi.en: Confirm that resets reflect real activity on the bridge and that the alarm can be heard above the ambient noise.

Stage sequence ve cabin routing testini.en: Test the stage sequence and the routing to cabins with the SMS and maker's procedure, right through to the actual recipients.

Mode access/keys ve power-failure alarmı.en: Check access to the mode setting, the keys and the power failure alarm against the bridge equipment checklist.

Stage alarm/routing arızası veya unautho.en: On a stage alarm or routing fault, or an unauthorised bypass, inform the Master and set up a compensating watch arrangement.

Alarmı susturmak için sürekli reset/weig.en: Never use constant resetting, a weight or tape to silence the alarm; it disables a critical safety system.

Normal status lamp tüm data channel'ları.en: A normal status lamp does not prove that every data channel is being recorded usefully; the annual performance test and monitoring of each source are needed.

Power/UPS, capsule/beacon, microphones,.en: Monitor power and the UPS, the capsule and beacon, the microphones, input channel faults and the recording status.

Incident/near miss sonrası overwrite sür.en: After an incident or near miss, carry out the maker's and SMS save and preserve action without waiting for the overwrite time.

Annual performance test report ve channe.en: Compare the annual performance test report and the channel list with the sensors and displays actually installed.

Approved playback/check ile time sync, a.en: Confirm with an approved playback or check that time synchronisation, audio and selected channels are usable; do not alter the data.

Recording/input fault'ta Master ve compa.en: On a recording or input fault, inform the Master and the company and plan the defect report and repair; do not report as if normal voyage data were being recorded.

Kaza sonrası capsule/data'ya yetkisiz er.en: After an accident, do not access, delete or export the capsule data without authority; protect the chain of evidence.

VDR carriage ve revised performance stan.en: VDR carriage and the revised performance standard; a VDR or S-VDR applies depending on the ship and its date of build

Filika/davit testleri yüksek risklidir;.en: Lifeboat and davit tests are high-risk; release gear, overload and dynamic tests are carried out only within the limits of SOLAS III/20, MSC.402(96), the maker and an authorised service provider.

Hull/door, drain plug, equipment, engine.en: Check the hull and doors, drain plug, equipment, engine and fuel, battery, steering, falls, brake, limits and release indicators as planned.

Launch/recovery'de ship motion, water ar.en: During launching and recovery, a dedicated person in charge watches the ship's motion, the water area, communications, the hooks and the winch and fall loads.

Checklist/LSA plan ile inventory ve secu.en: Physically compare the inventory and securing with the checklist and the LSA plan; run the engine test within the cooling and maker's restrictions.

Annual/5-year service ve release gear re.en: Verify the annual and 5-yearly service and release gear records against the authorised provider and the Administration's acceptance.

Unclear hook status, damaged fall/brake,.en: Stop launching or recovery if the hook status is unclear, a fall or brake is damaged, someone is in the danger zone or communication is lost.

Safety pin/interlock bypass veya yetkisi.en: Never allow a safety pin or interlock to be bypassed or an unauthorised on-load release test.

HRU raft'ı şişirmez; container'ı gemiden.en: The HRU does not inflate the raft; it frees the container from the ship. Without the painter's weak link and connection to the ship and the correct lashing, the float-free arrangement will not work.

Container/cradle, lashing, HRU orientati.en: Check the container and cradle, the lashing, the HRU orientation and expiry date, the weak link, the painter connection and the launching path.

Embarkation ladder/MES/lighting ve assig.en: Keep the embarkation ladders, MES, lighting and the assigned capacity and location in line with the muster plan.

Label serial/capacity/service date ve ce.en: Compare the serial number, capacity and service date on the label and the certificate with the actual raft.

Securing arrangement'ı maker installatio.en: Verify the securing arrangement against the maker's installation drawing; never open the raft to test it.

Yanlış painter/weak-link bağlantısı, exp.en: Do not treat the raft as serviceable if the painter or weak link is wrongly connected, the service or HRU has expired or the float-free path is obstructed.

Container'ı gemiye doğrudan zincir/halat.en: Never make the container fast to the ship with an extra chain or line, which defeats the HRU.

Rescue boat, lifeboat ve FRB şartları ay.en: The requirements for rescue boats, lifeboats and fast rescue boats are not the same; crew competence, PPE, the painter, the release gear and the davit's working load and motion limits are specific to the ship.

Engine/fuel/battery, steering, communica.en: Check the engine, fuel and battery, steering, communications, recovery strop, hooks, davit and brake and the boat's equipment.

Launch/recovery'de ship speed/lee, sea s.en: During launching and recovery, a dedicated person in charge watches the ship's speed and lee, the sea state, the propeller hazard, the hook load and the condition of the crew.

Pre-use function ve equipment inventory'.en: Physically verify the pre-use function check and the equipment inventory against the checklist and the LSA plan.

Davit/release annual ve 5-year service r.en: Compare the annual and 5-yearly service records of the davit and release gear with the authorised provider's requirements.

Hook/fall/brake uncertainty, engine/stee.en: Stop the operation if there is any doubt about the hook, fall or brake, the engine or steering fails, someone is in the fall zone or communication is lost.

FRB'yi training/launch limitleri dışında.en: Do not put the fast rescue boat at risk outside its training and launching limits just to save time; the Master decides the SAR plan.

Deniz emniyetinin temel taşıdır. Yetersi.en: It is the cornerstone of safety at sea. Poor watchkeeping leads directly to collisions, groundings and loss of life. It is essential for keeping operations safe under section 7 of the ISM Code.

Vardiya düzenini belirler, özel talimatl.en: Sets the watch arrangements, gives special instructions and is called to the bridge when needed.

Vardiya süresince geminin güvenli seyri.en: Is fully responsible for the safe navigation of the ship throughout the watch.

Hava ve trafik koşullarına göre ayrı bir.en: A separate lookout is posted to suit the weather and traffic. The OOW may act as sole lookout only in daylight, in open sea and in good visibility.

Manuel dümen gerektiğinde görev alır. Kı.en: Takes the wheel when hand steering is needed. In confined waters, is on standby at all times.

STCW Kod A-VIII/2 – Vardiya tutma ilkele.en: STCW Code A-VIII/2 – Principles of watchkeeping

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 14 – Personel ve kö.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 14 – Ships' manning and bridge organisation

ISM Kod Bölüm 7 – Gemi operasyonlarının.en: ISM Code section 7 – Development of plans for shipboard operations

Pusula kursu ve autopilot ayarı kontrol.en: Compass course and autopilot settings checked

Vardiya devrinde '5 dakika kuralı' uygul.en: Apply the '5-minute rule' at handover: the relieving officer spends at least 5 minutes on the bridge to adjust to the dark and take in the situation. Never rush a handover.

Kısıtlı görüşte seyir için temel cihaz o.en: It is the essential instrument for navigating in restricted visibility, and COLREG Rule 7 requires it to be used to determine risk of collision. Failing to use radar, or using it wrongly, is one of the main causes of marine accidents.

Radar/ARPA'yı etkin kullanır, hedefleri.en: Uses the radar/ARPA effectively, tracks targets and decides on manoeuvres when necessary.

Kısıtlı görüşte köprüüstüne gelir. CPA a.en: Comes to the bridge in restricted visibility and sets the CPA alarm limits.

COLREG Kural 7 – Çatışma riski (Radar ku.en: COLREG Rule 7 – Risk of collision (use of radar)

COLREG Kural 19 – Kısıtlı görüşte seyir.en: COLREG Rule 19 – Conduct of vessels in restricted visibility

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19.2 – Seyir cihazl.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19.2 – Carriage requirements for navigational equipment

STCW Kod A-II/1 – Radar ve ARPA yetkinli.en: STCW Code A-II/1 – Radar and ARPA competence

Range/gain/clutter ayarları mevcut koşul.en: Range, gain and clutter settings suit the conditions

Kısıtlı görüşte tek bir range'de kalmayı.en: In restricted visibility, do not stay on one range. Switch regularly between the 6 NM and 12 NM ranges so that you miss neither close nor distant targets. Turning the sea clutter control all the way down to clear the screen loses small targets.

COLREG, denizde çatışmaları önlemenin te.en: COLREG is the basic legal framework for preventing collisions at sea. A breach can lead both to criminal liability and to insurance claims being refused.

COLREG kurallarını anlık olarak uygular,.en: Applies the COLREG rules as situations develop and decides on manoeuvres.

Karmaşık trafik durumlarında köprüüstüne.en: Comes to the bridge in complex traffic situations and makes the final decision.

Hedeflerin kerteriz değişimini raporlar..en: Reports changes in the bearings of targets.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 34 – Güvenli seyir.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 34 – Safe navigation

Radar kullanılarak çatışma riski değerle.en: Risk of collision assessed using radar (Rule 7)

Manevra yeterince erken ve belirgin yapı.en: Action taken early enough and large enough to be readily apparent (Rule 8)

COLREG kurallarını ezberlemek yetmez; he.en: Memorising the COLREG rules is not enough; you must understand why each rule exists. For example, the stand-on vessel's right to act under Rule 17(a)(ii) applies only when the give-way vessel is not taking appropriate action.

STCW Kod A-VIII/2 Bölüm 3-1, kaptanın uy.en: STCW Code A-VIII/2 Part 3-1 sets out clearly when the Master must be called. Failing to call the Master when required is gross negligence and leads to disciplinary or criminal liability.

Kaptanı uygun zamanda, yeterli bilgiyle.en: Calls the Master in good time and with enough information, without hesitating.

Night/standing orders ile çağrılma krite.en: Writes clear criteria for being called in the night orders and standing orders, and comes to the bridge at once when called.

STCW Kod A-VIII/2, Bölüm 3-1 – Kaptanın.en: STCW Code A-VIII/2, Part 3-1 – Calling the Master

ISM Kod Bölüm 5 – Kaptanın yetki ve soru.en: ISM Code section 5 – Master's responsibility and authority

Kıyı/sığlık yaklaşması var mı?.en: Is the ship closing the coast or shallow water?

Makine/dümen arızası bildirildi mi?.en: Has an engine or steering failure been reported?

Distress/urgency mesajı alındı mı?.en: Has a distress or urgency message been received?

Night orders'ta belirtilen durum oluştu.en: Has a situation listed in the night orders arisen?

Altın kural: 'Tereddüt ettiğiniz anda ka.en: The golden rule: 'If in doubt, call the Master.' The Master will not be angry with you, but if there is an accident because you did not call, the consequences are serious. Even experienced officers never relax this rule.

Logbook'lar yasal belgelerdir ve mahkeme.en: Logbooks are legal documents and can be used as evidence in court. They are among the documents most often checked at PSC inspections. Missing or incorrect entries can lead to fines and detention.

Vardiyası süresince tüm kayıtları tutar..en: Makes all the entries during the watch.

Günlük kontrol ve onay. Önemli olayların.en: Checks and signs daily, confirming that important events have been recorded correctly.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 28 – Kayıt tutma yü.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 28 – Records of navigational activities

MARPOL Ek I, Kural 17 – Oil Record Book.en: MARPOL Annex I, Regulation 17 – Oil Record Book

MARPOL Ek V, Kural 10.3 – Garbage Record.en: MARPOL Annex V, Regulation 10.3 – Garbage Record Book

MLC 2006 – Çalışma saatleri kaydı.en: MLC 2006 – Records of hours of work

Saatlik mevki ve seyir bilgileri işlendi.en: Hourly position and navigation data entered

UTC/yerel saat doğru kullanıldı.en: UTC and local time used correctly

Logbook yazarken 'mahkemede okunabilecek.en: Write the logbook knowing it may be read out in court. Avoid vague wording; use exact values instead of 'about' or 'around'. Always give times in 24-hour format and in UTC.

Pilot transfer sırasında düşme ve yarala.en: Pilot transfer is one of the operations with the highest risk of falls and injuries. SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 23 and IMO Res. A.1045(27) set the standards for pilot transfer arrangements.

Pilotla bilgi alışverişi, manevra soruml.en: Information exchange with the pilot, responsibility for manoeuvring, safety decisions.

Pilot merdiveni hazırlığı, güverte ekibi.en: Preparing the pilot ladder and coordinating the deck team.

Merdiven rigleme, güvenlik ekipmanları h.en: Rigging the ladder and preparing the safety equipment.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 23 – Pilot transfer.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 23 – Pilot transfer arrangements

STCW Kod A-II/1 – Pilot alma/bırakma yet.en: STCW Code A-II/1 – Competence in embarking and disembarking pilots

VHF ile pilot istasyonu ile temas kuruld.en: Contact made with the pilot station on VHF

Pilot merdiveni basamaklarını her kullan.en: Check every step of the pilot ladder ONE BY ONE before each use. A cracked, loose or worn step can cause a fatal accident. Where the climb is more than 9 metres, a combination arrangement (pilot ladder + accommodation ladder) is mandatory.

Kısıtlı sularda manevra alanı sınırlıdır.en: In confined waters there is little room to manoeuvre, squat increases and traffic is heavy. Most accidents happen in confined waters.

Köprüüstünde bizzat bulunur. Tüm kararla.en: Is on the bridge in person and bears final responsibility for every decision.

Mevki tespiti, radar gözetimi, trafik iz.en: Position fixing, radar watch, traffic monitoring.

Manuel dümen. Kurs talimatlarını tekrarl.en: Hand steering; repeats and carries out the helm orders.

Özellikle dar sularda bow lookout görevl.en: A lookout is posted in the bow, especially in narrow waters.

Makine stand-by, azami manevra kabiliyet.en: Engine on standby for maximum manoeuvrability.

Yerel boğaz/kanal kuralları (TSS, VTS ra.en: Local strait and canal rules (TSS, VTS reporting)

İstanbul Boğazı geçişinde squat etkisi c.en: Squat can become serious when passing through the Istanbul Strait (Bosphorus). At 12 knots in shallow sections it can reach 1.5 metres. Always include squat in your UKC calculation.

GMDSS, denizde can güvenliğinin son savu.en: GMDSS is the last line of defence for safety of life at sea. It is mandatory for all ships covered by SOLAS Chapter IV.

Distress çağrısı kararını verir. Genel a.en: Decides on sending a distress alert, sounding the general alarm and abandoning ship.

GMDSS cihazlarının bakımı ve operasyonu..en: Maintains and operates the GMDSS equipment; must hold a GOC (General Operator's Certificate).

Vardiyada GMDSS cihazlarını izler. Alına.en: Monitors the GMDSS equipment on watch and answers incoming calls according to procedure.

STCW Kod A-IV/2 – GMDSS operatör yetkinl.en: STCW Code A-IV/2 – GMDSS radio operator competence

Inmarsat-C açık ve mesaj kontrolü yapılı.en: Inmarsat-C on and messages being checked

Distress prosedürü köprüüstünde asılı.en: Distress procedure posted on the bridge

EPIRB'in HID (Hydrostatic Release) ünite.en: Always check the expiry date of the EPIRB's hydrostatic release unit. An expired unit may stop the EPIRB floating free if the ship sinks. It is usually replaced every 2 years.

Deniz kazalarının %80'inden fazlasında i.en: The human element plays a part in more than 80% of marine accidents. Bridge discipline is the most effective tool for keeping it to a minimum.

Köprüüstü disiplin kurallarını belirler.en: Sets and enforces the bridge discipline rules and leads by example.

Disiplin kurallarına uyar. Closed-loop i.en: Follow the discipline rules, use closed-loop communication and accept a culture of challenge.

STCW Kod A-VIII/2 – Köprüüstü kaynak yön.en: STCW Code A-VIII/2 – Bridge resource management

ISM Kod Bölüm 7 – Gemide operasyonların.en: ISM Code section 7 – Development of plans for shipboard operations

MLC 2006 – Çalışma/dinlenme saatleri.en: MLC 2006 – Hours of work and rest

Çalışma/dinlenme saatleri uygun.en: Hours of work and rest complied with

En tehlikeli an 'sıkıcı' anlardır. Açık.en: The most dangerous moments are the 'boring' ones. In open sea, fine weather and light traffic, attention wanders; that is exactly when the lookout slackens and dangers go unnoticed. Build a routine: every 15 minutes, scan the horizon, check the radar and verify the position.

Güncel olmayan haritayla seyir etmek kar.en: Navigating with an uncorrected chart can lead to grounding or striking an uncharted danger. Chart corrections are checked closely at PSC inspections.

Tüm harita düzeltmelerinden birinci dere.en: Has primary responsibility for all chart corrections.

Haritaların güncel tutulduğunu denetler..en: Checks that the charts are kept up to date.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19 – Seyir cihazlar.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19 – Navigational equipment and charts

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 27 – Haritaların gü.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 27 – Nautical charts and publications kept up to date

Son NtM bülteni tarih numarası kontrol e.en: Number and date of the latest NtM bulletin checked

Geçersiz haritalar (withdrawn) listeden.en: Withdrawn charts removed from the list

Harita düzeltmelerini biriktirmeyin. Her.en: Do not let chart corrections pile up; do them every week. When a PSC inspector pulls out a chart at random and looks at the last correction date, weeks of delay are recorded as a serious deficiency.

ECDIS'in birincil seyir cihazı olarak ku.en: On ships where ECDIS is the primary means of navigation, navigating with out-of-date ENCs can be as serious an offence as not carrying paper charts.

ECDIS güncelleme ve lisans yönetiminden.en: Is responsible for ECDIS updates and licence management.

ECDIS güncelliğini denetler..en: Checks that the ECDIS is kept up to date.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19.2.1.4 – ECDIS ge.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19.2.1.4 – ECDIS requirements

ECDIS yazılım versiyonu güncel.en: ECDIS software version up to date

ECDIS'te 'base display' modunda seyir et.en: Do not navigate with ECDIS in 'display base'. Use the standard display or all-display mode. Display base hides much critical information (depth contours, wrecks, restricted areas).

NtM takibi yapılmadan harita düzeltmesi.en: Charts cannot be corrected without following the NtMs; they are the starting point of the whole updating chain.

NtM takibi ve uygulamasından sorumludur..en: Is responsible for following and applying the NtMs.

Son NtM bülten numarası kaydedildi.en: Number of the latest NtM bulletin recorded

İlgili NtM'ler haritaya uygulandı.en: Relevant NtMs applied to the charts

NAVAREA uyarıları acil NtM niteliğindedi.en: NAVAREA warnings are urgent notices and must be plotted on the chart at once as temporary (T) corrections. Ignoring NAVAREA warnings received by NAVTEX or Inmarsat-C SafetyNET means heading into a known danger with your eyes open.

Navigational warnings hayat kurtarır. NA.en: Navigational warnings save lives. NAVAREA, coastal and local warnings cover different areas, and all of them must be monitored.

Tüm navigational warnings takibi ve hari.en: Monitors all navigational warnings and plots them on the charts.

Vardiya sırasında gelen uyarıların anınd.en: Reads and assesses warnings received during the watch at once.

Rota üzerindeki uyarılar haritaya işlend.en: Warnings on the route plotted on the chart

NAVTEX'te bazı mesaj kategorileri varsay.en: Some NAVTEX message categories may be switched off by default. Warnings of military exercises (category L) and failures of aids to navigation (category A) in particular must always be enabled.

Pusula hataları tespit edilmezse gemi ya.en: If compass errors are not found, the ship steers the wrong course. If the gyro fails, the magnetic compass is the back-up, and it is of no use unless the deviation is known.

Düzenli gyro/manyetik pusula karşılaştır.en: Compares the gyro and magnetic compasses regularly and records the errors.

Her vardiyada en az bir gyro kontrolü ya.en: Checks the gyro error at least once every watch.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19 – Seyir cihazlar.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19 – Navigational equipment

STCW Kod A-II/1 – Pusula kullanımı yetki.en: STCW Code A-II/1 – Competence in the use of compasses

Gyro/manyetik karşılaştırması logbook'a.en: Gyro and magnetic compass comparison entered in the logbook

Gyro hatası aniden değişiyorsa (1° üzeri.en: A sudden change in gyro error (a shift of more than 1°) may mean the gyrocompass is failing. In that case inform the engine room and prepare to change to the magnetic compass. Steering by the magnetic compass without a deviation card is not safe.

Draft bilgisi UKC hesabında, stabilite d.en: Draft information is critical for the UKC calculation, the stability assessment and meeting port entry conditions. Position fixing is the foundation of safe navigation.

Düzenli mevki tespiti ve haritaya işleme.en: Fixes the position regularly and plots it on the chart.

Draft okumaları ve draft survey koordina.en: Reads the drafts and coordinates the draft survey.

STCW Kod A-II/1 – Mevki tespiti yetkinli.en: STCW Code A-II/1 – Competence in position fixing

Açık denizde saatlik, kıyısal sularda he.en: Hourly in open sea, every 15-30 minutes in coastal waters

Set/drift hesaplanıp rota düzeltildi.en: Set and drift calculated and the course corrected

GPS'e körü körüne güvenmeyin. Her mevki.en: Do not trust GPS blindly. Verify every fix with at least one independent source (radar range, visual bearing). Remember to check the GPS antenna offset setting.

BNWAS, vardiya zabitinin köprüüstünde ak.en: BNWAS confirms that the officer of the watch is active on the bridge and starts the alarm sequence if not. AIS lets ships identify each other and helps reduce the risk of collision.

BNWAS'ın aktif çalışmasını sağlar. AIS v.en: Makes sure the BNWAS is active and keeps the AIS data up to date.

AIS'in kapatılma kararı sadece master'ın.en: Only the Master may decide to switch AIS off (for security reasons).

BNWAS aktif ve alarm zinciri çalışıyor.en: BNWAS active and alarm sequence working

AIS dinamik verileri güncellendi (draft,.en: AIS voyage data updated (draft, destination, ETA, navigational status)

AIS 'Navigational Status' alanını her du.en: Update the AIS 'navigational status' every time it changes. If you anchor and leave it at 'under way using engine' instead of 'at anchor', other ships will think you are moving. PSC also checks it often.

Arızalı seyir cihazı, seyir emniyetini d.en: Faulty navigational equipment is a direct threat to safe navigation. SOLAS Chapter V requires navigational equipment to be kept in working order.

Seyir cihazları bakım ve testlerin koord.en: Is responsible for coordinating the maintenance and testing of navigational equipment.

Elektriksel arıza tespiti ve basit onarı.en: Finds electrical faults and carries out simple repairs.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 19 – Seyir cihazlar.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 19 – Carriage requirements for navigational equipment

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 16 – Cihazların bak.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 16 – Maintenance of equipment

IMO Res. A.694(17) – Gemi telsiz ve elek.en: IMO Res. A.694(17) – General requirements for shipborne radio and electronic navigational equipment

Radar manyetron ömrü genellikle 5.000-10.en: A radar magnetron usually lasts 5,000-10,000 hours. Watch the signal level on the radar performance monitor (PM) regularly; a level below 50% indicates that the magnetron needs replacing.

Hatalı yük planı, aşırı stress, stabilit.en: A faulty cargo plan can lead to excessive stresses, loss of stability, cargo damage and even the loss of the ship. It is governed by the ISM Code and SOLAS Chapters VI and VII.

Yük planının hazırlanması ve uygulanması.en: Has primary responsibility for preparing and carrying out the cargo plan.

Yük planını onaylar. Nihai sorumluluk ma.en: Approves the cargo plan; the final responsibility lies with the Master.

Yükleme/tahliye sırasında sahada gözetim.en: Supervises on deck during loading and discharging.

SOLAS Bölüm VI – Yük taşıma.en: SOLAS Chapter VI – Carriage of cargoes

SOLAS Bölüm VII – Tehlikeli yük taşıma.en: SOLAS Chapter VII – Carriage of dangerous goods

IMDG Code – Tehlikeli yük segregasyonu.en: IMDG Code – Segregation of dangerous goods

Loading computer'da stabilite kontrol ed.en: Stability checked on the loading computer

Loading computer sonuçlarına körü körüne.en: Do not trust loading computer results blindly; wrong input gives wrong output. Cross-check with tank soundings and draft readings. On ships carrying heavy cargoes in particular, do not use the SF/BM values at the check points without applying the corrections.

Yükleme/tahliye sırasında stabilite, muk.en: During loading and discharging, stability, hull strength and the safety of the cargo must be monitored continuously. Mistakes lead to cargo damage, loss of stability and injuries.

Yükleme/tahliye operasyonunun genel koor.en: Overall coordination of loading and discharging.

Sahada gözetim, sounding, draft okuma..en: Supervision on deck, soundings, draft readings.

Operasyonun genel güvenliğinden nihai so.en: Has final responsibility for the overall safety of the operation.

Yükleme hızını kontrol edemediğiniz duru.en: Do not compromise on safety even when you cannot control the loading rate (pressure from the terminal). The Master's overriding authority is a legal right under SOLAS: the Master can always reduce the loading rate or stop the operation.

Kuru yük gemilerinde yük miktarının beli.en: It is the most widely used method of determining the cargo quantity on dry bulk ships, and serves as legal evidence in commercial disputes.

Draft survey'in koordinasyonu ve hesapla.en: Coordinates the draft survey and carries out the calculations.

Draft okuma ve sounding operasyonları..en: Reads the drafts and takes the soundings.

Bağımsız doğrulama (gönderen/alıcı adına.en: Independent verification (on behalf of the shipper or receiver).

UN/ECE Draught Survey Code (1992) – Draf.en: UN/ECE Draught Survey Code (1992) – Draft survey procedures

Constant son güncelleme tarihi kontrol e.en: Date of the last update of the ship's constant checked

Draft okumasını sakin suda yapın. Dalga.en: Read the drafts in calm water. If there is a sea running, read over several minutes and take the mean. The second trim correction (due to the change in LCF) is often overlooked, but it makes a significant difference at large trims.

Doğru sounding verileri stabilite hesabı.en: Accurate soundings are critical for stability calculations, fuel planning and cargo quantity. Wrong soundings lead to calculation errors and stability problems.

Balast ve kargo tanklarının sounding koo.en: Coordinates the sounding of ballast and cargo tanks.

Yakıt ve yağ tanklarının soundingleri..en: Sounds the fuel and lubricating oil tanks.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Tank sounding düzenle.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Tank sounding arrangements

MARPOL Ek I – Yağlı suların izlenmesi.en: MARPOL Annex I – Control of oily water

Sounding tape'i çekerken hızlı çekmeyin;.en: Do not pull the sounding tape up quickly; it causes wrong readings. In oil tanks, use sounding paste to get a clear reading. Even where there are remote gauges, verify them with a manual sounding at least once a week.

Cargo watch, kargo hasarının önlenmesi,.en: A cargo watch is essential to prevent cargo damage, keep the ship safe and make sure the operation goes according to plan.

Cargo watch düzenini belirler, denetler..en: Sets up and supervises the cargo watch arrangements.

Cargo watch sırasında uyanık ve mobil ol.en: Stay alert and keep moving on cargo watch; standing in one place is ineffective. Make regular rounds to check all the hatches, the crane areas and both sides of the ship.

Mooring, gemicilik mesleğinde en tehlike.en: Mooring is one of the most dangerous operations in seamanship. A parting line or wire causes serious injury and death. Follow the OCIMF MEG (Mooring Equipment Guidelines).

Manevra sorumluluğu. Bağlama/çözme komut.en: Responsible for manoeuvring; gives the mooring and unmooring orders.

Baş veya kıç bağlama ekip şefi..en: In charge of the forward or aft mooring team.

Güverte ekibini yönetir, halat/tel opera.en: Leads the deck team and coordinates the handling of lines and wires.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1, Kural 3-8 – Mooring dü.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 3-8 – Towing and mooring equipment

SNAP-BACK ZONE'DA ASLA DURMAYIN. Kopan b.en: NEVER STAND IN A SNAP-BACK ZONE. A parting mooring line or wire carries enough energy to cut a person in two. These zones are marked on deck with yellow or red lines. Keep out of them whenever any line is under tension.

Su sızdıran hatch cover, kargo hasarı, s.en: Leaking hatch covers are one of the most common causes of cargo damage, loss of stability and loss of ships. P&I clubs attribute a large share of cargo damage claims to hatch cover leaks.

Hatch cover operasyonunun genel sorumlul.en: Overall responsibility for hatch cover operations.

Operasyonun fiili yönetimi ve bakım..en: Runs the operation on deck and maintains the covers.

International Load Line Convention – Hat.en: International Load Line Convention – Hatch cover standards

Hose test yapıldı ve geçti.en: Hose test carried out and passed

Hatch cover gasket'lerini kargoya baslam.en: Check the hatch cover gaskets BEFORE cargo work starts. Replacing a damaged gasket under time pressure is very difficult, so keep a stock of spare gasket between ports. An ultrasonic test gives far more reliable results than a hose test.

Kargo hasarı tazminat talepleri P&I kulü.en: Cargo damage claims are one of the largest costs for P&I clubs. Proper documentation is vital in establishing the ship's liability.

Kargo hasar takibi ve belgelenmesinden s.en: Is responsible for following up and documenting cargo damage.

Sahada hasar tespiti ve fotoğraflama..en: Inspects and photographs damage on deck and in the holds.

Letter of Protest imzası ve P&I bildirim.en: Signs the letter of protest and notifies the P&I club.

Yükleme öncesi kargo durumu kontrol edil.en: Condition of the cargo checked before loading

Hasarlar Mate's Receipt'e işlendi.en: Damage noted on the mate's receipt

Mate's Receipt'e 'clean' (temiz) yazmak.en: Do not give in to pressure to sign a clean mate's receipt. If the cargo is damaged, always clause the receipt. The words 'apparent good order and condition' mean the ship accepts responsibility, and that can later turn into a claim worth millions of dollars.

Denizde iş kazaları, karada endüstriyel.en: Occupational accidents happen at sea at several times the rate of industrial accidents ashore. Effective safety management keeps deaths and injuries to a minimum.

Güvenlik yönetiminin günlük koordinasyon.en: Coordinates safety management day to day.

ISM Kod kapsamında gemideki güvenliğin n.en: Has final responsibility for safety on board under the ISM Code.

ILO C155 – İş güvenliği ve sağlığı sözle.en: ILO C155 – Occupational Safety and Health Convention

Risk assessment operasyon öncesi yapıldı.en: Risk assessment carried out before the operation

Near-miss raporlamayı teşvik edin, cezal.en: Encourage near-miss reporting; do not punish it. Every near miss is an accident that did not happen, and a chance to learn. According to Heinrich's pyramid, every serious accident is the result of 300 unsafe situations.

Denizde yangın, en tehlikeli acil duruml.en: Fire at sea is one of the most dangerous emergencies. Until help arrives, the crew must fight it with their own resources, and an equipment failure can end in disaster.

Yangın ekipmanlarının bakımı ve kontrol.en: Is responsible for the maintenance and inspection programme for firefighting equipment.

Makine dairesi yangın sistemlerinin bakı.en: Maintains the engine room fire systems.

FSS Code – Yangın güvenlik sistemleri ko.en: FSS Code – International Code for Fire Safety Systems

Fire hose ve lans çalışır durumda.en: Fire hoses and nozzles in working order

BA setleri tüpleri dolu, maskeleri temiz.en: BA sets with full cylinders and clean masks

BA (Breathing Apparatus) kullanmayı dril.en: Practise using BA (breathing apparatus) AGAIN AND AGAIN in drills. Putting on BA under the adrenaline and stress of a real fire is much harder. Every crew member must be able to move about in darkness and smoke wearing BA.

Abandon ship durumunda bu ekipmanlar hay.en: When the ship is abandoned, this equipment is the only difference between life and death. Poorly maintained equipment will not work when it is needed.

Can kurtarma araçlarının bakım programın.en: Is responsible for the maintenance programme for the life-saving appliances.

Fiziksel bakım ve temizlik..en: Carries out hands-on maintenance and cleaning.

Drill organizasyonu ve etkinliğinin değe.en: Organises drills and assesses how effective they are.

SOLAS Bölüm III – Can kurtarma araçları.en: SOLAS Chapter III – Life-saving appliances and arrangements

LSA Code – Can kurtarma gereçleri kodu.en: LSA Code – International Life-Saving Appliance Code

IMO MSC.402(96) – Lifeboat bakım kılavuz.en: IMO MSC.402(96) – Requirements for maintenance, examination and testing of lifeboats and their release gear

Immersion suit'ler sağlam ve yerinde.en: Immersion suits sound and in place

Lifeboat hook'ları (on-load release) den.en: Lifeboat on-load release hooks are among the most dangerous mechanisms in maritime history. An accidental release during maintenance means DEATH. Hook maintenance must always be done by trained personnel with the safety pin fitted. Follow the IMO MSC.1/Circ.1206/Rev.2 guidance.

Periyodik kontroller, ekipman arızaların.en: Periodic checks find equipment failures early and prevent detainable deficiencies at PSC inspections.

Emniyet ekipmanı haftalık/aylık testleri.en: Coordinates the weekly and monthly tests of safety equipment.

SOLAS Bölüm III, Kural 20 – Periyodik ba.en: SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 20 – Operational readiness, maintenance and inspections

SOLAS Bölüm II-2, Kural 14 – Yangın güve.en: SOLAS Chapter II-2, Regulation 14 – Fire safety maintenance and tests

ISM Code, Bölüm 10 – Bakım.en: ISM Code, section 10 – Maintenance of the ship and equipment

Testleri sadece 'kâğıt üzerinde' yapmayı.en: Do not carry out tests only 'on paper'. A PSC inspector will ask when the last test was done and tell you to run the equipment. Equipment that does not work + 'tested' in the records = a serious deficiency and possible detention.

Drill, mürettebatın acil durumlarda otom.en: Drills are the only way to make sure the crew react correctly and automatically in an emergency. SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 19 requires drills at least once a month.

Drill emrini verir, performansı değerlen.en: Orders the drill and assesses performance.

Güverte ekip performansını denetler..en: Supervises the performance of the deck team.

Makine ekip performansını denetler..en: Supervises the performance of the engine team.

SOLAS III/19 – Drill ve eğitim gereklili.en: SOLAS III/19 – Training and drill requirements (19.3.2 monthly drills, 19.3.3 enclosed space, 19.3.4.3/19.3.4.6 lowering lifeboats and rescue boats)

SOLAS III/30.2 – Yolcu gemilerinde hafta.en: SOLAS III/30.2 – Weekly drills on passenger ships

ISPS Code A/13.4 – Güvenlik drilleri (en.en: ISPS Code A/13.4 – Security drills (at least every three months)

ISM Code 8 / şirket SMS'i – Oil spill (S.en: ISM Code section 8 / company SMS – additional scenarios such as oil spill (SOPEP), MOB and blackout

En az 2 ayda bir kapalı mahal giriş/kurt.en: Enclosed space entry and rescue drill at least every 2 months

En az 3 ayda bir filika suya indirildi v.en: Lifeboat launched and manoeuvred in the water at least every 3 months

Gemiye katılan personele en geç 2 hafta.en: LSA/FFE training given to new crew within 2 weeks of joining

Drill'leri her zaman aynı senaryoyla yap.en: Running drills with the same scenario every time prepares the crew for that scenario only. Add demanding conditions such as night drills, bad-weather drills and casualty scenarios. Real emergencies never come at a convenient time.

Muster list, acil durumda kargaşayı önle.en: The muster list is the basic organisational tool that prevents confusion in an emergency. It is mandatory under SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 37.

Muster list'in hazırlanması ve onaylanma.en: Has final responsibility for preparing and approving the muster list.

Muster list'in güncellenmesi ve asılması.en: Keeps the muster list up to date and posted.

SOLAS Bölüm III, Kural 37 – Muster list.en: SOLAS Chapter III, Regulation 37 – Muster list and emergency instructions

STCW Kod A-VI/1 – Temel güvenlik eğitimi.en: STCW Code A-VI/1 – Basic safety training

Muster list güncel (son personel değişik.en: Muster list up to date (latest crew change included)

Alarm sinyalleri muster list'te açıklanm.en: Alarm signals explained on the muster list

Muster list'i sadece kağıt üzerinde tutm.en: Do not keep the muster list only on paper; make sure every crew member knows their OWN duty by heart. Reading the list during a drill wastes time. The aim is for everyone to go straight to their station when the alarm sounds.

ISM Kod uyumsuzluğu, DOC (Document of Co.en: Non-compliance with the ISM Code can lead to withdrawal of the DOC (Document of Compliance) and the SMC (Safety Management Certificate), which means the ship cannot trade.

Gemideki ISM sisteminin uygulanmasından.en: Has final responsibility for implementing the ISM system on board.

ISM Code (IMO Res. A.741(18)) – Tüm bölü.en: ISM Code (IMO Res. A.741(18)) – All sections

SOLAS Bölüm IX – ISM Code uygulaması.en: SOLAS Chapter IX – Implementation of the ISM Code

SMS dokümanları son versiyon.en: SMS documents at the latest revision

ISM kayıtlarını 'denetim için' değil, 'ö.en: Keep ISM records to learn, not to pass audits. Every non-conformity is a chance to learn. A report closed without a real root-cause analysis lets the same problem happen again.

ISPS Code, gemilerin terörizm ve sabotaj.en: The ISPS Code aims to protect ships against the threats of terrorism and sabotage. Non-compliance can lead to the ship being refused entry to port.

Gemide güvenliğin nihai sorumlusu..en: Has final responsibility for security on board.

ISPS uygulamalarını koordine eder. Genel.en: Coordinates ISPS measures; usually an officer is appointed.

SOLAS Bölüm XI-2 – Deniz güvenliği.en: SOLAS Chapter XI-2 – Special measures to enhance maritime security

ISPS Code – Part A (zorunlu) ve Part B (.en: ISPS Code – Part A (mandatory) and Part B (guidance)

Güvenlik seviyesi belirlenmiş ve uygulan.en: Security level set and in force

Gangway nöbeti 24 saat aktif.en: Gangway watch kept 24 hours a day

SSAS butonunun yerini TÜM zabitler bilme.en: ALL officers must know where the SSAS buttons are, but the buttons must have a protective cover so they are not pressed by accident. SSAS sends a silent alert in a real security threat; it is the way to call for help without the attackers knowing.

Limanda gemi, dışarıdan gelecek tehditle.en: In port, the ship is exposed to outside threats (theft, sabotage, stowaways, terrorism). The security watch deters and detects them.

Nöbet düzenini planlar ve denetler..en: Plans and supervises the watch arrangements.

Ziyaretçi defteri mevcut ve kullanılıyor.en: Visitors' log in place and in use

Security watch nöbetinde uyanık kalın. G.en: Stay alert on security watch. A gangway watch at night can be boring, but stowaways usually board quietly at night. Finding a stowaway costs the ship thousands of dollars and causes serious legal problems.

Deniz ortamında korozyon kaçınılmazdır..en: Corrosion is unavoidable at sea. Without regular chipping and painting, the structure loses strength, the ship may be detained at PSC inspections and its value falls.

Boya ve bakım programının planlanmasında.en: Is responsible for planning the painting and maintenance programme.

Boya ekibini yönetir, malzeme kontrolü y.en: Leads the painting team and controls the materials.

Boya işlemini kuru ve ılık havada yapın..en: Paint in dry, mild weather. Do not paint when the relative humidity is above 85% or the surface temperature is not at least 3°C above the dew point; the paint will not adhere, will soon flake off and the job will have to be done twice.

Temiz güverte, kayma/düşme kazalarını ön.en: A clean deck prevents slips and falls, lets the first signs of corrosion be spotted early and reflects the ship's general standard of maintenance.

Güverte bakım standardını belirler..en: Sets the standard of deck maintenance.

Güverte yıkarken su hortumunu asla gözet.en: Never leave a hose unattended while washing down; uncontrolled water under pressure can injure people. In winter, do not wash down in areas at risk of freezing; ice makes the deck lethally slippery.

Kopan halat veya tel, personel için ölüm.en: A parting line or wire is a deadly danger to the crew. If a worn line or wire is not found in time, a mooring or cargo operation can end in disaster.

Halat/tel envanter ve değişim planlaması.en: Keeps the inventory of lines and wires and plans their renewal.

Fiziksel kontrol ve bakım..en: Carries out the physical inspection and maintenance.

OCIMF MEG4 – Mooring halat/tel kriterler.en: OCIMF MEG4 – Criteria for mooring lines and wires

Tüm mooring halatları/telleri kontrol ed.en: All mooring lines and wires inspected

Kopuk tel sayısı limit altında.en: Number of broken wires below the limit

Sentetik halatlarda kesik/erime yok.en: No cuts or fused areas on synthetic lines

ASLA tel halat ile sentetik halatı aynı.en: NEVER use wire and synthetic lines together on the same bollard or the same winch. Because their elasticity is different, the load is not shared evenly; one line takes far more of the load and is more likely to part.

Yağlanmayan mekanik parçalar aşınır, ısı.en: Moving parts that are not lubricated wear, overheat and seize. A crane failure stops cargo work; a winch failure puts the safety of the moorings at risk.

Yağlama ve temizlik işlemlerini yapar..en: Carries out the lubrication and cleaning.

Bakım kalitesini denetler..en: Checks the quality of the maintenance.

Grease gun ile yağlarken aşırı yağlama y.en: Do not over-grease with the grease gun; too much grease forces the seals and causes leaks. Use the right type of grease (marine grade, water-resistant); the wrong grease gives no protection against seawater.

Yetersiz güverte aydınlatması gece opera.en: Poor deck lighting increases the risk of accidents during night operations. It is also critical that deck lights other than the navigation lights do not spoil the OOW's night vision at sea.

Aydınlatma planlaması ve standart belirl.en: Plans the lighting and sets the standard.

Seyirde gereksiz ışıklar kapatıldı.en: Unnecessary lights switched off at sea

LED aydınlatmaya geçiş yapın. Geleneksel.en: Change over to LED lighting. Conventional halogen bulbs fail very quickly at sea and use a lot of power. LEDs last 10 times longer and save energy.

Seyir fenerleri, geminin diğer gemiler t.en: Navigation lights are the main way other ships recognise a vessel (its type, aspect and status). A failed or wrong light can lead directly to a collision.

Seyir fenerleri ve işaretlerin sorumlulu.en: Responsible for the navigation lights and shapes.

Fener temizliği ve ampul değişimi..en: Cleans the lights and changes bulbs.

Fener devresi arıza tespiti..en: Finds faults in the navigation light circuits.

Fener arızası seyir sırasında acil durum.en: A navigation light failure at sea is an emergency. Always keep a set of portable spare lights ready. Remember to test the changeover to the standby lamp on the navigation light panel; on some older systems the automatic changeover may not work.

Plansız çalışma, verimsizlik, iş güvenli.en: Unplanned work leads to inefficiency, safety risks and an unhappy crew. A good daily plan makes the best use of limited resources.

Günlük iş planını hazırlar ve onaylar..en: Prepares and approves the daily work plan.

İş planını güverte ekibine aktarır ve uy.en: Passes the work plan to the deck crew and runs the work.

İş güvenliği risk değerlendirmesi yapıld.en: Risk assessment for the work carried out

Çalışma saatleri MLC'ye uygun.en: Hours of work comply with the MLC

Sabah toplantısını 5-10 dakikada tamamla.en: Finish the morning meeting in 5-10 minutes; long meetings are inefficient. Stress the critical safety points, give clear instructions and ask 'any questions?'. Never make plans that break the hours of work and rest; an MLC breach is a PSC deficiency.

Doğru kişiyi doğru göreve atamak, hem em.en: Putting the right person on the right job is critical for both safety and efficiency. The ISM Code requires crew competence to be assessed regularly.

Güverte personelinin yönetimi ve perform.en: Manages the deck crew and follows their performance.

ISM Code, Bölüm 6 – Kaynaklar ve persone.en: ISM Code, section 6 – Resources and personnel

Tecrübesiz personeli deneyimli personell.en: Pair inexperienced crew with experienced ones (buddy system); do not give them jobs on their own. Every newcomer on board is a potential source of risk, so carry out familiarisation to really teach, not as a formality.

Disiplinsiz bir gemi, güvensiz bir gemid.en: An undisciplined ship is an unsafe ship. Establishing authority properly has a direct effect on both safety and morale.

Gemideki disiplinin nihai sorumlusu..en: Has final responsibility for discipline on board.

Güverte departmanı disiplinini izler..en: Oversees discipline in the deck department.

Makine departmanı disiplinini izler..en: Oversees discipline in the engine department.

Alkol/uyuşturucu politikası tüm personel.en: Drug and alcohol policy made known to all crew

Çalışma/dinlenme saatleri kayıt altında.en: Hours of work and rest recorded

Disiplin, korku ile değil SAYGI ile sağl.en: Discipline comes from RESPECT, not fear. Be fair, consistent and open, and apply the same rules to everyone. A good Master listens to the crew but does not hesitate when a decision is needed.

Denizde iş kazaları, karadaki endüstriye.en: Occupational accidents at sea happen at 2-3 times the rate of industrial accidents ashore. Effective safety management saves lives.

PPE kullanımı, güvensiz durumları raporl.en: Wears PPE and reports unsafe conditions.

İş sorumlusu.en: Person in charge of the job

Bosun/İş sorumlusu.en: Bosun / person in charge of the job

En tehlikeli düşünce 'bunu her zaman böy.en: The most dangerous thought is 'we have always done it this way and nothing happened'. Assess every job as if it were being done for the first time. Complacency is the biggest killer at sea.

STCW Kod A-VI/1 ve ISM Code kapsamında z.en: It is mandatory under STCW Code A-VI/1 and the ISM Code. When new crew work without knowing the ship, the risk of an accident multiplies.

Familiarization training'in koordinasyon.en: Coordinates familiarisation training and keeps the records.

Güverte personelinin görev tanıtımı..en: Introduces deck crew to their duties.

Oryantasyonun tamamlandığını teyit eder..en: Confirms that familiarisation has been completed.

Muster station ve görev kartı gösterildi.en: Muster station and duty card shown

Yeni personele gemideyi İLK GÜN tanıtın..en: Show new crew around the ship on their FIRST DAY. If they cannot find their way in an emergency, they may lose their life. Never put off familiarisation; even someone who joins at night must be shown round first thing the next morning.

Sürekli eğitim, yetkinliğin korunması ve.en: Continuous training is essential to maintain and develop competence. STCW and the ISM Code require training to be planned and recorded.

Eğitim programının onayı ve genel soruml.en: Approves the training programme and has overall responsibility for it.

Güverte ekibi eğitim koordinasyonu..en: Coordinates training for the deck team.

Makine ekibi eğitim koordinasyonu..en: Coordinates training for the engine team.

Eğitimi sıkıcı yapmayın. Gerçek kaza rap.en: Do not make training boring. Discuss real accident reports (MAIB, NTSB); crews learn far more from real events. Asking 'could this have happened to us?' is a powerful learning tool.

PSC denetiminde ciddi eksiklik (deficien.en: If a PSC inspection finds serious deficiencies, the ship can be detained. That means commercial losses, higher insurance premiums and damage to the company's reputation.

PSC hazırlığının genel sorumlusu..en: Has overall responsibility for PSC preparation.

Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – PSC prosedürleri.en: Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – PSC procedures

IMO Res. A.1138(31) – PSC prosedürleri.en: IMO Res. A.1138(31) – Procedures for port State control (PSC)

Tüm SOLAS, MARPOL, STCW, MLC gereklilikl.en: All SOLAS, MARPOL, STCW and MLC requirements

Logbook'lar güncel ve düzgün tutulmuş.en: Logbooks up to date and properly kept

Çalışma saatleri kayıtları uygun.en: Hours of work records in order

PSC müfettişinin ilk izlenimi çok önemli.en: The PSC inspector's first impression matters a great deal. A clean gangway, a tidy deck, a friendly welcome and documents ready to hand make an expanded inspection less likely. If the first impression is bad, the inspector will check everything.

Logbook'lar yasal belgelerdir. Mahkemede.en: Logbooks are legal documents. They are used as evidence in court, in insurance claims and at PSC inspections.

Vardiya süresince Deck Log Book tutulmas.en: Keeps the deck logbook during the watch.

Engine Log Book ve Oil Record Book Part.en: Engine logbook and Oil Record Book Part I.

Oil Record Book Part II (kargo operasyon.en: Oil Record Book Part II (cargo operations, tankers) and Cargo Record Book.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 28 – Kayıt tutma.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 28 – Records of navigational activities

Deck Log Book güncel ve imzalı.en: Deck logbook up to date and signed

Oil Record Book güncel.en: Oil Record Book up to date

Garbage Record Book güncel.en: Garbage Record Book up to date

Oil Record Book'u doldurmaktan ASLA kaçı.en: NEVER neglect the Oil Record Book. PSC inspectors pay particular attention to the ORB. Blank pages or inconsistent entries raise suspicion of a MARPOL violation and trigger a more detailed inspection. The time and quantity of every operation must be clear.

Checklist, kritik adımların atlanmasını.en: A checklist is the most effective tool for making sure critical steps are not missed. Adapted from the aviation industry, the system has a proven record in preventing marine accidents.

Kendi sorumluluk alanındaki checklist'le.en: Works through the checklists for their own area of responsibility.

Checklist'i 'tick box exercise' olarak y.en: Do not treat a checklist as a box-ticking exercise. Tick each item only after you have really checked it. Skipping items because 'I already know' has caused accidents even in aviation. Checklist discipline saves lives.

Geçersiz sertifika, geminin seferden men.en: An invalid certificate means the ship cannot sail. Certificates are checked closely by the flag State and by PSC.

Tüm sertifikaların geçerliliğinden nihai.en: Has final responsibility for the validity of all certificates.

Kendi alanlarına ilişkin sertifikaların.en: Follow up the certificates for their own areas.

SOLAS, MARPOL, Load Line Convention – Se.en: SOLAS, MARPOL, Load Line Convention – Certificate requirements

Yıllık/ara survey tarihleri planlandı.en: Annual and intermediate survey dates planned

Sertifika geçerliliğini bir Excel tablos.en: Track certificate validity with a spreadsheet or a calendar so that no survey comes as a surprise. It is especially important not to miss the annual endorsement windows (±3 months); a missed endorsement makes the certificate invalid.

Etkin raporlama, kara ile gemi arasındak.en: Effective reporting keeps communication between ship and shore working well and supports compliance with the ISM Code.

Tüm raporlamanın doğruluğu ve zamanlamas.en: Is responsible for the accuracy and timeliness of all reports.

IMO DCS – Yakıt tüketimi raporlaması.en: IMO DCS – Fuel oil consumption reporting

Voyage raporu sefer sonunda tamamlanıyor.en: Voyage report completed at the end of the voyage

Noon report'taki verilerin DOĞRU olduğun.en: Make sure the figures in the noon report are CORRECT. Under-reporting fuel consumption to 'look good' leads to serious problems later (charter party disputes, CII calculation errors). Report the real figures.

Kapatılmayan deficiency, follow-up inspe.en: A deficiency left open raises the risk of a follow-up inspection and detention. It also raises the ship's risk profile, so it is inspected more often.

Güverte tarafı deficiency takibi ve düze.en: Follows up and rectifies deck-side deficiencies.

Makine tarafı deficiency takibi ve düzel.en: Follows up and rectifies engine-side deficiencies.

Genel takip ve şirket ile koordinasyon..en: Overall follow-up and coordination with the company.

Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – Deficiency kodla.en: Paris MoU / Tokyo MoU – Deficiency codes and procedures

Deficiency'yi sadece 'kapatmak' için değ.en: Work to really FIX a deficiency, not just to close it. A superficial fix without a root-cause analysis means the same deficiency is written up again at the next inspection, and a repeated deficiency is a red flag to an inspector.

Yangın, geminin kaybına, personel ölümün.en: A fire can lead to the loss of the ship, loss of life and environmental disaster. A fast, organised response saves lives.

Genel alarm kararı, koordinasyon, dış il.en: Decides on the general alarm, coordinates the response and handles outside communications (MAYDAY if needed).

Yangın ekibi liderliği, müdahale koordin.en: Leads the fire party and coordinates the response.

Yangın ekibi üyesi, BA seti ile müdahale.en: Fire party member; fights the fire wearing a BA set.

Fire pump, ventilasyon, yakıt kesme..en: Fire pump, ventilation, shutting off fuel.

STCW Kod A-VI/1 ve A-VI/3 – Yangınla müc.en: STCW Code A-VI/1 and A-VI/3 – Firefighting training

Yangın ekibi BA ile olay yerine gitti.en: Fire party at the scene wearing BA

Yangın ilk 5 dakikada söndürülmezse kont.en: If a fire is not put out in the first 5 minutes, the risk of it getting out of control multiplies. That is why the first response (the nearest extinguisher) is vital. Every crew member must know where the nearest extinguisher is and be able to use it. Do NOT enter a smoke-filled space without BA – CO poisoning can kill in a few breaths.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 33.1 – Denizde tehl.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 33.1 – International law requires assistance to be given to persons in distress at sea.

Manevra, koordinasyon, MRCC ile iletişim.en: Manoeuvring, coordination and communication with the MRCC.

Haberleşme ve mevki takibi..en: Communications and keeping track of the position.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 33.1 – Yardım yüküm.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 33.1 – Obligation to render assistance

STCW Kod A-VI/1 – Kişisel kurtarma tekni.en: STCW Code A-VI/1 – Personal survival techniques

Soğuk suda kurtarılan kişileri YATAY ola.en: Lift people rescued from cold water HORIZONTALLY. A vertical lift can cause sudden cardiac arrest in a hypothermic casualty (circum-rescue collapse). Never forget this in a cold-water rescue.

Denize düşen kişinin hayatta kalma süres.en: How long a person overboard can survive depends on the water temperature; in cold water it is a matter of minutes. A fast, correct response saves lives.

Manevra kararı, genel koordinasyon..en: Decides on the manoeuvre and coordinates overall.

Can simidi atma, gözle takip..en: Throws a lifebuoy and keeps the person in sight.

SOLAS Bölüm III – Can kurtarma.en: SOLAS Chapter III – Life-saving appliances and arrangements

Williamson Turn: Dümen tam bir tarafa ba.en: Williamson turn: put the rudder hard over to one side → after a 60° change of heading, put it hard over to the other side → when the heading is nearing the reciprocal of the original course, put the rudder amidships. The manoeuvre brings the ship back along its original track. The first turn is towards the side the person fell from (if they fell from the starboard side → hard a-starboard).

Çatışma, su alma, yangın, çevre kirliliğ.en: A collision can lead to flooding, fire, pollution and loss of life. The right decisions in the first minutes decide the outcome.

Pompa operasyonu, makine durumu izleme..en: Runs the pumps and monitors the machinery.

COLREG Kural 8 – Çatışmayı önleme manevr.en: COLREG Rule 8 – Action to avoid collision

Deniz Hukuku – Çatışma sonrası sorumlulu.en: Maritime law – Duties after a collision

Çatışma sonrası gemileri birbirinden HEM.en: After a collision, do NOT separate the ships straight away. Sometimes the other ship's bow is plugging your damaged area, and flooding can speed up once the ships part. Assess the damage first. The VDR record of the incident is also legal evidence – do NOT tamper with the VDR.

Karaya oturma, gövde hasarı, çevre kirli.en: A grounding can lead to hull damage, pollution and loss of the ship. The wrong response (going astern at once) can make the damage worse.

Makine durumu, yakıt transferi, pompa op.en: Machinery status, fuel transfers, pump operation.

Karaya oturduktan sonra ASLA ana makiney.en: After grounding, NEVER put the main engine full astern. The propeller wash draws sand and mud from the seabed into the cooling water intakes (blocked sea chests), and there is a high risk of propeller damage. Wait for the tide and professional assistance.

Abandon ship, son çare olarak uygulanır..en: Abandoning ship is the last resort. Many cases in maritime history show the fatal consequences of abandoning too early or too late.

Abandon ship kararı, son MAYDAY, en son.en: Decides to abandon ship, sends the last MAYDAY and is the last to leave.

Makine güvenliğe alma, son personel kont.en: Makes the machinery safe and does the final check for personnel.

Denize atlamak ZORUNLU kalmadıkça yapılm.en: Jump into the sea only if you HAVE to. A jump from more than 5 metres above the water can cause serious injury. If you must jump: do not inflate the lifejacket first (it can be forced up against your throat), keep your feet down, hold your nose with one hand and grip the lifejacket with the other. Inflate it once you are in the water and move away from the ship.

Denizde hastane yoktur. İlk yardım ve te.en: There is no hospital at sea. First aid and telemedicine (radio medical advice) save lives. Depending on the case, the ship may divert or ask for a helicopter evacuation.

Tıbbi kararlar (TMAS ile koordineli), ro.en: Medical decisions (coordinated with TMAS), diversion and evacuation decisions.

ILO C164 – Denizcilerin sağlık koruması.en: ILO C164 – Health Protection and Medical Care (Seafarers) Convention

IMO MSC/Circ.960 – Tıbbi ilk yardım kıla.en: IMO MSC/Circ.960 – Medical first aid guide

Medical Log kaydı tutuldu.en: Entry made in the medical log

Her gemide en az bir kişi Medical First.en: Every ship must have at least one person trained in medical first aid (STCW). EVERYONE should be able to use the AED (automated external defibrillator); it is not complicated and the device gives spoken instructions. Defibrillation in the first 3 minutes of cardiac arrest raises the chance of survival to 70%.

Deniz kirliliği ağır para cezaları, gemi.en: Marine pollution leads to heavy fines, detention and damage to the company's reputation. Under MARPOL Annex I, every oil spill must be reported.

Oil spill müdahale koordinasyonu. SOPEP.en: Coordinates the oil spill response and carries out the SOPEP.

Bildirimlerin yapılması, genel koordinas.en: Makes the reports and coordinates overall.

Makine tarafı sızıntı kontrolü..en: Controls leaks on the engine side.

MARPOL Ek I – Petrol kirliliğinin önlenm.en: MARPOL Annex I – Prevention of pollution by oil

OPRC Convention – Petrol kirliliğine haz.en: OPRC Convention – Oil pollution preparedness, response and co-operation

SOPEP – Gemi Yağ Kirliliği Acil Planı.en: SOPEP – Shipboard Oil Pollution Emergency Plan

Sızıntı kaynağı tespit ve durduruldu.en: Source of the spill found and stopped

Oil Record Book'a kayıt yapıldı.en: Entry made in the Oil Record Book

SOPEP'i okumadan rafa kaldırmayın. Oil s.en: Do not put the SOPEP on the shelf unread. Searching for the contact list in the panic of an oil spill wastes time. Update the coastal State contact details in the SOPEP BEFORE ENTERING EVERY PORT. Scupper plugs must always be within easy reach.

Ana makine, geminin hareket yeteneğini s.en: The main engine is the basic equipment that moves the ship. Its failure is a direct threat to safe navigation and can end in a blackout.

Ana makine operasyonunun genel sorumlulu.en: Overall responsibility for the main engine.

Vardiyalı operasyon ve izleme..en: Runs and monitors the engine on watch.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Makine ve elektrik te.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Machinery and electrical installations

Exhaust temp silinderler arası fark kabu.en: Difference in exhaust temperatures between cylinders acceptable

Exhaust temperature sapması (bir silindi.en: An exhaust temperature deviation (one cylinder 50°C+ away from the others) is an early warning of an injector fault, a leaking valve or a piston ring problem. Ignoring it invites major damage.

Yardımcı makineler geminin elektrik, hav.en: The auxiliary machinery supplies the ship's electricity, air and water. Its failure leads to a blackout or to critical systems being lost.

Yardımcı makine bakım programının koordi.en: Coordinates the auxiliary machinery maintenance programme.

Fiziksel bakım ve onarım işlemleri..en: Carries out the maintenance and repair work.

Yardımcı makinelerin bakımını ertelemeyi.en: Do not postpone maintenance on auxiliary machinery. 'It's running, leave it alone' is one of the most dangerous attitudes at sea. Keep to the running hours in the PMS; postponed maintenance brings the failure at the worst possible moment.

Balast operasyonu, stabilite ve yapısal.en: Ballast operations directly affect stability and hull strength; a ballasting error can sink a ship. Under the BWM Convention, the spread of invasive species is also controlled.

Stabilite hesabı ve balast planı onayı..en: Approves the stability calculation and the ballast plan.

Balast operasyonunu ASLA gözetimsiz bıra.en: NEVER leave a ballast operation unattended. An overflowing tank causes pollution and a safety hazard on deck. Always allow for the free surface effect of slack tanks; partly filled tanks reduce stability seriously.

Bunkering sırasında yakıt sızıntısı, çev.en: Fuel spills during bunkering are one of the most common causes of pollution. Bunkering is subject to strict rules under MARPOL Annex I.

Manifold başında gözetim ve tank izleme..en: Watches the manifold and monitors the tanks.

MARPOL Ek I – Yakıt sızıntısı önleme.en: MARPOL Annex I – Prevention of oil spills

MARPOL Ek VI – Yakıt kalitesi (sülfür li.en: MARPOL Annex VI – Fuel oil quality (sulphur limit)

Bunkering sırasında ASLA gözetimsiz bıra.en: NEVER leave bunkering unattended; someone must be at the manifold at all times. 'No leak, no problem' is a recipe for disaster. Keep the fuel samples for 12 months – they are your legal evidence in a fuel quality dispute.

Jeneratör arızası blackout'a yol açar. B.en: A generator failure leads to a blackout, which means losing navigation, steering, fire pumps and emergency systems. At sea this can be fatal.

Frekans ve voltaj nominal.en: Frequency and voltage at rated values

Senkronizasyon sırasında synchroscope ib.en: When synchronising, the synchroscope pointer must turn CLOCKWISE and SLOWLY. Closing the breaker while it turns anticlockwise causes a reverse power trip and damage to the generator. Do not rush; match the frequency gently.

Yakıt transferi sırasında taşma, sızıntı.en: Overflows, leaks and choosing the wrong tank during fuel transfers are among the most common causes of oil spills. They can end in a MARPOL violation and a heavy fine.

Fiziksel transfer operasyonu ve izleme..en: Carries out and monitors the transfer.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Yakıt sistemi güvenli.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Safety of the fuel oil system

Tank kapasiteleri ve mevcut seviyeler ko.en: Tank capacities and present levels checked

Oil Record Book'a kaydedildi.en: Entered in the Oil Record Book

Yakıt transferini ASLA yatmadan önce baş.en: NEVER start a fuel transfer and leave it running when you go to bed. If the tank overflows, the alarm may fail or not be heard. Name a responsible person to watch the transfer, and remember to plug the scuppers.

Yağlama yetersizliği, yatak yanması, pis.en: Insufficient lubrication leads directly to burnt-out bearings, piston seizure and engine damage. Low LO pressure is one of the most critical alarms and needs immediate action.

Yağlama sistemi yönetimi ve analiz takib.en: Manages the lubrication system and follows up the oil analyses.

Günlük kontroller, filtre temizliği, yağ.en: Daily checks, filter cleaning, topping up oil.

LO analizinde TBN (Total Base Number) de.en: In the LO analysis, a TBN (total base number) below 20 shows that the oil's capacity to neutralise acids has fallen. With high-sulphur fuels this is critical: a low TBN leads to liner corrosion.

Yetersiz soğutma, aşırı ısınma, termal s.en: Insufficient cooling leads to overheating, thermal stress and engine damage. If cooling water leaks into a cylinder, it can cause a hydraulic lock and break the connecting rod.

Jacket water sıcaklığının ani yükselmesi.en: A sudden rise in jacket water temperature can point to a thermostat failure, pump cavitation or an air lock. A falling expansion tank level points to a leak, and a leak into a cylinder has disastrous consequences.

Sintine yönetimi MARPOL Ek I'in en sıkı.en: Bilge management is the most strictly inspected subject under MARPOL Annex I. Bypassing the OWS or discharging dirty bilge water can lead to severe criminal penalties, including imprisonment.

Sintine pompası ve OWS operasyonu..en: Runs the bilge pump and the OWS.

Sintine seviye takibi ve pompa operasyon.en: Monitors the bilge levels and runs the pump.

MARPOL Ek I, Kural 14 – Yağlı su deşarjı.en: MARPOL Annex I, Regulation 14 – Oily water discharge (15 ppm rule)

Oil Record Book Part I güncel.en: Oil Record Book Part I up to date

OWS'yi ASLA bypass etmeyin. 'Magic pipe'.en: NEVER bypass the OWS. 'Magic pipe' cases have led to some of the heaviest penalties in maritime history; if one is found in a US port, the result is fines of millions of dollars and prison sentences. If the 15 ppm alarm is not working properly, do not use the system; deliver the bilge water ashore.

Temizlenmemiş yakıt, enjektör tıkanması,.en: Untreated fuel leads to blocked injectors, excessive wear and engine damage. With cat fines (Al+Si) above 15 ppm, liner and piston ring damage is inevitable.

LO separator operasyonu ve sludge tank t.en: Runs the LO separators and monitors the sludge tank.

Separator'ü tam kapasitede çalıştırmayın.en: Do not run a separator at full capacity; running it at 50-70% capacity improves separation dramatically. If there is a cat fines problem, run two separators in series (purifier + clarifier). With the wrong gravity disc, the oil–water interface moves and there is no separation.

Kazan patlaması denizcilik tarihinin en.en: Boiler explosions are among the deadliest accidents in maritime history. Low water level or a failed safety valve has disastrous consequences.

Kazan operasyonunun planlanması ve bakım.en: Plans boiler operation and coordinates its maintenance.

Günlük operasyon, su testi ve blowdown..en: Daily operation, water tests and blowdown.

Su seviyesi gauge glass ile kontrol edil.en: Water level checked in the gauge glass

Kazan su seviyesini ASLA gauge glass olm.en: NEVER follow the boiler water level without the gauge glass; electronic level indicators can fail. Keep a spare glass ready in case the gauge glass bursts. Never skip the pre-purge: unburnt fuel collecting in the furnace causes a furnace explosion.

Başlatma havası olmadan ana makine çalış.en: Without starting air the main engine cannot be started. Being unable to start the engine in an emergency is a direct threat to the safety of the ship. SOLAS requires capacity for at least 12 consecutive starts.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – Başlatma havası gerek.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – Starting air requirements

Hava şişelerini drenaj etmeyi ihmal etme.en: Do not neglect draining the air receivers. Moisture carried through the starting air line into the cylinders causes corrosion and damages the starting valves. Drain them daily and always keep at least two air receivers full.

Pompalar geminin damar sistemidir. Yakıt.en: Pumps are the ship's circulatory system. The fuel, cooling, lubrication, ballast, bilge, fire and cargo systems all depend on them.

Fiziksel bakım ve onarım..en: Carries out the maintenance and repairs.

PMS bakım kayıtları güncel.en: PMS maintenance records up to date

Santrifüj pompayı kuru çalıştırmak, mech.en: Running a centrifugal pump dry burns out the mechanical seal in seconds. Before starting, make sure the suction valve is open and the pump is primed and not drawing air. If you hear cavitation (a sound like gravel), stop it at once.

Elektrik arızası blackout'a yol açar. Bl.en: An electrical failure leads to a blackout. At sea, a blackout means losing the steering gear, radar, ECDIS and fire pumps.

Elektrik sistemi bakım ve arıza gidermes.en: Maintains the electrical system and finds faults.

Elektrik sistemi yönetim sorumluluğu..en: Responsible for managing the electrical system.

Switchboard üzerinde çalışırken ASLA tek.en: NEVER work on a switchboard alone. Someone must be standing by who knows where the emergency stop is. Arc flash is a deadly hazard; wear suitable PPE (arc flash suit, insulating gloves).

Modern gemilerin büyük çoğunluğu UMS (Un.en: Most modern ships are classed for UMS (unattended machinery spaces). An automation failure means the engine room has to be manned continuously, which adds to the crew's workload.

Otomasyon sistemi genel sorumluluğu..en: Overall responsibility for the automation system.

Sensor, PLC ve kontrol sistemi bakımı..en: Maintains sensors, PLCs and the control system.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1 – UMS gereklilikleri.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1 – UMS requirements (periodically unattended machinery spaces)

UMS night mode alarm transferi çalışıyor.en: UMS alarm transfer to cabins working

Alarm yorgunluğu (alarm fatigue) ciddi b.en: Alarm fatigue is a serious risk: constant nuisance alarms make a real critical alarm easy to miss. Fix the root cause instead of suppressing unnecessary alarms, and write an 'accepted alarm' policy under the ISM system.

Denizde yedek parça bulunamaz. Kritik bi.en: Spare parts cannot be found at sea. A missing critical spare means a machinery failure that cannot be fixed, and the ship going off hire.

Yedek parça bütçesi ve genel yönetim..en: Spare parts budget and overall management.

Envanter takibi ve sipariş koordinasyonu.en: Keeps the inventory and coordinates orders.

IMPA katalog numaralarını doğru kullanın.en: Use IMPA catalogue numbers correctly; a wrong part number means the wrong part arriving and weeks of waiting. Keep at least 1 extra set of critical spares (injectors, piston rings, gasket sets).

Engine Log Book, makine performansının t.en: The engine logbook is the history of the machinery's performance. It is a critical document at PSC inspections, in failure analysis and in legal disputes.

Engine Log Book'un doğruluğu ve kontrolü.en: Checks the engine logbook and is responsible for its accuracy.

Vardiya süresince kayıtları tutar..en: Makes the entries during the watch.

C/E kontrolü ve imzası.en: Checked and signed by the C/E

Engine Log Book'taki exhaust temperature.en: Trend the exhaust temperatures in the engine logbook. A gradual rise on one cylinder over several weeks gives early warning of injector wear or a leaking exhaust valve.

PMS, ISM Code Bölüm 10 gereği zorunludur.en: A PMS is mandatory under section 10 of the ISM Code. PMS records are examined in detail at PSC inspections; missing or false records are grounds for a deficiency and detention.

PMS koordinasyonu ve bakım planlaması..en: Coordinates the PMS and plans maintenance.

Kendi sorumluluk alanlarındaki bakım işl.en: Carry out and record the maintenance in their own areas of responsibility.

Bakım programı güncel ve takip ediliyor.en: Maintenance programme up to date and being followed

PMS kayıtlarını 'yapmış gibi' doldurmak.en: Filling in PMS records for work that was not done is the most dangerous habit of all. PSC inspectors can check physically whether maintenance recorded as 'done' in the PMS was really carried out. A false record is a major non-conformity under the ISM Code.

LO analizi erken arıza teşhisi sağlar (m.en: LO analysis gives early warning of failures (metal particles show bearing wear, water contamination shows a leak). FO analysis confirms that the fuel quality meets MARPOL and ISO 8217.

Analiz programı ve sonuç değerlendirmesi.en: Runs the analysis programme and reviews the results.

MARPOL Ek VI – Yakıt sülfür limiti.en: MARPOL Annex VI – Fuel oil sulphur limit

LO numuneleri planlanan aralıkta alındı.en: LO samples taken at the planned intervals

FO numunesi her bunkering'de alındı.en: FO sample taken at every bunkering

Limit aşımı varsa aksiyon alındı.en: Action taken on any result over the limit

LO analizinde demir (Fe) partikül miktar.en: A sudden rise in iron (Fe) particles in the LO analysis is an early warning of bearing or liner wear. A rising trend shows that serious damage may be close. Follow the analysis results as a TREND: look at the trend, not at a single result.

Kirli makine dairesi yangın riskini artı.en: A dirty engine room increases the fire risk (oil deposits + hot surfaces = fire), makes leaks harder to find and gives a bad impression at PSC inspections.

ISM Code – Genel bakım standardı.en: ISM Code – General standard of maintenance

Temiz makine dairesi = güvenli makine da.en: A clean engine room is a safe engine room. The first impression when a PSC inspector enters the engine room matters a great deal: a dirty, untidy engine room suggests poor maintenance too and triggers a more detailed inspection. Oil-soaked lagging can also catch fire on a hot exhaust manifold.

Blackout durumunda acil aydınlatma, seyi.en: In a blackout, the emergency generator supplying the emergency lighting, navigation lights, GMDSS, steering gear and fire pumps is vital equipment. SOLAS requires it to start and come on load automatically within 45 seconds.

Emergency generator bakım ve test soruml.en: Responsible for maintaining and testing the emergency generator.

Fiziksel bakım ve testler..en: Carries out the maintenance and tests.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1, Kural 44 – Acil güç ka.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 44 – Emergency source of power

Emergency generator testini GERÇEKTEN ya.en: Test the emergency generator PROPERLY. In the weekly test, 'start and stop' is not enough; run it for at least 10 minutes and watch the readings. In the 6-monthly test, put real load on the emergency switchboard. Testing it only off load will not stop it failing under load.

Dümen arızası, geminin manevra kabiliyet.en: A steering failure means the ship loses its ability to manoeuvre. SOLAS requires the steering gear to be tested before every voyage, and PSC inspections check it.

Steering gear bakım ve test sorumluluğu..en: Responsible for maintaining and testing the steering gear.

Fiziksel bakım ve kontroller..en: Carries out the maintenance and checks.

SOLAS Bölüm V, Kural 26 – Dümen testi ge.en: SOLAS Chapter V, Regulation 26 – Steering gear: testing and drills

SOLAS Bölüm II-1, Kural 29 – Steering ge.en: SOLAS Chapter II-1, Regulation 29 – Steering gear

Pre-departure dümen testi yapıldı.en: Pre-departure steering gear test carried out

Köprüüstü-tiller flat iletişim çalışıyor.en: Communication between bridge and steering gear room working

Steering gear odasını düzenli ziyaret ed.en: Visit the steering gear room regularly. A hydraulic oil leak can be seen before the pressure starts to drop, and repairing a small leak before it grows prevents a loss of steering at sea. ALL officers must know the way to the steering gear room.

Makine dairesi, geminin en tehlikeli çal.en: The engine room is the most dangerous workplace on the ship: high temperatures, pressurised systems, rotating parts, noise, chemicals and enclosed-space risks all come together there.

Makine dairesi güvenliğinin genel soruml.en: Overall responsibility for safety in the engine room.

PTW düzenlendi (gerekli işler için).en: Permit to work (PTW) issued for jobs that need one

İlk yardım malzemesi makine dairesinde m.en: First-aid kit in the engine room

Lock-out/Tag-out hayat kurtarır. Bakım s.en: Lockout/tagout saves lives. Thinking 'it'll only take a minute, no need to lock it out' is the most common way people lose hands and fingers during maintenance. Isolate the machine, lock it out and keep your own key in your pocket. Do NOT let anyone else remove the lock for you.

Kaptanın ana sorumluluğu, geminin seyir.en: The Master's main responsibility, as the final authority under the ISM Code, is to ensure at all times the safe navigation of the ship, the integrity of its operations, its environmental compliance and the safety of the crew.

ISM Code 5.2 gereğince kaptanın overridi.en: Under ISM Code 5.2, the Master's overriding authority cannot be restricted in any circumstances — not even commercial pressure, a charterer's request or a company directive can override the Master's safety decision.

Kaptanın seyir planını onaylamadan gemi.en: The ship must not weigh anchor or sail before the Master has approved the passage plan; sailing without an approved plan is an ISM non-conformity.

PSC denetiminde kaptan birincil muhatapt.en: The Master is the PSC inspector's main point of contact; how well the crew is prepared for an inspection is a direct result of the Master's training plan.

Yaşlı gemilerde (15+ yıl) condition of c.en: On older ships (15+ years), close follow-up of conditions of class, hull survey findings and structural integrity reports is critical for the Master.
