Yükseltme sonrası FMEA revizyonu, provin.en: Plan the FMEA revision, proving trials and class survey for after the upgrade before the work ends; in the meantime, enter the valid DP class and restrictions in the ASOG.

Yükseltme sırasında gemi beyan edilen DP.en: During an upgrade the vessel may not meet its declared DP class; acceptance of work must be restricted during this period.

Yazılım ve parametre değişiklikleri eski.en: Software and parameter changes can invalidate the failure mode assumptions of the old FMEA.

Korunan eski kablolamanın izolasyon ve s.en: The insulation and terminations of any old cabling that is kept must be verified separately.

Filika amirleri.en: Persons in charge of the lifeboats

Altı MARPOL ekinin hangi kirlilik türünü.en: Telling apart which type of pollution and which shipboard operations each of the six MARPOL Annexes regulates

Bir deşarj kararını gemi tipi, konum, öz.en: Assessing a discharge decision together with the ship type, position, special area, the state of the equipment and the record-keeping requirements

Operasyonun fiziksel akışı ile ORB/GRB/B.en: Proving that the physical flow of an operation agrees with the ORB, GRB, BDN and other record book entries

Kirlilik olayında ilk müdahale, bildirim.en: Putting in order the steps for first response, reporting and preserving evidence in a pollution incident

Petrol operasyonu ve Oil Record Book büt.en: Oil operations and the integrity of the Oil Record Book

Sintine, sludge, yakıt transferi, tank t.en: Bilge, sludge, fuel transfer, tank cleaning and applicable cargo operations must be carried out with approved equipment and procedures, and recorded in the Oil Record Book without delay and truthfully.

PSC, yalnızca defter formatına değil; ta.en: PSC looks not only at the format of the book but at whether the tank soundings, OWS counters and alarms, incinerator records or shore receipts and consumption records all tell the same story.

Sludge landing receipt ve tank sounding.en: Sludge landing receipts and tank sounding records

ORB miktarlarını tank kapasitesi ve soun.en: Reconcile the ORB quantities with tank capacities and changes in the soundings

OWS testini, mühürleri ve overboard hatt.en: Check the OWS test, the seals and the physical arrangement of the overboard line

Her düzeltmenin imza/tarih ve prosedüre.en: Verify that every correction is signed, dated and made according to procedure

Kayıtlar matematiksel olarak mümkün görü.en: Records that look arithmetically possible but do not agree with the tanks, the counters, the shore receipts or the actual pipework

Çöp sınıflandırma ve deşarj kararı.en: Classifying garbage and deciding on discharge

Çöp; gemi planına göre ayrılmalı, depola.en: Garbage must be segregated and stored according to the ship's plan and discharged only under the permitted exceptions and conditions; discharging plastics into the sea is prohibited.

Yanlış kategori seçimi veya özel alanın.en: Choosing the wrong category or overlooking a special area can turn even a small discharge into a serious violation.

Reception facility receipt ve çöp hacim.en: Reception facility receipts and tracking of garbage volumes

Aşçı ve departman sorumluları.en: The Cook and the heads of department

Güncel konum ve özel alan durumuna göre.en: Have someone explain a sample discharge decision for the current position and special area status

GRB miktarlarını depolama kapasitesi ve.en: Compare the GRB quantities with the storage capacity and the delivery receipts

Mutfak, güverte ve makine atık akışını f.en: Follow the flow of waste from the galley, deck and engine room on the spot

Kâğıt üzerinde doğru ayrıştırma varken ç.en: Correct segregation on paper while categories are mixed at the garbage stations, or reception receipts missing or wrongly recorded

Hava emisyonu, yakıt ve enerji verimlili.en: Evidence on air emissions, fuel and energy efficiency

Yakıt uygunluğu, bunker teslimi/numunesi.en: Fuel compliance, bunker deliveries and samples, the NOx, SOx and ODS requirements and the applicable energy efficiency obligations must be managed together with the ship's certificates, plans and operating records.

Annex VI uyumu yalnızca yakıt sülfür yüz.en: Annex VI compliance is not just the sulphur percentage of the fuel; fuel changeovers, equipment settings, the sample chain, the emission abatement system and the reported consumption data are one system.

BDN ve MARPOL delivered sample.en: BDN and the MARPOL delivered sample

SEEMP, DCS/CII veri ve doğrulama kayıtla.en: SEEMP, DCS/CII data and verification records

Bunker tesliminden tüketime numune ve be.en: Check that samples and documents can be traced from the bunker delivery through to consumption

ECA giriş/çıkışındaki yakıt değişimini t.en: Verify fuel changeovers on entering and leaving an ECA against tank, valve, position and time data

DCS/CII verisini noon report, flowmeter.en: Reconcile the DCS/CII data with the noon reports, flowmeters and the bunker figures

BDN uygun olsa bile gemideki numune, tan.en: Even with a compliant BDN, not being able to trace the sample on board, the use of tanks, the changeover record or the reported consumption

Son sludge hareketini kaynaktan nihai be.en: How would you prove the last sludge movement, from its source to final disposal?

Kaynak tank, miktar hesabı, transfer vey.en: You must be able to show, without a gap, the source tank, the calculation of the quantity, the transfer or incineration, the ORB code, the responsible person's signature and the shore receipt or incinerator record.

Toplu ve gecikmiş kayıt.en: Entries made late and in bulk

Fiş ile ORB miktar farkı.en: Difference between the receipt and the ORB quantity

Bu konumda hangi çöp türünün deşarjına h.en: At this position, which kinds of garbage may be discharged, and under what conditions?

Cevap geminin konumunu, nearest land mes.en: The answer must take into account the ship's position, the distance from the nearest land, any special area, the garbage category, the comminution requirement and any stricter company policy.

ECA'ya girişte yakıt değişiminin tamamla.en: How do you verify that the fuel changeover has been completed before entering an ECA?

Gerekli düşük sülfürlü yakıtın tüm servi.en: Calculate the time needed for compliant low-sulphur fuel to reach the whole service system, and show the tank quantities, the position, the date and time and the record of the completed changeover.

Sadece valf çevirme saati.en: Only the time the valve was turned

Sistem hacmi hesabı yok.en: No calculation of the system volume

Oşinografik/ekolojik koşullar ve trafik.en: A sea area where, because of its oceanographic and ecological conditions and its traffic, stricter mandatory methods for preventing pollution apply.

Petrol ile ilgili makine veya kargo oper.en: The Oil Record Book, in which machinery or cargo operations involving oil are recorded using codes.

Teslim edilen deniz yakıtının özellik ve.en: The bunker delivery note, which documents the specification and quantity of the marine fuel delivered.

Sözleşmeye taraf olmayan bayrak gemileri.en: The principle that ships flying the flag of a State that is not party to a convention must receive no more favourable treatment than ships of States that are party to it.

MLC'nin beş başlığını gemiadamının işe g.en: Reading the five Titles of the MLC as a life cycle, from the seafarer's recruitment through to repatriation and the right to complain

SEA, DMLC, ücret, work/rest, sağlık ve y.en: Verifying the SEA, DMLC, wage, work/rest, health and living-condition records together

Onboard complaint prosedürünü misilleme.en: Making the on-board complaint procedure accessible without fear of victimisation

Bayrak denetimi, MLC sertifikası ve PSC.en: Explaining the relationship between flag State inspection, the MLC certificate and PSC

Her gemiadamının anlaşılır ve imzalı Sea.en: Every seafarer must have a clear, signed Seafarers' Employment Agreement; wages, leave, termination and repatriation rights must be handled as the agreement and the flag State's rules require.

Çalışma ilişkisi yalnızca bir personel d.en: An employment relationship is more than a personnel file; the seafarer must know the conditions they work under, their pay and the guarantee that they will get home.

Aylık wage account/allotment kayıtları.en: Monthly wage accounts and allotment records

Bayrakta tanımlanan yetkili kişi.en: The authorised person designated by the flag State

SEA kopyasının gemiadamında bulunduğunu.en: Verify that the seafarer has a copy of the SEA

Ücret hesabını SEA/CBA ve banka/allotmen.en: Compare the wage statement with the SEA/CBA and the bank or allotment records

Financial security belgesinin erişilebil.en: Check that the financial security certificate is available and valid

İmzalı SEA bulunurken gemiadamının kopya.en: A signed SEA on file but the seafarer has no copy, cannot explain the items in their pay, or cannot find the financial security information

Çalışma/dinlenme ve gerçek kayıt.en: Work and rest, and truthful records

Çalışma veya dinlenme sınırları bayrak u.en: The limits on work or rest must be monitored as the flag State requires; the posted schedule and individual records must reflect what actually happens, and each seafarer must receive an endorsed copy.

Aşırı çalışma hem çalışma hakkı ihlali h.en: Overwork is both a breach of labour rights and a risk to navigational and engineering safety; together with STCW, the same event can be examined from two compliance angles.

İstisna/telafi kaydı.en: Records of exceptions and compensatory rest

Rastgele günleri logbook ve work/rest ka.en: Match random days in the logbook against the work/rest records

Gemiadamının kaydı görüp onayladığını do.en: Verify that the seafarer has seen and endorsed the record

Sistematik fazla mesai için manning ve i.en: Where overtime is systematic, review the manning and the work plan

Kayıtların kalıp olarak tekrarlanması, p.en: Records that repeat the same pattern, do not match the hours actually worked or are changed after a complaint

Yaşam, sağlık, iaşe ve şikâyet mekanizma.en: Living conditions, health, food and the complaint mechanism

Konaklama, gıda/su, gemide sağlık ve güv.en: Accommodation, food and water, health and safety on board, medical care and the complaint procedure must be maintained through their physical condition, regular inspections and accessible records.

MLC uygunluğu sadece sertifika dosyası d.en: MLC compliance is not just a certificate file; it shows in the cabins the crew live in every day, in the galley, in the hospital and in safe working arrangements.

Aşçı/kamarot sorumlusu.en: The Cook / person in charge of the stewards

Rastgele yaşam mahallerini kayıtlarla bi.en: Walk round random parts of the accommodation with the records in hand

Gemiadamına şikâyeti gemi içinde ve dışa.en: Ask seafarers who they would take a complaint to, on board and ashore

Düzeltici faaliyetlerin misilleme olmada.en: Verify that corrective actions have been closed without any victimisation

Denetim günü temizlenen mahaller, tekrar.en: Spaces cleaned only on the day of the inspection, recurring hygiene or pest problems, or crew who do not know the complaint channel

SEA'nızın bir kopyası sizde mi ve ücret/.en: Do you have a copy of your SEA, and can you explain your pay, leave and repatriation conditions?

Gemiadamı belgeyi erişilebilir biçimde g.en: The seafarer should be able to produce the document and explain the main conditions in their own words.

Belge yalnız kaptanda.en: Document held only by the Master

Fiilî ücretle sözleşme farkı.en: Difference between actual pay and the agreement

Şikâyetinizi kaptanı atlayarak kime ve n.en: Who could you take a complaint to without going through the Master, and how?

Personel, misillemeye karşı koruma dâhil.en: Crew must know the on-board steps, including protection against victimisation, and the flag State and shore contact details.

Şikâyet edenin cezalandırılacağı algısı.en: Belief that anyone who complains will be punished

Son accommodation veya galley kontrolünd.en: What was found at the last accommodation or galley inspection, and how was it closed?

Kayıt, fiziksel bulgu, sorumlu, son tari.en: The record must show the physical finding, who was responsible, the deadline and the follow-up check.

Pest-control veya water-test kaydı.en: Pest control or water test records

Fiilî durumla uyumsuz kayıt.en: Records that do not match the actual condition

Gemiadamı ile armatör/işveren arasındaki.en: The Seafarers' Employment Agreement, which sets the conditions of work between the seafarer and the shipowner or employer.

Bayrak gerekleri ile şirketin bunları ge.en: The Declaration of Maritime Labour Compliance, which sets out the flag State's requirements and how the company applies them on board continuously.

Toplu iş sözleşmesi; SEA tarafından atıf.en: A collective bargaining agreement; it can form part of the conditions of employment when the SEA refers to it.

Belirli koşullarda gemiadamının masrafla.en: The seafarer's right, in certain circumstances, to be returned home or to an agreed place at no cost to themselves.

D-1 değişim standardı ile D-2 performans.en: Distinguishing the D-1 exchange standard from the D-2 performance standard, and the regime that applies to the ship

Ballast Water Management Plan, Record Bo.en: Managing the Ballast Water Management Plan, Record Book, Certificate and BWMS operation as a single chain of evidence

Bypass, contingency, uptake/discharge ve.en: Recording bypasses, contingency measures, uptake and discharge, and sediment handling in full

Port State örneklemesinde ekipman, kayıt.en: Explaining that port State sampling assesses the equipment, the records and the crew's competence together

BWM Convention Regulations B-1, B-2 ve E.en: BWM Convention Regulations B-1, B-2 and E-2

Onaylı Ballast Water Management Plan gem.en: The approved Ballast Water Management Plan must match the ship's actual pipework and BWMS; every ballast operation must be recorded in the Record Book and the applicable certificate kept valid.

Kopya/genel plan, gemideki valf sırası v.en: A copied or generic plan that does not reflect the valve sequence or treatment limits on board cannot be relied on in an emergency and contradicts the actual system at inspection.

Plan üzerindeki tank/valf/sampling point.en: Verify on site the tanks, valves and sampling points shown in the plan

BWRB'yi ballast log ve tank soundingleri.en: Reconcile the BWRB with the ballast log and tank soundings

Certificate ve type-approval limitationl.en: Check the certificate and the type-approval limitations

Planın sister ship kopyası olması veya k.en: A plan copied from a sister ship, or records that do not agree with tank movements or BWMS trends

BWMS'in treatment limitleri içinde işlet.en: Operating the BWMS within its treatment limits

BWM Convention Regulation D-2 ve BWMS Co.en: BWM Convention Regulation D-2 and the BWMS Code

BWMS; type-approval ve üretici limitleri.en: The BWMS must be run within its type-approval and maker's limits, with the correct flow and UV dose or chemical parameters; alarms, bypasses and failures must be handled according to procedure.

Sistem 'running' gösterse bile treatment.en: Even if the system shows 'running', treatment performance is not guaranteed. Water quality outside the limits, a sensor failure or too high a flow rate can affect D-2 compliance.

Consumable/neutralizer kayıtları.en: Records of consumables and neutralising agent

Son operasyon trendini type-approval lim.en: Compare the trend of the last operation with the type-approval limits

Bypass valfi ve alarm geçmişini incele.en: Examine the bypass valve and the alarm history

Arıza halinde port/flag/company bildirim.en: Have someone explain the port, flag and company reporting and the contingency steps in case of a failure

Alarmın resetlenip nedeninin araştırılma.en: An alarm reset without investigating the cause, an unrecorded bypass, or treatment defeated to increase the flow rate

Örnekleme, contingency ve sediment yönet.en: Sampling, contingency measures and sediment management

BWM Convention Sections C-D ve ilgili IM.en: BWM Convention Sections C-D and the related IMO Guidelines

Numune alma noktaları erişilebilir tutul.en: Sampling points must be kept accessible; if the BWMS is non-compliant or fails, the approved contingency measures and communication with the port must be applied; sediment must be managed according to plan.

Arıza anında doğaçlama deşarj kararı, bi.en: An improvised discharge decision at the time of a failure increases both the biological and the legal risk. Pre-planned options must be coordinated with the port State in good time.

Sampling point erişimini ve etiketini ko.en: Check access to the sampling points and their labels

Arıza senaryosunu liman gereklilikleriyl.en: Run a tabletop exercise of a failure scenario against the port's requirements

Sediment faaliyetini tank bakım ve tesli.en: Match sediment activities with tank maintenance and delivery records

Arıza limana geç bildirilmesi, örnekleme.en: A failure reported to the port late, a sampling point that cannot be reached, or sediment disposal left unrecorded

Son ballast discharge sırasında BWMS'in.en: How would you show that the BWMS was operating within the limits needed to meet D-2 during the last ballast discharge?

Operasyon kaydı, trend/alarmlar, debi ve.en: Show the operating record, trends and alarms, flow rate and treatment parameters, calibration and the BWRB entry together.

BWMS limana varmadan arızalanırsa hangi.en: If the BWMS fails before arrival in port, what would you do, and in what order?

Operasyonu emniyete alma, kaptan/şirket.en: The answer should cover making the operation safe, informing the Master and the company, the BWMP contingency options, coordinating with the port State in advance and full records.

Plan dışı kimyasal/işlem.en: Chemicals or methods not in the plan

Numune nereden ve emniyetli biçimde nası.en: Where is the sample taken, and how is it taken safely?

Personel sampling pointi sahada göstereb.en: Crew should be able to show the sampling point on site and explain the access and pressure risks and the conditions for a representative sample.

Belirlenen koşullarda ballast suyu değiş.en: The exchange standard, which reduces the transfer of organisms by exchanging ballast water under specified conditions.

Deşarj edilen ballast suyunda canlı orga.en: The performance standard for viable organisms and indicator microbes in discharged ballast water.

Ballast suyunu D-2 standardına ulaşmak a.en: A ballast water management system, which treats ballast water to meet the D-2 standard.

Suyun treatment prosesinin tamamı veya b.en: Routing water past all or part of the treatment process; every use must be justified and recorded.

SMS'i doküman klasörü değil, riskleri ko.en: Treating the SMS as a living management system that controls risks, not as a folder of documents

Şirket-kaptan-departman zincirinde yetki.en: Distinguishing authority, reporting and shore support responsibilities along the company–Master–department chain

Non-conformity, near miss, audit ve mana.en: Turning data from non-conformities, near misses, audits and management reviews into continuous improvement

Kritik ekipman bakımında arıza, geçici t.en: Building the chain of failure, temporary measures, redundancy and verification for the maintenance of critical equipment

SMS prosedürleri geminin operasyonuna uy.en: SMS procedures must suit the ship's operation, be accessible and be under controlled revision; crew must understand and be able to apply the procedures for their own work.

Aşırı genel veya kopyalanmış prosedür, s.en: A procedure that is too general or copied from elsewhere does not control the risk on the job. An audit looks less at whether the document exists than at whether practice matches it.

Prosedür ile gerçek ekipman/iş akışını s.en: On site, compare the procedure with the actual equipment and workflow

Rastgele personele kendi kritik görevini.en: Ask randomly chosen crew members to explain their own critical duty using a scenario

Prosedürün sister ship veya eski ekipman.en: A procedure that belongs to a sister ship or to old equipment; crew who have only signed for it and cannot apply it

Rutin olmayan ve yüksek riskli işler; te.en: Non-routine and high-risk jobs must be planned specifically for the job, taking into account the hazards, barriers, who is responsible, the stop-work criteria and changing conditions.

Genel risk assessment formu, işi yapan e.en: A generic risk assessment form will not prevent an accident unless it gives the team doing the work a shared picture of the job.

İşi yöneten zabit/mühendis.en: Officer or engineer in charge of the job

Tehlike-bariyer-sorumlu ilişkisini ekipt.en: Have the team explain how the hazards, barriers and responsibilities fit together

Koşul değiştiğinde dynamic risk assessme.en: Verify that a dynamic risk assessment is made when conditions change

Permit kapanışında izolasyonların ve sis.en: When the permit is closed, check that the isolations have been removed and the system returned to normal

İş adı değiştirilmiş standart form, gerç.en: A standard form with only the job title changed, actual isolations that differ from the form, or crew not knowing their authority to stop work

Uygunsuzluk, kaza ve bakım geri beslemes.en: Feedback from non-conformities, accidents and maintenance

Kaza, near miss, non-conformity ve kriti.en: Accidents, near misses, non-conformities and failures of critical equipment must be reported and closed with a root cause, corrective and preventive action and a check of effectiveness.

Bulgunun yalnız kapatılması aynı olayın.en: Simply closing a finding does not stop the same event happening again. For the management system to learn, the cause and the barrier failure must be fed back to the fleet.

Faaliyetin yalnız tamamlanmasını değil t.en: Verify not only that the action was completed but that it reduced the risk of recurrence

Kritik arızada geçici tedbir ve shore su.en: For a critical failure, check the temporary measures and the shore support approval

Benzer gemilere lesson learned yayıldığı.en: Verify that the lessons learned have been shared with similar ships

Semptomu onarıp kök nedeni kapatmamak; g.en: Repairing the symptom without dealing with the root cause; postponing overdue work without justification; punishing near-miss reporting

Son near miss hangi SMS değişikliğine ve.en: What change to the SMS or strengthening of a barrier did the last near miss lead to?

Olay, kök neden, faaliyet, sorumlu, son.en: Show the event, root cause, action, person responsible, deadline, check of effectiveness and feedback to the fleet.

Bu kritik ekipman arızası açıkken gemi n.en: With this critical equipment failure still open, why is the ship considered safe?

Risk, yedeklilik, geçici kontrol, bayrak.en: Explain the risk, the redundancy, the temporary controls, the reports to flag, class and the company, and the plan for a permanent repair.

Dispensation/condition gerektiğinde.en: A dispensation or condition where needed

Bitiş tarihi/sorumlu yok.en: No completion date or person responsible

DPA'ya hangi durumda doğrudan ulaşırsını.en: In what situations would you contact the DPA directly?

Personel emniyet/çevre konusunda shore m.en: Crew must know when they would need shore management support on safety or environmental matters, and the current way to make contact.

DPA'nın kim olduğunun bilinmemesi.en: Not knowing who the DPA is

İletişimin yalnız kaptan üzerinden mümkü.en: Thinking contact is possible only through the Master

Şirket ve geminin emniyet/çevre politika.en: The structured safety management system through which the company and the ship put the safety and environmental policy into effect.

Gemi ile en üst yönetim arasında doğruda.en: The Designated Person Ashore, who provides a direct link between the ship and the highest level of management and makes sure there is adequate shore support.

Belirlenmiş bir gerekliliğin karşılanmad.en: An observed situation showing that a specified requirement has not been met.

Bir şartın uygulanıp uygulanmadığını gös.en: A verifiable record, observation or statement showing whether a requirement is being applied.

Safety ile security arasındaki farkı ve.en: Explaining the difference between safety and security and the mandatory relationship between SOLAS XI-2 and the ISPS Code

Security level değişikliğini access cont.en: Turning a change of security level into changes in access control, restricted areas and the watch arrangements

SSO-CSO-PFSO iletişim zinciri ile Declar.en: Assessing the SSO–CSO–PFSO communication chain and whether a Declaration of Security is needed

SSP'nin gizliliğini korurken mürettebatı.en: Making sure the crew know their own duties while keeping the SSP confidential

SOLAS Chapter XI-2 ve ISPS Code Part A.en: SOLAS Chapter XI-2 and ISPS Code Part A

Gemi, bildirilen security level için SSP.en: For the security level notified, the ship must apply without delay the controls on access, visitors, baggage, stores and restricted areas laid down in the SSP.

Security level bir tabela değildir; pers.en: A security level is not a sign on the wall; it must produce measurable changes in manning, watches, how often checks are made and physical barriers.

Security level message ve implementation.en: Security level message and record of implementation

Mevcut level için açık erişim noktaların.en: Compare the access points open at the current level with the SSP

Rastgele ziyaretçi kaydını kimlik/refaka.en: Follow a random visitor entry through identification, escort and departure

Restricted area kilit ve devriyesini sah.en: On site, verify the locks and patrols of the restricted areas

Security level değiştiği halde manning,.en: The security level changes but manning, patrols and access control stay the same

Onaylı SSP kontrollü ve korunmuş tutulma.en: The approved SSP must be kept controlled and protected; the SSO, the CSO and the crew must know their own authority and duties, how to report incidents and the confidentiality limits on the SSAS.

Planın gizli olması personelin görevini.en: The plan being confidential does not mean the crew should not know their duties; only sensitive details are protected on a need-to-know basis.

Plan revizyonu ve onay durumunu kontrol.en: Check the plan's revision and approval status

Personelin kendi level-specific görevini.en: Ask crew members to explain their own duty at each security level

Güvenlik olayında CSO/PFSO ve otorite bi.en: Verify the order of reporting to the CSO, PFSO and authorities in a security incident

SSP'nin kontrolsüz kopyalanması veya giz.en: The SSP being copied without control, or crew kept unaware of their basic duties on the grounds of confidentiality

Tatbikat, DoS ve güvenlik olayına müdaha.en: Drills, DoS and responding to security incidents

Drill/exercise programı farklı tehditler.en: The drill and exercise programme must test different threats and interfaces; where necessary, ship–port or ship–ship responsibilities must be clearly shared through a Declaration of Security.

İki tarafın aynı işi yaptığını varsaymas.en: Gaps where nobody carries out a check create as much of a security risk as both parties assuming they are doing the same job.

PFSO ve ilgili gemi temsilcisi.en: The PFSO and the ship's representative concerned

Tatbikatın alarmdan raporlamaya kadar za.en: Assess the drill's timeline, from the alarm to the report

DoS'ta her kontrolün sorumlusunu ve süre.en: Verify who is responsible for each control in the DoS and for how long

Önceki güvenlik bulgusunun kapanış etkin.en: Test whether the closure of the previous security finding was effective

Tatbikatların aynı senaryoyla kâğıt üzer.en: Drills repeated on paper with the same scenario, or a DoS signed while the responsibilities in it are not carried out

Security Level 2 ilan edilirse ilk 30 da.en: If Security Level 2 is declared, what changes in the first 30 minutes?

Gemiye özgü SSP önlemleri; access point,.en: The answer should describe the ship-specific SSP measures in terms of access points, patrols, searches, stores and who is responsible for communications.

Level tanımını söyleyip somut değişiklik.en: Reciting the definition of the level without being able to show a concrete change

Bu limanda Declaration of Security neden.en: Why is a Declaration of Security needed, or not needed, in this port?

Risk, level farkı, tesis durumu, önceki.en: Take into account the risk, any difference in security levels, the status of the facility, previous incidents and the Administration's and SSP criteria.

Her limanda otomatik aynı cevap.en: The same automatic answer in every port

Şüpheli paket bulduğunuzda ilk eylemleri.en: What are your first actions if you find a suspicious package?

Dokunmama/alanı izole etme, güvenli bild.en: The answer should describe, for this ship, not touching it and isolating the area, reporting safely, the SSP chain and waiting for expert instructions.

SSO'yu atlayarak kontrolsüz alarm.en: Raising an uncontrolled alarm without going through the SSO

Gemi güvenlik değerlendirmesine dayanan,.en: The approved Ship Security Plan, based on the ship security assessment.

SSP'nin gemide uygulanmasından sorumlu S.en: The Ship Security Officer, responsible for implementing the SSP on board.

Belirli bir arayüzde güvenlik sorumluluk.en: A Declaration of Security, in which security responsibilities at a particular interface are shared between the parties.

Yetkisiz erişime karşı özel kontrol uygu.en: An area of the ship with special controls against unauthorised access.

PSC'nin bayrak devleti sorumluluğunun ye.en: Explaining that PSC does not replace the flag State's responsibility but is a second layer of verification

Initial inspection, clear grounds, more.en: Distinguishing the stages of initial inspection, clear grounds, more detailed inspection and detention

Belge, fiziksel durum, kayıt ve müretteb.en: Bringing documents, physical condition, records and crew competence together into one consistent picture of compliance

Bulguya hızlı kozmetik cevap yerine kök.en: Preparing evidence of the root cause and a lasting closure instead of a quick cosmetic answer to a finding

Denetim öncesi kanıt bütünlüğü.en: Consistency of evidence before an inspection

IMO Procedures for Port State Control ve.en: IMO Procedures for Port State Control and the applicable MoU regime

Sertifika/record of equipment, logbook,.en: Certificates and records of equipment, logbooks, planned maintenance, the physical equipment and what the crew say must all be consistent.

PSC'de en güçlü hazırlık kalın bir dosya.en: The best preparation for PSC is not a thick file but records that show the same reality as the ship's actual condition.

Son PSC/flag/class bulgularını ve tekrar.en: Review the latest PSC, flag and class findings and the risk of them recurring

Kritik ekipmanı kayıt sahibinden bağımsı.en: Test critical equipment independently of the person who keeps its records

Rastgele kayıtları logbook, sayaç ve per.en: Cross-check random records against logbooks, counters and what the crew say

Denetim için oluşturulmuş ayrı dosyanın.en: A separate file made up for the inspection that contradicts the actual PMS, logs or physical condition

Clear grounds oluşmasını önleme ve doğru.en: Avoiding clear grounds and receiving the inspector properly

Eksik belge, kötü genel durum, alarm/eki.en: Signs such as missing documents, poor general condition, alarm or equipment failures, or crew unable to demonstrate basic operations can trigger a more detailed inspection, so the first contact must be handled professionally and openly.

Bir eksikliği gizlemeye çalışmak güveni.en: Trying to hide a deficiency damages trust and widens the inspection. For a known failure, the risk management and the official notification must be ready.

Belge ve escort sorumlularını önceden be.en: Decide in advance who will handle the documents and who will escort the inspector

Bilinen arızanın statü, tedbir ve onarım.en: Present the status, measures and repair plan for a known failure from a single source

Personelin ezber değil kendi görevini gö.en: Verify that crew can demonstrate their own duties rather than recite them

Denetçiye farklı kişilerden çelişkili bi.en: The inspector being given conflicting information by different people, or a known failure being hidden

Her bulgu; immediate correction, root ca.en: Every finding must be dealt with by immediate correction, root-cause and extent analysis and preventive action; where required, flag or class approval and the follow-up inspection must be completed.

Tek ekipmanı onarmak, sistemik neden diğ.en: Repairing one item does not prevent a repeat finding if the systemic cause is still present in similar equipment or procedures.

Repair/service evidence ve effectiveness.en: Evidence of repair or service, and a check of effectiveness

Aynı kök nedenden etkilenebilecek diğer.en: Check other equipment that could be affected by the same root cause

Kapanışın otorite beklentisini karşıladı.en: Verify that the closure meets the authority's expectations

Fleet-wide lesson learned ve prosedür/PM.en: Consider fleet-wide lessons learned and changes to procedures or the PMS

Yalnız fotoğraf veya servis fişi sunup k.en: Presenting only a photograph or a service receipt, with no evidence of the root cause, the extent or the prevention of recurrence

Son PSC veya iç denetim bulgusunun tekra.en: How would you prove that the last PSC or internal audit finding has not recurred?

Kök neden, filo/gemi kapsamı, CAPA, soru.en: Show the root cause, the extent across the ship and fleet, the CAPA, the person responsible and dates, and the verification of effectiveness.

Açık durumdaki bu arızayı neden denize e.en: Why do you not consider this open defect to affect the ship's seaworthiness?

Uygulanabilir kural, risk, yedeklilik, g.en: Present the applicable rule, the risk, the redundancy, the temporary measures, the official approval and the plan for a permanent repair.

Tek kişiye bağlı kontrol.en: Control that depends on one person

Rastgele seçilen personel acil durum gör.en: Can a randomly chosen crew member demonstrate their emergency duty and equipment?

Muster görevi, alarm, toplanma yeri, PPE.en: They should show, for this ship, their muster duty, the alarm, the muster station, PPE, communications and first actions.

Ezberlenmiş ama sahada gösterilemeyen ce.en: An answer learnt by heart but not demonstrated on site

Sertifika, genel durum ve temel uyum gös.en: The first assessment of the certificates, general condition and basic indicators of compliance.

Clear grounds bulunduğunda belirli alanl.en: An inspection widened in particular areas when clear grounds are found.

Eksiklikler gemiyi, kişileri veya çevrey.en: Preventing the ship from sailing when deficiencies clearly endanger the ship, persons on board or the environment.

PSC bulgusunun konu ve gerekli eylemle s.en: The coding that records a PSC finding in a standard way, with its subject and the action required.

Tehlikeli yükü UN number, proper shippin.en: Identifying dangerous goods by UN number, proper shipping name, class or division, packing group and subsidiary risk

Doküman, ambalaj/IBC/tank, markalama/eti.en: Verifying the chain of documents, packagings, IBCs and tanks, marking and labelling, placards and stowage and segregation

Container/vehicle packing certificate il.en: Explaining where responsibility lies between the container/vehicle packing certificate and the ship's loading plan

EmS ve MFAG bilgisini gerçek bir sızıntı.en: Using EmS and MFAG information in a realistic spill or fire scenario

Yük, Dangerous Goods List'e göre doğru t.en: The cargo must be correctly identified from the Dangerous Goods List; the declaration, packaging approval, quantity, marine pollutant status and special provisions must be verified before deciding to load.

Yanlış proper shipping name veya gözden.en: A wrong proper shipping name or an overlooked subsidiary risk makes every stowage and emergency response decision wrong.

UN number ve PSN'i DGL ile doğrula.en: Verify the UN number and PSN against the DGL

Packing instruction/special provision ko.en: Check the packing instructions and special provisions

Manifest ile gerçek stow planı eşleştir.en: Match the manifest against the actual stowage plan

SDS'yi taşıma belgesi yerine kabul etmek.en: Accepting an SDS in place of the transport document, or taking a trade name for the proper shipping name

Stowage, segregation ve yangın planı.en: Stowage, segregation and the fire plan

IMDG Code Part 7 ve SOLAS Chapter VII.en: IMDG Code Part 7 and SOLAS Chapter VII

Tehlikeli yükler; gemi tipi, deck/underd.en: Dangerous goods must be stowed and segregated safely, taking into account the ship type, on-deck or under-deck requirements, foodstuffs, the accommodation and machinery spaces, and their incompatibility with one another.

Tek tek her konteyner uygun olsa bile ya.en: Even if each container is acceptable on its own, the wrong neighbours, ventilation or a source of heat can raise the overall risk to an unacceptable level.

Fire plan ve reefer monitoring kayıtları.en: Fire plan and reefer monitoring records

Segregation table ve DGL stowage codes b.en: Check the segregation table and the DGL stowage codes together

Gerçek bay/row/tier ile manifesti karşıl.en: Compare the actual bay, row and tier with the manifest

Acil erişim ve jettison/firefighting etk.en: Assess emergency access and the effect on jettisoning and firefighting

Yalnız yazılım sonucuna güvenmek, yanlış.en: Relying on the software result alone; not checking wrong cargo data or a last-minute restow independently

IMDG Code Supplement – EmS Guide ve MFAG.en: IMDG Code Supplement – EmS Guide and MFAG

DG manifesti ve EmS/MFAG bilgisi; limand.en: The DG manifest and the EmS/MFAG information must be kept where the responsible persons can reach them without delay, in port and at sea, and in an incident the position and hazards of the cargo must be passed on correctly.

Yangın/sızıntıda ilk dakikalar önemlidir.en: The first minutes of a fire or spill are critical; the wrong extinguishing agent or approaching without protection can make a secondary reaction worse.

Bir UN numarası üzerinden EmS ve PPE bil.en: Have someone find the EmS and PPE information from a UN number

Yük yerini plan üzerinde göster.en: Show where the cargo is on the plan

Shore emergency communication mesajını p.en: Rehearse the emergency message to shore

Manifestin güncel stowdan farklı olması.en: A manifest that differs from the current stowage, or teams unable to find the EmS information

Bu konteynerin gemide tam olarak nerede.en: Explain exactly where this container is on board, and why it is there.

UN/PSN/class, stowage category, segregat.en: Explain the UN number, PSN and class, the stowage category, the segregation and operational access together.

Bu yük yanarsa hangi EmS schedule uygula.en: If this cargo catches fire, which EmS schedule applies?

Yangın ve spill schedule, PPE, uygun aja.en: Show the fire and spillage schedules, the PPE, the right agent and any special risks.

Son dakika DG restowu kim tarafından nas.en: Who verified the last-minute DG restow, and how?

Değişiklik bağımsız segregation/stabilit.en: A change must lead to independent checks of segregation, stability and securing, and to an updated manifest.

Taşınan tehlikeli madde veya nesneyi ulu.en: The four-digit number that identifies a dangerous substance or article internationally.

Taşıma belgelerinde kullanılması gereken.en: The standard shipping name that must be used in transport documents.

Ana sınıfa ek olarak dikkate alınması ge.en: A secondary hazard that must be taken into account in addition to the main class.

Gemide tehlikeli madde yangını ve sızınt.en: Emergency schedules for fires and spillages involving dangerous goods on board.

Group A, B ve C sınıflandırmasını yükün.en: Relating the Group A, B and C classification to the real hazard of the cargo

TML, moisture content ve numune alma ser.en: Explaining the part played by the TML, the moisture content and the sampling certificates in the decision to load

Cargo declaration, schedule, trimming, b.en: Applying, cargo by cargo, the requirements for the cargo declaration, the schedule, trimming, bilges and ventilation and monitoring

Yağış veya yük özelliği değiştiğinde sto.en: Deciding without delay to stop work when there is rain or the cargo's properties change

Yük bilgisi ve doğru schedule.en: Cargo information and the correct schedule

SOLAS VI/2 ve IMSBC Code Sections 4 ve 1.en: SOLAS VI/2 and IMSBC Code sections 4 and 1.3

Shipper'ın yük bilgisi, Bulk Cargo Shipp.en: The shipper's cargo information, the Bulk Cargo Shipping Name and the applicable schedule must be verified before loading; for a cargo not listed in the Code, the competent authority procedure must be completed.

Ticari isim tehlikeyi güvenilir biçimde.en: A trade name is no reliable guide to the hazard. The wrong schedule makes the ventilation, bilge, PPE and stability measures wrong.

Ticari adı BCSN ile eşleştir.en: Match the trade name to the BCSN

Hazard/group ve special provisionları br.en: Include the hazards, group and special provisions in the briefing

Belge tarih/temsil edilebilirliğini kont.en: Check the dates of the documents and whether they represent the cargo

Önceki seferin sertifikasını kullanmak v.en: Using the certificate from a previous voyage, or assuming the cargo is Group C from its appearance

Sıvılaşabilir yükte TML ve moisture kont.en: TML and moisture control for cargoes that may liquefy

IMSBC Code Section 7 ve ilgili individua.en: IMSBC Code section 7 and the relevant individual schedules

Group A yük, temsilî numune ve geçerli t.en: A Group A cargo must not be loaded until representative samples and valid tests have confirmed that its moisture content is below the TML; rain and a change of source must be reassessed.

Sıvılaşma, görünür yüzey suyu olmadan ge.en: Liquefaction can develop without any visible surface water and can lead to a serious loss of stability very quickly.

Sertifika tarih ve numune kaynağını kont.en: Check the certificate dates and where the samples came from

Can test yalnız destekleyici saha kontro.en: Use the can test only as a supporting check on site

Yağışta stop-work ve hatch closure krite.en: In rain, apply the stop-work and hatch closure criteria

Can test sonucunu laboratuvar sertifikas.en: Treating a can test result as a substitute for the laboratory certificate, or relying on the same moisture certificate after rain

Yükleme, trimming ve sefer boyunca izlem.en: Loading, trimming and monitoring throughout the voyage

IMSBC Code Sections 2, 3 ve individual s.en: IMSBC Code sections 2 and 3 and the individual schedules

Yük dağılımı; loading manual/stability/s.en: The distribution of the cargo must be managed together with the loading manual, stability and strength limits, trimming, protection of the bilges, ventilation and monitoring of hazardous gases and temperatures.

Kargo tehlikesi yükleme bitince sona erm.en: The cargo hazard does not end when loading finishes; oxygen depletion, self-heating, gas or corrosion can develop during the voyage.

Başmühendis ilgili sistemlerde.en: The Chief Engineer, for the systems concerned

Loading rate/sequence ile stress ekranın.en: Cross-check the loading rate and sequence against the stress display

Schedule'ın ventilation ve bilge talimat.en: Follow the schedule's ventilation and bilge instructions

Trend değişiminde escalation kriterini k.en: Use the escalation criteria when a trend changes

Planlanan ve gerçek tonaj/sequence farkı.en: Differences between the planned and actual tonnages or sequence not entered in the stress calculation, or ventilation applied out of habit

Bu yükün Group sınıfı nedir ve gemi için.en: What Group is this cargo in, and what is the main hazard to the ship?

BCSN schedule, group ve gemiye özgü kont.en: Explain the BCSN schedule, the group and the ship-specific control measures.

Moisture certificate bu partiyi gerçekte.en: Does the moisture certificate really represent this consignment?

Numune yeri, tarihi, stok/yük kaynağı, y.en: Show where and when the sample was taken, the stockpile or source of the cargo, any rain and the comparison with the TML.

Eski/başka stok numunesi.en: An old sample, or one from another stockpile

Seferde hangi parametreyi ne sıklıkla ve.en: During the voyage, which parameters do you monitor, how often and with what alarm thresholds?

Individual schedule ve risk assessmenta.en: Describe the plan for temperature, gas, bilge and ventilation monitoring based on the individual schedule and the risk assessment.

IMSBC Code'da dökme yük için kullanılan.en: The Bulk Cargo Shipping Name used for a solid bulk cargo in the IMSBC Code.

Sıvılaşabilir yükün emniyetli taşınması.en: The Transportable Moisture Limit, which must not be exceeded if a cargo that may liquefy is to be carried safely.

Akış özelliklerinin başladığı Flow Moist.en: The Flow Moisture Point, the moisture content at which the cargo starts to flow; it is the basis for calculating the TML.

Sırasıyla sıvılaşma/dinamik ayrışma risk.en: The groups of cargoes that, respectively, may liquefy or undergo dynamic separation, have a chemical hazard, or have neither of these two main hazards.

Ekipman trend, alarm ve bakım kaydı.en: Equipment trends, alarms and maintenance records

Açık-kapalı bulgu listesi.en: List of open and closed findings

Düzeltici faaliyet ve etkinlik kanıtı.en: Evidence of corrective action and its effectiveness

Sertifikayı destekleyen ekipman/kayıt.en: Equipment and records supporting the certificate

Gerekli sertifika/plan/kayıt listesi.en: List of the certificates, plans and records required

İç denetim/gemi içi doğrulama kaydı.en: Record of the internal audit or on-board verification

Bulgu ve düzeltici faaliyet listesi.en: List of findings and corrective actions

Kayıt, fiziksel durum ve personel açıkla.en: Cross-check the records, the physical condition and the crew's explanation on the same example.

Uygulanabilir bayrak/klas/şirket şartını.en: Check whether the applicable flag, class or company requirement is stricter.

Prosedürün kayıt üzerinde tamamlanmış gö.en: A procedure that looks complete on paper but does not match what is actually done on board

Belge ile fiziksel durumun uyuşmaması.en: Documents that do not match the physical condition

Personelin yalnız ezberlenmiş genel ceva.en: Crew giving only general answers learnt by heart

Temel yükümlülükleri gemideki prosedür,.en: Turning the basic obligations into procedures, equipment, responsible persons and records on board

Sörvey/PSC sırasında objektif kanıt zinc.en: Showing the chain of objective evidence during a survey or PSC inspection

Uygunsuzluk halinde emniyetli geçici ted.en: Managing safe temporary measures, reporting and permanent correction when there is a non-conformity

Can test'i laboratuvar TML belgesinin ye.en: Treating a can test as a substitute for the laboratory TML certificate

MARPOL'un hukukî mimarisi, altı teknik e.en: The legal structure of MARPOL, its six technical annexes and its logic of control

MARPOL kirlilik olayını yalnız denize at.en: MARPOL does not see pollution simply as something thrown into the sea; it brings design, equipment, operations, records, reception facilities, emergency reporting and energy performance together in a single regime of prevention.

Sözleşme, 1978/1997 protokolleri ve Ek I.en: The convention, the 1978 and 1997 Protocols and Annexes I–VI

MARPOL 73/78; 1973 Sözleşmesi ile 1978 P.en: MARPOL 73/78 combines the 1973 Convention and the 1978 Protocol; the 1997 Protocol added Annex VI. Annex I covers oil, Annex II noxious liquid substances in bulk, Annex III harmful substances in packaged form, Annex IV sewage, Annex V garbage and Annex VI air pollution and energy efficiency. Each annex has its own scope, certificate, record book, discharge conditions and exceptions.

Bir operasyon birden fazla eki tetikleye.en: A single operation can bring several annexes into play. Tank washing on a tanker can involve Annex I or II, the cleaning agent used Annex V, incineration Annex VI, and any packaged waste produced Annex III and the IMDG Code. To decide correctly, the mode of carriage, ship type, tank or line, position and purpose of the operation are established as well as the type of substance.

Taraf devletlerin kabul durumu annex baz.en: States may have accepted different annexes; but the principle of no more favourable treatment prevents a ship of a non-Party from getting more favourable treatment in international trade. Flag State practice, port States and local environmental rules can impose stricter requirements than the MARPOL baseline.

Gemi çevre matrisi atık/emisyon akışını,.en: The ship's environmental matrix should show each waste or emission stream, the relevant annex, the equipment, the tank, the record book code, the permitted final route and the person responsible.

Bütün atıkları Annex V altında değerlend.en: Treating all waste as coming under Annex V

MARPOL asgarisini yerel liman kuralının.en: Assuming the MARPOL minimum overrides a local port rule

Special Area, Emission Control Area ve d.en: Special Areas, Emission Control Areas and the discharge decision tree

Special Area, belirli annex kapsamında o.en: A Special Area is a sea area where, under a particular annex, stricter mandatory methods apply because of its oceanographic and ecological conditions and its traffic. An area may be a special area under Annex I without having the same status, or the same effective date, under another annex. An ECA under Annex VI sets separate emission limits for SOx and particulate matter and/or NOx.

Bir deşarj kararı en az altı soruyu yanı.en: A discharge decision answers at least six questions: which annex and category does the substance fall under, what is the status of the ship and equipment, is the ship en route, what is the position, the distance from the nearest land and the special area status, have the treatment, comminution or monitoring conditions been met, and is there a stricter flag, port or company ban? A single distance figure cannot replace this tree.

Chart plotter veya GPS konumu kararın gi.en: The chart plotter or GPS position is an input to the decision; the special area boundary, the baseline and nearest land definition and any local no-discharge zone are verified separately. The position, time, quantity, category and equipment status before and after the decision must be consistent in the relevant record book or log.

Köprüüstü ve ilgili departman deşarj önc.en: The bridge and the department concerned should use a joint permit or checklist before any discharge, rather than leaving it to habit within one department.

Special area haritasını tüm annexler içi.en: Assuming the special area chart is the same for every annex

Nearest land mesafesini tek koşul sanmak.en: Thinking the distance from the nearest land is the only condition

Gemi special area sınırına yakın seyrede.en: While the ship is navigating close to a special area boundary, preparations are made to discharge food waste based on a measurement on the ECDIS; the comminuter is out of order.

Alan statüsü, nearest land, food waste'i.en: A decision cannot be based on distance alone without considering together the status of the area, the nearest land, whether the food waste is comminuted, the en route condition and company policy.

Deşarj durdurulur; güncel resmi sınır ve.en: The discharge is stopped; the current official boundary and all the Annex V conditions are verified. If not every condition can be proved, the waste is kept on board and delivered to a reception facility.

Sörvey, sertifika, kayıt kitabı ve PSC ç.en: Surveys, certificates, record books and the PSC cross-check

IOPP, NLS, ISPP, IAPP, IEE ve ilgili cer.en: The IOPP, NLS, ISPP, IAPP and IEE certificates and their supplements show that the ship's design and surveys comply with each annex. The supplement may detail the approved tanks, equipment or methods. Even with a valid certificate, an equipment bypass, a wrong valve line-up or a false record book entry can create a detainable risk.

Record book kayıtları olaydan sonra yazı.en: Record book entries are not a story written after the event but the contemporaneous legal trace of the operation. The quantity, date and time, position, tank, category or code, method and responsible signature must reconcile, arithmetically and physically, with the sounding log, flowmeters, alarm printouts, noon reports, bunker calculations and shore receipts.

Düzeltme yöntemi defter talimatına göre.en: Corrections must be transparent and follow the record book instructions; erasing, correction fluid or rewriting an old page raises suspicion. When an error is noticed, an explanatory correction, the responsible person's signature and, if necessary, a review by the Master or the company preserve the integrity of the record.

Aylık çevre doğrulaması bir rastgele ope.en: A monthly environmental check should reconcile one randomly chosen operation, from the tank to final disposal, with all the independent records.

Record book'u operasyon bitiminden günle.en: Filling in the record book in bulk days after the operation

Shore receipt miktarını kontrol etmeden.en: Copying the quantity on the shore receipt into the book without checking it

Önce doğru annex ve madde kategorisi bel.en: First the correct annex and substance category are established.

Special area ve ECA annex bazında okunur.en: Special areas and ECAs are read annex by annex.

Kayıt, fiziksel akışla matematiksel olar.en: The record must reconcile arithmetically with the physical flow.

Annex I: petrol kirliliğinin önlenmesi.en: Annex I: prevention of pollution by oil

Annex I makine dairesi kaynaklı oily was.en: Annex I governs the oily waste streams from machinery spaces and the operations in the cargo area of tankers through separate but linked systems of control.

Makine dairesi: bilge, sludge, 15 ppm si.en: Machinery spaces: bilge, sludge, the 15 ppm system and ORB Part I

Oily bilge water; sızıntı, drenaj ve tem.en: Oily bilge water comes from leaks, drains and cleaning, while sludge builds up in the purifiers, fuel and oil treatment and waste oil processes. Tank names, capacities and piping must match the IOPP Supplement and the approved plan. Transferring bilge water to the sludge tank, or the other way round, changes the record code and the disposal options.

Oil filtering equipment, uygulanabilir g.en: On ships where it is required, oil filtering equipment controls discharges with the 15 ppm standard, an alarm and an automatic stopping arrangement. Safe operation means the correct suction and overboard valve line-up, a clean sample line, a calibrated alarm, intact seals and no bypass, and tracking the actual throughput. Testing only the alarm with fresh water does not by itself prove the oily water separating performance.

ORB Part I; ballasting/cleaning of fuel.en: ORB Part I records operations such as ballasting or cleaning of fuel tanks, collection and disposal of oil residues, and non-automatic and automatic discharge or transfer of bilge water, each with its code. A tank balance cannot be negative; the amount of sludge produced must bear a reasonable relationship to fuel consumption and purifier performance. Incineration, burning in the boiler and delivery ashore each need their own supporting evidence.

Başmühendis aylık tank balance yapmalı;.en: The Chief Engineer should do a monthly tank balance and explain any difference between the ORB, the soundings, the incinerator hours and the reception receipts.

15 ppm alarmını yalnız test düğmesiyle d.en: Checking the 15 ppm alarm only with the test button

Sludge tank kapasitesini aşan kâğıt baki.en: Creating a paper balance that exceeds the sludge tank capacity

Sludge tank kâğıt üzerinde dolu, gerçekt.en: The sludge tank is full on paper but empty in reality

ORB toplamına göre sludge tankta 18 m³ o.en: According to the ORB totals there should be 18 m³ in the sludge tank; the sounding shows 4 m³ and there is no delivery receipt.

Bu fark ölçüm hatası, eksik kayıt veya y.en: The difference may be a measuring error, a missing entry or illegal disposal. Adding an approximate entry afterwards makes the integrity of the record even worse.

Operasyon durumu korunur, kaptan/şirket.en: The situation is preserved and the Master and the company are informed; the sounding calibration, transfers, incineration, receipts and logs are examined, the real cause is documented and any required report to the authorities is made with legal advice.

Tanker cargo area: slop, ODME, COW, segr.en: Tanker cargo area: slops, ODME, COW, segregated ballast and ORB Part II

Oil tanker'larda cargo tank ballast, tan.en: On oil tankers, ballast in cargo tanks, tank cleaning, slop management, dirty ballast and the discharge of cargo residues are subject to special design and operational provisions. The ODME monitors the rate of discharge and the total quantity together with the position and speed, and takes control when a limit is exceeded. A certified unit is not enough without a correct oil content meter, flow input and overboard valve action.

Crude Oil Washing, uygulanabilir tankerl.en: On tankers where it applies, crude oil washing is carried out under the approved COW Operations and Equipment Manual, with the required inert gas conditions, a washing programme and qualified personnel in charge. The wrong tank sequence or an inadequate inert atmosphere combines the risk of pollution with the risk of fire and explosion.

ORB Part II cargo loading/unloading, int.en: ORB Part II records loading and unloading of cargo, internal transfers, tank cleaning, ballast, slops and discharges. The cargo figures, ullage report, terminal statement, ODME printout and slop soundings must be reconciled on the same timeline. A quantity dispute with the charterer or terminal is no reason to alter a MARPOL entry so that it no longer matches the facts.

Baş zabit cargo planında her residue/bal.en: Before the operation, the Chief Officer should mark on the cargo plan the source and destination tank of every residue and ballast flow and the corresponding ORB Part II code.

ODME printout'u gözden geçirmeden dosyal.en: Filing the ODME printout without reviewing it

Slop miktarını cargo outturn'a uydurmak.en: Adjusting the slop quantity to fit the cargo outturn

SOPEP/SMPEP ve oil pollution emergency r.en: SOPEP/SMPEP and oil pollution emergency response

SOPEP; petrol kirliliği olayı veya tehdi.en: The SOPEP sets out, for the particular ship, the reporting, on-board control, shore contacts and national and local coordination in an oil pollution incident or threat. Where a combined plan covering Annex II is appropriate, the SMPEP format can be used. If the appendix of shore contacts is out of date, the plan will not save time in an emergency.

İlk öncelik insan ve gemi emniyetidir; k.en: The first priority is the safety of people and the ship; stopping the source, transferring from the tank, plugging scuppers and containment, checking overboard valves and a safe response on deck are planned at the same time. The ship cannot decide on its own to use dispersants or other chemicals; this needs approval from the competent shore authority and suitable environmental conditions.

Bildirimde tahminî miktar belirsiz olabi.en: The estimated quantity in a report may be uncertain; that is no reason to delay the first report. The position, time, substance, incident, weather and sea, action taken and assistance needed are given and updated as they are confirmed. Evidence such as photographs, samples, logs and VDR or CCTV recordings is kept safe.

Tatbikat yalnız boom sermek değil; gerçe.en: A drill is not just deploying a boom; it should also test the reporting, simulated without actually calling the real shore contact list, and the decision-making authority.

Kesin miktarı bekleyip ilk bildirimi gec.en: Delaying the first report while waiting for the exact quantity

SOPEP içindeki eski telefon listesini ge.en: Assuming the old telephone list in the SOPEP is still valid

Machinery-space ve tanker kayıt rejimler.en: The machinery space and tanker record regimes are separate.

15 ppm/ODME cihazı boru hattı ve kayıtla.en: The 15 ppm equipment and the ODME are verified together with their piping and records.

İlk kirlilik bildirimi erken yapılır, ve.en: The first pollution report is made early and the details are updated later.

Annex II: dökme zararlı sıvı maddeler.en: Annex II: noxious liquid substances in bulk

Annex II, ürünün deniz çevresine tehlike.en: Annex II links the hazard a product poses to the marine environment with the ship's tank and stripping capability and the port's reception arrangements; no decision on discharge can be made until the product name has been correctly established.

X, Y, Z ve Other Substances kategorileri.en: Categories X, Y, Z and Other Substances

Noxious Liquid Substances; Category X, Y.en: Noxious liquid substances are categorised as Category X, Y, Z or Other Substances. X represents the most serious hazard to marine resources or human health and the strictest control; Y and Z represent lower but still real levels of hazard. Although OS fall outside these categories for Annex II purposes, they are not exempt from other MARPOL, SOLAS or local obligations.

Doğru product name ve pollution category.en: The correct product name and pollution category are verified against the IBC Code product list, the MEPC circular and lists, and the Certificate of Fitness. A trade name or an SDS alone is not an authoritative carriage name. If the composition of a mixture changes, its category and carriage requirements are reassessed.

Prewash, stripping, ventilation veya rec.en: Whether a prewash, stripping, ventilation or a reception facility is required depends on the category and also on whether the product is high-viscosity or solidifying, the unloading port, the special area status and the approved procedure. A general 'pump it out beyond 12 miles' approach oversimplifies the Annex II decision tree.

Cargo plan her ürün için pollution categ.en: The cargo plan should have columns for each product's pollution category, tank, stripping limit, prewash or reception and discharge method.

Trade name ile kategori seçmek.en: Choosing the category from the trade name

OS ürününü hiçbir çevre kuralına tabi de.en: Thinking an OS product is subject to no environmental rules

Procedures and Arrangements Manual, stri.en: The Procedures and Arrangements Manual, stripping and the Cargo Record Book

Onaylı Procedures and Arrangements Manua.en: The approved Procedures and Arrangements Manual defines the methods of unloading, stripping, tank washing, residue transfer and discharge for the ship's tank and piping arrangement. It is this ship-specific manual, not a general summary of Annex II, that is the basis for the valve line-up and sequence on deck.

Efficient stripping, tankta kalan residu.en: Efficient stripping aims to reduce the residue left in the tank to the approved performance limit. The result of stripping can be affected by the condition of the pumps and lines, trim and list, temperature and viscosity, and the right back-pressure from the terminal. Even if the sequence has been completed on paper, a high level of residue or contents left in the lines changes the prewash or reception decision.

Cargo Record Book; loading, internal tra.en: The Cargo Record Book records operations such as loading, internal transfers, unloading, prewash, tank cleaning, discharge of residues and accidental discharges, tank by tank and product by product. It must reconcile with the terminal's prewash receipt, the cargo figures, the tank washing log and the slop and reception quantities.

Baş zabit operasyon öncesi P&A Manual'da.en: Before the operation, the Chief Officer should go through the actual tank and line sequence in the P&A Manual with the team and the terminal in a toolbox briefing.

Önceki ürünün checklist'ini yeni ürüne k.en: Copying the checklist for the previous product for the new one

Stripping performansını yalnız pompa çal.en: Trying to prove stripping performance with nothing more than a record that the pump ran

Tahliye sonrası tankta beklenenden fazla.en: After discharge more product than expected is left in the tank; the terminal does not want to accept a prewash and suggests the ship washes the tank at sea.

Kategori, ürün özelliği, liman/reception.en: No decision to discharge at sea can be made until the requirements for the category, the product's properties, the port and reception and the P&A Manual have been met. A commercial refusal does not remove a legal obligation.

Operasyon durdurulur; bayrak/liman/şirke.en: The operation is stopped; a suitable reception or prewash solution is arranged with the flag State, the port, the company and the terminal and documented. The tank and line quantities and all communications are kept with the supporting records for the Cargo Record Book.

Ürün adı ve pollution category kararın b.en: The product name and pollution category are where the decision starts.

P&A Manual gemiye özgü operasyon sırasın.en: The P&A Manual sets the ship-specific sequence of operations.

Terminal kısıtı Annex II zorunluluğunu o.en: A terminal restriction does not remove an Annex II requirement.

Annex III: paketli zararlı maddeler ve I.en: Annex III: harmful substances in packaged form and the link with the IMDG Code

Annex III deniz kirletici maddeleri pack.en: Annex III controls marine pollutants carried in packaged form, such as packages, freight containers, portable tanks or road and rail tank wagons, through the detailed system of the IMDG Code.

Marine pollutant sınıflandırması, paketl.en: Marine pollutant classification, packing and documentation

Bir maddenin harmful substance sayılması.en: Whether a substance counts as a harmful substance is decided by the marine pollutant criteria and lists in the IMDG Code. The UN number, proper shipping name, class and subsidiary hazard, packing group and marine pollutant status are declared together. An SDS is a useful supporting document; it does not replace the signed dangerous goods transport document.

Package tipi, test/UN approval mark, qua.en: The type of package, its test and UN approval marks, quantity limits, closures and condition must suit the product. The marine pollutant mark, class labels, UN number and placards on the cargo transport unit communicate the hazard correctly from the outside. A faded mark, or one put on the wrong surface, hides the information from the emergency team.

Dokümanda paket sayısı/tipi, toplam mikt.en: The document gives the number and type of packages, the total quantity and the correct shipping description; the shipper's declaration and the container/vehicle packing certificate record who is responsible at each stage. The manifest and stowage plan show where the dangerous goods are on board in a form that can be reached in an emergency.

Yük kabulünde belge, dış paket işareti v.en: When accepting cargo, the document, the marks on the outer package and the planned stowage position should be checked on the same item.

Marine pollutant mark'ı primary hazard l.en: Mistaking the marine pollutant mark for the primary hazard label

SDS ile eksik shipper declaration'ı kapa.en: Using an SDS to make up for a missing shipper's declaration

Stowage, segregation, kayıp/hasar ve aci.en: Stowage, segregation, loss or damage, and emergency response

IMDG stowage category, segregation group.en: IMDG stowage categories, segregation groups and provisions such as 'away from' and 'separated from' limit the spread of reactions, fire and toxic exposure. Proximity to foodstuffs, accommodation, heat sources and sources of ignition is checked separately. Even if the container planning software gives no warning, the current IMDG edition and the scope of the ship's Document of Compliance are verified.

Hasarlı/leaking package'da ilk hedef per.en: With a damaged or leaking package, the first aim is the safety of people and the ship. The area is isolated according to the EmS, MFAG, SDS and the company emergency plan, suitable PPE and monitoring are used, and spreading overboard is prevented. Repacking or jettisoning is considered only when authorised and genuinely necessary; the incident and any lost packages are reported through the proper channels.

Dangerous goods manifest, köprüüstü ve a.en: The dangerous goods manifest must be kept in a controlled arrangement that the bridge and the emergency teams can reach without leaving the ship.

Yazılımın kabulünü hukukî uygunluk onayı.en: Treating acceptance by the software as confirmation of legal compliance

Dökülen ürünü yıkayarak scupper'a yönlen.en: Washing spilled product towards the scuppers

Marine pollutant konteynerinde sızıntı.en: Leak from a container of marine pollutant

Güverte turunda konteyner kapısından sıv.en: On deck rounds, liquid is seen coming from a container door; the manifest lists the product as class 8 and a marine pollutant.

Yaklaşma, bilinmeyen buhar/reaksiyon ve.en: Approaching carries the risk of unknown vapours or reactions and of spreading into the sea. Washing with water can make the environmental incident worse.

Alarm/alan izolasyonu, EmS/MFAG ve uzman.en: The alarm is raised and the area isolated, and PPE and monitoring are chosen with the EmS, MFAG and expert advice; the scuppers are protected, the leak is contained safely and reports to the Master, the company and shore are started.

Annex III ayrıntılarını IMDG Code operas.en: The IMDG Code puts the detail of Annex III into practice.

Belge, paket ve stow position aynı yükü.en: The document, the package and the stowage position must all show the same cargo.

Sızıntıda personel güvenliği ile denize.en: In a leak, the safety of people and spreading into the sea are controlled together.

Annex IV: pis su sistemleri ve kontrollü.en: Annex IV: sewage systems and controlled discharge

Annex IV, sewage'ı onaylı arıtma tesisi,.en: Annex IV manages sewage through an approved treatment plant, a comminuting and disinfecting system or a holding tank; the system chosen changes the discharge conditions and the records and operations on board.

Sewage tanımı, sertifika ve sistem bütün.en: Definition of sewage, the certificate and system integrity

Sewage; toilet/urinal drenajı, medical p.en: Sewage covers drainage from toilets and urinals, from medical premises and from spaces containing living animals, and other waste water mixed with these. Grey water from the galley on its own may not be Annex IV sewage; but once mixed with sewage it comes under the same regime, and local rules may set separate, stricter limits for grey water.

ISPP Certificate, onaylı sewage treatmen.en: The ISPP Certificate shows the approved sewage treatment plant, comminuter and disinfector, or holding tank arrangement. The performance of a treatment plant depends on correct aeration, the condition of the biomass or chemicals, the blowers and pumps, the alarms and the manufacturer's operating envelope. A bypass valve, an overflow line or the wrong chemical dosing makes a certified system ineffective.

Holding tank kapasitesi kişi sayısı, sef.en: Holding tank capacity is planned for the number of persons, the length of the voyage and the actual sewage produced. A reception facility or a legal opportunity to discharge must be found before the tank fills. Silencing the high-level alarm is no substitute for an operating plan.

Başmühendis sewage flow'u, tank seviyesi.en: The Chief Engineer should monitor the sewage flow, the tank level and the plant's condition against the voyage plan, and the Master the position and permission conditions for discharge.

Grey water ve sewage hatlarını çizimden.en: Not checking the grey water and sewage lines against the drawings

Treatment plant blower çalışıyorsa efflu.en: Assuming the effluent is acceptable because the treatment plant blower is running

Deşarj seçenekleri: arıtılmış, parçalanm.en: Discharge options: treated, comminuted and disinfected, and untreated sewage

Onaylı sewage treatment plant uygun şeki.en: When an approved sewage treatment plant is working properly, discharge is made in line with the plant's performance standard and the Annex IV conditions; it must not produce visible floating solids or discolouration of the surrounding water. If the treatment system is bypassed, this option cannot be used.

Comminuted ve disinfected sewage, onaylı.en: Comminuted and disinfected sewage may be discharged using an approved system more than 3 nautical miles from the nearest land; sewage that is not comminuted or disinfected generally more than 12 nautical miles from the nearest land, with the ship en route and at a moderate rate approved by the Administration. Pumping out the whole tank at once, or discharging with the ship stopped, does not meet the condition.

Passenger ships için belirli special are.en: For passenger ships, particular special area provisions and local no-discharge and reception rules may also apply. When a discharge decision is made, the ship type, treatment status, position, speed and en route status, source tank and port instructions must all be recorded.

Sewage discharge checklist, plant valve.en: The sewage discharge checklist should combine the plant valve line-up and alarm status with the bridge's confirmation of position and speed into a permit signed by both departments.

3/12 mil sayılarını tek koşul olarak ezb.en: Memorising the 3 and 12 mile figures as the only conditions

Treatment plant arızasını loglamadan byp.en: Bypassing the treatment plant without logging the defect

Holding tank taşma riski.en: Risk of the holding tank overflowing

Liman çıkışından kısa süre sonra holding.en: Soon after leaving port the holding tank reaches its high-high alarm; the ship is not yet more than 12 nautical miles off.

Taşma riski ciddi olsa da bu durum planl.en: Although the risk of overflow is serious, it does not automatically justify an unplanned illegal discharge. The cause of the problem and the safe options are assessed quickly.

Üretim azaltılır, treatment/reception/tr.en: Sewage production is reduced and treatment, reception or transfer options and a safe solution on the route are looked for; the Master, the company and, if necessary, the shore authority are informed. If an emergency discharge really becomes necessary for the safety of life or the ship, the conditions of the exception and all the evidence for the decision are recorded in detail.

Sewage'ın kaynağı ve karışımı doğru tanı.en: The source and mixture of the sewage are correctly identified.

Sistem sertifikası gerçek işletme kondis.en: The system certificate is backed by its actual operating condition.

Mesafe, en-route ve arıtma şartları birl.en: The distance, en route and treatment conditions apply together.

Annex V: çöp kategorileri, yasaklar ve k.en: Annex V: garbage categories, prohibitions and the integrity of records

Annex V'nin varsayılan yaklaşımı çöpün d.en: The default approach of Annex V is that garbage is separated and reduced on board, not at sea, and delivered to a reception facility ashore; the limited exceptions for discharge depend on the category and conditions.

Garbage tanımı, kategoriler ve plastik y.en: Definition of garbage, its categories and the ban on plastics

Garbage; domestic waste, operational was.en: Garbage covers categories such as domestic waste, operational waste, food waste, plastics, cargo residues, incinerator ashes, cooking oil, fishing gear and animal carcasses. Not every category has the same discharge options. Hazardous substances in e-waste or maintenance waste can also bring other national or international waste rules into play.

Plastiklerin, synthetic ropes/nets, plas.en: Discharging plastics into the sea is prohibited, including synthetic ropes and nets, plastic garbage bags and incinerator ash from plastic products. A 'biodegradable' label does not automatically mean the product is not a plastic under Annex V or that it may be thrown into the sea; its composition and the authoritative guidance are checked.

Food waste, cargo residue, cleaning agen.en: The conditions on distance, comminution, special areas, HME status and being en route differ for food waste, cargo residues, cleaning agents and additives, and animal carcasses. Mixed garbage is subject to the requirements of whichever component is the strictest. Grinding garbage does not change its category or the plastics ban.

Çöp istasyonunda kategori renkleri GMP/G.en: The category colours at the garbage station must match the codes in the GMP and GRB; when waste is mixed, the stricter category must clearly be applied.

Biodegradable plastiği denize atılabilir.en: Thinking biodegradable plastic may be thrown into the sea

Comminuter kullanınca bütün food packagi.en: Counting all food packaging as food waste because a comminuter is used

GMP, placard, Garbage Record Book ve rec.en: The GMP, placards, the Garbage Record Book and reception facilities

Garbage Management Plan toplama, separat.en: The Garbage Management Plan describes collection, separation, processing, storage, discharge and delivery for reception, the persons in charge and the equipment on board. Placards show the crew and passengers the applicable prohibitions in a language they understand. The plan must match the ship's actual compactor, grinder, incinerator and storage arrangements.

Garbage Record Book; denize deşarj, rece.en: The Garbage Record Book records events such as discharges into the sea, deliveries to reception facilities, incineration, accidental loss or discharge and loss of fishing gear, with the category, quantity, time and position. The method of estimating volumes must be consistent, and the figures should balance reasonably with the receipts, the storage inventory and the incinerator log.

Port reception facility yetersizse bu du.en: An inadequate port reception facility does not give permission to discharge into the sea at will. The inadequacy is reported through the Master or the company using the appropriate IMO or port reporting mechanism; the ship's storage capacity and the plan for the next suitable port are updated. The waste contractor's licence and chain of custody are verified against local rules.

Baş zabit/çevre zabiti weekly garbage ba.en: The Chief Officer or environmental officer should track garbage generated, stored, incinerated and delivered, by category, with a weekly garbage balance.

Teslim fişindeki toplam miktarı kategori.en: Copying the total on the delivery receipt into the GRB without splitting it by category

Reception facility reddini kaydetmeden a.en: Storing waste unsafely on deck without recording that the reception facility refused it

Tahliye sonrası hold wash water planlanı.en: After discharge, hold washing is planned; the shipper cannot document that the cargo residue is not harmful to the marine environment.

HME status bilinmeden Annex V deşarj ist.en: An Annex V discharge exception cannot be assumed while the HME status is unknown. The cleaning agent and the special area status must also be established.

Denize deşarj yapılmaz; shipper declarat.en: No discharge is made into the sea; the shipper's declaration and the product criteria are verified.
