If compliance cannot be proved, the residue and wash water are kept on board or delivered to a reception facility and recorded in the GRB under the correct category.

Karışık çöp daha sıkı bileşenin rejimine.en: Mixed garbage comes under the regime of its strictest component.

Plastik yasağı öğütme veya biodegradable.en: The plastics ban is not lifted by grinding or by a claim that a product is biodegradable.

GRB miktarı fiziksel depolama ve receipt.en: The quantities in the GRB reconcile with physical storage and receipts.

Annex VI: hava kirliliği, yakıt uygunluğ.en: Annex VI: air pollution, fuel compliance and energy efficiency

Annex VI, baca emisyonlarından ozon taba.en: Annex VI brings together technical and operational controls ranging from exhaust emissions to ozone-depleting substances, and from the fuel quality chain to the ship's carbon intensity.

SOx/PM, fuel oil quality, BDN ve numune.en: SOx/PM, fuel oil quality, BDNs and the sample chain

SOx ve particulate matter kontrolü yakıt.en: SOx and particulate matter are controlled through the sulphur content of the fuel or an approved equivalent arrangement. The global limit and the ECA limit are different; the ship must complete its changeover before the ECA boundary, allowing for its position, the tank in use and the volume of the system. If an exhaust gas cleaning system is used, the procedures for approval, monitoring, washwater and residues and malfunctions apply.

Bunker Delivery Note teslim edilen yakıt.en: The Bunker Delivery Note carries the mandatory information on the fuel delivered and the supplier's declaration; the representative MARPOL delivered sample is protected by its seal, label, signatures and chain of custody. The onboard sample and the in-use sample serve different verification purposes. The sample seal number must match the BDN and the ship's records.

Off-spec şüphesi yalnız laboratuvar yüzd.en: Suspected off-spec fuel is not just a matter of a laboratory percentage. Tank segregation, notifying the supplier, reports to the flag and port States, the conditions for a Fuel Oil Non-Availability Report and safe fuel management are all considered. A FONAR does not give an automatic exemption; it documents the reasonable efforts the ship made to obtain compliant fuel.

Bunker checklist, BDN/sample seal/tank t.en: The bunker checklist should link the BDN, the sample seals, the tank allocation and the ECA changeover calculation in one traceable file.

BDN uygun olduğu için kullanılan tankı d.en: Not checking the tank in use because the BDN is compliant

FONAR'ı düşük sülfür sınırından genel mu.en: Thinking a FONAR is a general exemption from the low sulphur limit

ECA sınırında change-over gecikmesi.en: Changeover delayed at the ECA boundary

Beklenenden güçlü akıntı gemiyi ECA sını.en: A stronger current than expected brings the ship to the ECA boundary early; there is still high-sulphur fuel in the system.

Valfi sınırda çevirmek, service system i.en: Turning the valve at the boundary does not mean the contents of the service system are compliant in time. The planning calculation should have been updated with the actual speed and flow.

Emniyetli navigasyon korunarak change-ov.en: While keeping navigation safe, the changeover is completed in the shortest safe time and the Master, the company and the relevant authorities are informed; the time, position, tank, quantity and reason are recorded openly and the planning procedure is corrected.

NOx, ODS, VOC ve shipboard incineration.en: NOx, ODS, VOC and shipboard incineration

Marine diesel engine NOx uygunluğu; engi.en: NOx compliance of a marine diesel engine depends on when it was built or underwent a major conversion, its rated power and speed, the applicable Tier, the EIAPP Certificate and the approved Technical File. If the parameter check method is used, the records of components, settings and seals are kept; an unauthorised change to the turbocharger, injectors or timing can invalidate compliance.

Ozone-depleting substances içeren sistem.en: For systems containing ozone-depleting substances, the ban on deliberate emissions, the equipment list and ODS Record Book, recharging and servicing and the chain of disposal ashore are managed. Bans on new installations and their exceptions are checked against the dates for each substance and item of equipment. A refrigerant leak is not just a maintenance matter; it is a MARPOL record and an emission event.

VOC tanker gereklilikleri port designati.en: The VOC requirements for tankers are managed through port designation and the approved VOC Management Plan; shipboard incineration through an approved incinerator, the prohibited substances, the operating temperature and records. Improper burning of waste such as PVC or certain chemicals or contaminated packaging can cause toxic emissions and problems with ash disposal.

Başmühendis, critical engine components.en: When accepting spare parts, the Chief Engineer should compare critical engine components with the list of allowable components and settings in the Technical File.

EIAPP varsa her motor modifikasyonunu uy.en: Assuming every engine modification is acceptable because there is an EIAPP Certificate

Refrigerant eklemeyi leak repair olmadan.en: Treating refrigerant top-ups as normal consumption without repairing the leak

EEDI/EEXI, CII, SEEMP ve IMO DCS veri bü.en: EEDI/EEXI, CII, SEEMP and the integrity of IMO DCS data

EEDI yeni gemi tasarım verimliliğini, EE.en: The EEDI measures the design efficiency of new ships, the EEXI the technical efficiency of existing ships and the CII their annual operational carbon intensity; they are different tools. The attained and required values and the ships covered are verified separately. EEXI compliance may involve an approved technical arrangement such as engine power limitation; the override may be used only under the defined safety conditions and must be recorded.

SEEMP Part I operasyonel iyileştirme pla.en: SEEMP Part I contains the plan for operational improvement, Part II the method of collecting fuel oil consumption data, and Part III the CII implementation plan and the approach to any corrective action required. The CII rating from A to E shows annual performance; a poor rating is managed by addressing its root causes in routeing, waiting time, hull and propeller condition, weather routing, trim and commercial planning, rather than by a one-off cut in speed.

IMO DCS/CII verisi noon report, bunker d.en: IMO DCS and CII data are built from noon reports, bunker deliveries, tank soundings, flowmeters, distance and time, and cargo capacity. Manual corrections, sensor gaps, off-hire periods and voyage boundaries must be handled by a documented methodology. A verified report does not mean that an unexplained change in the raw data is automatically correct.

Gemi ve kıyı ekibi aylık fuel-distance-h.en: The ship and shore teams should reconcile fuel, distance and hours every month, and not cover a difference found at the end of the year with a retrospective estimate.

EEXI ile CII'yi aynı performans gösterge.en: Thinking the EEXI and the CII are the same performance indicator

CII için emniyetli sefer planı veya maki.en: Putting on pressure, for the sake of the CII, that would breach the safe passage plan or machinery limits

Yakıt uygunluğu belgeden tanka ve bacaya.en: Fuel compliance is traced from the document to the tank and the funnel.

NOx uygunluğu engine konfigürasyonunun T.en: NOx compliance means the engine configuration stays true to the Technical File.

Enerji verisi ham kaynaktan doğrulanmış.en: Energy data must be auditable from the raw source to the verified report.

Kirlilik olayı, istisnalar, bildirim ve.en: Pollution incidents, exceptions, reporting and managing evidence across annexes

MARPOL'un amacı kural dışı deşarjı kayıt.en: The aim of MARPOL is not to erase an illegal discharge from the records, but to prevent it, to limit the harm when it happens, to report it early and to learn from it at the level of the system.

İstisnalar dar yorumlanır: gemi/can emni.en: Exceptions are interpreted narrowly: safety of the ship and of life, and damage

Annexlerde can veya gemi emniyeti için z.en: The annexes may contain certain exceptions for a discharge necessary to secure the safety of the ship or save life, and for pollution following damage to the ship or its equipment. They do not cover ordinary capacity planning errors or poor maintenance. For the damage exception, conditions such as all reasonable precautions having been taken to prevent or minimise the discharge, and no intent or recklessness on the part of the owner or Master, are important.

Acil durumda önce hayat ve gemi emniyeti.en: In an emergency the safety of life and the ship comes first, but the environmental impact remains part of the decision. A contemporaneous log shows why there was no other option, how much was released, when and where, what mitigation was applied and who was informed.

Bir sistemin tank kapasitesi düzenli ola.en: If a system's tank capacity is regularly not enough, that is not an unexpected emergency but a failure of voyage and capacity management. The company must correct the root cause through the reception facility plan, the waste generation rate and equipment reliability.

Acil deşarj karar formu, karar yetkisi v.en: The emergency discharge decision form should speed up decision-making and reporting; it must not be used to produce a legal justification after the event.

Her arızayı otomatik force majeure sayma.en: Treating every failure automatically as force majeure

Olay küçük diye kıyı bildirimini tamamen.en: Skipping the report to shore altogether because the incident is small

Protocol I raporu ve ilk saatlerde kanıt.en: The Protocol I report and preserving evidence in the first hours

MARPOL Protocol I, harmful substances iç.en: MARPOL Protocol I requires incidents involving harmful substances to be reported without delay to the nearest coastal State through the proper channels. The first report may clearly mark uncertain data as an 'estimate'; what matters is the early warning and follow-up reports as facts are confirmed.

Olay yeri emniyetli hale getirildikten s.en: Once the scene has been made safe, the logbooks, record books, alarm and event logs, valve positions, tank soundings, samples, CCTV and VDR recordings and communication records are preserved. Each crew member gives a separate factual statement; agreeing a shared story or changing past records destroys credibility.

Şirket emergency response, P&I/charter v.en: The company's emergency response and communications with P&I, charterers and lawyers support the operational response; they must not make the Master delay the mandatory report to shore while waiting for commercial approval. The flag State, coastal and port States and other relevant authorities may be informed in parallel, depending on the type of incident.

SOPEP/SMPEP contact appendix her sefer b.en: The SOPEP/SMPEP contact appendix should be checked before entering each trading area; if the real numbers are not to be called in a drill, their accuracy should be confirmed by another safe method.

İlk raporu yüzde yüz kesin veri gelene k.en: Holding back the first report until the data are 100% certain

Olay sonrası record book sayfasını temiz.en: Replacing a record book page with a clean copy after an incident

2026 kayıp konteyner bildirimi ve MARPOL.en: Reporting lost containers from 2026 and the link with MARPOL

1 Ocak 2026 SOLAS değişiklikleri denize.en: The SOLAS amendments in force from 1 January 2026 strengthened the reporting of containers lost overboard. The main legal basis is safety of navigation under SOLAS; but a lost container may have MARPOL consequences such as marine pollutants or dangerous goods, plastics and packaging, or leaks of fuel or chemicals. So a SOLAS report does not replace the assessment of the environmental incident.

Manifest ve stow plan'dan UN number, mar.en: The UN numbers, marine pollutant status, number of packages and approximate positions are taken quickly from the manifest and stowage plan. The first count of containers may be an estimate; it is updated with the survey or tally and the VDR and radar data. The cargo securing failure, heavy weather routing and the condition of the lashings go into the ISM corrective action process.

Kayıp önlenmesi; doğru VGM, stow/lashing.en: Preventing losses requires correct VGMs, stowage and lashing calculations, the Cargo Securing Manual, weather avoidance, deck inspections and accelerometer and inclinometer trends to be managed together. The incident report should explain not just how many boxes went overboard but why the barriers failed.

Şirket acil durum planı, lost container.en: The company emergency plan should send the lost container data into both the SOLAS navigational warning and the MARPOL pollution report streams under a single incident reference.

SOLAS raporu gönderildiği için MARPOL de.en: Closing the MARPOL assessment because a SOLAS report has been sent

Konteyner içeriği belirsizken çevresel t.en: Assuming there is no environmental hazard while the container contents are uncertain

Tehlikeli yük konteyneri kaybı.en: Loss of a container of dangerous goods

Ağır havada üç konteyner kaybolur; birin.en: Three containers are lost in heavy weather; the manifest shows that one of them is a marine pollutant, and the exact final position is unknown.

Olay hem floating navigation hazard hem.en: The incident is both a floating hazard to navigation and a probable pollution incident. Rather than delaying the report because the position is uncertain, it should be reported with the range of uncertainty.

Gemi/insan emniyeti sağlanır, çevredeki.en: The safety of the ship and people is secured, nearby ships and the relevant coastal and flag State channels are warned; the dangerous goods details are added in a follow-up, all evidence of times, positions and cargo is preserved, and the root cause in the lashing and the route is investigated.

İstisna, önlenebilir planlama kusurunun.en: An exception is no excuse for a planning failure that could have been prevented.

İlk rapor hızlı, sonraki raporlar gidere.en: The first report should be quick, and later reports progressively more accurate.

Bir olay SOLAS ve birden fazla MARPOL ek.en: A single incident can bring SOLAS and several MARPOL annexes into play at the same time.

Gemide bütünleşik MARPOL yönetimi ve den.en: Integrated MARPOL management on board, and inspection cases

Güçlü MARPOL uyumu, her record book'u ay.en: Strong MARPOL compliance controls the flow of substances on board from source to final route, rather than filing each record book separately.

Kaynak–tank–işlem–nihai yol–kayıt zincir.en: The chain from source to tank, treatment, final route and record

Her atık/emisyon akışı beş düğümle incel.en: Every waste or emission stream can be examined at five points: where was it produced, which tank or container held it, which equipment processed it, where did it go and which record proves it? For oily bilge water the chain is bilge well – holding tank – OWS – overboard or reception – ORB; for garbage it is source station – storage – compactor or incinerator – shore or discharge – GRB.

Mass-balance, yasa dışı bir yolu kanıtla.en: A mass balance makes an inconsistency visible before it proves any illegal route. Opening and closing tank quantities, generation, transfers and disposal are balanced in the same units with reliable measurements. Density, tank tables, unpumpable quantities and measuring errors can be explained; a difference that cannot be explained is investigated.

Cross-annex kontrol, aynı olayın farklı.en: A cross-annex check compares the different records of the same event. The bunker quantity must be consistent in the BDN, the ORB, the fuel report and the Annex VI DCS data; incinerated garbage in the GRB, the incinerator log, the fuel used and the ash storage. Treating one system as the 'environmental officer's' file and another as the 'engine room's' can hide a shared error.

Aylık environmental meeting her seferind.en: Each monthly environmental meeting should do a mass balance and a physical walk-through for a different stream.

Bütün miktarları yuvarlayarak matematiks.en: Rounding every quantity to give the appearance of an arithmetic balance

Departmanlar arası aynı verinin farklı b.en: Not noticing that departments use different units for the same data

PSC vaka yöntemi: kayıt doğru, sistem ya.en: PSC case method: when the record is right but the system is wrong

PSC önce sertifika/plan ve genel kondisy.en: PSC first examines the certificates and plans and the general condition, then the records and physical trail of a selected operation. For example, if the ORB shows regular OWS discharges, the inspector will expect the OWS totaliser and alarm history, the sample line, the valve line-up and a tank balance. If the GRB shows a delivery ashore, the inspector will look for agreement with the receipt and the storage capacity.

Personel cevabı kayıtla aynı kelimeleri.en: The crew's answer should not repeat the words of the record but demonstrate the ship-specific operation. 'According to company procedure' is not enough if the location of the procedure, the decision criteria, the valves and equipment and the record entry cannot be shown. Rather than hiding an open defect or temporary measure, the Master and officers should explain it, with its authorisation and risk controls.

Bulgu sonrası immediate correction, exte.en: After a finding, the immediate correction, the check of the extent, the root cause, the corrective action and the review of effectiveness are kept separate. A wrong ORB entry is not simply corrected; the same watch, record book and fleet are checked for similar errors, and the interface between training and procedures is examined.

Denetim hazırlığı son hafta belge temizl.en: Preparing for an inspection should not mean tidying up documents in the last week; it should be the natural result of independent checks of the flows every month.

Personeli denetçi sorularına tek tip cüm.en: Making the crew learn standard answers to inspectors' questions by heart

Düzeltici faaliyet olarak yalnız tekrar.en: Writing 'retraining' as the only corrective action

OWS kaydı var, overboard valfi sıkışmış.en: An OWS entry exists, but the overboard valve is seized

ORB iki gün önce yasal OWS deşarjı göste.en: The ORB shows a legal OWS discharge two days ago; the inspection finds that the overboard valve has long been seized in the closed position.

Kayıt ile fiziksel olasılık çelişir. Arı.en: The record contradicts what is physically possible. It cannot be accepted as reliable until the date of the defect, any alternative line, the valve indicator and the tank balance have been examined.

Deşarj iddiası bağımsız kanıtlarla araşt.en: The claimed discharge is investigated with independent evidence and the possible false entry is taken into the company and flag State legal process; the valve is repaired safely and the root cause in the defect reporting and record verification system is eliminated.

Her akışın fiziksel ve kayıtlı yolu aynı.en: The physical and recorded route of every stream must be the same.

Mass-balance şüpheyi görünür kılan doğru.en: A mass balance is a verification tool that makes suspicion visible.

Düzeltici faaliyet yalnız satırı değil s.en: Corrective action fixes the system, not just the entry.

sertifika ve supplement, onaylı plan/man.en: the certificate and supplement, the approved plan or manual, the operations log, test and maintenance records, and the crew's practical explanation

code hükmünü gemiye özgü risk değerlendi.en: to put the provisions of the code into practice through a ship-specific risk assessment, limits, checklists, maintenance standards and emergency steps

uygunluk belgesi, onaylı operasyon manua.en: the document of compliance, the approved operations manual, the risk assessment, permits and checklists, equipment trends and drill records

genel checklist tamamlanmış görünürken c.en: a general checklist that looks complete while a limit or hazard specific to the code is not managed on site

madde/atık akışını kaynaktan tanka, arıt.en: to trace each substance or waste stream from its source to the tank, the treatment equipment, final disposal and the record book entry

sertifika, plan, record book, tank/ölçüm.en: the certificate, plans, record books, tank and measurement data, alarm and equipment records, samples and reception facility documents

kayıtlı miktar ve yöntemin tank bakiyesi.en: recorded quantities and methods that do not physically reconcile with the tank balance, equipment trends or delivery receipts

sörvey kapsamını doğru planlamak, gerçek.en: to plan the scope of the survey correctly, show the real condition, manage each finding according to its risk and prove that it has been permanently closed

survey/inspection report, status, condit.en: the survey or inspection report, the survey status, the list of conditions and recommendations, defect records, corrective action and the check of its effectiveness

bulgunun kâğıt üzerinde kapanmış görünme.en: the same physical or systemic deficiency continuing although the finding appears closed on paper

sertifikanın kapsam, ek, endorsement ve.en: to keep the scope, supplements, endorsements and conditions of the certificate always matching the actual equipment and operations on board

sertifika aslı, supplement/record of equ.en: the original certificate, the supplement or record of equipment, the survey status, approval letters and the records on site that support the certificate

ana sertifika tarihi geçerliyken eki, on.en: a supplement, approval, survey window or actual condition of the ship that differs while the main certificate is still in date

güncel yerel kuralı passage/pre-arrival.en: to turn the current local rule into the passage and pre-arrival plan, the ship's operations, communications with the agent and timely notifications

güncel circular/port information, pre-ar.en: the current circular or port information, the pre-arrival form, the voyage log, permits and approvals, correspondence with the agent and authorities and operational records

eski liman bilgisinin kullanılması veya.en: using out-of-date port information, or a notification sent to the agent that does not match the actual operation on board

uygulanabilir teknik ve operasyonel bari.en: putting the applicable technical and operational barriers in place

Uygulanabilir işlem gemiye özgü prosedür.en: The applicable operation is carried out according to the ship-specific procedure.

İşlem planlanır, uygulanır ve bağımsız o.en: The operation is planned, carried out and independently verified.

Genel bilgiye güvenip onaylı gemi belges.en: Relying on general knowledge and not checking the approved ship document or the current local requirement

Uygulanabilirlik; gemi tipi, tonaj, inşa.en: Applicability is determined from the official text according to the ship type, tonnage, date of construction or conversion, flag, trading area and the operation carried out.

Operasyon adımları onaylı gemi prosedürü.en: The steps of the operation are carried out under the approved ship procedure and the supervision of the responsible officer.

Liman devletlerinin yabancı bayraklı gem.en: Inspection by port States of foreign-flagged ships for compliance with international standards; it carries the risk of deficiencies and detention.

PSC kavramı SOLAS ve MARPOL sözleşmeleri.en: Although the concept of PSC is provided for in SOLAS and MARPOL, its systematic application began with the Paris MoU in 1982. UNCLOS Articles 218–220 define the port State's powers of enforcement. Today 9 regional MoUs (Paris, Tokyo, Indian Ocean, Mediterranean, Viña del Mar, Riyadh, Black Sea, Abuja, Caribbean) coordinate PSC worldwide. IMO Resolution A.1138(31) sets out the global PSC procedures.

Uluslararası sefer yapan tüm yabancı bay.en: All foreign-flagged ships on international voyages

Liman devletinin yargı alanındaki suları.en: Ships in waters under the port State's jurisdiction

Risk tabanlı hedefleme ile öncelikli den.en: Priority inspection by risk-based targeting: ship age and type, flag and class performance, past inspection results

Denetim türleri: Initial inspection (ser.en: Types of inspection: initial inspection (certificates and general condition), more detailed inspection (equipment and operational checks), expanded inspection (mandatory for HRS, passenger ships and tankers)

Denetim kapsamı: sertifika geçerliliği,.en: Scope of inspection: validity of certificates, condition and maintenance of equipment, crew competence and documents, operational procedures (ISM, ISPS, MARPOL), structural integrity

Eksiklik kodları: 17 ana kategori – sert.en: Deficiency codes: 17 main categories – certificates, structure, fire safety, life-saving appliances, safety of navigation, MARPOL, ISM, ISPS, MLC, BWM and others

Eksiklik aksiyonları: kod 10 (düzeltildi.en: Deficiency action codes: 10 (rectified), 15 (rectify at the next port), 16 (rectify within 14 days), 17 (rectify before departure), 30 (grounds for detention), 50 (flag State informed), 70 (classification society informed)

Alıkoyma (detention) kriterleri: ciddi e.en: Detention criteria: a serious deficiency, or deficiencies in several areas, that make the ship unsafe to proceed to sea

Denetimde bulunan her eksiklik, standart.en: Every deficiency found during an inspection is recorded with a standard code and given an action to rectify it. Some deficiencies are rectified on the spot (code 10), some are deferred to be rectified at the next port (code 15) or within a set time (code 16, for example 14 days), and some must be rectified before departure (code 17); notifications to the flag State or the classification society are recorded with separate codes (code 50/70). The most severe action is detention (code 30): the ship may not leave port until the serious deficiencies have been rectified and it is safe. Deficiencies are grouped into 17 main categories (certificates, structural safety, fire safety, life-saving appliances, safety of navigation, MARPOL, ISM, ISPS, MLC, BWM and others) with hundreds of sub-codes. This standardisation means that inspectors in every port in the world speak the same language and that results are shared consistently in the regional databases (THETIS, APCIS).

OCIMF'in SIRE programı 2 Eylül 2024'te k.en: On 2 September 2024 OCIMF's SIRE programme was thoroughly overhauled and became SIRE 2.0. The old fixed question list (VIQ7) was replaced by a tablet-based set of questions compiled for each ship according to its type and operation (the Compiled VIQ). The inspection covers dozens of areas, from certification and crew management to navigation, cargo and ballast operations and the engine room, and measures the human factor (the crew's knowledge and behaviour) far more than before. The HVPQ (vessel particulars questionnaire) and the company-level TMSA self-assessment complete the framework.

Vetting denetiminin çıktısı, üye şirketl.en: The output of a vetting inspection is a report shared with the member companies, so every potential charterer can see the negative observations from a single inspection. Observations that are not closed stop the ship winning new business, poor performance raises insurance premiums and terminals may refuse the ship. A drop in the company's TMSA assessment spreads the problem from one ship to the whole fleet. That is why ships carry out a thorough internal inspection before vetting (pre-vetting), keep their documentation faultless and, above all, prepare key personnel (the Master and the Chief Engineer) for questions in the SIRE 2.0 format. In modern tanker operation, vetting is a commercial gateway as decisive as regulatory compliance.

Eski SIRE formatı büyük ölçüde ekipman v.en: The old SIRE format focused largely on equipment and documentation: static checks such as whether a fire pump works or a certificate is valid. SIRE 2.0 keeps this but shifts the weight clearly to the human factor; responses are assessed under human, process and hardware, and through these questions the inspector tries to understand why the crew carry out a procedure in a particular way, how they assess a risk and how they make decisions under pressure. The change reflects a lesson the industry has drawn from accident statistics: most marine casualties are caused not by equipment failure but by the human factor (fatigue, breakdowns in communication, misunderstood procedures, hierarchical pressure). So even a technically faultless ship can receive negative observations under SIRE 2.0 if the crew's decision-making culture is weak. This shows that vetting has moved on from asking 'is the equipment there?' to asking 'will this team make the right decision in a crisis?', in line with the human-centred approach of modern safety management that the ISM Code also stresses.

Initially focused on safety, the platform began assessing environmental performance as well when it added the GHG Rating in 2012. Today it is the standard tool for commercial acceptance of bulk carriers, general cargo ships and container ships. In February 2021 the Safety Score replaced the old risk rating.

RightShip'in gerçek gücü, puanın kendisi.en: RightShip's real power lies not in the score itself but in how deeply it is built into the chartering processes of major cargo owners. Large grain and ore traders, mining companies and oil companies set a minimum Safety Score in their corporate policies and build that threshold into their chartering systems as a hard filter. The result is mechanical: a ship below the threshold cannot even be offered to that company's broker, because the system screens it out automatically. This is a different kind of exclusion from a PSC detention; the ship may not have broken any rule, but its commercial access has been closed by a software threshold. This makes RightShip less a regulator than an invisible front door to the chartering pool, and forces owners to manage risk knowing that a PSC detention or a casualty record will mark the score for a long time.

SMC (Safety Management Certificate), ISM.en: With the implementation of the ISM Code, the SMC (Safety Management Certificate) became mandatory from 1 July 1998 for passenger ships and for tankers, bulk carriers and high-speed craft of 500 GT and over, and from 1 July 2002 for other cargo ships of 500 GT and over. The ISM Code is the safety management system standard developed after the Herald of Free Enterprise (1987) and Scandinavian Star (1990) disasters. An SMC is issued to each ship individually, while the DOC (Document of Compliance) covers the company.

MLC 2006 (Maritime Labour Convention), 2.en: MLC 2006 (Maritime Labour Convention) was adopted by the ILO in 2006 and entered into force on 20 August 2013. It is a comprehensive 'super convention' that brings together 68 earlier ILO conventions and recommendations. Together with SOLAS, MARPOL and STCW it is regarded as one of the four pillars of international maritime regulation. The MLC Certificate and the DMLC are mandatory on all ships of 500 GT and over on international voyages.

It is mandatory for oil tankers of 150 GT and over and for other ships of 400 GT and over. The certificate confirms that the ship's oil pollution prevention equipment complies with MARPOL Annex I. The Supplement (Form A for ships other than oil tankers, Form B for oil tankers) is an integral part of the certificate.

MLC Certificate (Maritime Labour Certifi.en: The MLC Certificate (Maritime Labour Certificate) certifies that a ship meets the standards for working and living conditions under MLC 2006. While SOLAS certificates cover the ship and STCW certificates cover the competence of the crew, the MLC Certificate directly protects the seafarer's decent working conditions. It is mandatory for ships of 500 GT and over on international voyages and is issued by the flag State or an authorised classification society once compliance in the 16 MLC inspection areas has been verified. It is valid for 5 years, with an intermediate inspection midway through.

Sertifikanın kapsadığı 16 alan (2014 değ.en: The 16 areas the certificate covers (including the two financial security areas added by the 2014 amendments) take in almost every part of a seafarer's life on board: minimum age, medical certification, qualifications, the employment agreement (SEA), recruitment services, hours of work and rest, manning, accommodation, recreational facilities, food, health and safety, medical care, complaint procedures, payment of wages, and financial security for repatriation and for shipowners' liability. How each area is met is documented in the DMLC, an integral part of the certificate: Part I sets out the flag State's national requirements and Part II shows how the company complies with them. Hours of rest (at least 10 in any 24 hours and at least 77 in any 7 days) follow the same rules as STCW and are carefully recorded.

It is mandatory for cargo ships of 500 GT and over (for passenger ships this is covered by the Passenger Ship Safety Certificate).

International Tonnage Certificate, ITC 6.en: The International Tonnage Certificate is issued under ITC 69 (International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships, 1969). DMLC (Declaration of Maritime Labour Com.en: The DMLC (Declaration of Maritime Labour Compliance) is the distinctive, practical heart of the MLC 2006 certification system. The MLC Certificate 'confirms' compliance but does not say how it is achieved; the DMLC fills that gap and is kept on board as an integral part of the certificate. It has two parts: Part I is drawn up by the flag State and sets out what national law requires in the 16 MLC areas (with any substantially equivalent national provisions); Part II is drawn up by the company and sets out how it actually meets those requirements in each area. The declaration thus answers both 'what does the rule say?' and 'how do we apply it?' in one document.

DMLC, PSC denetiminde en çok incelenen b.en: The DMLC is one of the documents most closely examined at a PSC inspection, because it is a ready-made checklist for the inspector: every procedure written in Part II is compared with what is actually done on board. The most critical risk is a mismatch between the declaration and reality; for example, if Part II says records of hours of work are kept but the records are incomplete, that is a serious non-compliance and a possible ground for detention. So Part II must be updated when the company's personnel policy or procedures change, changes to the national requirements in Part I must be followed, and concrete evidence of compliance (records, agreements, certificates) must be kept ready on board for each of the 16 areas. If the MLC Certificate becomes invalid, so does the DMLC.

DMLC, MLC'nin 16 denetim alanını hem ulu.en: The DMLC documents the 16 MLC inspection areas at the level of both the national requirements and the company's practice. These areas cover almost every part of a seafarer's life on board: minimum age, medical certification, qualifications of seafarers, the employment agreement (SEA), recruitment services, hours of work and rest, manning levels, accommodation, recreational facilities, food and catering, health and safety, medical care, on-board complaint procedures, payment of wages, and financial security for repatriation and for shipowners' liability. Part I explains what the flag State requires in each area (and any substantially equivalent national provisions); Part II sets out the company's plan showing how it actually meets those requirements. The DMLC thus answers 'what does the rule say?' and 'how do we apply it?' in one document and serves as a ready-made checklist for the inspector.

DMLC denetiminin en kritik yönü, Part II.en: The most critical part of a DMLC inspection is comparing every procedure written in Part II with what is actually done on board. The most serious risk is a mismatch between the declaration and reality: for example, if Part II says records of hours of work are kept but the records are incomplete, or a complaint procedure is defined but the crew do not know about it, that is a major non-compliance and a possible ground for detention. So Part II must be updated and notified to the flag State or RO when the company's personnel policy or procedures change; changes to the national requirements in Part I must be followed; and concrete evidence of compliance (records, agreements, certificates) must be kept ready on board for each of the 16 areas. The DMLC only has meaning together with the MLC Certificate; if the certificate becomes invalid, so does the DMLC, and the ship cannot make international voyages.

ISGOTT (International Safety Guide for O.en: ISGOTT (International Safety Guide for Oil Tankers and Terminals) is published jointly by OCIMF (Oil Companies International Marine Forum), ICS (International Chamber of Shipping) and IAPH (International Association of Ports and Harbors). It originated in the 1970s when the Tanker Safety Guide and terminal safety guides were combined. It is not a mandatory IMO convention but an industry guide accepted in practice as the global standard; it turns regulations such as SOLAS, MARPOL and the FSS Code into practical operations. The latest edition is the 6th, published in 2020 (ISGOTT 6); it stands out for its approach to the human factor, ship/shore communication and the updated Ship/Shore Safety Checklist (SSSCL).

ISGOTT, zorunlu bir sözleşme değil, ama.en: ISGOTT is not a mandatory convention, but it is the 'gold standard' that the oil tanker and terminal world is expected to follow in practice. Regulations such as SOLAS, MARPOL and the FSS Code say what must be done; ISGOTT explains step by step how to do it safely on site. The hazards on tankers are exceptionally high: the cargo is flammable, toxic and harmful to the environment, much of the operation is a shared responsibility of the ship and the shore (or another ship), and a single mistake can turn into a disaster. ISGOTT standardises this shared responsibility; because OCIMF, ICS and IAPH publish it together, the ship and the terminal speak the same language. That is why vetting inspections look for ISGOTT practices as the de facto reference.

1982'de kurulan Paris MoU, liman devleti.en: Established in 1982, the Paris MoU is the world's first and most comprehensive memorandum of understanding coordinating port State control at regional level. It succeeded the Hague Memorandum (1978). With 28 participating maritime Administrations (the European Union coastal States plus Canada, Iceland, Montenegro, Norway and the UK; the membership of the Russian Federation has been suspended since 20 May 2022), it covers some of the world's busiest sea areas. The New Inspection Regime (NIR), introduced in 2011, set up a risk-based targeting system. About 18,000 inspections are carried out each year.

Paris MoU, liman devleti kontrolünün böl.en: The Paris MoU is the memorandum of understanding that invented regional coordination of port State control and became a model for the world. One State's inspections cover only its own ports, but ships move around a region. The basic idea of the Paris MoU is that the member States share their inspection results in a common database (THETIS) and divide the inspection workload between them. So when a ship is inspected in one member's port, every member can see the result, unnecessary repeat inspections are avoided and substandard ships can be followed across the region. With 28 participating Administrations, it covers one of the world's busiest areas of sea traffic.

It is the largest PSC region in the world by annual number of inspections, carrying out tens of thousands every year. It shares the same basic philosophy as the Paris MoU: sharing inspection results through a common database (APCIS), dividing the inspection workload between members and tracking substandard ships across the region. The two MoUs work closely together and often run joint CIC campaigns.

Black Sea MoU, Karadeniz'e kıyısı olan a.en: The Black Sea MoU coordinates port State control in the six countries with a Black Sea coast (Bulgaria, Georgia, Romania, Russia, Türkiye, Ukraine). The region has an interesting structural feature: Bulgaria and Romania, as EU members, are also members of the Paris MoU, while Türkiye belongs to both the Black Sea and the Mediterranean MoUs. These overlapping memberships keep Black Sea inspections closely in line with Paris MoU standards. Inspection data are shared through the regional BSIS system and are visible to all members.

Karadeniz'e giriş ve çıkış, dünyanın en.en: Entry to and exit from the Black Sea is through the Turkish Straits (the Istanbul and Çanakkale Straits), one of the most difficult passages in the world; it is a corridor of heavy traffic, sharp turns and strong currents. The transit requires compliance with the reporting requirements and traffic arrangements of the Turkish Straits Vessel Traffic Service (VTS); it is a place where COLREG and safe navigation practice are put to the test. From a PSC point of view, before entering Black Sea ports ships should review the current CIC subjects with the crew, share the evidence of closed findings with the flag State and the classification society, and take account of their own records in the BSIS system, where inspection data are shared. The geopolitical situation in the region can at times affect navigation and access to ports, adding a further variable to route planning.

Küçük bir bloğun veri paylaşım değeri: B.en: The value of data sharing in a small bloc: BSIS

Black Sea MoU, yalnızca altı üye devletl.en: With only six member States, the Black Sea MoU is a small bloc compared with the Paris or Tokyo MoU; but its small size does not reduce the value of data sharing – on the contrary, it makes it more manageable and focused. Inspection results, deficiencies and detention records shared through BSIS prevent a great deal of duplication even in a region with a limited number of ports: when a ship is inspected in Constanța and a deficiency is found, that information is also visible to the next inspector in Odesa or Novorossiysk, who can then concentrate on following up what was found before rather than inspecting the ship again unnecessarily. The small membership also speeds up coordination: choosing CIC subjects and joint decisions pass through fewer bureaucratic layers than in MoUs with many members. The dual membership of Bulgaria and Romania in the Paris MoU keeps BSIS indirectly in line with THETIS, so that even a small regional system contributes to the data integrity of the wider European PSC network.

Indian Ocean MoU, Hint Okyanusu ve çevre.en: The Indian Ocean MoU coordinates port State control by nearly 20 member States in and around the Indian Ocean; its members are spread over a vast area, from Australia to India and from South Africa to Iran and the coasts of East Africa. The region carries the busiest trade routes between Suez and the Strait of Malacca and a critical share of the world's oil and container traffic. The MoU shares inspection data through the regional IOMIS system and identifies priority ships by risk-based targeting.

It works closely with the Paris MoU, and its Mediterranean EU members (Malta, Cyprus) are also members of the Paris MoU.

Mediterranean MoU, Akdeniz'e kıyısı olan.en: The Mediterranean MoU coordinates port State control in the countries with a Mediterranean coast; its members include North African countries (Algeria, Egypt, Morocco, Tunisia), Eastern Mediterranean countries (Israel, Jordan, Lebanon, Türkiye), Malta and Cyprus. Because Malta and Cyprus, as EU members, also belong to the Paris MoU, the MoU works closely in line with Paris standards and shares data through THETIS-Med. This dual membership helps keep a consistent standard in Mediterranean inspections.

Akdeniz limanlarına girecek gemiler, gem.en: Ships entering Mediterranean ports face targeting based on ship age, type and flag performance; deficiency classification and detention conditions are in line with the IMO PSC procedures. A critical development specific to the region is the designation of the Mediterranean as a SOx Emission Control Area (ECA): since 1 May 2025 the fuel sulphur limit in the Mediterranean has been 0.10%, so ships must already have achieved fuel and scrubber compliance. Because North African ports may have additional local requirements, ships should check these before entry and review with the crew the CIC subjects coordinated with the Paris MoU.

Akdeniz'i ilgilendiren en önemli düzenle.en: The most important regulatory development affecting the Mediterranean is the designation of the region as a SOx Emission Control Area (ECA): under this rule, which has applied since 1 May 2025, the fuel sulphur limit in the Mediterranean has fallen from the global 0.50% to 0.10%. This requires ships either to use very low sulphur fuel or to operate an approved scrubber, and it directly affects route planning: on entering the Mediterranean the fuel changeover procedure is followed and recorded in the logbook prescribed by the flag State. Mediterranean MoU inspections are expected to focus more and more in the coming years on this new sulphur regime and on compliance with air emission rules in general. Ships entering the region should plan their fuel supply strategy and scrubber compliance for this regime.

Kuzey Afrika–Doğu Akdeniz çeşitliliği ve.en: North African–Eastern Mediterranean diversity and THETIS-Med

Mediterranean MoU, idari kapasite ve düz.en: The Mediterranean MoU has a diverse membership in terms of administrative capacity and regulatory approach: North African countries (Algeria, Egypt, Morocco, Tunisia) and Eastern Mediterranean countries (Israel, Jordan, Lebanon, Türkiye) sit alongside Malta and Cyprus, which are EU members. Because Malta and Cyprus are also members of the Paris MoU, the MoU works in line with Paris standards and data systems; inspection data are shared through the regional THETIS-Med platform and integrated with IMO's GISIS. Because of this diversity, ships entering the region should check in advance not only the common MoU standards but also any additional local requirements, especially in North African ports. CIC campaigns coordinated with the Paris MoU allow ships to comply with both regimes with a single preparation.

THETIS-Med ve GISIS entegrasyonunun birl.en: How THETIS-Med and GISIS integration work together

Akdeniz'de hem Mediterranean MoU hem de.en: For a ship trading in the waters of both the Mediterranean MoU and the Paris MoU, the integration of THETIS-Med and GISIS brings a concrete practical benefit. THETIS-Med collects the inspection results, deficiencies and detention records from the ports of Mediterranean MoU members at regional level; GISIS, as IMO's global data platform, carries this information into a wider international framework and forms an indirect bridge with the systems of other MoUs (including the Paris MoU's THETIS). Thanks to this integration, if for example a ship is first inspected in a Paris MoU port and a deficiency is recorded, that information becomes accessible in principle through GISIS, and when the ship later calls at a Mediterranean MoU port (for example in Morocco or Egypt) the inspector is not unaware of that history. Although in practice the data transfer is not always immediate, the two systems working together mean that a single ship's history can be followed largely consistently despite the fragmented administrative structure of the Mediterranean (EU members alongside non-EU coastal States).

Viña del Mar Agreement (Acuerdo Latinoam.en: The Viña del Mar Agreement (Acuerdo Latinoamericano) is Latin America's first regional port State control agreement and, with 16 member States, coordinates inspections in South America, Central America and the Caribbean. It was set up on the model of the Paris MoU and shares inspection data through the regional CIALA information system. The region has a dynamic of its own: Panama, which has one of the largest ship registers in the world, lies in this area, so the roles of port State and flag State interact intensely in the region.

Viña del Mar Agreement bölgesinin kendin.en: A dynamic peculiar to the Viña del Mar region is that Panama, which has one of the largest ship registers in the world, lies within it. This means the roles of flag State and port State are closely intertwined in the region: a large share of the ships passing through are Panama-flagged, so they are subject both to their own flag State's obligations and to the PSC inspections of the ports they call at. For Panama-flagged ships, making sure that their own flag State's inspection and certification processes match port State expectations is particularly important. In this context, regional PSC is not just about inspecting foreign flags; it is directly linked to the quality of one of the world's most widely used flag registers.

Latin Amerika'nın ilk PSC anlaşması olan.en: Latin America's first PSC agreement, Viña del Mar was set up on the model of the Paris MoU and, with 16 member States, coordinates inspections in South America, Central America and the Caribbean. Inspection data are shared through CIALA (the information centre of the Acuerdo Latinoamericano), and detention records can be seen by all members. The region's priority is to strengthen inspection capacity and standardisation among the member States; to this end it draws on IMO technical assistance programmes and develops training for inspectors and common procedures. Risk-based targeting, deficiency classification and detention criteria are in line with the IMO PSC procedures, and CIC campaigns are run in coordination with the other MoUs. Ships entering the region should check local regulations, follow CIALA inspection trends and prepare for the CIC subjects.

Viña del Mar bölgesini diğer MoU'lardan.en: The most striking feature that sets the Viña del Mar region apart from the other MoUs is that Panama, which has one of the largest ship registers in the world, is both a flag State and a port State lying geographically inside this MoU's area of operation. With most large open registers (such as Panama, the Marshall Islands and Liberia), the flag State function is geographically separate from the region where the ship actually trades; but in Panama's case that separation disappears. A Panama-flagged ship that transits the Panama Canal and calls at ports in the region is under two different inspection lenses at the same time: its own flag's responsibility for certification and inspection, and PSC inspection by a Viña del Mar port State — while in Panama's own ports, ships flying its flag come under flag State inspection rather than PSC. This dual position gives Panama an extra incentive to protect the quality of its register, because the detention of one of its ships in the region's ports directly affects the register's international reputation. For the other member States in the region, the heavy traffic of Panama-flagged ships brings both familiarity and the need to follow them carefully.

Viña del Mar Agreement'in 16 üye devleti.en: The 16 member States of the Viña del Mar Agreement cover a wide range of inspection capacity and resources: from large and relatively advanced maritime administrations such as Brazil and Mexico to small Caribbean and Central American States with more limited financial and human resources. These differences can lead to inequalities in the training of inspectors, in access to inspection equipment and even in how consistently risk profiles are calculated. CIALA tries to close this gap in two ways: first, by giving all members access to the same inspection data and deficiency codes through the regional information system, creating a minimum common language; second, through IMO technical cooperation programmes, more experienced member administrations provide instructors for inspectors and common checklists. This effort is neither linear nor quick – the differences in capacity have not been fully closed – but over time it aims to bring the quality of inspection in the region onto a more consistent line, so that which member's port a ship calls at should not greatly change how thorough an inspection it faces.

Carnot çevrimi, iki sabit sıcaklık (TH v.en: The Carnot cycle is the ideal reversible cycle that gives the theoretical upper limit of efficiency for all heat engines working between two fixed temperatures (TH and TC). It consists of four processes: (1) isothermal expansion (heat QH taken in at TH), (2) adiabatic expansion (TH→TC), (3) isothermal compression (heat QC rejected at TC), (4) adiabatic compression (TC→TH). In practice no real engine reaches the Carnot efficiency, but it is a reference point for assessing the thermal efficiency of real engines.

Bir gemi dizel motorunun silindir gaz sı.en: The cylinder gas temperature of a marine diesel engine is 1450°C and the exhaust outlet temperature 380°C. What is the theoretical Carnot efficiency?

Buhar türbinli sistemde TH = 540°C (kaza.en: In a steam turbine plant TH = 540°C (boiler) and TC = 35°C (condenser). What is the Carnot efficiency?

Sıcaklıkları Celsius olarak formüle koym.en: Putting temperatures into the formula in Celsius (a large error, especially at low TC).

TH'yi yakıt yanma sıcaklığı sanmak; gerç.en: Taking TH to be the fuel combustion temperature; the real peak cylinder temperature is much lower.

Carnot verimini gerçek hedef olarak görm.en: Treating the Carnot efficiency as a real target; it is an ideal limit and cannot be reached.

TC'yi düşürmek (örn. soğuk deniz suyuyla.en: Lowering TC (e.g. a better condenser with cold seawater) increases ηC more than raising TH.

Carnot verimi yalnızca ısı makinelerinin.en: The Carnot efficiency is only the UPPER limit for heat engines; it does not include mechanical losses, friction or incomplete combustion.

2. yasa: η < 1 her zaman; TC = 0 K olmad.en: 2nd law: η < 1 always; unless TC = 0 K, not all heat can be converted into work.

Diesel çevrimi, sabit basınçta ısı eklen.en: The Diesel cycle is the ideal air-standard cycle in which heat is added at constant pressure. It consists of four processes: (1) isentropic compression, (2) heat addition at constant pressure (fuel injection), (3) isentropic expansion (power stroke), (4) heat rejection at constant volume (exhaust). Modern large marine diesel engines operate close to this ideal cycle; the efficiency is determined by the compression ratio (r) and the cut-off ratio (rc).

İdeal Diesel çevrimi: r = 18, rc = 2.2,.en: Ideal Diesel cycle: r = 18, rc = 2.2, k = 1.4. What is the thermal efficiency?

İki zamanlı düşük devirli deniz dizeli:.en: Two-stroke slow-speed marine diesel: r = 14, rc = 2.0. What is the efficiency?

Sıkıştırma oranı r ile basınç oranını ka.en: Confusing the compression ratio r with the pressure ratio (pressure ratio ≈ r^k).

Cut-off'u küçük rc = 1 sanmak (rc = 1 ol.en: Taking a small cut-off as rc = 1 (with rc = 1 the cycle reduces to the Otto cycle).

k = 1.4 yerine yanma sonrası gaz değerin.en: Using the post-combustion gas value (1.30–1.33) instead of k = 1.4 and so spoiling the ideal version of the formula.

Rc arttıkça (uzun yanma) verim DÜŞER; kı.en: As rc increases (longer combustion) the efficiency FALLS; short, rapid combustion is more efficient.

Sıkıştırma oranı artarsa verim artar ama.en: A higher compression ratio raises the efficiency but multiplies thermal and mechanical stress — modern engines keep a balance at r = 18–22.

Gerçek motorda turbocharging, common-rai.en: In a real engine, turbocharging, common-rail injection and waste heat recovery raise η to 50%+.

Otto çevrimi, sabit hacimde ısı eklenen.en: The Otto cycle is the ideal air-standard cycle in which heat is added at constant volume; it models spark-ignition (SI) petrol engines. Processes: isentropic compression → heat addition at constant volume (spark) → isentropic expansion → heat rejection at constant volume. Its thermal efficiency depends only on the compression ratio, but for petrol, knock limits the compression ratio to ~10–12.

r = 9, k = 1.4 olan ideal Otto çevrimini.en: What is the efficiency of an ideal Otto cycle with r = 9 and k = 1.4?

Diesel formülünü Otto yerine kullanmak (.en: Using the Diesel formula instead of the Otto formula (there is no cut-off in the Otto cycle).

k değerini sıcak yanma ürünleri için düş.en: Lowering k for hot combustion products (for the ideal air standard, 1.4 is fixed).

Sıkıştırma oranını yakıt antiknock indek.en: Raising the compression ratio without matching it to the fuel's anti-knock index.

Aynı r için ηOtto > ηDiesel; ancak Diese.en: For the same r, ηOtto > ηDiesel; but because the Diesel cycle can use a higher r, it is more efficient in practice.

Gerçek SI motorda volumetrik verim, ateş.en: In a real SI engine, volumetric efficiency, ignition timing and mixture ratio reduce η to half the ideal value.

Deniz uygulamasında benzinli motorlar ya.en: At sea, petrol engines are restricted because of the fire risk; main power is provided by diesel engines.

Rankine çevrimi, buhar türbin sistemleri.en: The Rankine cycle is the basic thermodynamic cycle of steam turbine plants (LNG carriers, older steamships, waste heat recovery systems — WHRS). Processes: (1) isentropic pumping (liquid), (2) heat addition at constant pressure (steam generation in the boiler), (3) isentropic expansion (work produced in the turbine), (4) heat rejection at constant pressure (condensation in the condenser). The efficiency increases as the turbine inlet temperature and pressure rise and as the condenser pressure falls; adding reheat and regeneration (feed-water heating) raises it to 38–42%.

Düşük kondenser basıncının etkisi: konde.en: Effect of a low condenser pressure: with the condenser at 0.10 bar, h₄ ≈ 2200 and h₂ ≈ 192.

Pompa işini büyük sanıp türbinden çıkarm.en: Assuming the pump work is large and subtracting it from the turbine work — pump work is typically 1–2%.

Türbin çıkışında izentropik varsaymadan.en: Taking h₄ directly from the table without assuming isentropic expansion at the turbine outlet (in reality an ηturbine correction is needed).

Kondenser sıcaklığını basınç yerine doğr.en: Using the condenser temperature directly instead of the pressure; the saturation table works with pressure–temperature pairs.

Düşük kondenser basıncı = düşük TC → η a.en: Low condenser pressure = low TC → η increases (Carnot logic); the cooling water temperature is critical.

Reheat çevrimi türbin son kademe nemlik.en: A reheat cycle both solves the moisture (x) problem in the last turbine stage and increases efficiency.

WHRS (egzoz gazı kazanı + buhar türbini).en: A WHRS (exhaust gas boiler + steam turbine) added on top of the marine diesel plant raises the overall efficiency by 3–8%.

Brayton (Joule) çevrimi, gaz türbinli mo.en: The Brayton (Joule) cycle is the ideal air-standard cycle of gas turbine engines. Processes: (1) isentropic compression (in the compressor), (2) heat addition at constant pressure (in the combustion chamber), (3) isentropic expansion (in the turbine), (4) heat rejection at constant pressure (exhaust). It is preferred for high-speed ferries, LNG carriers and naval vessels. The efficiency depends on the pressure ratio (rp) and k.

Türbin giriş sıcaklığı (TIT) sınırını ih.en: Ignoring the turbine inlet temperature (TIT) limit and choosing an excessively high rp.

Aynı rp için Brayton ile Otto formülleri.en: For the same rp the Brayton and Otto formulae are similar; the difference is the compression process (continuous flow in the Brayton cycle, a piston in the Otto cycle).

Combined cycle: Brayton egzozu + Rankine.en: Combined cycle: Brayton exhaust + a Rankine WHRS gives a combined efficiency of 55%+.

SOLAS düzenli talimleri zorunlu kılar: h.en: SOLAS requires regular drills: every crew member takes part in at least one fire drill and one abandon ship drill each month (III/19.3.2); on passenger ships these drills are held weekly (III/30.2). If more than 25% of the crew have not taken part in drills on board in the previous month, the drills are held within 24 hours of leaving port. Crew members joining the ship are given training in the life-saving and fire-fighting appliances within two weeks at the latest (III/19.4.1). On passenger voyages longer than 24 hours, the passenger muster is held before or immediately upon departure (III/19.2.2). Each lifeboat is launched and manoeuvred in the water at least once every three months (III/19.3.4.3); the rescue boat is launched monthly where practicable and in any case at least once every three months (III/19.3.4.6). Düzenleme, uluslararası asgari standardı.en: The regulation applies a common international minimum standard through flag State implementation, ship certification and port State control.

Gemide uygulama, kuralı gemi tipi, tonaj.en: Implementation on board means turning the rule into approved plans, equipment, procedures and competent personnel according to the ship type, tonnage, date of build and trading area.

Kod, yüksek riskli gemi, yük veya operas.en: The code turns the objective of the parent convention into detailed technical and operational barriers for high-risk ships, cargoes or operations.

Gemide uygulama, kod hükmünü gemiye özgü.en: Implementation on board means putting the provisions of the code into practice through a ship-specific risk assessment, limits, checklists, maintenance standards and emergency steps.

Objektif kanıt: uygunluk belgesi, onaylı.en: Objective evidence: the document of compliance, the approved operations manual, the risk assessment, permits and checklists, equipment trends and drill records.

Temel kırmızı bayrak: genel checklist ta.en: Key red flag: a general checklist that looks complete while a limit or hazard specific to the code is not managed in practice.

Düzenleme, kirletici veya istilacı etkin.en: The regulation controls the source of the polluting or invasive effect, how it is handled on board, the discharge or emission conditions and the chain of records.

Gemide uygulama, madde/atık akışını kayn.en: Implementation on board means tracking each substance or waste stream from its source to the tank, the treatment equipment, final disposal and the record book entry.

Objektif kanıt: sertifika, plan, record.en: Objective evidence: the certificate, the plan, the record book, tank and measurement data, alarm and equipment records, samples and the reception facility receipt.

Temel kırmızı bayrak: kayıtlı miktar ve.en: Key red flag: recorded quantities and methods that cannot be physically reconciled with tank balances, equipment trends or delivery receipts.

Düzenleme, gemi, şirket, bayrak, klas ve.en: The regulation defines the system of independent verification and closing of findings between the ship, the company, the flag State, the classification society and the port State.

Gemide uygulama, sörvey kapsamını doğru.en: Implementation on board means planning the scope of the survey correctly, showing the real condition, managing each finding according to its risk and proving its permanent close-out.

Objektif kanıt: survey/inspection report.en: Objective evidence: the survey or inspection report, the survey status, the list of conditions of class and recommendations, defect records, corrective action and the effectiveness check.

Temel kırmızı bayrak: bulgunun kâğıt üze.en: Key red flag: a finding that looks closed on paper while the same physical or systemic deficiency continues.

Gemide uygulama, sertifikanın kapsam, ek.en: Implementation on board means keeping the scope, supplements, endorsements and conditions of the certificate consistent at all times with the actual equipment and operation on board.

Bu hüküm, düzenlemenin genel amacı içind.en: This provision is read within the overall purpose of the regulation. The article heading alone is not the conclusion; the definitions, scope, exceptions and the mandatory texts it refers to must be checked together.

Bu açıklamanın gemideki karşılığı, genel.en: On board, this means matching the general text with the ship's approved arrangement and her actual operating limits.

Gemideki karşılık bu odakla değerlendiri.en: Its meaning on board is assessed with this focus. Rather than just quoting the rule, the person responsible must be able to show who acts, with which equipment or procedure, at what moment and within which limits.

Gemideki karşılık, uygulanabilir teknik.en: On board, this means putting the applicable technical and operational barriers in place. Rather than just quoting the rule, the person responsible must be able to show who acts, with which equipment or procedure, at what moment and within which limits.

Bu konu yalnız teorik bilgi olarak kalma.en: This subject must not remain theoretical knowledge. A walk-through of the relevant equipment, space or records on board reveals where the written procedure and the actual workflow diverge.

Düzenleme, ilgili uluslararası ve ulusal.en: The regulation links technical requirements to ship operation within the chain of international and national implementation. When reading its history, the consolidated text in force today and the transitional provisions matter as much as the date of first adoption.

Sapma görülünce önce güvenli durum kurul.en: When a deviation is seen, a safe condition is established first, followed by reporting and technical investigation. The authority for a temporary measure, its duration, its risk controls and the date of permanent close-out must be clear.
